tgt: Sepheo sa SACMEQ ke ho thakgola diketsahalo tse kopantsweng tsa diphuputso le thupelo tse tla eketsa menyetla bakeng sa ba rerang le bafuputsi ho fumana thupelo ya bokgoni bo hlokehang ba setekgeniki ba ho disa, ho hlahloba, le ho bapisa maemo a akaretsang a dikolo le boleng ba thuto ya motheo.

src: Cabinet recognised the Minister of Higher Education and Training, Blade Nzimande for leading a BRICS Education Ministers’ meeting which made ground breaking decisions.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholeditse Letona la Thuto le Thupelo e Phahameng, Blade Nzimande, ka ho etellapele kopano ya Matona a Thuto a BRICS moo ho nkilweng diqeto tse ntle haholo.

src: The meeting was organised on the margins of the 37th Session of UNESCO's General Conference.
tgt: Kopano e ne e hlophisitswe mabapi le diqeto tsa Seboka Kakaretso sa bo37 sa UNESCDintlha tse neng di tshohlwa di ne di akga: ho matlafatsa tshebedisano dipakeng tsa diyunivesithi tsa BRICS, dilekane le thakelano ya tsebo.

src: Issues discussed included: strengthening collaboration between BRICS universities, partnerships and knowledge exchanges.
tgt: Matona a ile a dumellana ka tlhokeho ya ho thea mokgwa o boemong bo hodimo ba sepolotiki le setekgeniki ka sepheo sa ho hlophisa le ho kenya tshebetsong dibaka tse hlwailweng tsa tshebedisanommoho tse tla hlophiswa ke Aforika Borwa jwaloka Modulasetulo wa BRICHo ile ha boela ha eba le tumellano dipakeng tsa dinaha tsohle tse hlano tseo e leng ditho ka bohlokwa ba ho tiisa tshebedisanommoho dipakeng tsa BRICS le UNESCO thutong.

src: The Ministers agreed on the need to establish a mechanism at the highest political and technical level in order to coordinate and implement the identified areas of cooperation which will be coordinated by South Africa as the current Chair of BRICThere was also consensus among all five member countries on the importance of scaling up cooperation between BRICS and UNESCO in education.
tgt: Kabinete e hlokometse tlaleho ya naha ya Aforika Borwa ho UNESCO ya hore batho ba baholo ba dimilione tse ba Aforika Borwa ba phethetse dithuto tsa Letsholo la Kgoro la Koqo la ho Bala le ho Ngola la Kha Ri Gude.

src: Cabinet noted South Africa’s country report to Unesco that 3,3 million adult South Africans have graduated from the Kha Ri Gude Mass Literacy Campaign.
tgt: Sena se bea Aforika Borwa mathuleng a ho fihlella sepheo sa yona sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng: boikitlaetso ba Thuto ya Bohle ba ho fokotsa sekgahla sa naha sa ho se tsebe ho bala le ho ngola ka 2015.

src: This takes South Africa closer to achieving its United Nations: Education for All commitment of halving the country’s illiteracy rate by 2015.
tgt: Letsholo le thakgotswe ka Hlakola ya 2008, ka maikemisetso a ho thusa batho ba baholo ba dimilione tse 4,7 ba kahodimo ho dilemo tse 15 ho tseba ho bala le ho ngola ka e nngwe ya dipuo tsa semmuso tse Kabinete e thoholetsa bahlodi ba Dikgau tsa Makgabane a Naha a Batho Pele tse thusang ho tiisa boporofeshenale, ho hlokomela, ho putsa, ho ananela le ho kgothaletsa makgabane Tshebeletsong ya Setjhaba esita le ho netefatsa hore e fihlella boemo bo phahameng.

src: The campaign was launched in February 2008, with the intention to help 4,7 million adults above the age of 15 years to become literate and numerate in one of the 11 official languages.
tgt: Kabinete e rorisitse papadi e kgabane ya Bafana Bafana, Dikila le Ditshephe ya ba ya thoholetsa Itumeleng Khune, ya ileng a kgethwa e le Kgalala ya Dipapadi ya 2013 ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet praised the recent sterling performances by Bafana Bafana, the Proteas and the Springboks and also congratulated Itumeleng Khune, who was named the 2013 South African Sport Star.
tgt: Tiisong ya hore re setjhaba se hlolang, Kabinete e hlokometse hore ka Laboraro hoseng Aforika Borwa yohle e tsohile e le morolo kamora hore Bafana Bafana e hlole Spain ka 1-0.

src: Emphasising that we are a winning nation, Cabinet noted that South Africa woke up in high spirits on Wednesday morning after Bafana Bafana’s 1-0 victory over Spain.
tgt: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho ba le seabo tshehetsong ya dihlopha tsa naha.

src: Cabinet was briefed by the Justice Crime Prevention and Security (JCPS) Cluster on the Public Protector`s report on security measures at President Jacob Zuma’s home in Nkandla.
tgt: Kabinete e ile ya kumelwa ke Setlamo sa Toka ya Tshireletso le Thibelo ya Ditlolo tsa Molao (JCPS) ka tlaleho ya Mosireletsi wa Setjhaba mehatong ya tshireletso lehaeng la Mopresidente Jacob Zuma le Nkandla.

src: Cabinet was briefed that government’s engagement with the Public Protector on this matter has been premised on the security of the Head of State.
tgt: Kabinete e ile ya kumelwa hore dipuisano tsa mmuso le Mosireletsi wa Setjhaba ntlheng ena di ne di tsepamisitswe tshireletsong ya Hlooho ya Naha.

src: Cabinet was also briefed that a government task team report on security upgrades at Nkandla had been referred to the Joint Standing Committee on Intelligence which subsequently published its own Special Report on this matter.
tgt: Kabinete e ile ya boela ya kumelwa hore tlaleho ya sehlopha sa tshebetso sa mmuso ntlafatsong ya tshireletso Nkandla e fetiseditswe Komiting ya Kopanelo ho tsa Boutlwela eo le yona e phatlaladitseng Tlaleho ya yona e Ikgethileng ka taba ena.

src: The government task team reported to the Joint Standing Committee on Intelligence that there was no evidence that the Department of Public Works had paid for the construction of houses for the President.
tgt: Sehlopha sa tshebetso sa mmuso se tlalehetse Komiti ya Kopanelo ho tsa Boutlwela hore ha ho bopaki ba hore Lefapha la Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba le lefelletse kaho ya matlo a Mopresidente.

src: Ministers from the JCPS Cluster have been invited to this Cabinet briefing and are available to answer questions on this matter.
tgt: Matona a Setlamong sa JCPS a memilwe makumaneng ana a Kabinete mme a tla ba teng ho tla araba dipotso tabeng ena.

src: Key Cabinet discussions and decisions.
tgt: Dipuisano le diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.

src: Cabinet approved the draft White Paper on Post School Education and Training: “Building an Expanded, Effective and Integrated Post-School Education and Training System”.The draft White Paper sets out strategies to expand on the current provision of education and training in South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse Pampiri e Tshweu ya nakwana ya kamora ho Qeta Sekolong ya Thuto le Thupelo e reng: “Ho Aha Mokgwa wa Thuto le Thupelo wa Kamora ho Qeta Sekolong o Atolotsweng, o Sebetsang Hantle o bile o Momahantswe”.Pampiri e tshweu ya nakwana e rala mawa a ho atolla phanong ya jwale ya thuto le thupelo Aforika Borwa.

src: It sets out to improve quality, integrate the various strands of the post-school system, and to set out modalities for ways in which employers in both private and public sectors can play an important role in the creation of a skilled labour force.
tgt: E habile ho ntlafatsa boleng, ho momahanya mekgwa e fapaneng ya kamora ho qeta sekolong, esita le ho rala mawa bakeng sa mekgwa eo bahiri makaleng a poraefete le setjhaba ba ka kenyang letsoho ka teng ho theweng ha bokgoni le boqhetseke ba basebetsi.

src: The Paper emphasises inclusive growth and employment which is essential for the National Development Plan.
tgt: Pampiri e thasisetsa kgolo le mesebetsi e kenyeletsang bohle e hlokehang bakeng sa Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP).Lefapha la Thuto le Thupelo e Phahameng le tla fana ka makumane a tomanyana.

src: The Department of Higher Education and Training will brief further.
tgt: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka tlaleho ya Komiti ya Matona e mabapi le Tjhebobotjha ya Ditjhelete tse Fuwang Diyunivesithi ya ba ya ananela hore tlaleho eo e phatlalatswa bakeng sa hore diyunivesithi di tshwaele ka yona.

src: Cabinet was apprised on the Ministerial Committee report on the Review of the Funding of Universities and approved that the report be released for public comment by universities.
tgt: Taba ya ditjhelete tse fuwang diyunivesithi ha e a fapana le diphephetso tse ding tseo naha e tobaneng le tsona ka kakaretso, mme e akga tharollo ya ditshita tsa diyunivesithi tse ka mosing ha ka lehlakoreng le leng ho ntse ho netefatswa hore diphetoho tse etswang kabong ya disebediswa ha di sitise bokgoni ba diyunivesithi tse boemong bo botle hore di dule di hlompheha di bile di le boemong ba ho qothisana lehlokwa lefatsheng.

src: Cabinet approved the Bio-economy Strategy for South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse Lewa la Bayo-ikonomi Aforika Borwa.

src: The Bio-economy Strategy is a science-based strategy to position bio-innovation as an essential arm of various line departments.
tgt: Lewa la Bayo-ikonomi ke lewa leo motheo wa lona e leng wa saense ho bea tshibollo ya tlhaho e le seikokotlelo sa mafapha a fapafapaneng.

src: It also calls for a close relationship with industry to ensure that biotechnology and bio-innovations are more market relevant and that they find easier application in South Africa.
tgt: E boetse e habile dikamano tse hlokolotsi le indasteri ho netefatsa hore bayo-theknoloji le tshibollo ya tlhaho di tsamaisana le mebaraka le hore di sebediseha habobebe Aforika Borwa.

src: South Africa’s Bio-economy Strategy provides an economic engine for the new economy that will in turn provide a basis for future growth.
tgt: Lewa la Bayo-ikonomi la Aforika Borwa le fana ka kgubu ya moruo bakeng sa moruo o motjha o tla fana ka motheo wa kgolo ya kamoso.

src: Cabinet approved the Expanded Public Works Programme (EPWP) High Level Proposal for Phase 3 (2014-2019) for implementation.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse Tshisinyo ya Mokgahlelo wa 3 wa Lenaneo le Atolotsweng la Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba (EPWP) bakeng sa ho kenngwa tshebetsong.

src: The overall target of million work opportunities over the five-year period (2014/2015 – 2018/2019) is based on the Public Employment Programmes target articulated in the National Development Plan.
tgt: Pehelo ka kakaretso ke menyetla ya mesebetsi e dimilione tse 7,5 nakong ya dilemo tse hlano (2014/15 – 2018/19) e itshetlehile pehelong ya Mananeo a Tlhahiso ya Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba ho NDP.

src: Cabinet approved the establishment of the Presidential Public Employment Coordinating Commission to coordinate and report on public employment programmes.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse ho thewa ha Khomishene ya Mopresidente ya Tlhophiso ya Tlhahiso ya Mesebetsi Setjhabeng ho hlophisa le ho tlaleha ka mananeo a tlhahiso ya mesebetsi ya setjhaba.

src: This will be aligned to the work of the Presidential Infrastructure Coordinating Commission.
tgt: Sena se tla amanngwa le mosebetsi wa Khomishene ya Mopresidente ya Tlhophiso ya Meralo ya Motheo.

src: The EPWP aims to increase its contribution to address the triple challenges of poverty, unemployment and inequality.
tgt: EPWP e habile ho eketsa seabo sa yona sa ho rarolla diphephetso tse tharo tsa bofuma, leqeme la mesebetsi le ho se lekane.

src: The current economic down-turn has negatively impacted on employment in the country and has increased the importance of the EPWP as a major government initiative for contributing to development and reducing unemployment.
tgt: Ho nyotobela ha jwale ha moruo ho thefutse tlhahiso ya mesebetsi kahara naha ha ba ha eketsa bohlokwa ba EPWP e le kgato e ka sehloohong ya mmuso ya ho kenya letsoho tswelopeleng le phokotsong ya leqeme la mesebetsi.

src: Cabinet approved the tabling of the Instrument for the Amendment of the Constitution of the International Labour Organisation, 1986, in Parliament for ratification.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Sesebediswa sa Sehlomathiso sa Molaotheo wa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa tsa Mesebetsi (ILO), wa 1986, Palamenteng bakeng sa hore o tjhaellwe menwana.

src: The principle aim of the proposed Amendment is to make membership of the Governing Body of the International Labour Organisation more representative by providing a means of appointment that takes into account the various geographic, economic and social interests of its constituent WEBTOKEN terms of furthering the African agenda and should the 1986 Constitutional Amendment come into force, South Africa stands to benefit in terms of the special characteristics as outlined in the instrument, to be elected to a permanent seat.
tgt: Sepheopheo sa sehlomathiso se sisintsweng ke ho etsa botho ba Karolo ya Bolaodi ba ILO hore bo be le boemedi bo tomanyana ka ho fana ka mokgwa wa thonyo o nkela hloohong taba ya dibaka tse fapafapaneng, moruo le ditabatabelo tsa setjhaba dihlopheng tsa mabatowa a tsona.

src: Cabinet noted the adoption of the Recommendations on the Social Protection Floor by the International Labour Organisation and approved the tabling of the Recommendation in Parliament for ratification.
tgt: Mabapi le ho ntshetsapele maikemisetso a Aforika le haeba Sehlomathiso sa Molaotheo wa 1986 se ka phethahala, Aforika Borwa e tla fola molemo ho ya ka makgetha a ikgethileng jwaloka ha ho hlalositswe sesebedisweng, hore e kgethwa setulong sa moshwelella.

src: The Social Protection Floor approach is an integrated set of social policies designed to guarantee income security and access to essential social services for all, paying particular attention to vulnerable groups and protecting and empowering people across the life cycle.
tgt: Kabinete e tsebile ka kananelo ya Ditshisinyo tsa Boemo ba Tshireletso ya Setjhaba bo etswang ke ILO mme ya tjhaella menwana ho tekwa ha Tshisinyo ya Tokiso e tswang Palamenteng.

src: Cabinet approved for South Africa to host the 4th BRICS International Competition Conference in 2015.The Conference provides a forum for the exchange of views among competition agencies and non-governmental advisors from BRICS countries.
tgt: Mokgwa wa Boemo ba Tshireletso ya Setjhaba ke lethathama la maano a momahantsweng a setjhaba a ralletsweng ho netefatsa tshireletso ya lekeno le phihlello ya ditshebeletso tsa setjhaba tse hlokehang bakeng sa bohle, ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo dihlopheng tse kotsing le ho tshireletsa le ho matlafatsa batho mafapheng ohle a bophelo.

src: It takes place every two years and is hosted by BRICS member states’ Competition Authorities.
tgt: E ba teng ka dilemo tse ding le tse ding tse pedi mme e tshwarwa ke Makgotla a Tlhodisano a dinaha tseo e leng ditho tsa BRICKabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Leano la Thonyo ya Basebetsi ba ho Jewa ha Thepa ke Molaodi wa Lekgotla le Phahameng la Dinyewe Palamenteng esita le ho phatlalatswa Koranteng ya Mmuso.

src: Cabinet approved the tabling of the Policy on the Appointment of Insolvency Practitioners by the Master of the High Court to Parliament and publication in the Government Gazette.
tgt: Tsepamiso ya maikutlo ya Leano ke ho kgothaletsa tshwano, bosiyo ba leeme, ponaletso le phihlello ya tekano bakeng sa batho ba neng ba kotetswe ke kgethollo e nang le leeme nakong e fetileng.

src: The focus of the Policy is to promote consistency, fairness, transparency and the achievement of equality for persons previously disadvantaged by unfair discrimination.
tgt: Bolaodi ba Makgotla a Phahameng a Dinyewe dikantorong tse fapaneng tsa Balaodi nakong e fetileng di ne di na le boikemelo ba ho nka diqeto ho ya kamoo di neng di utlwisisa molao ka teng mabapi le tshebetso le motjha o latelwang dikantorong tsa bona.

src: The Masters of the High Court in the different Masters’ offices previously had autonomy to decide in accordance with their interpretation of the law on the practice and procedure to be followed in their offices.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse kamohelo ya ho tloha ka la 3 Pudungwana ho ya ho la 3 Tshitwe e le Kgwedi ya Naha ya Tlhokomediso ya Ditokelo tsa Kgolofalo ya ba ya tsebisa semmuso hore mohla la 3 Tshitwe ke Letsatsi la Naha la Batho ba Holofetseng.

src: Cabinet approved the formalisation of 3 November to 3 December as the National Disability Rights Awareness Month and officially declared 3 December as the National Day of Persons with Disabilities.
tgt: Kgwedi ya Naha ya Tlhokomediso ya Ditokelo tsa Kgolofalo, e susumeditsweng ke Letsatsi la Naha la Batho ba Holofetseng, e fana ka nako ya hore naha e bontshe e be e keteke kgatelopele e entsweng ya ho fa batho ba holofetseng phihlello e lekanang thutong, mesebetsing e metle, bophelo bo botle, ntshetsopele ya mahae le tikoloho e sireletsehileng, ho tse ding.

src: Cabinet approved the South African Mint Company’s coin design for the 2013 numismatic commemorative and R2 circulation coin.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse moralo wa tjhelete o entsweng ke Khamphane ya Minte ya Aforika Borwa bakeng sa sehopotso sa 2013 sa pokello ya tjhelete e lewana le ho ntshuwa ha R2 ya tshepe.

src: a) R2 Circulation Coin: “100 Year Anniversary of the Union Buildings”b) R2 Commemorative Crown Silver Coin: “100 Year Anniversary of the Union Buildings”c) The 2013 Protea Coin Series: “the Life of a Legend: NR Mandela” (childhood).
tgt: a) Ho ntshuwa ha R2 ya tshepe: “Keteko ya Dilemo tse 100 ya Meaho ya Kopanong”b) R2 ya Tjhelete ya Tshepe ya Sehopotso sa Tlokola ya Silifera: “Keteko ya Dilemo tse 100 ya Meaho ya Kopanong”c) Lethathama la Tjhelete ya Tshepe la Sekila la 2013: “Bophelo ba Mohale: NR Mandela” (bongwaneng).

src: Cabinet also approved the designs for the 2014 numismatic commemorative and circulation coin designs:a) The Protea Coin Series: “the Life of a Legend: NR Mandela” (education)b) The Natura Coin Series: “Nocturnal Hunters”c) R1 Gold Coin Series: “South African Pollinators”d) R2 Gold Coin Series: “Discovery of Gold in South Africa”e) Crown and Tickey Silver Coin Series: “Trains of South Africa”f) The Sterling Silver Coin Series: “Marine Protected Areas of South Africa”g) R200 Gold Commemorative Coin: “20 Years of Democracy”h) R2 Sterling Silver Commemorative Crown Coin: “20 Years of Democracy”i) R5 Circulation Coin: “20 Years of Democracy”The coin designs together with their Proclamations will be printed in the Government Gazette.
tgt: Kabinete e boetse ya ananela meralo ya sehopotso sa 2014 sa pokello ya tjhelete e lewana le ho ntshuwa ha meralo ya R2 ya tshepe:a) Lethathama la Tjhelete ya Tshepe la Sekila la 2013: “Bophelo ba Mohale: NR Mandela” (thutong)b) Lethathama la Tjhelete ya Tshepe ya Natura: “Ditsomi tsa Bosiu”c) Lethathama la Tjhelete ya Tshepe ya R1 ya Kgauta: “Bafetisi ba Aforika Borwa”d) Lethathama la Tjhelete ya Tshepe ya R2 ya Kgauta: “Tshibollo ya Kgauta Aforika Borwa”e) Lethathama la Tjhelete ya Tshepe ya Dikorone le Diteke tsa Silifera: “Diterene tsa Aforika Borwa”f) Lethathama la Tjhelete ya Tshepe ya Seteling ya Silifera: “Dibaka tse Tshireleditsweng Mawatleng a Aforika Borwa”g) R200 ya Tjhelete ya Tshepe ya Sehopotso sa Kgauta: “Dilemo tse 20 tsa Demokrasi”h) R2 ya Tjhelete ya Tshepe ya Sehopotso sa Korone: “Dilemo tse 20 tsa Demokrasi”i) Ho Ntshuwa ha R5 ya Tshepe: “Dilemo tse 20 tsa Demokrasi”.Meralo ya ditjhelete tsa tshepe le Tsebahatso ya tsona di tla phatlalatswa Koranteng ya Mmuso.

src: Thereafter the coins will be manufactured and sold through the normal channels.
tgt: Kamorao ho moo ditjhelete tsa tshepe di tla botjwa di be di rekiswe ka ho latela metjha e tlwaelehileng.

src: Appointments.
tgt: Dithonyo.

src: Cabinet’s position on prominent issues in the current environment.
tgt: 05 Dec Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.

src: Cabinet congratulated the Department of Basic Education, principals, teachers and learners on the successful conclusion of the 2013 National Senior Certificate examinations.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholeditse Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo, dihlooho tsa dikolo, matitjhere le barutwana ka ho phethelwa ka katleho ha dihlahlobo tsa Naha tsa Setifikeiti se Phahameng tsa 2013.Kabinete e amohela ho ntshuwa ha Ditekolo tsa Naha tsa Selemo le Selemo tsa 2013 kajeno, la 4 Tshitwe 2013, e leng sesebediswa se babatsehang sa tshekatsheko e thusang Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo ho fofonela kgatelopele ya diphetho tsa ho ithuta esita le ho ntlafatsa boleng ba thuto.

src: Cabinet welcomes the release of the Annual National Assessments 2013 today, 4 December 2013, which is an excellent diagnostic tool that helps the Department of Basic Education to track progress of learning outcomes and improve the quality of education.
tgt: Kabinete e boela e thoholetsa Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le Khomishene ya Mopresidente ya Tlhophiso ya Meralo ya Motheo (PICC) ka boemo bo hatetseng pele phanong ya dibuka tsa ho bala, dibuka tsa ho ngolla, fenetjhara, le neelano ya sekolo se le seng ka beke haesale ho tloha ka la 22 Phupu 2013, e le karolo ya Morero wa Naha wa Meralo ya Motheo.

src: Cabinet further commends the Department of Basic Education and the Presidential Infrastructure Co-ordinating Commission (PICC) on the advanced stage of the delivery of textbooks, workbooks, furniture, and the handing over of one school a week since 22 July 2013, as part of the National Infrastructure Plan.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse ho thakgolwa ha Morafo wa Tlhahiso wa Stanley Nkosi wa khamphane ya manganese ya Kgalakgadi, Hotazel, Kapa Leboya, eo e leng setsi se seholo ka ho fetisisa sa tlhahiso ya manganese lefatsheng.

src: Cabinet welcomed the launch of the Stanley Nkosi Sinter Mine of Kalagadi Manganese company, Hotazel, Northern Cape, which is the world's largest manganese sinter plant.
tgt: Sena se bopa karolo ya pokello ya diprojeke tse hlophisitsweng ke PICC, e etelletsweng pele ke Mopresidente Zuma.

src: Through this project, the Northern Cape has seen a capital injection of about R.5 billion, within four years, with at least 3 000 direct jobs created, and skills being developed among local youth.
tgt: Ka projeke ena, ho bile le tjhelete e kaalo ka R.5 bilione e keneng Kapa Leboya, ka nako ya dilemo tse nne, moo ho theilweng mesebetsi e 3 000 ka kotloloho, mme le tsebo ya ho etsa mesebetsi e ntse e ntshetswa pele kahara batjha.

src: President Jacob Zuma will mark the Day of Reconciliation on 16 December at the Union Buildings under the theme: “Nation Building, Social Cohesion and Reconciliation”.The celebration coincides with the 100-year anniversary of the Union Buildings as the seat of government.
tgt: Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla thakgola Letsatsi la Poelano ka la 16 Tshitwe Meahong ya Kopanong tlasa mookotaba o reng: “Kaho ya Setjhaba, Momahano le Poelano ya Setjhaba”.Keteko e thulana le sehopotso sa dilemo tse 100 tsa Meaho ya Kopanong e le setsi sa mmuso.

src: A statue of former President Nelson Mandela, a stalwart in freedom and reconciliation for our country, will be unveiled at the Union Buildings as part of the commemoration.
tgt: Seemahale sa Mopresidente wa mehleng Ntate Nelson Mandela, senatla tokolohong le poelanong ya naha ya rona, se tla kgurumollwa Meahong ya Kopanong e le karolo ya sehopotso.

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to use the day to reflect on the phenomenal strides we have made as a nation to live and work together.
tgt: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ho sebedisa letsatsi lena ho hetla morao ho bona dikgato tseo re di tsamaileng re le setjhaba, ho phela le ho sebetsa mmoho.

src: Deputy President Kgalema Motlanthe will lead the Second Government Leadership Summit at the CSIR International Convention Centre, Pretoria from 10 to 12 December 2013.
tgt: Motlatsi wa Mopresidente Ntate Kgalema Motlanthe o tla etela pele Seboka sa Bobedi sa Boetapele ba Mmuso Setsing sa Diboka tsa Matjhaba sa Lekgotla la Diphuputso tsa Saense le Indasteri, Pretoria ho tloha ka la 10 ho isa ho la 12 Tshitwe 2013.

src: This summit will bring together senior managers from all three spheres of government, with the aim of enhancing a shared understanding about the role of the Public Service in meeting the basic needs of South Africans and leading the development of our economy.
tgt: Seboka se tla kgobokanya baokamedi ba baholo ba tswang makaleng ohle a mararo a mmuso, ka sepheo sa ho ntlafatsa kutlwisiso e abelanweng ka seabo sa Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba ho fihlelleng ditlhoko tsa mantlha tsa maAforika Borwa esita le ho etela pele ntshetsopele ya moruo wa rona.

src: President Jacob Zuma will host the King of the Federation of Malaysia, Tuanku Abdul Halim Mu'adzam Shah, for a State Visit at the Union Buildings on 10 December 2013.
tgt: Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla amohela Kgosi ya Setlamo sa Malaysia, Tuanku Abdul Halim Mu’adzam Shah, Meahong ya Kopanong bakeng sa Ketelo ya Naha ka la 10 Tshitwe 2013.

src: The State Visit will deepen our bilateral political and economic relations with Malaysia, as well as serve as an opportunity to further our African Agenda.
tgt: Ketelo ya Naha e tla tiisa maqhama a rona le Malaysia a sepolotiki le moruo esita le ho sebetsa e le monyetla wa ho ntshetsapele Ditabatabelo tsa rona tsa Aforika.

src: Cabinet deliberated on the presentation by the Minister of Public Works on the Inter-Ministerial Task Team report on the security upgrades at the President’s Nkandla houses.
tgt: Kabinete e tshohlile puo e entsweng ke Letona la Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba ka tlaleho ya Setlamo sa Matona a Kopantsweng mabapi le dintlafatso tsa tshireletso matlong a Mopresidente a Nkandla.

src: Cabinet endorsed the recommendations and directed that the report be released to the public.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse ditshisinyo yaba ya laela hore tlaleho e fetisetswe setjhabeng.

src: The Security Cluster Ministers and the Minister of Public Works will conduct a media briefing on Tuesday, 10 December 2013.
tgt: Matona a Setlamo sa Tshireletso le Letona la Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba ba tla bua le boraditaba ka Labobedi, mohla la 10 Tshitwe 2013.

src: Cabinet welcomes the outcomes of the 2nd BRICS Urbanisation Forum and the 3rd Friendship Cities and Local Government Cooperation Forum.
tgt: Kabinete e ananela sephetho sa Foramo ya bobedi sa BRICS sa Keketseho ya Setjhaba Ditoropong le Foramo ya boraro ya Ditoropokgolo tse nang le Setswalle esita le Tshebedisanommoho ya Mmuso wa Dibaka.

src: The Forum focused on the need of the various levels of government to strengthen dialogue and cooperation in the areas of infrastructure, community development, green economy, cultural exchanges, investment and technology transfer.
tgt: Foramo e tsepamisitse maikutlo tlhokehong ya mehato e fapaneng ya mmuso hore e matlafatse puisano le tshebedisanommoho dikarolong tsa meralo ya motheo, ntshetsopele ya dibaka tsa ditjhaba, moruo o sa senyeng tikoloho, phapanyetsano ya botjhaba, matsete le phetisetso ya thekenoloji.

src: Cabinet welcomes the 16 African nations and their supporters participating in the third Orange African Nations Championship (CHAN) between 11 January and 1 February 2014 in South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela dinaha tsa Aforika tse 16 le batshehetsi ba tsona tse tla ba le seabo Ditlhodisanong tsa boraro tsa Orange African Nations Championship (CHAN) dipakeng tsa la 11 Pherekgong le la 1 Hlakola 2014 Aforika Borwa.

src: Hosting the tournament will allow South Africa to build on the positive legacy of the 2010 FIFA World Cup and the 2013 Africa Cup of Nations, and further entrench social cohesion and national pride.
tgt: Ho tshwara dipapadi tsena ho tla fa Aforika Borwa monyetla wa ho aha hodima lefa le letle la Mohope wa Lefatshe wa FIFA wa 2010 le Mohope wa Dinaha tsa Aforika wa 2013, e boele e matlafatse momahano ya setjhaba le motlotlo wa setjhaba.

src: The tournament also presents an opportunity for South Africans to showcase our country as a vibrant tourism, trade and investment destination.9 Over this holiday season, government is leading a range of campaigns in partnership with all sectors of society to ensure responsible and safe behaviour.
tgt: Tlhodisano e boela e fana ka monyetla bakeng sa maAforika Borwa hore a bapatse naha ya rona e le sebaka se hlaphohetsweng sa bohahlaudi, kgwebisano le matsete.9 Nakong ya sehla sena sa phomolo, mmuso o etelletse pele matsholo a fapafapaneng ka tshebedisanommoho le makala ohle a setjhaba ho netefatsa polokeho le boikarabelo boitshwarong.

src: Foremost among these are Healthy Lifestyles, Arrive Alive, 16 Days of Activism and World AIDS Day Campaigns.
tgt: Tse ka sehloohong ho tsena ke Matsholo a Mekgwa ya ho phela Bophelo bo Botle, Fihla o Phela moo o yang, Matsatsi a 16 a Boitseko le Letsatsi la AIDS la Lefatshe.

src: All South Africans must play their part in giving meaning to these campaigns.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa ohle tlameha ho ba le seabo ho fana ka moelelo matsholong ana.

src: Government cannot do it alone.
tgt: Mmuso o ke ke wa e etsa o le mong.

src: Over this period the increased visibility of law enforcement officials at roadblocks and search operations countrywide will ensure that South Africans are safe.
tgt: Nakong ena keketseho e bonahalang ya bahlanka ba qobello ya molao dithibelleng tsa mebileng esita le ditshebetso tsa ho phenyekolla naha ka bophara di tla netefatsa hore maAforika Borwa a bolokehile.

src: Road-users are reminded not to drink and drive, or drink and walk.
tgt: Basebedisi ba mebila ba hopotswa hore ba se ke ba kganna ba tahilwe, kapa ba se ke ba tsamaya ba tahilwe.

src: Those found guilty of transgressing the rules will be dealt with to the full extent of the law.10 Cabinet calls on all South Africans to take extra precautions to ensure that our children are cared for and kept away from harm.
tgt: Bao ba fumanweng ba le molato wa ho tlola melao ba tla sebetswa ka phethahalo ho ya ka molao.10 Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho ba sedi ho netefatsa hore bana ba rona ba a hlokomelwa mme ba bolokwa hole le kotsi.

src: It is the duty and responsibility of parents, guardians and society to ensure the safety of our children, especially over this upcoming period.11 Being the last Cabinet meeting for 2013, members of the Executive wish all South Africans a restful, peaceful and safe festive season.
tgt: Ke boikarabelo ba batswadi, bahlokomedi le setjhaba ho netefatsa hore bana ba rona ba bolokehile, haholoholo nakong ena eo re lebileng ho yona.11 Jwaloka ha e le kopano ya ho qetela ya Kabinete ya 2013, ditho tsa Phethahatso di lakaletsa maAforika Borwa ohle phomolo e monate, kgotso le polokeho sehleng sena sa keteko.

src: Cabinet calls on all of us who can, to put Ubuntu/Botho in practice by assisting those individuals and families that are unable to support themselves, and to show compassion as a nation that cares for and respects each other.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho rona bohle ba ka kgonang, ho etsa Botho ka ho thusa batho le malapa a sa kgoneng ho iphedisa, le ho bontsha kutlwelobohloko re le setjhaba se hlokomelanang se bile se hlomphana.

src: Key Cabinet decisions.1 Cabinet approved the National Broadband Policy, Strategy and Plan referred to as South Africa Connect.
tgt: Diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.1 Kabinete e ananetse Leano, Lewa le Morero tsa Maqhubu a Dikgokahanyo a Naha a bitswang ka hore ke Hokahanya Aforika Borwa.

src: This will contribute significantly to economic growth, development and job-creation.
tgt: Sena se tla thusa haholo kgolong ya moruo, ntshetsopele le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi.

src: The overall goal is to achieve a universal average download speed of 100 mbps by 2030.
tgt: Sepheo se akaretsang ke ho fihlella monyollo e lekaneng ya lebelo la lefatshe lohle la di-mbps tse 100 ka 2030.

src: To reach this target in a progressive manner, there are reviewable targets starting with an average user experience speed of 5 mbps to be reached by 2016 and available to 50% of the population and to 90% by 2020.
tgt: Ho fihlella pehelo ena ka mokgwa o hatelang pele, ho na le dipehelo tse ka shejwang botjha tse qalang ka lebelo le lekaneng la mosebedisi wa di-mbps tse 5 tse tla fihlellwa ka 2016 tse seng di fumaneha ho 50% ya setjhaba mme e tla ba 90% ka 2020.

src: Targets are also set for schools and clinics and general public sector connectivity.
tgt: Dipehelo di boetse di lokiseditswe ho hokelwa dikolong, ditleliniking le lekaleng la setjhaba ka kakaretso.

src: The rapid evolution of broadband technology means that these targets will be reviewed annually.
tgt: Kgolo e potlakileng ya theknoloji ya maqhubu a dikgokahanyo e bolela hore dipehelo tsena di tla shejwa botjha selemo le selemo.2 Kabinete e ananetse ho kenngwa ha Pampiri e Tala ya Leano la Theknoloji ya Lesedi la Dikgokahanyole Kopantsweng (ICT) la Naha koranteng ya mmuso bakeng sa ho bontshana le setjhaba.

src: The Green Paper deals with the need to amend policies and regulations to take account of the rapid changes in ICT in recent years.
tgt: Pampiri e Tala e sebetsana le tlhokeho ya ho fetolwa ha maano le melawana ho nkela hloohong diphetoho tse potlakileng ho ICT dilemong tsa moraorao.

src: Among the issues it focuses on are telecommunications, broadcasting and postal services.
tgt: Ho tse ding tsa dintho tseo e tsepamisitseng maikutlo ho tsona ke ditshebeletso tsa dikgokahanyo tsa mehala, tsa kgaso le tsa poso.

src: Public hearings will be held in all the provinces early next year.
tgt: Dipitso tsa nonyo ya maikutlo a setjhaba di tla tshwarwa diporofenseng tsohle qalong ya selemo se tlang.3 Kabinete e ananetse diphetolo tsa Leano la ho Fetolwa ha mokgwa wa Kgaso le amanang haholo le taba ya hore na ebe Mabokoso a Kenngwang Hodimo (STB) (didikhouda) di tshwanela ho ba le mokgwa wa ho laolwa kapa tjhe.

src: Cabinet approved the amendments of the Broadcasting Digital Migration Policy relating mainly to whether the Set Top Box (decoders) should have a control system or not.
tgt: E meng ya mekgwa e sebedisitsweng ho nka qeto ho sena ke e latelang:tlhokeho ya ho fetola mokgwa wa kgaso ka potlako, haholoholo ho ntsha mefutafuta ya maqhubu a seyalemoyaho netefatsa hore ditjhelete tsa ditshehetso tsa mmuso di sebediswa hantleho qholotsa indasteri ya lapeng ya dielektroniki le tlhahiso ya mesebetsihore borakgwebo ba thuthuang ba fole molemoho fokotsa kgonahalo ya hore mebaraka ya Aforika Borwa e subuhlellwe ke di-STB tsa theko e tlase tse sa sebetseng hantleho tshireletsa ditabatabelo tsa SABCho ba hlokolotsi diphetohong tse potlakileng tsa lekala la kgaso le ICT ka kakaretsoho fokotsa sekgahla sa ho kotela ba bang mme ho kgothaletswe tlhodisano ka ho thea lepatlelo bakeng sa ditlabotjha mmarakeng wa dithelevishene tse lefellwang ntle le leeme la ho fola molemo dithusong tsa ditjhelete tsa mmusoho fokotsa sekgahla sa dikgato tsa molao tse nkwang ke bahasi le bahwebi ba tla henahenana le mosebetsi wa ho fetola mokgwa wa kgaso.

src: Among the criteria used to decide on this were the following: the need for speed on digital migration, especially to release radio frequency spectrumensure that the government subsidy is used productivelystimulate the local electronics industry and create jobsbenefit emerging entrepreneursreduce prospects of the South African market being flooded by cheap Set Top Boxes (STBs) that are not fully functionalprotect the interests of the SABCbe sensitive to rapid changes in the broadcasting and ICT sector as a wholereduce the extent of monopolization and encourage competition by creating space for new players in the pay television market without unfairly benefitting from the Government subsidyreduce the prospects of legal action from broadcasters and entrepreneurs that would hold-up the migration process.
tgt: Ho kopanya mokgwa ona le e meng, Kabinete e qetile ka hore tshebediso ya ho laola mokgwa wa kgaso ha e a tshwanela ho tlama.

src: The STBs will, however, have a control system to protect Government’s investment in the subsidized STB market and the local electronics industry and, with rapid technological changes, for future use by broadcasters who might not want to use it now.
tgt: Leha ho le jwalo, di-STB di tla ba le mokgwa wa taolo ho tshireletsa matsete a Mmuso mmarakeng le indastering ya dielektroniki tsa lapeng tsa STB tse tsheheditsweng ka ditjhelete tsa mmuso, mme ka diphetoho tse potlakileng ho tsa theknoloji, bakeng sa tshebediso ke bahasi ba ka nnang ba batla ho e sebedisa hona jwale.

src: To avoid subscription broadcasters unfairly benefiting from the STB control system, government’s investment in the STB Control System will be recovered from those subscription broadcasters that choose to make use of the STB Control system.
tgt: Ho qoba boingodiso bahasi ba folang molemo ka leeme mokgweng wa tsamaiso wa STB, ho tla hulwa ditjhelete ho bahasi bao ba ingodisitseng empa ba kgetha ho sebedisa mokgwa wa Taolo wa STB.

src: Cabinet urges all parties to move on from their previous differences and work together with the government in rolling out digital migration as soon as possible in the country’s interests.
tgt: Kabinete e kopa mekgatlo yohle hore e tlohele diphapang tsa yona tsa nako e fetileng mme e sebetse mmoho le mmuso ho thakgola mokgwa o motjha wa kgaso ka potlako molemong wa naha.4 Kabinete e ananetse mekgwa e reretsweng ho thusa malapa a tetebetseng dikolotong esita le ho matlafatsa botsitso ba tsa ditjhelete.

src: Cabinet approved measures aimed at assisting over-indebted households and strengthening financial stability.
tgt: Matona a tsa Ditjhelete le Kgwebisano le Indasteri a ne a filwe matla a ho kenya tshebetsong mekgwa ya thibelo ho fokotsa kotsi ya ho tetebela ka ho fetisisa dikolotong ka dikadimo tsa kamoso tsa ditjhelete.

src: The Ministers of Finance and Trade and Industry were authorised to implement preventative measures to minimise the risk of over-indebtedness through future loans.
tgt: Sena se akga ho fana ka lenaneo le kopaneng la dikgato tse sebetsang hantle la ho thusa malapa ao e bang hona jwale a se a ntse a le tebetebeng ya dikoloto hore a se ke a tetebela ka ho fetisisa dikolotong kamoso.

src: This includes providing a joint programme of effective steps to assist currently over-indebted households, and also to prevent households from becoming over-indebted in future.
tgt: Letona la tsa Ditjhelete le tla boela le nka dikgato tsa ho kgothatsa bahiri ho thusa bahiruwa ba bona ba tetebetseng haholo dikolotong ka ho fuputsa ditokomane tsa qobello ya tefo ho bona hore na ke nnete ho le hokae, esita le ho fa bahiruwa mekgwa ya dikeletso ka tsa ditjhelete.5 Kabinete e ananetse Pampiri e Tshweu ya Leano la Naha la Bolaodi ba Tikoloho ya Mawatleng.

src: The Minister of Finance will also take steps to encourage employers to assist their over-indebted employees by investigating employees’ emolument attachment orders for validity, and providing employees with financial wellness mechanisms.
tgt: Leano le teka mokgwa wa bolaodi bo hlophisitsweng ba lekala ho ya bolaoding ba tikoloho ya mawatleng.

src: Cabinet approved the White Paper on the National Environmental Management of the Ocean Policy.
tgt: Sena se tla dumella Aforika Borwa ho rarolla ka bokgabane diphephetso tse holang tse bakwang ke tshenyo e etswang ke batho tikolohong ya mawatleng, ha ka lehlakoreng le leng e thusa kahohlehohle bokgoning ba ntshetsopele ya moruo boo mawatle a fanang ka bona.6 Kabinete e ananetse Maemo a makgaolakgang a Leano la Naha la Metsi yaba ya ela hloko mesebetsi ya dipuisano tsa setjhaba e entsweng ho phethelaTjhebobotjha ya Leano la Naha la Metsi.

src: The policy sets out a coordinated sectoral management approach to ocean environmental management.
tgt: Maemo a matjha a Leano la Metsi a amohela ntlha ya ntshetsopele ya bolaodi ba metsi, e rarollang dikgohlano dipakeng tsa bolaodi ba metsi le ntshetsopele esita le sepheo sa mmuso sa diphetoho.

src: This will allow South Africa to address the growing challenges posed by human impacts on the ocean environment more effectively, while at the same time maximising the economic development potential that the ocean presents.
tgt: Sena se lekodisisa boleng ba tsamaiso ya metsi ka kakaretso mabapi le kamoo metsi a ka thusang ka teng ntshetsopeleng ya tekano, ya ho fola molemo le ya nako e telele naha ka bophara.7 Kabinete e ananetse mosebetsi wa ho amahanya botjha Diboto tsa Metsi ho ba Ditheo tsa Mabatowa tsa Metsi tse robong.

src: The new Water Policy Positions adopts the position of developmental water management, which addresses the linkages between water management and developmental and transformational goals of government.
tgt: Mosebetsi wa bohlokwahlokwa wa Ditheo tsa Mabatowa tsa Metsi e tla ba ho aha le ho laola moqeqeko wa meralo ya motheo ya mabatowa (phepelo ya metsi le mohlodi wa metsi) ho akga le ditjhelete, ntshetsopele ya projeke le mesebetsi e tswelang pele le poloko ya disebediswa di le maemong a matle.

src: This considers the entire water value chain with regards to how water can contribute to achieving equitable, beneficial and sustainable development across the country Cabinet approved the process of realigning Water Boards into nine Regional Water Utilities.
tgt: Sena se tla thusa ka phano e betetshana ya tshehetso mmusong wa dibaka, e leng tlhokeho ya bohlokwa ya popobotjha ya lekala ka kakaretso.8 Kabinete e ananetse ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha ho entelwa Kokwanahloko ya Papiloma Bathong, eo tsamaiso ya yona e tla laolwa ka dikgwedi tse tsheletseng tse qadikaneng, ka 2014, bananeng ba dilemong tse pakeng tsa tse robong le tse 10 ka Lenaneo la Kopantsweng la Bophelo bo Botle Dikolong.

src: This follows the final report on the proposed reform of Water Boards.
tgt: Sena se tsamaisana le tshisinyo ya Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle.

src: The core business of Regional Water Utilities will be to develop and manage regional bulk infrastructure (water supply and water resource) including financing, project development and ongoing operations and maintenance.
tgt: Sepheo ke ho fokotsa kotsi ya ho ba le mofetshe wa popelo hamorao bophelong ba banana, mme e tla thusa ntlafalong ya bophelo ba boleng basading e be e eketse tebello ya dilemo tsa bona tsa ho phela, athe e boetse e fokotsa haholo boteng ba mafu a diqebo.

src: This will enable better provision of support to local government, which is a key requirement of the overall sector reform.
tgt: Dibili.1 Kabinete e ananetse ho kenngwa koranteng ya mmuso ha Bili ya nakwana ya Agrément ya Aforika Borwa, ya 2013 le Memorandamo o mabapi le sepheo sa Bili hore setjhaba se tshwaele.

src: 3 Bills.1 Cabinet approved the gazetting of the draft Agrément South Africa Bill, 2013 and Memorandum on the Objects of the Bill for public comment.
tgt: Sena se tla thusa ho theweng ha indasteri ya kaho e hatelang pele ebile e le ya maemo e tla thusa tlhahisong ya mesebetsi ha ka ho le leng e tla be e kenya letsoho mererong ya meralo ya motheo ya Mmuso.2 Kabinete e ananetse ho tekwa ha Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Aforika e ka Borwa, ya 2013 Palamenteng.

src: The draft Bill makes provision for the recognition of Agrément South Africa, as a public entity.
tgt: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Aforika e ka Borwa, wa 1997.Leqheka la tjhadimo ya Bili ya Sehlomathiso ke ho kgontsha katoloso ya Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Aforika e ka Borwa ho ya naheng efe kapa efe e kontinenteng ya Aforika esita le dihlekehlekeng tse mawatleng a yona.

src: The Board of Agrément South Africa is mandated to, among others, evaluate the fitness-for-purpose of non-standardised construction related products or systems for use in the construction industry, and for which a national standard does not exist.
tgt: Sena se tla kgontsha Banka ho ba le seabo meralong e meholo ya motheo le diprojeke tse ding kantle ho lebatowa la Dinaha tse Tswelang pele tsa Aforika e ka Borwa tse nang le bokgoni ba ho ntlafatsa kgwebisano le kgolo ya moruo kontinenteng esita le ho tshehetsa boitelo le boikitlaetso ba naha tse pedi momahanong ya -3.3 Kabinete e ananetse hore Bili ya nakwana ya Bolaodi ba Lekala la tsa Ditjhelete e ntshuwe bakeng sa hore setjhaba se tshwaele ka yona, ho thusa boikitlaetsong ba Aforika Borwa ba G-20.Sepheo sa Bili ke ho etsa hore lekala la tsa ditjhelete le bolokehe ka ho kenya tshebetsong mokgwa wa taolo wa ‘tlhoro pedi’ e leng ho thewa ha balaodi ba babedi: e mong o ikarabela polokehong le botsitsong ba ditheo tsa ditjhelete ha e mong a ikarabela mokgweng oo ditheo tsa ditjhelete di etsang mosebetsi wa tsona ka teng.

src: This will contribute to the creation of a dynamic and innovative construction industry that positively impacts on job creation while contributing to Governments infrastructure plans.
tgt: Dithonyo.1 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa ha Esther Sarah Makau mosebetsing wa Mohlanka e Moholo wa tsa Ditjhelete Lefapheng la Bonono le Botjhaba.2 Kabinete e ananetse dithonyo tse latelang Lefapheng la Dokgokahanyo:a) Reneva Fourie mosebetsing wa Motlatsi wa Molaodikakaretso: Lesedi la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba le Diphuputsob) Tinyiko Moses Ngobeni mosebetsing wa Motlatsi wa Molaodikakaretso: Kaho ya Meralo ya Motheo ya ICTc) Sibongile Vulikhaya Makopi mosebetsing wa Motlatsi wa Molaodikakaretso: Tekolo ya Dikhamphane tseo e leng tsa Mmuso le Kaho ya Dikgwebo tsa ICT.3 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa ha Siyakhula Paradise Simelane mosebetsing wa Mohlanka e Moholo wa tsa Ditjhelete Lefapheng la Ntshetsopele ya Dibaka tsa Mahae le Tlhabollo ya Naha.4 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwabotjha ha Siyabulela Thomas Tsengiwe mosebetsing wa Mokomishenara e Moholo wa Khomishene ya Tsamaiso ya Kgwebisano ya Matjhaba.5 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa ha Mme Thezi Rosemary Mabuza e le Motlatsi wa Mokhomishenara wa Khomishene ya Naha ya Bareki.6 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa ha Ntate Themba Thomas Cyril Dlamini e le Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) Botong ya Dipapadi ya Naha.7 Kabinete e ananetse ho thonngwa ha Moadvokheiti Solomon Makhosini Msibi e le CEO ya Koporasi ya Taolo ya Sephethephethe Mebileng.8 Kabinete e ananetse dithonyo tse latelang tsa ditho tseo e seng sa Phethahatso Botong ya Koporasi ya Taolo ya Sephethephethe Mebileng.

src: The 24th State of the Nation Address (SoNA) since the ushering in of democracy provided a critical end-of-term assessment on the implementation of government priorities for 2009-2014.
tgt: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa bohlokwa maemong a ha jwale.1 Polelo ya Maemo a Naha ya bo 24 (SoNA) esale ho ba le demokrasi e fane ka tekolo ya bohlokwa ya pheletso ya nako mabapi le ho kengwa tshebetsong ha maikemisetso a mmuso bakeng sa 2009-2014.

src: The introduction of the outcomes system in 2009 enabled evidence-based and results-oriented monitoring of implementation to ensure that government delivered efficiently and effectively.
tgt: Tsebiso ya sistimi ya diphetho ka 2009 e dumelletse hore ho be le tshalomorao e thehilweng hodima bopaki le diphetho ya ho kenya dintho tshebetsong ho netefatsa hore mmuso o sebetsa hantle le ka tokelo.

src: Following the State of the Nation Address and the Debate on the State of the Nation Address, the current series of Ministerial media briefings provides an opportunity for engagement with various Ministers who will elaborate on the President’s Address.
tgt: Kamora Polelo ya Maemo a Naha le Ngangisano mabapi le Polelo ya Maemo a Naha, letoto la hajwale la ditsebiso tsa Matona ho boraditaba le fana ka monyetla bakeng sa puisano le Matona a fapaneng a tla hlalosa Polelo ya Mopresidente.

src: The end-of-term report for the period 2009 to 2014 will be supplemented by the evidence-based 20 Year Review Report which forms part of our 20 Years of Freedom celebration campaign.
tgt: Tlaleho ya pheletso ya nako bakeng sa 2009 ho isa 2014 e tla tlatseletswa ka Tlaleho ya Tekolobotjha ya Dilemo tse 20 e thehilweng hodima bopaki e leng karolo ya letsholo la rona la ketekelo ya Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho.

src: All South Africans are called on to Play Your Part in reversing the legacy of apartheid by celebrating 20 Years of Freedom, which demonstrates that South Africa is undoubtedly a better country than it was in 1994.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa ohle a kotjwa ho Bapala Karalo ya Bona ho fetoleng lefa ka kgethollo ka ho keteka Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho, ho bontshang hore Aforika Borwa ehlile ke naha e betere hona le kamoo e neng e le ka teng ka 1994.

src: Cabinet reiterates President Jacob Zuma‘s message on protest.
tgt: Kabinete e tlatselletsa molaetsa wa Mopresidente Jacob Zuma mabapi le boipelaetso.

src: Protest that threatens lives and property and destroys valuable infrastructure that is meant to serve communities, undermine the very democracy that upholds the right to protest.
tgt: Boipelaetso bo tshosetsa maphelo le thepa mme bo senya ditheo tsa bohlokwa tse reretsweng ho sebeletsa ditjhaba, hape bo nyenyefatsa demokrasi e sireletsang tokelo ya ho ipelaetsa.

src: As South African we all have a collective responsibility to build a society that respects the rule of law, respects one another and respects life and property.
tgt: Jwalo ka MaAforika Borwa re na le boikarabello mmoho ba ho aha setjhaba se hlomphang molao, se hlomphanang hape se hlomphang bophelo le thepa.

src: Cabinet assures the public that loss of life through negligence by the police in the course of dealing with the protests will not be overlooked or condoned.
tgt: Kabinete e tiisetsa setjhaba hore tahlehelo ya maphelo ka bohlaswa ba sepolesa nakong ya ho sebetsana le boipelaetso e ke ke ya lebalwa kapa ya amohelwa.

src: Likewise, protesters in possession of weapons or found burning public facilities or endangering the lives of others will face the full might of the law.
tgt: Ka tsela e jwalo, baipelaetsi ba nang le dibetsa kapa ba fumanwang ba tjhesa meaho ya setjhaba kapa ba beha maphelo a batho ba bang kotsing ba tla ahlolwa ka matla a felletseng a molao.

src: Government will work with communities to improve living conditions in all parts of the country Communities are urged to engage with councilors in a bid to jointly and amicably resolve service delivery disputes.
tgt: Mmuso o tla sebetsa le ditjhaba ho ntlafatsa maemo a bophelo dikarolong tsohle tsa naha mme ditjhaba di kgothaletswa ho buisana le makhanselara tekong ya ho rarolla mathata a phano ya ditshebeletso mmoho le ka kgotso.

src: Negotiations on wages between the platinum mines and the Association of Mineworkers and Construction Union (AMCU) are being mediated by the Commission for Conciliation, Mediation and Arbitration (CCMA).
tgt: Ditshekatsheko mabapi le mekgolo pakeng tsa dimmaene tsa polathinamo le Mokgatlo wa Basebetsi ba Dimmaene le Yunione ya (AMCU)) di ntse di tsamaiswa ke CCMCCMA e beile makhomishenara a maholo hore a tsamaise tshebetso eo.

src: Cabinet is confident that the parties will produce a mutually beneficial agreement that will protect the rights of the workers and protect the economy of the country.
tgt: Kabinete e na tle tshepo ya hore mahlakore ohle a tla hlahisa tumellano e molemo ho bohle e tla sireletsa ditokelo tsa basebetsi le ho sireletsa moruo wa naha.

src: Cabinet welcomes the registration of over 80% of all eligible voters as a result of the successful registration campaign by the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC).
tgt: Kabinete e amohela boingodiso ba bakgethi ba tshwanelehang ba fetang 80% ka lebaka la letsholo le atlehileng la boingodiso la Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC).

src: In the spirit of celebrating and commemorating 20 Years of Freedom, Cabinet commends the IEC, political parties and members of society whose combined efforts ensured that more eligible voters registered.
tgt: Moyeng wa ho keteka le ho hopola Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho, Kabinete e rorisa IEC, mekgatlo ya dipolotiki le ditho tsa setjhaba tseo mesebetsi ya bona e kopaneng e netefaditseng hore bakgethi ba bangata le ho feta ba tshwanelehang baa ingodisa.

src: Cabinet further commends the active participation by those citizens who ensured that their names were on the voters roll.
tgt: Kabinete e boetse e rorisa bonkakarolo ba baahi ba netefaditseng hore mabitso a bona a teng lenaneng la bakgethi.

src: Eligible voters who still need to verify their registration details and those still needing to register should visit with their local IEC office before the voter’s roll closes.
tgt: Bakgethi ba tshwanelehang ba ntseng ba hloka ho netefatsa dintlha tsa bona tsa ngodiso le ba ntseng ba hloka ho ya ngodisa ba lokela ho etela diofisi tsa bona tsa lehae tsa IEC pele lenane la bakgethi le kwalwa.

src: The voter’s roll will close when the President proclaims (publishes in the Government Gazette) 7 May as the election date.
tgt: Lenane la bakgethi le tla kwalwa ha Mopresidente a phatlalatsa (kgatiso ho Koranta ya Mmuso) hore la 7 Motsheanong ke letsatsi la dikgetho.

src: All eligible South Africans are called on to exercise their right to vote during the fifth National Elections.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa ohle a tshwanelehang a kotjwa hore a sebedise tokelo ya bona ya ho kgetha nakong ya Dikgetho tsa bohlano tsa Naha.

src: Cabinet calls on political leaders to instill political tolerance within their parties and supporters.
tgt: Kabinete e bitsa baetapele bohle ba dipolotiki hore ba hatelle taba ya boitshwaro dipolotiking hara mekga le batshehetsi ba bona.

src: This is critical to secure a free and fair election and to uphold the values of our Constitution.
tgt: Sena se bohlokwa ho netefatsa dikgetho tse lokolohileng hape tse nang le tekatekano ho sireletsa ditumelo tsa Molaotheo wa rona.

src: Cabinet welcomes the first round of the Human Papillomavirus Vaccination (HPV) vaccination drive, which will start on 7 March 2014.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela karolo ya pele ya letsholo la kentelo ya Human Papillomavirus Vaccination (HPV), e tla qala ka la 7 Hlakubele 2014.

src: Vaccination against cervical cancer will be administered to girls between the ages 9 and Parents and guardians of Grade 4 school girls aged 9 and 10 are encouraged to support this drive by giving their consent and discussing with their children the significance of this vaccination.
tgt: Kentelo kgahlano le mofetshe wa popelo e tla fuwa banana ba pakeng tsa dilemo tse 9 le Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba banana ba sekolo ba Kereite ya 4 ba kgothaletswa ho tshehetsa letsholo lena ka ho fana ka tumello ya bona le ho buisana le bana ba bona ka bohlokwa ba ente ena.

src: This public health milestone, which is in line with the World Health Organisation recommendation, is expected to contribute to the reduction of cervical cancer among women and reduce associated mortality.
tgt: Kgatelopele ena ya bophelo bo botle ba setjhaba, e tsamaisanang le kgothaletso ya Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo botle, ho lebelletswe hore e tla fokotsa mofetshe wa popelo hara basadi le ho fokotsa ho shwa ho tsamaisanang le hona.

src: Cabinet also welcomed the launch of the revised Contraceptive and Fertility Planning Policy and Service Delivery Guidelines on 27 February 2014 by the Minister of Health.
tgt: Hape Kabinete e amohetse tsebiso ya Molawana o shebilweng botjha wa Thero ya Dithibelapelehi le ho Tswala le Ditataiso tsa Phano ya Tshebeletso ka la 27 Hlakola 2014 ke Letona la Bophelo bo botle.

src: (This will allow young women to complete schooling and pursue their dreams without the hindrance of unplanned parenthood.
tgt: (Sena se tla dumella basadi ba batjha ho phethela dithuto tsa bona le ho sala ditoro tsa bona morao ntle le tshitiso ya botswadi bo sa rerwang.

src: The Minister of Health will also launch a sub-dermal (under-the-skin) implant which is a new, long acting-contraceptive device for women.
tgt: Letona la Bophelo bo botle le boetse le tla tsebisa kenyo ya ka tlaase ho letlalo e leng sesebediswa sa ho thibela pelehi se setjha se sebetsang ka nako e telele bakeng sa basadi.

src: President Jacob Zuma, as the Commander-in-Chief of the South African National Defence Force (SANDF), will attend the Armed Forces Day in Bloemfontein on 21 February 2014.This annual event pays tribute to the selfless service of our men and women in uniform and honours those who have fallen in the line of duty.
tgt: Mopresidente Jacob Zuma, jwalo ka Kgosi e ka Sehloohong ya Sesole sa Tshireletso sa Aforika Borwa (SANDF), o tla ba teng ho Letsatsi la Mabotho a Hlometseng ho la Lejwe Leputswa ka la 21 Hlakola 2014.Ketsahalo ena ya selemo le selemo e tlotla tshebeletso ya boinehelo ya banna le basadi ba rona ba yunifomo hape e rorisa ba weleng ba le tshebetsong.

src: It also provides an opportunity for members of the public to learn first-hand about the work and responsibility of the SANDF.
tgt: E boetse e fana ka monyetla ho ditho tsa setjhaba hore di ithute di le haufi ka mosebetsi le boikarabello ba SANDF.

src: Cabinet is pleased with the number of successful missions that the SANDF has carried out in the continent, like in Burundi which today has a stable government the eastern DRC, where the SANDF has, as part of the Force Intervention Brigade (FIB), dealt a severe blow to armed groups, and its contribution to saving hundreds of thousand lives in the Darfur region of the Sudan.
tgt: Kabinete e thabetse palo ya matsholo a atlehileng ao SANDF e a entseng kontinenteng ka bophara, jwalo ka ho la Burundi eo kajeno e nang le mmuso o tsitsitseng DRC e botjhabela, moo SANDF, jwalo ka karolo ya Force Intervention Brigade (FIB), e thefutseng dihlopha tse hlometseng, le neelano ya yona ho pholoseng maphelo a makgolo a dikete sebakeng sa Darfur, Sudan.

src: Furthermore, Cabinet has noted the successful prevention of piracy encroaching the Southern Africa region by the SANDF deploying in and patrolling the Mozambique Channel.
tgt: Ho feta moo, Kabinete e ananetse thibelo e atlehileng ya bophaerete bo atamelang Aforika e Borwa ke SANDF ka ho lebela le ho paterola Lebopo la Mozambique.

src: President Jacob Zuma will undertake a working visit to the United Kingdom from 2 to 4 March 2014, during which he will attend the National Service of Thanksgiving to celebrate the life and work of former President Nelson Mandela in Westminster Abbey, London on 3 March 2014.
tgt: Mopresident Jacob Zuma o tla nka leeto la mosebetsi ho ya United Kingdom ho tloha ka la 2 ho isa la 4 Hlakubele 2014, moo a tlang ho ya ho Tshebeletso ya Naha ya Teboho ho ketekela bophelo le mesebetsi ya Mopresidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela ho la Westminster Abbey, London ka la 3 Hlakubele 2014.

src: Deputy President Kgalema Motlanthe will attend the 100-Year Anniversary of the Unification of the North and South of Nigeria in Abuja on 27 February 2014.
tgt: Motlatsa Mopresidente Kgalema Motlanthe o tla ya ho Mokete wa Dilemo tse 100 tsa Kopano-hape ya Nigeria e Leboya le Borwa e Abuja ka la 27 Hlakola 2014.

src: Cabinet congratulates the people of the Federal Republic of Nigeria on this milestone event which takes place in the same year as South Africa celebrates 20 Years of Freedom.
tgt: Kabinete e lebohisa batho ba Riphaboliki ya Federale ya Nigeria ka ketsahalo ena ya boiphihlelo e etsahalang ka selemo se le seng le ha Aforika Borwa e keteka Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho.

src: Human Rights Month will be celebrated under the theme: “Celebrating 20 years of changing lives through human rights”.President Jacob Zuma will deliver the keynote address for Human Rights Day (21 March 2014) at the main event in Sharpeville.
tgt: Kgwedi ya Ditokelo tsa Botho e tla ketekelwa tlasa tema ya: “Ho keteka dilemo tse 20 tsa ho fetola maphelo ka ditokelo tsa botho”.Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla fana ka puo ya sehlooho bakeng sa Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa Botho (21 Hlakubele 2014) ketsahalong ya sehlooho ho la Sharpeville.

src: Government’s programme will bolster the 20 Years of Freedom campaign by highlighting issues that foster and promote social cohesion, nation-building and unity in our South African society.
tgt: Lenaneo la mmuso le tla matlafatsa letsholo la Dilemo tse 20 tsa Tokoloho ka ho toboketsa ditaba tse ahang le ho ntlafatsa kopano ya setjhaba, kaho ya naha le bonngwe setjhabeng sa rona sa Aforika Borwa.

src: The Economic Development Department, the National Youth Development Agency (NYDA) and the Presidency will host the Presidential Youth Indaba on Jobs and Skills at Birchwood Conference Centre, Boksburg, from 28 February to 3 March 2014 under the theme: “Working together to empower and provide hope to the youth of South Africa.”Over the past 20 years government has implemented a multi-pronged strategy to deal with youth unemployment.
tgt: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo, Setsi sa Naha sa Ntshetsopele ya Batjha (NYDA) le Bopresidente di tla tshwara Indaba ya Bopresidente ya Batjha e mabapi le Mesebetsi le Bokgoni ho Setsi sa Dikopano sa Birchwood, Boksburg, ho tloha la 28 Hlakola ho isa la 3 Hlakubele 2014 tlasa tema ya: “Ho sebetsa mmoho ho matlafatsa le ho fana ka tshepo ho batjha ba Aforika Borwa.”Dilemong tse 20 tse fetileng mmuso o kentse tshebetsong moralo o makala a fapaneng ho sebetsana le tlhokeho ya mosebetsi batjheng.

src: The National Skills, Basic Education and Youth Employment Accords capture strong commitments by social partners, complemented by various Public Employment Programmes and legislation such as the Employment Tax Incentive Act No 26 of 2013.
tgt: Ditumellano tsa Bokgoni ba Naha, Thuto ya Motheo le Matlafatso ya Batjha di ananela boitlamo bo matla ba balekane ba setjhaba, hammoho le ba Mananeo a fapaneng a Khiro ya Setjhaba le molao jwalo ka Molao wa Kgohelo ya Lekgetho la Khiro No 26 wa 2013.

src: Cabinet welcomes the convening of all social sector partners at the upcoming Expanded Public Works (EPWP) Social Sector Conference to assess the progress of the EPWP and how it can be further expanded.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela ho kopana ha balekane bohle ba makala a setjhaba Kopanong e Atolositsweng ya Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba (EPWP) ya Makala a Setjhaba ho lekola tswelopele ya EPWP le hore na e ka atoloswa jwang le ho feta.

src: The conference will be held under the theme: “United in action to accelerate employment creation through EPWP social sector.”The EPWP was launched in 2004 and remains a key government initiative that creates work opportunities for millions of South Africans in the short to medium-term.
tgt: Kopano e tla tshwarwa tlasa tema ya: “Ho kopana tshebetsong ho potlakisa boteng ba mesebetsi ka lekala la setjhaba la EPWP.”EPWP e thehilwe ka 2004 mme e ntse e le morero wa bohlokwa wa mmuso o hlahisang menyetla ya mesebetsi bakeng sa dimilione tsa maAforika Borwa nakong e kgutshwane ho isa ho e mahareng.

src: Cabinet wishes the Bafana Bafana team well at the upcoming friendly international soccer match with the World Cup hosts Brazil at the FNB Stadium on 5 March 2014.Cabinet calls on all South Africans to show our visitors a warm Ubuntu welcome, and to rally behind our national team.
tgt: Kabinete e lakaletsa sehlopha sa Bafana Bafana katleho papading e tlang ya bolo ya setswalle ya matjhaba le batshwari ba Mohope wa Lefatshe Lebaleng la FNB ka la 5 Hlakubele 2014.Kabinete e kopa maAforika Borwa ohle ho amohela baeti ba rona ka kamohelo e mofuthu ya Ubuntu, le ho tshehetsa sehlopha sa rona sa naha.

src: Key Cabinet discussions and decisions.
tgt: Dipuisano le diqeto tsa bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.

src: Cabinet approved the development of a National Career Development Service policy, implementation strategy and consultation process across all spheres of government.
tgt: Kabinete e amohetse ntshetsopele ya molawana wa Tshebeletso ya Naha ya Ntshetsopele ya Mesebetsi, ho kengwa tshebetsong ha morero le tshebetso ya puisano makaleng ohle a mmuso.

src: A coordinated career development service is urgently needed to ensure that youth, students, under-employed workers and unemployed citizens have access to quality career information and career services.
tgt: Tshebeletso e hokahantsweng ya ntshetsopele ya mesebetsi e hlokahala ka potlako ho netefatsa hore batjha, baithuti, le basebetsi ba sa sebetseng le baahi ba se nang mesebetsi ba na le phihlello ho tlhahisoleseding ya maemo ya mesebetsi le ditshebeletso tse amanang le mesebetsi.

src: This will enable them to make better and more informed career choices that deliver higher levels of employment and help to increase sustainable economic growth in the country.
tgt: Sena se tla ba dumella hore ba etse dikgetho tse ntle ho feta hape tse nang le tsebo tsa mesebetsi tse fanang ka maemo a hodimo ho feta a mesebetsi hape e thuse ho eketsa kgolo ya nako e telele ya moruo kahare ho naha.

src: Cabinet supports the implementation of the eDisclosure system in the Public Service from April 2014, which replaces the manual system of submission, processing and verification of the disclosures.
tgt: Kabinete e tshehetsa ho kengwa tshebetsong ha sistimi ya eDisclosure Ditshebeletsong tsa Setjhaba ho tloha ka Mmesa 2014, e nkang sebaka sa sistimi ya matsoho ya phano, tshebetso le netefatso ya ditsebiso.

src: eDisclosure is an electronic register to capture and manage financial disclosures of designated employees (SMS members) who are required to disclose their registrable interests to their relevant Executive Authority by 30 April of each year.
tgt: eDisclosure ke ngodiso ya elektroniki e amohelang le ho laola ditsebiso tsa ditjhelete tsa bahiruwa ba kgethilweng (ditho tsa SMS) ba hlokwang hore ba tsebise dikgahleho tsa bona tse ka ngodiswang ho ba Boholong ba Phethahatso ka la 30 Mmesa selemo le selemo.

src: The e-Disclosure system is located on the homepage of the Department of Public Service and Administration website – WEBTOKEN - and is linked to other relevant existing databases such as the Companies and Intellectual Property Commission, deeds registration offices and eNatis for verification and validation purposes.
tgt: Sistimi ya eDisclosure e fumanwa leqepheng la lehae la webosaete ya Lefapha la Ditshebeletso tsa Setjhaba le Tsamaiso – WEBTOKEN - mme e hokahantswe le didathabeise tse ding tse teng tse jwalo ka Khomishene ya Dikhamphani le Thepa ya Kelello, diofisi tsa ngodiso ya ditokomane tsa semolao le eNatis bakeng sa mabaka a netefatso le tiisetso.

src: The system aims to strengthen accountability in line with government’s zero-tolerance of eliminate corruption.
tgt: Sepheo sa sistimi ke ho matlafatsa boikarabello tatellong ya leano la mmuso la ho se mamelle bomenemene le ho bo fedisa.

src: Cabinet noted the hosting of the African Ombudsman Summit and related events in Gauteng from 24 to 27 February 2014.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse ho tshwarwa ha Kopano ya Banamolli ba Aforika le diketsahalo tse amanang tse Gauteng ho tloha la 24 ho isa la 27 Hlakola 2014.

src: The African Ombudsman Research Centre will host the Summit under the theme: “Strengthening Good Governance in Africa through the Role of the Ombudsman”.The aim of the Summit is to explore the contributions Ombud institutions make to the consolidation of democracy and good governance, therefore contributing to peace and stability on the continent.
tgt: Setsi sa Dipatlisiso sa Banamolli ba Aforika se tla tshwara kopano tlasa tema ya: “Ho Matlafatsa Puso e Ntle Aforika ka Mosebetsi wa Monamolli”.Sepheo sa Kopano ke ho sibolla ditlatsetso tseo ditsi tsa Banamolli di di etsang ho kopanya demokrasi le puso e ntle, mme kahoo ba tlatsetsa kgotso le botsitso kontinenteng.

src: It also provides a platform to engage on strengthening the concept of Ombudmanship in Africa.
tgt: E boetse e fana ka sebae sa ho buisana ka ho matlafatsa mohopolo wa Monamolli ho la Aforika.

src: The Summit comes at a time when more emphasis if being placed on clean governance, accountability and just service delivery to ordinary people in African states.
tgt: Kopano e tla ka nako eo ka yona ho bewang kgatello e fetang hodima puso e hlwekileng, boikarabello le phano e loketseng ya ditshebeletso ho batho ba tlwaelehileng ba dinaha tsa Aforika.

src: Bills.
tgt: Dibili.

src: Cabinet approved that the Merchant Shipping Amendment Bill, 2014 be tabled in Parliament.
tgt: Kabinete e amohetse Molao wa Tokiso wa Dikepe tsa Thekiso, 2014 o tlo hlahiswa Palamenteng.

src: The Bill aims to amend the Merchant Shipping Act, No.
tgt: Molao o rera ho lokisa Molao wa Dikepe tsa Thekiso, wa bo 57 wa 1951 o tlang pele ho Molaotheo, 1996 o etsang hore ho be bohlokwa ho matahanya boleng le dipehelo tsa Molaotheo le ho matahanya Ditumellano tsa hajwale tsa Matjhaba.

src: 57 of 1951 which predates the Constitution, 1996 making it imperative to align to the values and provisions of the Constitution and also to align to current International Conventions.
tgt: Molao wa Tokiso le ona o fana ka matla ho Tumellano ya Mosebetsi wa Mawatleng, 2006 le Tumellano ya Tshebetso Tshwasong ya Dihlapi, 2007.

src: Both Conventions were adopted by the United Nations International Labour Organisation.
tgt: Ditumellano ka bobedi di nkuwe ke Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Mosebetsi wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng.

src: The alignment of domestic legislation to the Conventions provides South Africa with a global instrument to ensure global protection to the rights of seafarers and decent working and living conditions.
tgt: Matahanyo ya molao wa lehae le Ditumellano ho fa Aforika Borwa sesebediswa sa matjhaba sa ho netefatsa tshireletso ya matjhaba ya ditokelo tsa basebetsi ba mawatleng le maemo a hantle a tshebetso le bophelo.

src: This will enable South Africa to intervene in cases where foreign ships entering our ports have contravened the rights of seafarers.
tgt: Sena se tla dumella Aforika Borwa ho kena dikgetsing tseo ho tsona dikepe tsa kantle tse kenang boemakepe ba rona di hataketseng ditokelo tsa basebetsi ba dikepe.

src: Implementation of the Bill will also improve the operations and image of the maritime industry, which is imperative for international trade and the international economy.
tgt: Ho kengwa tshebetsong ha Molao ho boetse ho tla ntlafatsa tshebetso le tjhebeho ya indasteri ya mawatle, ho leng bohlokwa bakeng sa kgwebo ya matjhaba le moruo wa lefatshe.

src: AppointmentsCabinet approved the following appointments:.
tgt: DithonyoKabinete e amohetse dithonyo tse latelang mesebetsing:.

src: Statement on the Cabinet meeting of 5 March Cabinet’s decisions on current issues and upcoming events.1 Cabinet reiterates President Jacob Zuma’s call on government, business and labour to work together to grow our economy at a rate that is able to create more jobs.
tgt: Diqeto tsa Kabinete mabapi le dintlha tsa ha jwale le diketsahalo tse tlang.1 Kabinete e hatella kgoeletso ya Mopresidente Jacob Zuma ho mmuso, kgwebo le mesebetsi ho sebetsa mmoho ho hodisa moruo wa rona ka sekgahla se kgonang ho hlahisa mesebetsi e meng.

src: The State of the Nation Address and the Budget Speech laid the foundation for intensified implementation of the National Development Plan over the next term of the new administration.
tgt: Puo ya Boemo ba Naha le Puo ya Ditekanyetso di beile motheo bakeng sa ho kengwa tshebetsong ho potlakileng ha Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha nakong ya kotara e tlang ya tsamaiso e ntjha.

src: The 21st National Budget of this democratic dispensation indeed tells a good story of how we are transforming the country and advancing against the key challenges of poverty, inequality and unemployment – and, importantly, doing so within our finite resources.2 Cabinet expressed its abhorrence at the recent murders of two teenage girls in the alleged furtherance of cult-related rituals.
tgt: Tekanyetso ya bo 21 ya Naha ya tsamaiso ena ya demokrasi efeela e hlahisa pale e monate ya hore na re fetola naha jwang le ho tswelapele kgahlano le mathata a bohlokwa a bofuma, tlhokeho ya tekatekano le tlhokeho ya mesebetsi – mme, hwa bohlokwa, re etsa jwalo ka disebediswa tsa rona tse fokolang.2 Kabinete e hlahisitse ho nyahama ha yona ho ho holo mabapi le dipolao tsa bacha ba babedi ba banana bakeng sa diketso tse ho thweng ke tsa boloi.

src: Such practices have no place in our country.
tgt: Diketso tse tjena ha di amohelwe naheng ya rona.

src: Given that the Constitution enshrines the right to life, any person found to have committed crime will be dealt with to the full extent of the law.3 Cabinet thanks all South Africans and corporates for their energy-saving initiatives, particularly when the national grid has been under pressure.
tgt: Ka hore Molaotheo o hatella tokelo ya bophelo, motho mang kapa mang ya fumanwang a tlotse molao o tla qoswa ka matla a felletseng a molao.3 Kabinete e leboha maAforika Borwa ohle le dikhamphani bakeng sa diteko tsa bona tsa poloko ya motlakase, haholo ha phepelo ya naha e le tlasa kgatello.

src: While the country has the capacity to meet its current demand, all electricity consumers are urged to adopt energy- saving as a way of life.4 Cabinet congratulates all schools and teachers who have been nominated for the National Teaching Awards 2013: Via Afrika People's Choice Awards which will be held on 6 March 2014 at the Birchwood Conference Centre in Gauteng.
tgt: Leha naha e na le bokgoni ba ho kgotsofatsa tlhoko ya ha jwale, basebedisi bohle ba motlakase ba kgothaletswa ho kenyeletsa poloko ya motlakase jwalo ka mokgwa wa bophelo.4 Kabinete e lebohela dikolo le matitjhere ohle ba thongweng bakeng sa Dikgau tsa Naha tsa ho Ruta 2013: Dikgau tsa Via Afrika People's Choice tse tla tshwarwa ka la 6 Hlakubele 2014 Setsing sa Dikopano sa Birchwood se Gauteng.

src: These awards are but one of the ways in which the Department of Basic Education acknowledges and encourages dedicated and caring teachers in their efforts to develop learners as responsible citizens of a democratic, non-racial and non-sexist South Africa.
tgt: Dikgau tsena ke tsela e le nngwe feela eo ka yona Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le tlotlang le ho kgothaletsa matitjhere a kgothetseng a tsotellang ditekong tsa bona tsa ho ntshetsapele baithuti jwalo ka baahi ba nang le boikarabello ba Aforika Borwa e nang le demokrasi, e se nang kgethollo ya morabe kapa ya bong.

src: Cabinet also reiterates the rights of children to learn in a safe and conducive environment.5 Cabinet welcomes the Department of Science and Technology’s continued support of the National Science Festival, known as Scifest Africa, to be held from 12 to 18 March 2014 in Grahamstown in the Eastern Cape under the theme “Into the Space”.
tgt: Kabinete hape e thatisella ditokelo tsa bana tsa ho ithuta tikolohong e bolokehileng hape e kgothaletsang thuto.5 Kabinete e amohela tshehetso e tswellang ya Lefapha la Saense le Theknoloji ya Mokete wa Naha wa Saense, o bitswang Scifest Africa, o tla tshwarwa ho tloha ho la 12 ho isa ho la 18 Hlakubele 2014 ho la Grahamstown e Kapa Botjhabela tlasa tema ya “Ho kena Sebakeng.” Ketsahalo ena ya selemo le selemo e tsebahatsa saense, theknoloji, boenjineri le mmetse jwalo ka menyetla ya mesebetsi ho batjha ba rona hape e theha kutlwisiso e ntlafetseng ya mafapha ana hara maAforika Borwa.

src: This annual event promotes science, technology, engineering and mathematics as career opportunities to our youth and forges a better understanding of these fields among South Africans.
tgt: Mmuso o tswelapele ho beha kapele le ho tsebahatsa kgetho ya Mmetse le Disaense tsa Tshwaro jwalo ka karolo ya ho ntshetsapele bokgoni ba bohlokwa bo hlokwang ke moruo wa rona o ntseng o hola.6 Kabinete e amohela phatlalatso e entsweng ke Mokgatlo wa Setsha sa Lenaneo la Dipatlisiso tsa AIDS ka hare ho Aforika Borwa ka tshibollo ya dianthibodi tse matla tsa HIPatlisiso e mabapi le kamoo mmele wa mosadi wa KwaZulu-Natal o ileng wa arabela tshwaetso ya hae ya HIV ka ho etsa dianthibodi tse matla.

src: Government continues to prioritise and promote the uptake of Mathematics and Physical Sciences as part of developing the critical skills needed by our developing economy.6 Cabinet welcomes the announcement made by the CAPRISA Consortium on the discovery of potent new HIV antibodies.
tgt: Phuputso, e hatisitsweng ho jenaleng ya maemo a hodimo ya saense e bitswang, Nature, e hlalosa kamoo sehlopha sa patlisiso se fumaneng sa ba sa supa dianthibodi tseo mading a mosadi eo ya ba ba etsa dianthibodi tse tshwanang le tseo hantle ka laborathoring.

src: The research centres on how a KwaZulu-Natal woman’s body responded to her HIV infection by making potent antibodies.
tgt: Dianthibodi tsena tse iketseditsweng di ile tsa sebediswa letotong la diteko ka laborathoring ho hlakisa tsela e latetsweng ke masole a mmele wa mosadi eo ho etsa dianthibodi tsena tse matla.

src: The study, published in the prestigious scientific journal, Nature, describes how the research team found and identified these antibodies in the woman’s blood and then cloned the antibodies in the laboratory.
tgt: Ditsebo tse ntjha tse fumanweng ho tswa ho mosadi enwa wa KwaZulu-Natal mabapi le dikarabelo tsa masole a mmele kgahlano le HIV di tlisa tshepo bakeng sa thibelo ya HIV le maano a kalafo a nako e tlang.

src: The cloned antibodies were then used in a series of experiments in the laboratory to elucidate the pathway followed by the woman’s immune system to make these potent antibodies.
tgt: Tshibollo ena ha se pheko ya HIV/AIDS ka tsela efe kapa efe mme kahoo mmuso o kopa maAforika Borwa ho tswelapele ho etsa diteko bakeng sa HIV kapa ho tswelapele ka kalafo ya dianthiretrovaerale e fuwang batho bao diteko tsa bona di hlahisang hore ba na le HIV.7 Mopresidente Jacob Zuma o tla bua ketekelong ya Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa Botho tsa selemo sena ka la 21 Hlakubele 2014 tlasa tema ya “Ho ketekela Dilemo tse 20 tsa ho fetola maphelo ka ditokelo tsa botho!” Lebaleng la Kirikete la Sharpeville le Gauteng.

src: The new insights gained from this KwaZulu-Natal woman into immune responses against HIV bring hope for future HIV prevention and treatment strategies.
tgt: Kabinete e kopa maAforika Borwa ho ketekela ho phela naheng e netefatsang hore le ka mohla botho ba rona bo ke ke ba nkuwa ho moAforika Borwa ofe kapa kapa, ho sa natswe morabe, bong, bodumedi kapa tshekamelo ya ho ratana.

src: This discovery is no means a cure for HIV/AIDS and government therefore calls on South Africans to continue to have themselves tested for HIV or to stick to the antiretroviral treatment that is being offered to people who test positive.7 President Jacob Zuma will address this year’s Human Rights Day celebrations on 21 March 2014 under the theme “Celebrating 20 Years of changing lives through human rights!” at the Sharpeville Cricket Grounds in Gauteng.
tgt: Kaofela re na le boikarabello ba ho netefatsa hore rekote ya rona ya ditokelo tsa botho le nalane di bolokwa le ho matlafatswa bakeng sa meloko e tlang.8 Beke ya Naha ya Metsi e tla phatlalatswa ho la Bushbuckridge ka la 14 Hlakubele mme e tla tswelapele ka diketsahalo tse mmalwa ho fihlela la 23 Hlakubele 2014.

src: The launch event will take place around the lowering of pumps at the South Vertical Shaft of the old ERPM mine to deal with the issue of Acid Mine Drainage in the Central Witwatersrand Basin.
tgt: Ketsahalo ya phatlalatso e tla be e le mabapi le ho theolwa ha dipompo Mokoting wa South Vertical e leng mmaene wa kgale wa ERPM ho sebetsana le taba ya Phallo ya Asiti ya Mmaene ho Central Witwatersrand Basin.

src: The remainder of the week will also see the handover of waste water treatment works and bulk water supply projects in a number of provinces.
tgt: Matsatsing a mang a beke eo ho tla fanwa ka tshebeletso ya tlhwekiso ya metsi a ditshila le merero ya phepelo ya metsi ka bongata diporofenseng tse itseng.

src: This year’s theme is “Water is Life - 20 Years of Water Delivery for Social and Economic Development”.
tgt: Tema ya selemo sena ke “Metsi ke Bophelo – Dilemo tse 20 tsa Phepelo ya Metsi bakeng sa Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba le Moruo.” Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho boloka metsi hape e hatella tlhokomelo ya tsamaiso ya nako e telele ya sesebediswa sena se fokolang, ele ho ka atolosa phihlello ho maAforika Borwa a mangata.9 Kabinete e bolelletswe ka Presidential Youth Indaba e atlehileng ya pele e tshwaretsweng ho la Ekurhuleni ho tloha la 28 Hlakola ho isa la 03 Hlakubele 2014.

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to conserve water and reiterates the need for sustainable management of this scarce resource, in order to widen access to even more South Africans.9 Cabinet was apprised of the successful inaugural Presidential Youth Indaba that was held in Ekurhuleni from 28 February to 03 March 2014.
