tgt: Kabinete e lakaletsa bohle matsatsi a phomolo a qetellang selemo a kgathollang, le ho ba a kgotso le ho kgothaletsa MaAforika Borwa ho sebedisa Ubuntu/Botho ka ho thusa bao ka hara metse ya rona ba sa kgoneng ho itaetela le ho bontsha kutlwelobohloko jwaloka setjhaba se kgathallang le ho hlokomelana.

src: All parents to take care of their children during this period.
tgt: Batswadi bohle ba kgothaletswa ho hlokomela bana ba bona nakong ena.

src: Victims of abuse must speak out, report abuse and contact the 24 hour command centre 0800 428 428.Cabinet calls on all South Africans to take every precaution during the upcoming festive season, stay away from the abuse of alcohol and drugs, and to enjoy the holiday period in a safe and responsible manner.
tgt: Mahlatsipa a tlhekefetso a tshwanela ho bua, ho tlaleha tlhekefetso le ho ikopanya le setsi sa taolo sa dihora tse 24 ho 0800 428 428.Kabinete e ipiletsa ho MaAforika Borwa oohle ho ba sedi matla nakong ya sehla sa boithabiso se tlang, ho phema tshebediso e mpe ya jwala le dithethefatsi, le ho thabela nako ya phomolo ka tsela e bolokehileng le ho ba le boikarabelo.

src: All South Africans have a part to play in curbing incidents of crime, accidents and abuse, which tend to increase during this period.
tgt: Maaforika Borwa oohle a na le karolo eo a lokelang ho e bapala bakeng sa ho thibela diketsahalo tsa botlokotsebe, dikotsi le tlhekefetso, tse batlang di phahama nakong ena.

src: Cabinet reiterates that traffic officials will have a zero tolerance approach to lawlessness on our roads during this festive season.
tgt: Kabinete e pheta hore bahlanka ba sephethephethe ba tla hloka mamello bakeng saditlolo tsa molao mebileng ya rona nakong ena ya sehla sa mekete.

src: We urge all road users to adhere to the speed limit ensure vehicles are roadworthy not to drive intoxicated and to wear safety belts.
tgt: Re kgothaletsabasebedisi ba tsela bohle ho imatahanya le lebelo le lekanyeditsweng ho netefatsa hore dipalangwang di loketse tsela ho se kganne ba tahilwe le ho sebedisa mabanta a pholoso.

src: Pedestrians are urged to ensure that when using the roads they do not endanger their well-being or that of motorists.
tgt: Ditaaso di kgothaletswa ho netefatsa hore ha ba sebedisa mebila ha ba behe bophelo ba bona tsietsing kapa ba bakganni ba bang.

src: Government will play its part by leading a range of campaigns such as Healthy Lifestyles and Arrive Alive in a bid to partner with communities to promote responsible and safe behaviour.
tgt: Mmuso o tla bapala karolo ya ona ka ho etella pele letoto la matsholo a kang Healthy Lifestyles le Arrive e le tsela ya ho etsa semphato le badudi bakeng sa ho kgothaletsa boitshwaro bo nang le boikarabelo le ho bolokeha.

src: Cabinet is saddened by the tragic killing of South African teacher Pierre Korkie who was in Yemen, and that of Werner Groenewald, and his two children, Rode and Jean-Pierre who died in an attack in Afghanistan.
tgt: Kabinete e utlwisitswe bohloko ke polao e sehloho ya titjhere ya Aforika BorwaPierre Korkie ya neng a le Yemen mmoho le ya Werner Groenewald, le bana ba hae ba babedi, Rode le Jean-Pierre ba hlokahetseng tlhaselong ho la Afghanistan.

src: The work to identify the remaining 11 South Africans who died tragically in the Nigerian building collapse continues and government is intensifying efforts to ensure their remains are brought home without undue delay.
tgt: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona ho ba lelapa le metswalle.4 Mosebetsi wa ho hlwaya maAforika Borwa 11 a shweleng ka sehloho ho putlameng ha moaho ho la Nigeria o ntse o tswela pele mme mmuso o matlafatsa mekutu ya hore ditopo tsa bona di tliswa lapeng ntle le tiehiso e sa hlokahaleng.5 Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho lelapa la Gigaba ka tahlehelo ya ntate wa bona, Moruti Jabulani Gigaba.

src: Cabinet conveys its condolences to the Gigaba family on the loss of their father, Reverend Jabulani Gigaba.
tgt: E ne e le ntate wa Letona la Merero ya Lehae, Monghadi Malusi Gigaba.

src: Cabinet congratulates the national soccer team Bafana Bafana and coach Ephraim “Shakes” Mashaba on qualifying for the Africa Cup of Nations 2015 in Equatorial Guinea, which begins on 17 January 2015, and calls on all South Africans to support the national team as they fly our flag high.
tgt: Kabinete hape e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho lelapa le metswalle ya Sisi Mabe, eo e neng e le Motsamaisi wa Dipuisano wa Lekgotla la Ketsamolao la Foerisetata.6 Kabinete e thoholetsa sehlopha sa naha sa bolo BafanaBafana le mokwetlisi Ephraim “Shakes” Mashaba ka ho phunyeletsa bakeng sa Mohope wa Dinaha tsa Aforika wa 2015 ho la Equatorial Guinea o qalang ka la 17 Pherekgong 2015, mme e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa oohle ho tshehetsa sehlopha sa naha ha se fofisetsa folakga ya rona hodimo.7 Kabinete e ananetse ho thakgolwa ha Lebotho la Batjha la Bodulo ba Batho ka la 1-2 Tshitwe 2014 ke Mafapha a Bodulo ba Batho, Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, le Lekala la Naha la Ntshetsopele ya Batjha (NYDA) Sebokeng sa Batjha sa Bodulo ba Batho sa Naha.

src: Cabinet noted the launch of the Human Settlements Youth Brigade on 1-2 December 2014 by the Departments of Human Settlements, Small Business Development, and the National Youth Development Agency (NYDA) at the National Human Settlements Youth Summit.
tgt: Seboka se buisane ka mananeo a matlafatso a mafapha a tobaneng le merero ya batjha le kamoo ba ka nkang karolo phanong ya matlo.

src: The summit deliberated on the empowerment programmes of the departments targeting young people and how they can participate in the delivery of houses.
tgt: Qetellong ya seboka bankakarolo bohle ba saenne Tumellano ya Batjha ya Bodulo ba Batho ba Naha eo sepheo sa yona e leng pehelo ya boikemisetso ka morero wa ho bopa katamelo e kopanetsweng le e akaretsang bakeng sa phano ya bodulo ba batho ka kenyeletso ya batjha, ntshetsopele le bonkakarolo ka mokgwa wa Mabotho aBatjha a Bodulo ba Batho ba Naha.

src: At the end of the summit all stakeholders signed the National Human Settlements Youth Accord which serves as a statement of intent towards creating a holistic and integrated approach to human settlements delivery through youth mobilisation, development and participation in a form of National Human Settlements Youth Brigades.
tgt: Sepheo ke ho lemosa batho ba batjha kamora boikemisetso ba menyetla ya matlo e milione le ho thaotha le ho rupella Mabotho a Batjha a ka bang 10 000 dilemong tse hlano tse tlang.

src: Upcoming events.
tgt: Diketsahalo tse tlang.

src: On 12 December 2014, the President of South Sudan, His Excellency Salva Kiir Mayardit will pay an official visit to South Africa where he will be hosted by President Jacob Zuma in Cape Town.
tgt: Ka la 12 Tshitwe 2014, Moporesidente wa Sudan Borwa, Motlotlehi Salva KiirMayardit o tla etela Aforika Borwa mme Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla mo amohela ho la Motse Kapa.

src: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.
tgt: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Mananeo a Bohlokwa a Mmuso.

src: Cabinet welcomes President Jacob Zuma’s State of the Nation Address, which afforded South Africans an opportunity to hear government Programme of Action.
tgt: Kabinete e ananela Puo ya Boemo ba Naha ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma, e fileng maAforika Borwa monyetla wa ho utlwa ka Lenaneo la Tshebetso la mmuso.

src: Government calls on all stakeholders across the country to Work Together on the nine-point plan in order to ignite growth and create jobs.
tgt: Mmuso o etsa kgoeletso ho bankakarolo bohle naheng ka bophara ho Sebetsa Mmoho hodima morero o ntlha di robong bakeng sa ho hotetsa kgolo le ho hlahisa mesebetsi.

src: To ensure that South Africans better understand government’s Programme of Action, post-State of Nation Address communication initiatives have been put in place to provide details on the announcements made by the President.
tgt: Ho netefatsa hore maAforika Borwa a utlwisisa betere Lenaneo la Tshebetso la mmuso, boikitlaetso ba kgokahanyo ya kamora Puo ya Boemo ba Naha bo kentswe tshebetsong bakeng sa ho fana ka dintlha ka botlalo mabapi le ditsebiso tse entsweng ke Moporesidente.

src: These include the Ministerial Cluster Media briefings held from 15 to 24 February WEBTOKEN addition, the 2015/16 Budget Speech scheduled for the 25 February 2015 will highlight the allocation of resources to the various government programmes as emphasised by the President.
tgt: Tsena di kenyeletsa Sehlopha sa Matona sa ditsebiso sa Boraditaba se ileng sa bitsa dikopano ho tloha ka la 15 ho ya ka la 24 Hlakola 2015.Ho feta moo, Puo ya Ditekanyetso ya 2015/16 e reretsweng ho tshwarwa ka la 25 Hlakola 2015 e tla hlakisa phano ya mehlodi mananeong a fapafapaneng a mmuso jwaloka ha Moporesidente a tobokeditse.

src: Cabinet condemns the unruly and un-parliamentary conduct of some Members of Parliament during the opening of WEBTOKEN is disappointing that these elected public representatives chose to dishonor the sacrifices and struggle made to realise our hard-earned democracy.2 Cabinet was briefed on the progress made with the oceans economy Operation Phakisa.
tgt: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe boitshwaro bo bobe le boo e seng ba bopalamente ba Ditho tsa Palamente tse ding nakong ya Pulo ya Palamente.

src: The ‘Lab’ or planning phase took place in Durban during July and August 2014 and resulted in the production of detailed ‘three feet plans’ to grow the ocean economy.
tgt: Ho a swabisa hore ditho tsena tse kgethilweng ho ba baemedi ba setjhaba di ile tsa kgetha ho hlompholla ho intsha sehlabelo le ntwa e lwannweng bakeng sa ho fumana demokerasi ya rona e thotsweng ka thata.2 Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka kgatelopele e entsweng ka moruo wa mawatleng wa Operation Phakisa.

src: The Operation has now entered an implementation phase, which involves the monitoring and project managing the implementation.
tgt: ‘Laboratori’ kapa mokgahlelo wa ho rera o etsahetse ho la Durban ka Phupu le ka Phato 2014 mme wa tswala tlhahiso e tebileng ya ‘merero e bebofaditsweng’ bakeng sa ho hodisa moruo wa mawatleng.

src: Delivery units have been established and monitoring and escalation mechanisms and processes are in place.
tgt: Operation Phakisa jwale e se e le mokgahlelong wa ho kenngwa tshebetsong, o kenyeletsang bodisa le taolo ya ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha porojeke.

src: The strategy will further ensure an improved coordination, synergy and alignment with the programme of government, civil society and development partners that already work in the area of adolescent sexual and reproductive health.
tgt: Diyuniti tsa phano di se di theilwe mme le mekgwa ya bodisa le ntlafatso le ditsamaiso di se di theilwe.

src: The Inter-Ministerial committee for the Population Policy will oversee the implementation, monitoring and evaluation of this Strategy.4 Cabinet approved the publication of the draft Early Childhood Development Policy in the Government Gazette.
tgt: Hape ho ile ha fanwa ka tsebiso mabapi le Operation Phakisa ya bobedi e eteletsweng pele ke Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle, ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo hodima Phihlello ya Sebele ya Ditliliniki le Tokiso eo e leng motjheng mme e thakgotswe ke Moporesidente ka la 18 Pudungwana 20.3 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Morero wa Lewa la Naha wa Ditokelo tsa Bophelo bo Botle mabapi le Thuto ya Boikatiso le ya Thobalano ya ho Kena boholong.

src: This forms part of the South African Integrated Programme of Action for Early Childhood Development – Moving ahead 2013-2016, approved by Cabinet on 18 September 2013.
tgt: Lewa lena le tsepamisitse maikutlo bakeng sa ntshetsopele le kgodiso ya diphetho tsa kalafo eo eleng hore Thuto ya Bophelo bo Botle ya Thobalano le Boikatiso batjheng ke taba e bohlokwa.

src: The Policy provides a framework for government’s accountability to provide a comprehensive package of quality Early Childhood Development services that would be universally available in sufficient quantities and proximity so that all children enjoy an equal opportunity to access them.
tgt: Lewa hape le tla netefatsa kgokahano e ntlafetseng, tsamaelano le boimatahanyo le lenaneo la mmuso, setjhaba le balekane ba ntshetsopele ba seng ba ntse ba sebetsa mabakeng a bophelo bo botle ba ho kena boholong ho tsa thobalano le boikatiso.

src: The policy also introduces a number of new services to fill gaps identified in the range of services currently available especially within the first 1 000 days of a child’s life.
tgt: Komiti ya kopanelo ya Matona bakeng sa Leano la Setjhaba e tla okamela ho kenngwa tshebetsong, bodisa le tekolo ya Lewa lena.4 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya moralo wa Leano la Ntlafatso ya Kgodiso ya Bana Koranteng ya Mmuso.

src: The report covers the period April 2012- March 20.6 Cabinet approved that South Africa participates in the International Map Year in 2015 and 2016 by organising events at a national level with a view to increase the level of map awareness and literacy in South Africa.
tgt: Sena se etsa karolo ya Lenaneo la Tshebetso la Aforika Borwa le Kopanetsweng bakeng sa Ntlafatso ya Kgodiso ya Bana - Ho ya pele ka 2013-2016, le tjhaelletswe monwana ke Kabinete ka la 18 Loetse 2013.

src: Maps help to understand problems and possibilities, such as the provision of housing, sustaining natural resources, managing risk and facilitating timely and comprehensive transportation infrastructure.
tgt: Leano le fana ka moralo bakeng sa boikarabello ba mmuso ba ho fana ka pakana e pharaletseng ya ditshebeletso tsa Ntlafatso ya Kgodiso ya Bana ya boleng e tla ba teng bakeng sa bohle ka palo e lekaneng le sebaka hore bana kaofela ba fumane monyetla o lekalekanang wa ho di fihlella.

src: Understanding geospatial information informs planning and decision making for the development of South Africa.
tgt: Leano hape le hlahisa ditshebeletso tse mmalwa tse ntjha bakeng sa ho kwala dikgeo tse hlwailweng letotong la ditshebeletso tse teng hajwale haholoholo nakong ya matsatsi a pele a 1 000 a bophelo ba ngwana.

src: Key Cabinet decisions.1 Cabinet approved the Directive on the implementation of competency based assessments for member of the Senior Management (SMS), issued in terms of Chapter 4 part II
tgt: Kabinete hape e tjhaelletse monwana ho thehwa ha Komiti ya Kopanelo ya Matona (IMC), e tla netefatsa katamelo e momahaneng le ho hokahana.

src: and Chapter 4, part VI of the Public Service Regulations, 2001.The amended Directive promotes the independent identification of SMS Member’s developmental gaps, introduces the use of technical exercises and provides guidance on how departments can utilize the competency assessment results in conjunction with all other processes of recruitment and selection.2 Cabinet approved the hosting of the National Imbizo Focus Week from 7 to 12 April 2015 under the theme “Together we move South Africa forward”.The Week will be characterized by door-to-door household profiling walkabout or project visits stakeholder dialogues community engagements as well as commercial and community media engagements.
tgt: E tla tsamaiswa ke Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba.5 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho lokollwa ha tlaleho ya Moralo wa Pele wa nako le nako wa Naha mabapi le Seboka sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) mabapi le Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Phelang ka Boqhwala, bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba nakong ya matsatsi a Tlaleho e akaretsa nako ya Mmesa 2012- Hlakubele 20.6 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Aforika Borwa e nke karolo ho Selemo sa Matjhaba sa Mmapa ka 2015 le 2016 ka ho hlophisa diketsahalo maemong a naha ka maikemisetso a ho eketsa temoso ka dimmapa le tsebo Aforika Borwa.

src: These provide principals with a platform to interact directly with South Africans, hear community issues first-hand and monitor progress of government programmes.
tgt: Dimmapa di thusa ho utlwisisa diqaka le dikgonahalo, tse jwaloka phano ya matlo, paballo ya mehlodi ya tlhaho, ho laola dikotsi le ho thusa nako e sa le teng dikahong tsa motheo tse pharaletseng tsa dipalangwang.

src: Bills.1 Cabinet approved the publication of the draft Protection, Promotion, Development and Management of Indigenous Knowledge Systems Bill in the Government Gazette as well as a public consultation process.
tgt: Ho utlwisisa tlhahisoleseding ya dibaka tsa boaho ho a thusa bakeng sa ho etsa meralo le ho nka diqeto bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya Aforika Borwa.

src: The primary objective of this Bill is to facilitate the protection of Indigenous Knowledge and the restoration and recognition of Indigenous knowledge relating to and owned by indigenous and local communities in South Africa.
tgt: Diqeto tsa Bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.1 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Taelo e mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha tekolo e itshetlehileng hodima boitsebelo bakeng sa ditho tsa Ditshebeletso tse ka Sehloohong tsa Bolaodi (SMS), e ntshitsweng ho ya ka Kgaolo 4 Karolo II

src: It facilitates redress of rights and benefits that indigenous and local communities were deprived off.2 Cabinet approved the publication of the Firearm Control Amendment Bill, 2015 in the Government Gazette for public comments.
tgt: le Kgaolo 4, Karolo VI ya Melawana ya Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba, 2001.Taelo e hlomathisitsweng e kgothaletsa ho hlwauwa ho ikemetseng ha dikgeo tsa ntshetsopele tsa Ditho tsa SMS, e tsebisa tshebediso ya dihlakiso tsa setekginiki le ho fana ka tataiso kamoo mafapha a ka sebedisang diphetho tsa tekolo ya boitsebelo mmoho le ditsamaiso tse ding tsohle tsa ho hira le ho kgetha.2 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tshwarwa ha Beke ya Imbizo ya Naha ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ho tloha ka la 7 ho isa ka la 12 Mmesa 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Mmoho re ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele”.Beke ena e tla bonahala ka ho kena ntlo-le-ntlo bakeng sa dintlha ka maemo a malapa ho potapota malapeng kapa ho eta ka lebaka la porojeke ena dipuisano le bankakarolo ho ikopanya le badudi mmoho le tshebediso ya dikgwebo le boraditaba.

src: The Bill amends the Firearm Control Act, 2000 and responds to the Vision of the National Development Plan by seeking to improve the statutory and regulatory framework that will govern firearms.
tgt: Sena se neha ba ka sehloohong lepatlelo la ho buisana ka kotloloho le maAforika Borwa, ho utlwa mathata a setjhaba ho tswa ho bona le ho beha leihlo kgatelopele ya mananeo a mmuso.3 Dibili.1 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya moralo wa Bili ya Tshireletso, Kgothaletso, Ntshetsopele le Bolaodi ba Ditsamaiso tsa Tsebo ya Ditsamaiso tsa Ka hara Naha Koranteng ya Mmuso mmoho le tsamaiso ya dipuisano le setjhaba.

src: Cabinet’s Position on Current Issues.1 Cabinet urges communities and organized structures to work with government, under the leadership of the Ministry of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, to ensure the challenges around Malamulele in Limpopo are resolved.
tgt: E thusa ka ho hlabolla ditokelo le melemo tseo baahi ba lehae ba ka hara naha ba neng ba di tinngwe.2 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Taolo ya Dithunya, 2015 Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.

src: Cabinet condemns the disruption of schooling by some groups as a way of raising grievances.
tgt: Bili e hlomathisa Molao wa Taolo ya Dithunya, 2000 le ho arabela ho Pono ya Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha ka ho batla ho ntlafatsa moralo wa molao le bolaodi bo tla laola dithunya.

src: This robbed children of their right to education and denied some the right to register for their Grade 12 supplementary examinations.
tgt: Taolo ya dithunya ke ntlha ya bohlokwa ya katamelo ya mmuso ya ho lwantsha botlokotsebe.4 Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa hajwale.1 Kabinete e kgothaletsa badudi le dibopeho tse itlhophisitseng ho sebetsa le mmuso, tlasa boetapele ba Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba, ho netefatsa hore diphephetso tse potapotileng Malamulele ho la Limpopo di a rarollwa.

src: The establishment of a municipality in Malamulele should be within the confines of the law as prescribe by the Demarcation Board.2 Cabinet condemns attacks on foreign nationals as criminal activity and reiterates that law enforcement agencies will not hesitate to act decisively against anyone found to incite such violence.
tgt: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe tshitiso ya dikolo ke dihlopha tse itseng e le tsela ya ho hlahisa ditletlebo.

src: No amount of economic hardship and discontent can justify criminal activity associated with these attacks.
tgt: Sena se amohile bana tokelo ya bona ya thuto le ho thibela ba bang tokelo ya ho ingodisetsa dihlahlobo tsa bona tsa tlatsetso tsa Kereiti ya Ho thehwa ha masepala wa Malamulele ho tshwanela ho ba diatleng tsa molao jwaloka ha o behilwe ke Boto ya Karohanyo.2 Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ditlhaselo tsa melata jwaloka tlolo ya molao mme e thathiselletsa ka hore makala a tsa molao a keke a qeaqea ho sebetsana ka matla kgahlanong le mang kapa mang ya tla fumanwa a rotetsa merusu e jwalo.

src: South Africa is a signatory to the Geneva Protocol on Refugees and is committed to protect all foreign nationals in the country.
tgt: Aforika Borwa ke moitlami ka ho saena Porothokhole ya Geneva e mabapi le Baphaphathehi mme e itlamme ho tshireletsa melata yohle e ka hara naha.

src: As a signatory to this Protocol, and as a country that cherishes human rights, we will protect the basic rights of every human being within our borders, including foreign nationals.3 Cabinet approved the tabling in Parliament for ratification, the Treaty Establishing the BRICS Contingent Reserve Arrangement and Agreement on the New Development Bank.
tgt: Jwaloka moitlami ho Porothokhole ena, mme jwaloka naha e kgothaletsang ditokelo tsa botho, re tla tshireletsa ditokelo tsa motheo tsa motho ofe kapa ofe ya ka hara naha ya rona, ho kenyeletswa melata.3 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho hlahiswa Palamenteng bakeng sa tiisetso, Tumellano e Thehang Tumellano le Tlhophiso ya Mokgopi wa Resefe wa BRICS mabapi le Banka e Ntjha ya Ntshetsopele.

src: The Contingent Reserve Arrangement is being established to respond to short-term balance of payment pressures.
tgt: Tlhophiso ya Mokgopi wa Resefe e thewa bakeng sa ho arabela ho dikgatello tsa tsepamiso ya ditefello tsa nako e kgutshwanyane.

src: Further, it will serve as a precautionary measure to help the BRICS countries forestall short-term liquidity pressures, provide mutual support and further strengthen the global financial safety net.4 Cabinet notes the handover of the Chairperson of the South African component of the BRICS Business Council from Mr Patrice Motsepe to Mr. Brian Molefe.
tgt: Ho fetafeta moo, e tla sebetsa e le mokgwa wa temoso bakeng sa ho thusa dinaha tsa BRICS ho thibela dikgatello tsa nako e kgutshwanyane tsa phallo ya tjhelete, ho fana ka tshehetsano mmoho le ho tswella ho matlafatsa polokeho ya ditjhelete ya lefatshe.4 Kabinete e ananela ho fana ka marapo ha Modulasetulo wa moifo wa Aforika Borwa wa Lekgotla la Kgwebo la BRICS ho tswa ho Monghadi Patrice Motsepe ho ya ho Monghadi Brian Molefe.

src: Mr. Mostepe was the inaugural chair of both the South African component and the BRICS Business Council as a whole.
tgt: Monghadi Motsepe e ne e le modulasetulo wa sethathong wa ka bobedi moifo wa Aforika Borwa le Lekgotla la Kgwebo la Brazil, Russia, India, China, Aforika Borwa (BRICS) ka kakaretso.

src: During his tenure, Mr. Motsepe succeeded in establishing this important body as an integral component of the BRICS architecture and served as chair with distinction.
tgt: Nakong ya tshebetso ya hae, Monghadi Motsepe o atlehile bakeng sa ho theha lekgotla lena la bohlokwa jwaloka karolo ya setheo sa BRICS le ho sebetsa jwaloka modulasetulo ka bokgabane.

src: Cabinet thanks Mr. Motsepe for his service and wishes Mr. Molefe well as he takes over this important task.5 Cabinet commends the National Cricket team for their performance at the Cricket World Cup and wishes them well as the entire country rallies behind them for the tournament underway in Australia and New Zealand.6 Cabinet congratulates the flute player Wouter Kellerman who won the Grammy Award for best new age album.
tgt: Kabinete e leboha Monghadi Motsepe ka mosebetsi wa hae le ho lakaletsa Monghadi Molefe tse molemo jwaloka ha a tla kallana le mosebetsi ona wa bohlokwa.5 Kabinete e thoholetsa Sehlopha sa Naha sa Kirikete ka tshebetso ya sona Mohopeng wa Lefatshe wa Kirikete mme e ba lakaletsa tse molemo jwaloka naha e ba tshehetsa bakeng sa thonamente e motjheng Australia le New Zealand.6 Kabinete e thoholetsa seletsi sa folutu Wouter Kellerman ya hapileng Kgau ya Grammy bakeng sa alebamo e kgabane ka ho fetisisa ya moloko o motjha.

src: Mr Kellerman recorded Winds of Samsara with Indian composer Ricky Kej, which earned them the award for their collaboration.7 Cabinet expresses its gratitude to all energy consumers for responding to the call to decrease the usage of electricity.
tgt: Monghadi Kellerman o hatisitse Winds of Samsara le moqapi wa moIndia Ricky Kej, e ba hapetseng kgau bakeng sa kopanelo ya bona.7 Kabinete e hlahisa teboho ya yona ho basebedisi ba eneji ka ho arabela kgoeletso ya ho fokotsa tshebediso ya motlakase.

src: The process to address the energy challenges is receiving the highest priority attention.
tgt: Tsamaiso ya ho sebetsana le diphephetso tsa eneji e fumantshwa tjhesehelo e matla.

src: The War Room established by Cabinet in December 2014 led by the Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa is moving to fast-track the implementation of a five-point plan to turn the current situation around.8 Cabinet joins the President Zuma in conveying its condolences to the family and friends of the Afrikaans literary giant Profssor André Brink.
tgt: War Room e theilweng ke Kabinete ka Tshitwe 2014 e eteletsweng pele ke Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa e sebetsa ka thata ho akofisa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha morero o ntlha di hlano tsa ho fetola maemo a hajwale.

src: Cabinet also expresses its confidence in the ongoing facilitation work of the SADC Observer Mission to Lesotho under the leadership of Deputy President Ramaphosa.
tgt: Kabinete e imatahanya le Moporesidente Zuma ka ho fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho ba lelapa le metswalle ya senatla sa bongodi ba Seaforikanse Moporofesara André Brink.

src: As part of the decisions of the SADC Troika Heads of State and Government, South Africa will play its part by leading and forming part of the SADC Election Observer Mission to the Kingdom of Lesotho, for the scheduled election on 28 February 20.2 The Commander in Chief of the South African National Defence Force, President Jacob Zuma will be the main officiating functionary at the Armed Forces Day Celebration under the theme “A professional and capable defence force for the people of South Africa” on 21 February 2015, in Potchefstroom, North West.
tgt: O tla hopolwa jwaloka e mong wa bangodi ba ka sehloohong ba Seaforikanse ya sebedisitseng talente ya hae ya bongodi ho bua kgahlanong le mmuso wa kgethollo.5 Diketsahalo tse tlang.1 Kabinete e thathiselletsa kgoeletso ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma bakeng sa mekga yohle Lesotho ho sebetsa ka tsela e tla bopa maemo a matle bakeng sa ho tshwara dikgetho tse nang le kgotso, ponaletso, tsa nnete, le tse lokolohileng le ho hloka leeme, mme kahoo di bontsha thato ya setjhaba.

src: Armed Forces Day is celebrated annually in honour of the men and women in uniform who selflessly serve the nation at home and abroad.3 Cabinet encourages all employers who have complied with the Employment Equity (EE) Act to enter the Employment Equity Awards 2015 before the closing date of 13 March 2015.This event hosted by the Commission for Employment Equity, recognises employers who have implemented strategies that ensure employment equity and diversity, while eliminating all unfair discriminatory practices.4 Tourism Minister Derek Hanekom will deliver the opening address at Meetings Africa taking place at Sandton Convention Centre from 23 to 25 February 2015 under the theme: “Advancing Africa Together”.
tgt: Kabinete hape e hlahisa boitshepo ba yona mosebetsing wa bonamodi ba Moifo wa Mokgatlo wa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) wa Tekolo ya Dikgetho ho la Lesotho tlasa boetapele ba Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Ramaphosa.

src: This is the South Africa National Convention Bureau’s premier business trade show, which brings together African exhibitors and prospective international clients.5 Cabinet approved the hosting by South Africa of the World Economic Forum (WEF) - Africa, at the Cape Town International Convention Centre (CTCC) from 3 to 5 June 2015.
tgt: Jwaloka karolo ya diqeto tsa Dihlooho tsa Puso ya Troika tsa SADC le Mmuso, Aforika Borwa e tla bapala karolo ya yona ka ho eta pele le ho ba karolo ya Moifo wa SADC wa Tekolo ya Dikgetho ho Mmuso wa Lesotho, bakeng sa dikgetho tse rerilweng tsa la 28 Hlakola 20.2 Molaodi ya ka Sehloohong wa Sesole sa Naha sa Aforika Borwa, Moporesidente Jacob Zuma e tla ba mohlanka ya ka sehloohong moketeng wa Letsatsi la Mabotho a Hlometseng tlasa mookotaba “Lebotho la tshireletso la boporofeshenale le nang le bokgoni bakeng sa batho ba Aforika Borwa” ka la 21 Hlakola 2015, ho la Potchefstroom, Leboya Bophirima.

src: Implementation of key government programmes.
tgt: Ho kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Mananeo a Bohlokwa a Mmuso.

src: Cabinet welcomed the 2015 National Budget that will drive the implementation of the nine-point plan presented by the President during his State of the Nation Address.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse Tekanyetso ya Naha ya 2015 e tla kganna ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha morero o ntlha di robong tse ileng tsa tekwa ke Moporesidente nakong ya hae ya Puo ya Boemo ba Naha.

src: This budget provides certainty, stability and prudent fiscal management necessary to take the South African economy through these tough economic conditions.
tgt: Tekanyetso ena e fana ka bonnete, botsitso le taolo e hlwahlwa ya ditjhelete tse hlokahalang bakeng sa ho tsamaisa moruo wa Aforika Borwa hara maemo ana a boima a moruo.

src: Cabinet reiterates that the tax measures introduced in the 2015 National Budget are necessary to support the fiscus in the year ahead.
tgt: Kabinete e boeletsa hore mekgwa ya lekgetho e tsebisitsweng Tekanyetsong ya Naha ya 2015 e ya hlokahala bakeng sa ho tshehetsa ditjhelete selemong sena se ka pele ho rona.

src: South Africans are encouraged to work together with government to counteract the current economic conditions to stimulate further economic growth.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho sebetsa mmoho le mmuso ho lwantshana le maemo a hajwale a moruo bakeng sa ho susumetsa kgolo ya moruo ho ya pele.2 Kabinete e thoholetsa mosebetsi o kgabane o entsweng ke Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa ka ho thusa ka dikgetho tse lokolohileng le ho hloka leeme ka hara Lesotho mosebetsing wa hae jwaloka Motsamaisi wa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC).

src: Cabinet commends the sterling work done by the Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa in facilitating the free and fair elections in Lesotho in his role as the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Facilitator.
tgt: Kabinete hape e thoholetsa Lekgotla la Boeletsi la Dikgetho (EAC) la SADC, Khomishene ya Dikgetho ya Lesotho (LEC), Mabotho a Tshireletso le batho ba Lesotho bakeng sa ho tshwara dikgetho tsa kgotso, tse lokolohileng le ho hloka leeme.

src: Cabinet also commends the SADC Electoral Advisory Council (EAC), the Lesotho Electoral Commission (LEC), the security forces and the people of Lesotho for holding a peaceful, free and fair election.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e tla sebetsa le mmuso o motjha o kgethilweng wa Lesotho ho ntshetsapele moruo wa dinaha tsena tse pedi, Lebatowa la Aforika e Borwa le Kontinente ka bophara.3 Kabinete e ananela le ho amohela bonkakarolo ba Aforika Borwa ho tshwayeng ha Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Diphoofolo tse hlaha ka la 3 Hlakubele 2015.

src: South Africa will work with the newly elected government of Lesotho to develop the economy of the two countries, the southern African region and the continent as a whole.
tgt: Tlasa boetapele ba Letona Molewa Aforika Borwa e tswela pele ho kenya tshebetsong mananeo a tshireletsang tikoloho ya naha le ntwa kgahlanong le botsomi bo seng molaong.

src: Key amongst these is the placement of the Green Scorpions at OR Tambo International Airport.
tgt: Sa bohlokwa hara tsena ke ho behwa ha Sepolesa sa tsa Tlhaho Boemafofaneng ba Matjhaba ba O. Tambo.

src: This is to ensure compliance with the Threatened or Protected Species Regulations, CITES Regulations, Bio-prospecting, Access and Benefit-Sharing Regulations and the Alien and Invasive Species Regulations.
tgt: Sena ke ho netefatsa boimatahanyo le Melawana ya Mefuta e Kotsing kapa e Tshireleditsweng ya Diphoofolo, Melawana ya Khonferense ya Mekga bakeng sa Seboka sa Kgwebo ya Matjhaba bakeng sa Dibopuwa tse Kotsing tsa Diphoofolo le Dimela tse Hlaha (CITES), Botsomi naheng, Melawana ya Phumantsho le Karolelano ya Melemo le Melawana ya Mefuta ya Diphoofolo tsa Mekenella.

src: South Africa has also played a key role in engaging with Interpol, particularly on the Advisory Board of the Environmental Compliance and Enforcement Committee, and in the three Interpol crime-working groups namely Wildlife Crime Working Group, Fisheries Crime Working Group and the Pollution Crime Working Group.
tgt: Aforika Borwa hape e bapetse karolo ya bohlokwa tshebedisanong le Interpol, haholoholo ho Boto ya Boeletsi ya Boimatahanyo le Tikoloho le Komiti ya Bophethahatsi, mme ka hara dihlopha tse tharo tsa Interpol tsa tshebetso tseo e leng Sehlopha sa Tshebetso sa Botlokotsebe ba Diphoofolo tse Hlaha, sa Botlokotsebe ba Botshwasi ba Ditlhapi le sa Botlokotsebe ba Tshilafatso ya Tikoloho.4 Kabinete e elelletswe hore Durban e entse boiketo ba ho tshwara Dipapadi tsa Matjhaba tsa Commonwealth tsa 2022, bo entsweng semmuso London ka la 2 Hlakubele 2015.

src: Cabinet noted that Durban has bid to host the 2022 Commonwealth Games, which was formally lodged in London on 2 March 2015.
tgt: Ho tshwarwa ha dipapadi tsena ho ka tla le bokgoni ba ho hlahisa mesebetsi e ka bang 11 650 le ho Phahamisa moruo wa naha ka tjhelete e akantsweng ho R20 bilione.

src: Hosting of these games can potentially create approximately 11 650 jobs and boost the country’s economy by an estimated R20 billion.
tgt: Lefa le leng la Dipapadi e tla ba mokgwa wa dipalangwang tsa setjhaba o hokahantsweng bakeng sa Durban moo merero ya teng e seng e tjhaelletswe monwana.

src: Key Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Diqeto tsa Bohlokwa tsa Kabinete.

src: Cabinet approved the Broadcasting Digital Migration Amendment Policy with the inclusion of the control system in the Set Top Box (STB), which will be clearly defined when the policy is published.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Leano la Sehlomathiso sa ho Fetolwa ha Mokgwa wa Kgaso ka ho kenyeletswa ha mokgwa wa taolo ho Mabokose a kengwang Hodimo a Thelevishene (STB), o tla hlaloswa ka ho hlaka ha leano le se le phatlaladitswe.

src: Government will provide free STBs to more than 5 million poor television household owners.
tgt: Mmuso o tla fana ka STB mahala ho beng ba malapa a futsanehileng a fetang dimilione tse hlano.

src: The priority will be given to those households in the border region areas of the country.
tgt: Ho tla shejwa pele malapa a phelang dibakeng tsa mabatowa a meeding ya naha.

src: The Minister of Communications will announce the digital signal switch on and analogue signal switch off date shortly.2 Cabinet approved the five year Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries Strategic Framework and Agricultural Policy Action Plan.
tgt: Letona la Dikgokahanyo le tla tsebisa ka letsatsi la ho bulwa ha letshwao la dijithale le la ho kwalwa ha mokgwa wa Analoko haufinyane.2 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana morero wa dilemo tse hlano wa lewa la moralo wa Temo, Meru le Botshwasi ba Ditlhapi le Leano la Moralo wa Tshebetso wa Temo.

src: The Framework sets out the key challenges faced by the three sectors and propose interventions in the four areas namely equity and transformation equitable growth and competitiveness, environmental sustainability and governance.
tgt: Moralo o teka diphephetso tsa bohlokwa tse tobilweng ke makala a mararo le ho sisinya boitshunyako dibakeng tse nne e leng Tekatekano le diphethoho kgolo e lekalekanang le phehisano, paballo ya tikoloho le taolo.

src: The strategy and the action plan will be updated on an annual basis.
tgt: Lewa le morero wa tshebetso di tla behwa sehlohlolong selemo ka seng.

src: Land distribution is one of government programmes that has promoted equity, but so far without accomplishing a great deal by way of transformation.
tgt: Karolelano ya mobu ke le leng la mananeo a mmuso le hodisitseng tekatekano, empa ho fihlela mona ha e so fihlelle ho hongata ka tsela ya diphethoho.

src: Whereas the reconstruction and development programme declared that the main purpose of land distribution was to alter the structure of South African agriculture, it also seeks to support the sectors so as to grow the economy and create jobs.
tgt: Leha lenaneo la kahobotjha le ntshetsopele le tekile hore sepheo se seholo sa karolelano ya naha e ne e le ho fetola sebopeho sa Temo ya Aforika Borwa, hape e batla ho tshehetsa makala hore ho hodiswe moruo le ho hlahisa mesebetsi.3 Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa Seboka sa Lefatshe sa Dipetlele sa bo40 sa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Dipetlele se tla tshwarelwa Durban ho ya mafelong a 2016.

src: Cabinet approved for the International Hospital Federation 40th World Hospital Congress to be held in Durban towards the end of 2016.
tgt: Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Dipetlele ke mokgatlo wa lefatshe o ikemetseng, o sa etseng phaello, oo e seng wa mmuso bakeng sa dipetlele le mokgatlo wa tlhokomelo ya kalafo.

src: The annual congress affords the health practitioners an opportunity to, share best practice methodologies / approaches to improve healthcare outcomes.
tgt: Seboka sa selemo ka seng se neha basebeletsi ba kalafo monyetla wa ho arolelana mekgwa ya tshebetso ya dikatamelo tse hlwahlwa ka ho fetisisa tsa ho ntlafatsa diphetho tsa tlhokomelo ya kalafo.4 Kabinete e etsa boipiletso ho batswadi ho itahlela ka setotswana ho Dikgetho tsa Makgotlataolo a Dikolo (di-SGB) tsa 2015 tse tla tshwarwa dikolong tsohle tsa setjhaba ho tloha ka la 6 ho ya ho la 28 Hlakubele 2015.

src: Cabinet calls on parents to actively get involved in the 2015 School Governing Body (SGB) elections that will take place in all public schools from 6 to 28 March 2015.
tgt: Di-SGB di nehela ntshetsopeleng ya maikutlo a matla a ho ba beng ba dikolo tsa rona.

src: The SGBs contribute in the development of a strong sense of community ownership to our schools.
tgt: Tshebetso ya dikolo ka kakaretso ho kenyeletswa le ho sebetsa hantle dithutong ho a ntlafala ha batswadi ba itahletse ka setotswana le ho ba le kgahleho mererong ya sekolo.

src: The general performance of schools, including academic achievement, tends to improve when parents are actively involved and take an interest in the affairs of the school.
tgt: Ditho tsa SGB tse fetang 250 000 di kgethwa dilemong tse ding le tse ding tse tharo ho sebetsa dikolong tsa rona tsa setjhaba di kopane ka morero o tshwanang, ho etsa thuto ntlha ya mannete ya setjhaba.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of two Bills, both amending the Children’s Act, 2005 (Act No.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa ha Dibili tse pedi, tseo bobedi di hlomathisang Molao wa Bana, 2005 (Molao wa 38 wa 2005) jwaloka ha o hlomathisitswe ke Molao wa 41 wa 2007, ho Palamente.

src: The amendments respond to court judgments, which declared certain sections of the Act unconstitutional.
tgt: Dihlomathiso di arabela ho dikahlolo tsa makgotla a dinyewe, tse behileng hore dikarolo tse itseng tsa Molao di kgahlanong le Molao wa Motheo.

src: Children’s Amendment Bill, 2015 (section 75 Bill) – The amendments addresses the definition of “sexual offence” and aligns it to the Criminal Law (sexual offences and related matters) Amendment Act No 32 of 2007.
tgt: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Bana, 2015 (karolo 75 ya Bili) – Dihlomathiso di shebana le tlhaloso ya “tlolo ya molao wa motabo” le ho imatahanya le Molao wa Botlokotsebe (ditlolo tsa molao wa motabo le mabaka a tsamaelanang) ya sehlomathiso sa Molao wa 32 wa 2007.

src: The amendments also deal with allowing the child offenders to make representations before their names are included in the National Protection Register.
tgt: Dihlomathiso hape di sebetsana le ho dumella batlodi ba molao ba bana ho etsa ditlhahiso pele mabitso a bona a kenyeletswa ho Rejisetara ya Naha ya Tshireletso.

src: The proposed amendments also clarify the requirement for placing a child in foster care and provides for additional categories of children who may be adopted.
tgt: Dihlomathiso tse sisintsweng hape di hlakisa tlhoko ya ho beha ngwana tlhokomelong le ho fana ka mekgahlelo ya tlatsetso bakeng sa bana ba ka nkuwang ke batswadi bao e seng ba bona ka madi.

src: Children’s Second Amendment Bill, 2015 (section 76 Bill) - aims to ensure that all children enjoy services and benefits aimed at facilitating access to social care and safety and to create an effective social welfare system.
tgt: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya bobedi ya Bana, 2015 (karolo 76 ya Bili) – se rerile ho netefatsa hore bana bohle ba fumana ditshebeletso le melemo e reretsweng ho thusa ka phumantsho ya tlhokomelo ya kahisano le tshireletso le ho bopa mokgwa wa thekolohelo ya kahisano o hlwahlwa.

src: It also seeks to provide a safe and protective environment for the placement of children who are found to be in need of care and protection.
tgt: Hape e batla ho fana ka tikoloho e bolokehileng le e tshireletsehileng bakeng sa ho falliswa ha bana bao ho fumanehang hore ba hloka tlhokomelo le tshireletso.

src: Cabinet’s position on current issues.
tgt: Maemo a Kabinete Mabapi le Dintlha tsa Hajwale.

src: Cabinet condemns in strongest terms the leaking of documents that may put the security of the country in jeopardy.
tgt: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ka matla, ho nyenyelepa ha ditokomane tse ka behang tshireletso ya naha tsietsing.

src: While it is an international practice for countries to share intelligence on, among others, cross-cutting issues pertaining to economic opportunities and security matters, the purported leak of documents detailing operations of the State Security Agency is illegal.
tgt: Leha e le tshebetso ya matjhaba e tlwaelehileng bakeng sa dinaha ho arolelana mautlwela, hara tse ding, dintlha tse paroletsang tse amanang le menyetla ya moruo le mabaka a tshireletso, ho nyenyelepa ho bolelwang ha ditokomane tse hlahisang ditshebetso tsa Lekala la Tshireletso ya Puso ha ho molaong.

src: Cabinet welcomes the State Security Agency’s full investigation into the matter and reassures South Africans that the State Security Agency will continue to focus on its mandate to protect and secure the integrity of the country, its citizens and infrastructure.
tgt: Kabinete e ananela dipatlisiso ka botlalo tsa Lekala la Tshireletso ya Puso tabeng ena le ho netefaletsa maAforika Borwa hore Lekala la Tshireletso ya Puso le tla tswela pele ho tsepamisa maikutlo thomong ya lona ya ho tshireletsa le ho baballa seriti sa naha, baahi ba yona le dikaho tsa motheo.

src: Cabinet reiterates the message by the Minister of State Security, Minister David Mahlobo, that such conduct undermines operational effectiveness of the work to secure the country and its borders.
tgt: Kabinete e boeletsa molaetsa wa Letona la Tshireletso ya Puso, Letona David Mahlobo, hore boitshwaro bo jwalo bo nyenyefatsa bohlwahlwa ba tshebetso ba mosebetsi wa ho baballa naha le meedi ya yona.

src: Cabinet welcomes the announcement by Eskom that Unit 6 of Medupi Power Station produced its first power this week, making it the first of its six units to be synchronised.
tgt: Kabinete e ananela tsebiso ya Eskom ya hore Yuniti ya bo 6 ya Seteishene sa Motlakase sa Medupi e qadile ho hlahisa motlakase wa yona wa pele bekeng ena, ho e etsa ya pele ya diyuniti tsa yona tse tshelela hore e kenngwe tshebetsong.

src: Synchronisation is the process whereby the generator is electrically connected to the national power grid.
tgt: Ho kenngwa tshebetsong ke tsela eo ka yona sefehlamatla se hokelwang ka motlakase ho marangrang a naha a motlakase.

src: Whilst we continue to work towards increasing the power supply in the national grid, Cabinet calls on the public to continue adhering to the energy saving measures.
tgt: Ha re ntse re tswela pele ho sebeletsa tabeng ya ho eketswa ha phepelo ya motlakase ho marangrang a naha, Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho setjhaba ho tswela pele ho imatahanya le mekgwa ya ho baballa eneji.

src: Communities are encouraged to use electricity sparingly, while we continue to introduce other alternative sources of energy.3 Cabinet commends the bravery, commitment, dedication and hard work of the men and women who are working tirelessly to save lives and prevent damage to property, livestock and our prestigious natural environment that were engulfed by the veld fires in Cape Town.
tgt: Badudi ba kgothaletswa ho boloka motlakase, ha re tswella ho hlahisa mehlodi e meng ya eneji.3 Kabinete e thoholetsa sebete, boitlamo, boitelo le mosebetsi o matla wa banna le basadi ba sebetsang ka thata ho pholosa bophelo le ho thibela tshenyo ya thepa, mehlape le tikoloho ya tlhaho tse neng di kupeditswe ke mello e hlaha ho la Motse Kapa.

src: Cabinet expresses its gratitude to the communities that in the spirit of Ubuntu, partnered with government in setting up mass care centres to accommodate those who have been displaced.
tgt: Kabinete e hlahisa teboho ya yona ho badudi ka moya wa Botho, ka kopanelo le mmuso ka ho theha ditsha tsa tlhokomelo ya bongata ho thusa ba lahlehetsweng ke bodulo.

src: The spirit of volunteerism displayed by people who are assisting the victims of fires is enormous and encouraging.4 Cabinet remains concerned about the attacks of foreign nationals and warns that the law enforcement agencies will continue to have a strong presence in affected areas, and that perpetrators will face the full might of the law.
tgt: Moya wa boithaopi o bontshitsweng ke batho ba neng ba thusa diphofu tsa mello ke o moholo le o kgothatsang.4 Kabinete e dula e ngongorehile ka ditlhaselo tsa melata mme e hlokomedisa hore makala a kgatello ya molao a tla tswela pele ho iponahatsa ka bongata dibakeng tse amehang, mme batlodi ba molao ba tla kopana le letsoho le matla la molao.

src: Violence against foreign nationals is being addressed decisively through various existing government structures.
tgt: Dikgoka kgahlanong le melata di shebuwe ka leihlo le ntjhotjho le ho sebetswa ka dibopeho tse fapaneng tse teng tsa Mmuso.5 Kabinete e thoholetsa Sehlopha sa bolo sa Aforika Borwa sa ba ka Tlasa Dilemo tse 17 (U17), Amajimbos, bakeng sa ho etsa naha motlotlo ka ho atleha ho kenela makgaolakgang a 2015 a Bompodi ba Aforika ba U17 Niamey, ho la Niger.

src: Cabinet congratulates the South African National Under-17 football team, the Amajimbos, for making the country proud by qualifying for the final of the 2015 African Under-17 Championship in Niamey, Niger.
tgt: Mosebetsi wa bona o babatsehang ho Bompodi ba Batjha ba Aforika o ba dumella ho kenela Mohope wa Lefatshe wa FIFA wa U17 ho la Chile hamorao selemong sena.6 Kabinete e utlwisitswe bohloko ke ho hlokahala ha mohale wa mmino wa Aforika Borwa Zayn Adam, sephoko se hlwahlwa sa sehlopha se matla sa di-70 Pacific Express eo mosebetsi wa hae o nkileng ho feta dilemo tse E ne e le ntho e le nngwe le nalane ya mmino ya Motse Kapa.7 Kabinete e thabile hore, jwaloka letshwao la nnete la mmuso o kgathallang, mokgahlelo wa ho qetela wa ho busetsa masalla oohle a maAforika Borwa a ileng a timela ho putlameng ha ntlo ya baeti eo e leng ya Synagogue Church of All Nation (SCOAN) ho la Lagos o phethetswe.

src: Their gallant performance at the African Youth Championship qualifies them for the FIFA U17 World Cup in Chile later this year.
tgt: Mehopolo ya rona e na le ba malapa ba lahlehetsweng ke baratuwa ba bona le ba lemetseng mahlomoleng ao.5 Diketsahalo tse tlang.1 Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o tla etsa puo pulong ya Ntlo ya Naha ya Baetapele ba Setso Palamenteng, Motse Kapa ka la 5 Hlakubele 2015 (kajeno).

src: Cabinet mourned the passing of one of South Africa’s musical legends Zayn Adams, a renowned lead vocalist for the seminal 70s outfit Pacific Express, whose career spanned more than 50 years.
tgt: Kamano dipakeng tsa mmuso le baetapele ba setso e hlokolosi bakeng sa ho aha metse ya mahae e kganyang, e lekalekanang le ya moshwelella.2 Kabinete e ananela ho kgutla ha bahale ba hlomphehang ba ntwa ya tokoloho J.

src: President Jacob Zuma will address the opening of the National House of Traditional Leaders in Parliament, Cape Town on 5 March 2015 (today).
tgt: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o laetse hore Folakga ya Naha e fofele hare ho tloha ka la 9 Hlakubele ho fihlela bosiung ba la 22 Hlakubele 2015.

src: Cabinet welcomes the return of the mortal remains of renowned struggle icons JB Marks and Moses Kotane to South Africa from Russia where they were buried 42 years ago.
tgt: Selemong se fetileng molwantshi wa kgethollo ya hlomphehang, raditaba Nat Nakasa o ile a busetswa ka katleho ho tswa New York hore a tlo patwa botjha Setsheng sa Bafu sa Bahale Chesterville, Durban.3 Kabinete e ananela letsholo le matla le pharaletseng la ho hlolwa le ho etsa diteko tsa Lefuba (TB) le tla thakgolwa ke Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa ka la 24 Hlakubele 2015 e leng Letsatsi la Lefatshe la TB, Seterekeng sa Ngaka Kenneth Kaunda sa Porofense ya Leboya Bophirima – tlasa mookotaba “Phediso ya lefu la TB Aforika Borwa: Ho akofisa karabelo ya rona Ditjhabeng tse ka Sehloohong”.

src: These selfless leaders, who are regarded as the fathers of the liberation struggle and had inspired stalwarts such as Nelson Mandela, Oliver Tambo and Walter Sisulu, will receive special official funerals.
tgt: Letsholo lena la nako e telele le tla susumetsa maAforika Borwa oohle haholoholo ba dulang metseng ya merafo, batshwaruwa ba leng tjhankaneng le ditsing tsa ntshetsopele ya thuto ya pele ya bana hore ba hlolwe le ho etswa diteko bakeng sa TDilemong tse hlano tse fetileng ho entswe mehato e meholo bakeng sa ho matlafatsa mawa a mmuso a taolo ya TB ka ho hlolwa le diteko tse ekeditsweng haholoholo ka Dikeletso tsa Kgothatso tsa HIV le letsholo la Diteko.

src: President Jacob Zuma has instructed that the National Flag fly at half-mast from 9 March until the evening of 22 March 2015.
tgt: Dikgetho bakeng sa Dikgau tsa Botitjhere tsa Naha di ananela nehelo e kgethehileng eo matitjhere a e etsang bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya naha ya rona Mokete wa Dikgau o tla tshwarwa ka la 7 Hlakubele 2015 Gallagher Estate, ho la Midrand.

src: Moses Kotane will be reburied in Pella, North West on 14 March 2015 and JB Marks in Ventersdorp, North West on 22 March 2015.
tgt: Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le tshwara ketsahalo ena ya selemo ka seng ho isa tlhompho ho matitjhere a itetseng, a itlammeng, a sebetsang ka thata le a seporofeshenale.5 Letona la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya Dikgwerekgwere, Letona Nomvula Mokonyane le tla thakgola Beke ya Naha ya Metsi tulong e hlasetsweng ke komello ya KwaDukuza ho la KwaZulu-Natal ka la 16 Hlakubele 2015 tlasa mookotaba: “Ha ho se ka nkelang Metsi Sebaka”.

src: Cabinet welcomes the massive comprehensive TB screening and testing campaign to be launched by the Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa on 24 March 2015 which is World TB Day, at Dr Kenneth Kaunda District of the North West province – under the theme “Ending South Africa’s TB epidemic: Accelerating our response in Key Populations”.
tgt: Kabinete e hopotsa maAforika Borwa oohle hore re phela naheng eo ho yona metsi a haellang le ho kgothaletsa bohle ho a boloka, ka ho lokisa ho dutla hwa dipeipi le ho phela ka ho hlalefela metsi.6 Sontaha, 8 Hlakubele, e tshwaya Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Basadi (IWD) e leng letsatsi le sebediswang selemo ka seng lefatshe ka bophara ho shebela morao kgatelongpele e entsweng, kgoeletso bakeng sa diphethoho le ho keteka diketso tsa sebete le maikemisetso ke basadi ba tlwaelehileng ba bapetseng karolo e kgolohadi nalaneng ya metse ya bona le dinaha tsa bona.

src: This life-long campaign will mobilise all South Africans, in particular those living in mining communities, inmates at correctional facilities and early childhood development centres, to be screened and tested for WEBTOKEN the past five years great strides have been made to strengthen government’s strategies for TB control with increased screening and testing especially through the HIV Counselling and Testing campaign.
tgt: Lefapha la Basadi le tla etella pele mekete ya IWD Sekolong se Phahameng sa Langa ho la Motse Kapa tlasa mookotaba, “Ditokelo tsa Basadi ke Ditokelo tsa Botho: Mmoho re Ntshetsa Aforika Borwa e hlokang Dikgoka pele”.

src: Screening and testing has been further boosted by the introduction of the rapid diagnostic tests for TB and drug resistant TCabinet commends the dedication and commitment of our teachers, without whom we would not have been able to achieve many of our national goals.
tgt: Mookotaba ona o imatahantse le mookotaba wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng wa: “Tekatekano bakeng sa Basadi ke tswelopele ya bohle!” le pehelo ya Kopano ya Aforika ya selemo sa 2015 e leng “Selemo sa Matlafatso ya Basadi le Ntshetsopele ho ya ho Lenanetsamaiso la Aforika la 2063”.

src: The passing of Minister Ohm Collins Chabane.
tgt: Ho hlokahala ha Letona Ohm Collins Chabane.

src: Cabinet is saddened by the untimely passing of Minister Chabane and his protectors, Sergeants Lesiba Samuel Sekele and Mareme Lawrence Lentsoane, who died in a tragic car crash on Sunday, 15 March 2015.
tgt: Kabinete e utlwisitswe bohloko ke ho hlokahala ka tshohanyetso ha Letona Chabane le batshireletsi ba hae, Bosajene Lesiba Samuel Sekele le Mareme Lawrence Lentsoane, ba hlokahetseng kotsing e sisimosang ya koloi ka Sontaha,sa 15 Hlakubele 2015.

src: Government and the people of South Africa will solely miss the contribution from this servant of the people who remained committed to building a better South Africa until WEBTOKEN a member of the Executive, the late Public Service and Administration Minister will be afforded an Official Funeral Category The funeral service will take place on Saturday, 21 March 2015 at Xikundu village in Malamulele, Limpopo.
tgt: Mmuso le batho ba Aforika Borwa ba tla hopola ka ho sarelwa nyehelo e entsweng ke mohlanka enwa wa setjhaba eo esale a itetse bakeng sa ho aha Aforika Borwa e betere ho isa lefung.

src: President Jacob Zuma will lead the 50th anniversary celebrations of South Africa’s nuclear research reactor SAFARI-1 operated by the National Energy Regulator of South Africa (NERSA) at Pelindaba near Pretoria.
tgt: Jwaloka setho saKabinete, mofu Letona la Tshebeletso ya Setjhaba le Tsamaiso o tla nehwa Lepato la Semmuso la Mokgahlelo wa Tshebeletso ya lepato e tla ba ka Moqebelo wa la 21 Hlakubele 2015 motsaneng wa Xikundu Malamulele, ho la Limpopo.

src: Since its commissioning on 18 March 1965, the reactor, which is a major producer of medical and industrial isotopes for both domestic and international consumption, received many accolades and international accreditation.
tgt: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a maholo ka ho fetisisa ho ba malapa le metswalle ya bafu Letona le batshireletsi ba hae ba babedi.

src: In addition it will also assist in developing detailed plans in selected sectors that require focussed attention to drive economic growth, radical economic transformation and sustainable development.
tgt: Rieketara ena hape e bapetse karolo e hlokolosi diphuputsong tsa nutleleya, ntshetsopeleng le thutong le ho beha Aforika Borwa maemong a pele dikgatelopeleng tsa saense.

src: The amendments include the definition of crimes of aggression and additional acts constituting the war crimes in the Rome Statute adopted by the Assembly of State Parties (in Kampala, Uganda on 11 June 2010).Ratification of these amendments to the Rome Statute by South Africa demonstrates government’s commitment to fight serious crimes against humanity and crime of aggression when committed in or outside our country.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa Palamenteng ha Dihlomathiso ho Molao wa Roma wa Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Matjhaba bakeng sa kamohelo.

src: Cabinet’s position on current issues.
tgt: Maemo a Kabinete mabapi le Dintlha tsa Hajwale.

src: Cabinet notes the responses to the latest round of proposed demarcations and acknowledges that robust debate is an integral part of our democracy.
tgt: Kabinete e ananela dikarabelo ho mokgahlelo wa moraorao wa ditsheho tsa meedi tse sisintsweng le ho amohela hore dingangisano tse matla ke karolo ya demokerasi ya rona.

src: Since there are some municipalities that are struggling to deliver services and remain unsustainable due to insufficient revenue and inadequate governance, municipal boundaries are constantly reviewed.
tgt: Kaha ho na le bomasepala ba bang ba sokolang ho fana ka ditshebeletso le ho hloka ho hatela pele ka lebaka la lekeno le haellang le puso e fokolang, meedi ya bomasepala e dula e shejwa botjha.

src: The proposed changes are first scrutinised by the Municipal Demarcation Board (MDB), which is charged with determining municipal boundaries in accordance with the Local Government: Municipal Demarcation Act, 1998 (Act 27 of 1998) and the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.
tgt: Diphethoho tse sisintsweng di hlahlojwa pele ke Boto ya Tsheho ya Meedi ya Bomasepala (MDB), e laetsweng ho beha meedi ya bomasepala ho ya ka Molao wa Tsheho ya Meedi wa 1998 (Molao 27 wa 1998) wa Bomasepala ba Mebuso ya Lehae le Molaotheowa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996.Jwaloka mokgatlo o ikemetseng, ditsamaiso tsa MDB di a bonaletsa le ho kenyeletsa.

src: Cabinet, encourages communities to actively participate in these processes.
tgt: Kabinete e kgothaletsa badudi ho nka karolo ka matla ditsamaisong tsena.

src: Cabinet condemns the usage of violent protest marches as a means of resolving demarcation disputes.
tgt: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe tshebediso ya mehwanto ya boipelaetso e tletseng dikgoka jwaloka mokgwa wa ho rarolla mathata a tsheho ya meedi.

src: The work of the MDB is an integral part of government’s Back to Basics approach to ensure better delivery of services to communities.
tgt: Mosebetsi waMDB ke karolo ya mmuso ya katamelo ya Ho Boela ho tsa Motheo ho netefatsa phano ya ditshebeletso e betere ho badudi.

src: Cabinet congratulates the Basotho people for a smooth transfer of power and has urged them to work together for lasting peace and economic development.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa Basotho ka phethisetso e bobebe ya puso mme e ba kgothaleditse ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa kgotso ya moshwelella le ntshetsopele ya moruo.

src: Cabinet also congratulated the new Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Lesotho, Right Honourable Pakalitha Mosisili on his election and successful inauguration that took place on Tuesday, 17 March 2015, which was attended by His Excellency President Jacob Zuma and Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa.
tgt: Kabinete hape e thoholeditse Tonakgolo e ntjha ya Mmuso wa Borena ba Lesotho, Mohlomphehi PakalithaMosisili ka ho kgethwa le tlhomamiso e atlehileng e etsahetseng ka Labobedi la 17 Hlakubele 2015, e neng e kenetswe ke Mohlomphehi Moporesidente Jacob Zuma le Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa.

src: Cabinet congratulated the Deputy President on the role he played leading to the successful elections in the Kingdom of Lesotho.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholeditse Motlatsiwa Moporesidente ka karolo eo a e bapetseng ho iseng ho dikgetho tse atlehileng tsa Borena ba Lesotho.

src: It further appreciated the role played by the Southern African Development Community in facilitating a roadmap for peace and elections of the new government.
tgt: O tswetse pele ho ananela karolo e bapetsweng ke Dinaha tse Tswelang pele tsa Aforika e ka Borwa ka ho thusa ka moralo wa tsela bakeng sa kgotso le dikgetho tsa mmuso o motjha.

src: Cabinet reiterated South Africa’s commitment to continue working with the Kingdom of Lesotho to further enhance the existing relations by focusing on strengthening economic and social cooperation that will lead to the improvement of people’s lives.
tgt: Kabinete e boeleditse boitlamo ba Aforika Borwa ba ho tswela pele ho sebetsa mmoho le Borena ba Lesotho ho ntlafatsa dikamano tse teng ka ho tsepamisa maikutlo ho matlafatseng ha tshebedisanommoho ho tsa moruo le kahisano e tla lebisa ntlafatsong ya bophelo ba batho.

src: Upcoming events.
tgt: Diketsahalo tse tlang.

src: Deputy President Ramaphosa will attend the Republic of Namibia’s 25th Independence Anniversary, including the Inauguration of President Hage Geingob in Windhoek on 21 March 2015.
tgt: Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Ramaphosa o tla kenela Sehopotso sa bo-25 sa Boipuso ba Riphaboliki ya Namibia, ho kenyeletsa le Tlhomamiso ya Moporesidente Hage Geingob Windhoek ka la 21 Hlakubele 2015.

src: Cabinet commends Namibia on its Silver Jubilee celebrations and President Geingob on becoming the country’s third Head of State.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa Namibia letsatsing la ho keteka Jubile ya Silivera le Moporesidente Geingob ka ho ba Hlooho ya Puso ya boraro ya naha eo.

src: President Zuma will host Zimbabwe’s President Robert Mugabe from 8 to 9 April 2015 in Pretoria.
tgt: MoporesidenteZuma o tla amohela Moporesidente wa Zimbabwe Robert Mugabe ho tloha ka la 8 ho ya ho la 9 Mmesa 2015 Pretoria.

src: The visit will culminate into the South Africa-Zimbabwe Business Forum scheduled for 9 April 2015, which aims to increase bilateral trade and investment.
tgt: Leeto lena le tla qetella e le phihlello ya Foramo ya kgwebo ya Aforika Borwa-Zimbabwe e reretsweng mohla la 9 Mmesa 2015, e rerileng ho eketsa kgwebisano ya bobedi bona le matsete.

src: President Zuma will on 19 March 2015 launch 95 locomotives in Pretoria that have been built as part of Transnet’s R300 billion capital investment programme to revitalise the country’s freight infrastructure.
tgt: Moporesidente Zuma ka la 19 Mmesa 2015 o tla thakgola dihlooho tsa terene tse 95 Pretoria tse ahilweng e le karolo ya Lenaneo la R300 bilione ya matsete a tjhelete ya dikaho tsa bohlokwa laTransnet ho tsoseletsa dikaho tsa motheo tsa tsamaiso ya dithoto.

src: Over the duration of the investment programme a number of new jobs will be created and local businesses stand to benefit from localisation, skills development and technology transfer.
tgt: Nakong ya lenaneo lena la matsetemesebetsi e mengata e tla hlahiswa le dikgwebo tsa lehae di tla una molemo ho tswa ho tshebediso ya mehlodi ya lehae, ntshetsopele ya bokgoni le phetisetso ya thekenoloji.

src: The new trains will address the country’s rail system backlog and will help improve the productivity and efficiency of our rail network.
tgt: Diterene tsena tse ntjha di tobana le tshallomorao ya mokgwa wa diterene wa naha le ho thusa ho ntlafatsa tlhahiso le bohlwahlwa ba marangrang a rona a diporo.

src: The launch also signals the transformation of Transnet Engineering into a fully-fledged original equipment manufacturer as 85 of the trains were produced at its facility at Koedoespoort, near Pretoria.
tgt: Ho thakgolwa hona hape ho tshwaya phethoho ya Boenjineri ba Transnet ho ba mohlahisi wa thepa e felletseng ya mantlha kaha tse 85 tsa diterene di hlahisitswe setsheng sa bona se Koedoespoort, haufi le Pretoria.

src: President Zuma will open the Black Industrialists Indaba taking place from 25 to 26 March 2015 at Gallagher Convention Centre, Midrand, as part of government’s commitment to develop black industrialists in the country.
tgt: Moporesidente Zuma o tla bulaIndaba ya Boraindaseteri ba Batho ba Batsho e tla tshwarwa ho tloha ka la 25 ho ya ka la 26 Hlakubele 2015 Setsing sa Dikopano sa Gallagher, Midrand, jwaloka karolo ya boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho ntshetsa pele boraindaseteri ba batho ba batsho ka hara naha.

src: The Indaba will foster dialogue between the public and private sector to advance black industrialists, and to radically transform and restructure the economy to achieve inclusive growth.
tgt: Indaba e tla fohla dipuisano pakeng tsa lekala la setjhaba le la poraefete ho ntshetsa pele boraindaseteri ba batho ba batsho, le ho fetola ka matla le ho bopa botjha moruo ho fihlella kgolo e kenyeletsang.

src: President Zuma will address the National Members Assembly (NMA) of the South African Local Government Association, which will take place at Gallagher Convention Centre, Midrand from 24 to 26 March 2015.
tgt: Moporesidente Zuma o tla etsa puo ho Kopano ya Ditho tsa Naha (NMA) ya Mokgatlo wa Aforika Borwa wa Mebuso ya Lehae, e tla tshwarelwa Setsing sa Dikopano sa Gallagher, Midrand ho tloha ka la 24 ho ya ka la 26 Hlakubele 2015.

src: The NMA will reflect on the state of local government after 15 years and discuss strategies to deal effectively with service delivery, capacity building, corruption and issues around the demarcation of municipalities.
tgt: NMA e tla lekola maemo a mebuso ya lehae kamora dilemo tse 15 le ho tshohla mawa a ho sebetsa ka bokgabane le phano ya ditshebeletso, kaho ya bokgoni, bobodu le dintlha tse mabapi le tsheho ya meedi ya bomasepala.

src: The Assembly will be held under the theme: “15 Years of Democratic Local Government – Consolidating and Deepening Vibrant, Developmental and People Centered Local Democracy”.
tgt: Kopano e tla tshwarwa tlasa mookotaba: “Dilemotse15 tsa Mebuso ya Lehae ya Demokerasi – Re matlafatsa le ho Kenyeletsa Demokerasi ya Lehae e shebileng batho ya Ntshetsopele e Kganyang”.

src: South Africans will celebrate the national Human Rights Day event on 21 March 2015 in Uitenhage, Eastern Cape under the theme: “Celebrating the Freedom Charter, Enjoying Equal Human Rights for All”.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a tla keteka ketsahalo ya naha ya Letsatsi la Ditokelo tsa Bothoka la 21 Hlakubele 2015 Uitenhage, ho la Kapa Botjhabela tlasa mookotaba: “Re keteka Tjhata ya Tokoloho, Re ThabelaDitokelo tsa Botho tse Lekanang Bakeng sa Bohle”.

src: These events will provide a platform for all South Africans to commemorate the sacrifices that accompanied the struggle for democracy and our commitment to advance human rights as enshrined in the Constitution.
tgt: Diketsahalo tsena di tla fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa maAforika Borwa oohle ho hopola ho intsha sehlabelo ho neng ho tsamaelana le ntwa bakeng sa demokerasi le boitelo ba rona ba ho ntshetsapele ditokelo tsa botho jwaloka ha di phuthetswe ka hara Molaotheo.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to celebrate this important day by fostering greater social cohesion and nation-building.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa oohle ho keteka letsatsi lena la bohlokwa ka ho fohla momahano e matla ya kahisano le kaho ya setjhaba.

src: As part of Human Rights Month, community dialogues will take place across all provinces to promote interaction among communities of different backgrounds.
tgt: Jwaloka karolo ya Kgwedi ya Ditokelo tsa Botho, dipuisano tsa badudi di tla ba teng ho parola le diporofense tsohle ho kgothaletsa kopakopano ka hara badudi ba ditlwaelo tse fapaneng.

src: This will culminate in the National Social Cohesion Report-back and Monitoring Summit to be held on 30 March 2015 in Port Elizabeth.
tgt: Sena se tla finyella ho Tlaleho ya Naha ya Momahano ya Setjhaba leSeboka sa Bodisa se tla tshwarwa ka la 30 Hlakubele 2015 Port Elizabeth.

src: The Department of Social Development will host the National Social Work Indaba from 24 to 26 March 2015 at the International Convention Centre in Durban under the theme: “Revitalising social work practice in South Africa”.The Indaba will develop proposals and interventions to address matters that impact on the social work practice and align the development mandate of the profession to support government’s radical socio-economic transformation.
tgt: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhabale tla tshwara Indaba ya Naha ya Mesebetsi ya Kahisanoho tloha ka la 24 ho ya ho la 26 Hlakubele 2015 Setsing sa Matjhaba sa Dikopano ho la Durban tlasa mookotaba: “Re tsoseletsa tsamaiso ya mesebetsi ya kahisano ka hara Aforika Borwa”.Indaba ena e tla hlahisa ditshisinyo le boitshunyako bakeng sa ho tobana le dintlha tse nang le kgahlamelo hodima tsamaiso ya mesebetsi ya kahisano le ho matahanya thomo ya ntshetsopele ya lekala bakeng sa ho tshehetsa phethoho e matla ya mmuso ya moruo wa kahisano.

src: To accomplish this, the department has rolled out a scholarship programme to fund students studying social work at universities.
tgt: Ho fihlella sena, lefapha le fanne ka lenaneo la ho ithuta bakeng sa ho thusa ka ditjhelete baithuti ba ithutang mesebetsi ya kahisano diyunivesithing.

src: The Department of Social Development will also hold the 2nd Anti-Fraud and Corruption Conference from 30 to 31 March 2015 at St George’s Hotel, Centurion under the theme: “Ensuring human rights for all through a fraud free social grants system”.
tgt: Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba hape le tla tshwara Khonferense ya bo-2 e Kgahlanong le Boqhekanyetsi le Boboduho tloha ka la 30 ho ya ho la 31 Hlakubele 2015Hoteleng ya St George’s, Centurion tlasa mookotaba: “Re netefatsa ditokelo tsa botho tsa bohle ka tsamaiso e hlokang boqhekanyetsi ditjheleteng tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba”.

src: The conference will evaluate the current measures to root out corruption within the social grant system.
tgt: Khonferense e tla lekola mekgwa ya hajwale ya ho hlaola bobodu ka hara tsamaiso ya dithuso tsa setjhaba.

src: Cabinet welcomes the hosting of the inaugural basketball Four Nations Challenge taking place at Wembley Stadium, Johannesburg from 19 to 22 March 2015.
tgt: Kabinete e ananela ho tshwarwa hapulo ya papadi ya baseketebolo ya Tlhodisano ya Dinaha tse Nnee tla etsahala Lebaleng la Dipapadi la Wembley, Johannesburg ho tloha ka la 19 ho ya ka la 22 Hlakubele 2015.

src: This brings the senior men’s teams of South Africa, Nigeria, Mozambique and Kenya together in what is envisaged to become an annual event.
tgt: Sena se tlisa mmoho dihlopha tse kgolo tsa banna tsa Aforika Borwa, Nigeria, Mozambique le Kenya ho seo ho hopolwang hore e tla ba ketsahalo ya selemo ka seng.

src: Cabinet congratulates our cricket team, which has advanced to the semis with a nine-wicket win over Sri Lanka in their World Cup match.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa sehlopha sa rona sa kirikete, se tswetseng pele ho ya ho seka-makgaolakgang ka tlholo ya diwikete tse robong kgahlanong le Sri Lanka papading ya bona ya Mohope wa Lefatshe.

src: We wish the team and the coach well as they proceed with the rest of the tournament.
tgt: Re lakaletsa sehlopha le mokwetlisi mahlohonolo ha ba ntse ba tswela pele ka thonamente.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di tla lokela ke ho netefatswa ha mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.

src: Government Sector Education and Training WEBTOKEN Gugu Dlamini as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO).
tgt: Bookamedi ba Mmuso ba Lekala la Thuto le ThupelloMofumahadi Gugu Dlamini jwaloka Mohlanka ya ka Sehloohong wa Phethahatso (CEO).

src: Recent spate of attack on foreign nationals.
tgt: 1.Letoto la ditlhaselo tsa moraorao tjena tsa Melata.1 Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ka matla diketso tsa merusu ya moraorao tjena kgahlanong le melata.

src: Cabinet condemns in the strongest terms the recent acts of violence against foreign nationals.
tgt: Ha jwale, Kabinete e rata ho fetisa matshediso a yona a tebileng ho malapa a bohle ba lahlehetsweng ke bophelo le pholo e potlakileng ho ba lemetseng.

src: No amount of frustration or anger can justify these attacks and looting of shops.
tgt: Ha ho boholo ba ho teneha le ho kgena bo ka dumellang ditlhaselo tsena le kgapo ya thepa ka mahahapa mabenkeleng.

src: Whilst noting the issues raised by communities, violence towards another fellow human being can never solve these issues.
tgt: Le ha re ananela mabaka a hlahiswang ke badudi, merusu kgahlanong le batho ba bang di keke tsa rarolla dintlha tsena.

src: Rather, it reflects badly on us as a people, going against the very ideals and foundations of our democracy.
tgt: Empa, sena se re hlahisa hampe jwaloka batho, re le kgahlanong le mehopolo le metheo ya demokerasi ya rona.

src: South Africa fought against colonialism and Apartheid alongside fellow Africans so that all humanity in our continent should be respected and treated with dignity.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e lwanne kgahlanong le bokoloniale le Kgethollo mmoho le maAforika a bo rona hore batho bohle ka hara kontinente ya rona ba hlomphuwe le ho tshwarwa ka seriti.2 Kgahlamelo ya ditlhaselo tsena e na le ditlamorao tse matla hodima moruo wa rona, kahisano le ho dikamano tsa rona tsa sepolotiki kontinenteng le lefatsheng.

src: The impact of these attacks has far reaching implications on our economic, social and relations with the continent and the world.
tgt: Dikhamphani tsa Aforika Borwa tse nang le dikgwebo tse atlehileng ka hara kontinente tse thusang ka ho nyehela lekenong la rona le ho tsitsisa moruo wa rona di ka tloha tsa iphumana di le maemong a tshwanang le ana.

src: Recently, South African artists who were to showcase their craft outside our borders of our country, such as BigNuz in Zimbabwe, Kelly Khumalo and Casper in London, have had their concerts cancelled as a result of these attacks.
tgt: Moraorao tjena, dibini tsa Aforika Borwa tse neng di lokela ho ya bontsha makgabane a tsona ka ntle ho meedi ya rona, tse kang BigNuz ho la Zimbabwe, Kelly Khumalo le Casper ho la London, dikonsarete tsa bona di phumutswe ka lebaka la ditlhaselo tsena.

src: Many of our communities who relied on shops owned by foreign nationals for their bread and butter are now WEBTOKEN, South Africa enjoys a free country, which was attained through the contribution of a number of the African Countries.
tgt: Boholo ba badudi ba rona ba tshepileng mabenkele a melata bakeng sa ditlhoko tsa bona tsa letsatsi ka leng jwale ba tlaletswe ke naha.

src: Our own late icon, President Oliver Tambo was accommodated for close to 30 years in Zambia and many other South Africans that lived in exile.
tgt: Kajeno, maAforika Borwa a thabela ho ba naha e lokolohileng, e fihlelletsweng ka lebaka la nyehelo ya dinaha tse ngatanyana tsa Aforika.

src: Fellow African countries, did not only host our people, they also contributed resources and some paid the ultimate price and lost their own citizens in the course of South Africa attaining democracy.
tgt: Mofu eo e neng e le qhoku ya rona, Moporesidente Oliver Tambo o dutse nako e ka etsang dilemo tse 30 Zambia le maAforika Borwa a mang a mangata a neng a le palehong.

src: South Africa will never be derailed from pursuing the Pan African vision as encapsulated in AU Agenda 2063, which was since pursued by our forefathers Kwame Nkruma, Azikiwe, Mualimu Julius Nyerere and Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Dinaha tsa habo rona tsa Aforika ha di a fella feela ka ho amohela batho ba rona, hape di ile tsa nyehela ka mehlodi mme tse ding di ile tsa phehisa ha bohloko ka ho lahlehelwa ke baahi ba tsona tseleng ya Aforika Borwa ya ho fihlella demokerasi.

src: President Jacob Zuma has tasked the Justice Crime Prevention and Security Cluster Ministers together with Ministers of Small Business Development, Trade and Industry and Social Development to engage all the relevant parties to seek a solution.
tgt: Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o laetse Moifo wa Matona a Toka ya Thibelo ya Botlokotsebe le Tshireletso mmoho le Matona e leng la Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, la Lefapha la Kgwebo le Indaseteri le la Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba ho kenyeletsa mekga yohle e amehang bakeng sa ho batla tharollo.

src: The ministers have also been tasked to deal with the underlying socio-economic conditions which seems to be at the heart of these attacks, so that this matter can be dealt with decisively and comprehensively.
tgt: Matona a boetse a laetswe ho sebetsana le maemo a moruo wa kahisano a bonahalang eka a motsong wa ditlhaselo tsena, hore taba ena e sebetswe ka matla le ka botlalo.

src: The President has further announced the measures undertaken by the South African National Defence Force to bring control to our borders.
tgt: Moporesidente o ile a tswela pele ho phatlalatsa ditsela tse nkuweng ke Lebotho la Naha la Tshireletso la Aforika Borwa bakeng sa ho tlisa maemo tlasa taolo meeding ya rona.

src: Cabinet calls on all communities, organisations and individuals to join hands against these attacks.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi bohle, mekgatlo le batho ka bo mong ho ipopa kgahlanong le ditlhaselo tsena.

src: South Africa is not a violent country and therefore a few individuals cannot be allowed to hold the whole country at ransom.
tgt: Aforika Borwa ha se naha ya merusu mme kahoo methwaela e seng mekae e keke ya dumellwa ho kenya naha yohle ditlamong.

src: Violence has never been a solution for problems in any society and will never be in South Africa.
tgt: Meruru ha e ya tloha e le tharollo bakeng sa mathata setjhabeng sefe kapa sefe mme ho keke ha ba jwalo le ka hara Aforika Borwa.

src: Not in our name!2.
tgt: E seng lebitsong la rona!2.

src: Cabinet noted the decision by the management of the university to remove the Rhodes statue from the campus of the University of Cape Town.
tgt: Diemahale.1 Kabinete e lemohile qeto ya bolaodi ba yunivesithi ya ho tlosa seemahale sa Rhodes khamaphaseng ya Yunivesithi ya Motse Kapa.

src: South Africa over the last two decades has made huge strides in ensuring that our historical symbols reflect the demographics of our country and our democratic order.
tgt: Aforika Borwa dilemong tse mashome a mabedi tse fetileng e entse menyabuketso e meholo bakeng sa ho netefatsa hore matshwao a rona a nalane a bontsha maemo a baahi ba naha ya rona le tsamaiso ya demokerasi.

src: Cabinet however, acknowledged that the journey of removing the historically offensive symbols and names within our country has not moved fast enough.
tgt: Kabinete le ha ho le jwalo, e ananetse hore leeto la ho tlosa matshwao a nalane a nyenyefatsang le mabitso ka hara naha ya rona ha le ya potlaka ho ya kamoo ho lebeletsweng.

src: Cabinet noted and encourages the current broad debate that have commenced on transformation within our society, noting that transformation has not been fast enough we understand the frustrations of the students.
tgt: Kabinete e lemohile le ho kgothaletsa dingangisano tsa hajwale tse batsi tse qadileng mabapi le diphethoho ka hara setjhaba, le ho lemoha hore diphethoho ha di so ka di potlaka kamoo ho lebeletsweng mme re utlwisisa ho nyahama ha baithuti.

src: We therefore encourage them to follow the processes as defined in our laws.
tgt: Kahoo re ba kgothaletsa ho latela ditsamaiso tse hlaloswang melaong ya rona.2 Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho itahlela ka setotswana ditsamaisong tse ntseng di tswela pele tse eteletsweng pele ke Lefapha la Bonono le Botjhaba mabapi le botjhaba le kaho ya setjhaba.

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to get involved in the ongoing processes led by the Department of Arts and Culture on heritage and nation building.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a hopotswa hore Molao wa Naha wa Mehlodi ya Setso wa 1999 o totobatsa ditsamaiso tsa ditherisano tse lokelang ho latelwa moo ho tshwanelang ho tloswa kapa ho iswa ha diemahale sebakeng se seng.
