tgt: Kabinete hape e fetisetsa kananelo e ikgethang ho sehlopha sa Working on Fire se lwantshitseng mello e neng e befile ka sebete.

src: They are our pride!
tgt: Ke motlotlo wa rona!

src: Cabinet wishes a speedy recovery to the two injured firefighters including Ian Barnard who sustained injuries whilst trying to save Bradley Richards.
tgt: Kabinete e lakaletsa batimamollo ba babedi ba lemetseng ho fola ka potlako ho kenyeletswa Ian Barnard ya ileng a lemala ha a ne a leka ho pholosa Bradley Richards.

src: President Zuma visited the communities of Wit Lokasie and Knysna Heights that were adversely affected by the fires.
tgt: Moporesidente Zuma o etetse badudi ba Wit Lokasie le Knysna Heights ba anngweng ha bohloko ke mello.

src: President Zuma attended the memorial service of Mr Richards.
tgt: Moporesidente Zuma o ile a kenela tshebeletso ya bofifi ya Monghadi Richards.

src: In the true firefighter team spirit, Mr Barnard was able to attend the memorial service of his colleague Mr Richards.
tgt: Ka moya wa nnete wa sehlopha sa batimamollo, Monghadi Barnard o ile a kgona ho ba teng tshebeletsong ya bofifi ya mosebetsi-mmoho le yena Monghadi Richards.

src: The President dispatched humanitarian and other support to all the affected areas.
tgt: Moporesidente o nehelane ka tshehetso ya botho le tshehetso e nngwe dibakeng kaofela tse amehileng.

src: This was coordinated through the National Joint Operations Centre Disaster Management structure, working with the Western Cape Provincial Government and Provincial Disaster Management teams.
tgt: Sena se ile sa hokahanngwa ka sebopeho sa Setsi se Kopanetsweng sa Naha sa Taolo ya Dikoduwa, ka tshebedisano le dihlopha tsa Mmuso wa Porofense wa Kapa Bophirima le Porofense tsa Taolo ya Dikoduwa.

src: Cabinet thanks all non-governmental organisations, the private sector, volunteers and communities who are supporting affected communities.
tgt: Kabinete e leboha mekgatlo yohle eo e seng ya mmuso, lekala la poraefete, baithaopi le badudi ba tshehetsang badudi ba amehileng.

src: Cabinet urges communities in Limpopo bordering Zimbabwe to be vigilant and exercise caution with their chicken stock.
tgt: Kabinete e kgothaletsa badudi ba Limpopo ba arolelanang moedi le Zimbabwe ho fadimeha le ho ela hloko dikgoho tsa bona.

src: This follows a report of an outbreak of a bird and chicken flu virus called H5N.
tgt: Sena se latela tlaleho ya ho ropoha ha kokwanahloko ya ntaramane ya dinonyana le dikgoho e bitswang H5Kgwebisano ka dihlahiswa tsa bommaditshibana ho tswa Zimbabwe e sa fanyehilwe.

src: The H5N8 virus is highly pathogenic and extremely contagious, and leads to a high level of mortality.
tgt: Kokwanahloko ya H5N8 e kgona ho baka mafu a mang haholo le ho tshwaetsana ka ho fetisisa, le ho lebisa maemong a phahameng a ho shwa.

src: Commercial farmers are also encouraged to increase their biosecurity measures on farms.
tgt: Borapolasi ba kgwebo le bona ba kgothaletswa ho eketsa mekgwa ya tshireletso ya tsa tlhaho mapolasing a bona.

src: Cabinet has welcomed the High Court ruling that declared Section 18 of the Criminal Procedure Act, 1977 (Act 51 of 1977) unconstitutional, lifting the 20-year limit to lay criminal charges against those accused of sexual abuse.
tgt: Kabinete e amohetsekahlolo ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Dinyewe le tsebisitseng hore Karolo 18 ya Molao wa Tsamaiso ya Botlokotsebe, 1977 (Molao wabo-51 wa 1977) ha o ipapise le molaotheo, le phahamiseditse moedi ho dilemo tse20 bakeng sa ho ritela dinyewe kgahlanong le ba qoswang ka diketso tsa tlhekefetso ka thobalano.

src: This ruling will go a long way in strengthening our justice system’s capacity to act against those perpetrating violence against women and children.
tgt: Kahlolo ena e tla thusa haholo mabapi le ho matlafatsa bokgoni ba tsamaiso ya rona ya toka bakeng sa ho sebetsa kgahlanong le ba tsitlalletseng merusu kgahlanong le basadi le bana.

src: Cabinet welcomes the recent Internet for All community session held in Kliptown, Soweto.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela tulo ya haufinyana tjena ya badudi ya Inthanete bakeng sa Bohle e neng e tshwaretsweKliptown, Soweto.

src: The session – led by Telecommunications and Postal Services Minister Siyabonga Cwele, in partnership with the World Economic Forum, private sector and civil society – resulted in the training of about 500 young people in basic information and communications technology (ICT) skills.
tgt: Tulo ena– e neng e eteletswe pele ke Letona la Meralo ya Motheo ya Dikgokahanyo le Ditshebeletso tsa PosoSiyabonga Cwele,ka bolekane le Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Moruo, lekala la poraefete le setjhaba ka kakaretso– e entse hore ho be le thupello ya motheo ya maitsebelo a Tlhahisoleseding le Thekenoloji ya Dikgokahanyo (ICT) bakeng sa batjha ba ka bang 500.

src: The Declaration on Internet for All adopted the leadership structure and also identified targets for implementation within the next six months.
tgt: Tumellano ya Inthanete bakeng sa Bohle e amohetse sebopeho sa boetapele mme hape le ho hlwaya tse lokelang ho kenngwa tshebetsong nakong ya dikgwedi tse tsheletseng tse tlang.

src: Cabinet further welcomed the intervention by the Department of Telecommunications and Postal Services through the Independent Communications Authority of South Africa and the Economic Development Department through the Competition Commission, to look into the high data costs that continue to be an inhibition to increase access to ICTs.
tgt: Kabinete hape e amohetse boitshunyako ba Lefapha la Meralo ya Motheo ya Dikgokahanyo le Ditshebeletso tsa Poso ka Bolaodi bo Ikemetseng ba Dikgokahanyo ba Aforika Borwa le Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo ka Khomishene ya Diphehisano, ho hlahloba ditjeho tse hodimo tsa datha tse tswelang pele ho ba tshita bakeng sa ho eketsa phumantsho yadi-ICKabinete e tshwenyehile ka ditlaleho tsa ho sitiswa ha ditshebeletso dimotjhareng tsa Gauteng ka lebaka tsa dikgang tsa basebetsi tse ntseng di tswela pele.

src: As a result, grieving families are unable to claim their relatives’ bodies.
tgt: Ka lebaka leo, malapa a bofifing ha a kgone ho tseka ditopo tsa bo bona.

src: Death in any family brings an element of vulnerability and pain to the surviving family members.
tgt: Lefu lelapeng le leng le le leng le tlisa bodutu le bohloko ho ba lelapa ba setseng.

src: As society no amount of dispute is worth such insensitivity.
tgt: Jwaloka setjhaba ha ho ntho e kgolo hakalo e ka lokelang maemo a bosula hakana.

src: Cabinet appeals to all parties involved to find an amicable solution to their disputes without affecting the families of the deceased.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bohle ba amehangho fumana tharollo ya kgotso ya dikgang tsa bona ntle le ho ama ba malapa a ba hlokahaletsweng.

src: Cabinet welcomes the formation of the Local Government Youth Development Forum.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela ho thehwa ha Foramo ya Batjha ya Ntshetsopele ya Mebuso ya Lehae.

src: The forum is set to be a progressive voice of youth in the implementation of various youth development initiatives within local government.
tgt: Foramo ena e reretswe ho ba lentswe la tswelopele la batjha mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha maikitlaetso a fapafapaneng a ntshetsopele ya batjha ka hara mebuso ya lehae.

src: The Forum held its first inaugural conference on the 20 -21 June in Muldersdrift, west of Johannesburg.
tgt: Foramo ena e ne e tshwere pitso ya yona ya ho thakgolwa la pele ka la 20-21 Phuptjane Muldersdrift, ka bophirima ho Johannesburg.

src: Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.

src: Cabinet approved the White Paper on the National Health Insurance (NHI), to be gazetted as a policy document.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Pampiri ya Mosupatsela ya Inshorense ya Naha ya Bophelo bo Botle (NHI), e tla kenngwa koranteng ya mmuso jwaloka tokomane ya maano.

src: The White Paper takes the country closer to ensuring all South Africans have access to healthcare, irrespective of their socio-economic status.
tgt: Pampiri ya Mosupatsela e re atametsa ntlheng ya ho netefatsa hore maAforika Borwa kaofela a fumantshwa tlhokomelo ya kalafo, ho sa natswe maemo a bona a ditjhelete.

src: The NHI is a health financing system that allocates funds to provide access to healthcare.
tgt: NHI ke tsamaiso e thusang ka ditjhelete ho tsa kalafo e abang matlole bakeng sa phumantsho ya tlohokomelo ya kalafo.

src: This is consistent with the National Development Plan’s (NDP) objective that seeks to ensure everyone has access to healthcare, regardless of their income.
tgt: Sena se kgema le maikemisetso a Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) a batlang ho netefatsa hore mang le mang o fumantshwa tlhokomelo ya kalafo, ho sa tsotellwe lekeno la hae.

src: The Department of Health will hold a briefing on 29 June 2017 to fully unpack the elements of this White Paper.
tgt: Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle le tla tshwara kopano ka la 29 Phuptjane2017 ho hlopholla ka botlalo dikateng tsa Pampiri ya Mosupatsela.

src: Cabinet approved the Revised Human Resource Development Strategy towards 2030.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lewa le Shebilweng Botjha la Ntshetsopele ya Mehlodi ya Basebetsi le lebisang selemong sa 2030.

src: The revised strategy addresses the weaknesses identified in the last five years in some parts of the education and training system and also identified the lack of coordination between different parts of the system.
tgt: Lewa lena le shebilweng botjha le sebetsana le bofokodi bo hlwauweng dilemong tse hlano tse fetileng dikarolong tse ding tsa tsamaiso ya thuto le thupello mme hape le hlwaile bohokahanyi pakeng tsa dikarolo tse fapaneng tsa tsamaiso.

src: The strategy is now aligned to the NDP and the Medium Term Strategic Framework WEBTOKEN also focuses all the relevant stakeholders (government, labour, civil organisations and private sectors) on the needs of the economy and the importance of supporting an industrial strategy to achieve inclusive growth and development.
tgt: Lewa jwale le matahantswe le NDP le Lewa la Moralo wa Nako e Mahareng (MTSF) la 2014-2019.Hape le tsepamisitse maikutlo hodima bankakarolo kaofela ba amehang (mmuso, basebetsi, mekgatlo ya setjhabale mafapha a poraefete) mabapi le ditlhoko tsa moruo le bohlokwa ba ho tshehetsa lewa la diindaseteri bakeng sa ho fihlella kgolo e kenyeletsang le ntshetsopele.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the key findings of the 2015/16 survey on government funding for Scientific and Technological Activities.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya diphetho tsa bohlokwa tsa diphuputso tsa 2015/16 mabapi le thuso ya mmuso ka ditjhelete bakeng sa Mesebetsi ya Saense le Thekenoloji.

src: The 1996 White Paper on Science and Technology requires that the Department of Science and Technology monitor government funding of the science and technology sectors, and its contribution to South Africa’s growth and development.
tgt: Pampiri ya Mosupatsela e mabapi le Saense le Thekenoloji ya selemo sa 1996 e batla hore Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji le behe leihlo thuso ya ditjhelete ya makala a saense le thekenoloji, le nyehelo ya yona kgolong le ntshetsopeleng ya Aforika Borwa.

src: The results of the findings of 30 national departments indicate that an estimated R23,4 billion was spent from the national fiscus in the 2015/16 financial year.
tgt: Sephetho sa diphuputso tsa mafapha a naha a 30 se supa hore se akanngwang ho R23,4 bilione se sebedisitswe ho tswa matlotlong a mmuso selemong sa ditjhelete sa2015/16.Kabinete e lemohile keketseho e bonahalang ya 6.6% ha ho bapiswa le selemo se fetileng ha ho shejwa ditshita tsa hajwale tsa matlotlo.

src: Cabinet noted the nominal increase of 6.6% increase when compared with the previous year given the current fiscal constraints.
tgt: Matsete ana kaofela a emela.7% ya palohohle ya ditekanyetso tsa naha tsa selemo.

src: Cabinet appreciated the fact that most of these funds were used in scientific services that support service delivery in core areas of government competency such as education, health, minerals, energy, agriculture and environment.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse ntlha ya hore boholo ba matlole ana a sebedisitswe ditshebeletsong tsa saense tse tshehetsang phano ya ditshebeletso dibakeng tsa bohlokwa tsa bokgoni ba mmuso tse kang thuto, kalafo, diminerale, eneji, temo le tikoloho.

src: Bills.
tgt: Dibili.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the Customary Initiation Bill for public comment.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Bili ya Lebollo la Setso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.

src: The Bill seeks to protect, promote and regulate the customary initiation practices.
tgt: Bili e rerile ho tshireletsa, ho hodisa le ho laola diketsahalo tsa lebollo la setso.

src: Once approved, the Bill will provide acceptable norms and standards in conducting these customary practices.
tgt: Hang ha e se e tjhaelletswe monwana, Bili e tla fana ka mekgwa le maemo a amohelehang mabapi le ho tsamaisa diketsahalo tsena tsa setso.

src: It will deal with the abuse of the initiation practice, which has seen a number of young boys dying in initiation schools.
tgt: E tla sebetsana le tshebediso e mpe ya diketsahalo tsa setso, e leng moo palo e ngata ya bashanyana e shwelletseng mephatong.

src: Government and traditional leadership institutions have adopted a zero-tolerance stance towards the death of initiates as a result of initiation practices.
tgt: Mmuso le dikaho tsa boetapele ba setso ba nkile mohato wa ho se hlole ho hang ba mamella mafu a makolwane ka lebaka la diketsahalo tsa mephatong.

src: Cabinet approved the National Research Foundation (NRF) Amendment Bill of 2017 for submission to Parliament.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwanaSehlomathiso sa Bili ya Motheo wa Naha wa Diphuputso (NRF) ya selemo sa 2017bakeng sa ho tekwa Palamenteng.

src: The Bill has gone through its full public consultations.
tgt: Bili e se e ile ya feta ka botlalo mohatong wa dipuisano le setjhaba.

src: The amendments clarify the authority of the Minister of Science and Technology over the foundation and makes explicit the NRF’s responsibilities in respect of science engagement.
tgt: Dihlomathiso di hlakisa bolaodi ba Letona la Saense le Thekenoloji hodima motheo le ho hlakisa maikarabelo aNRF mabapi le dipuisano ka tsa saense.

src: These amendments will enhance the authority of the Minister to guide the NRF to improve efficiencies.
tgt: Dihlomathiso tsena di tla matlafatsa bolaodi ba Letona bakeng sa ho tataisaNRF bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa bohlwahlwa.

src: They will also improve the responsiveness and effectiveness of research, development and innovation provision to the quality of life of South Africans, through better alignment with government priorities.
tgt: Hape di tla matlafatsa karabelo le bohlwahlwa ba diphuputso, phano ya ntshetsopele le ntlafatso ho boleng ba bophelo ba maAforika Borwa, ka boimatahanyo bo betere le dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa mmuso.

src: Cabinet approved the Civil Aviation Amendment Bill of 2017 for submission to Parliament.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Bofofisi ba Setjhaba ya selemo sa 2017bakeng sa ho tekwaPalamenteng.

src: The Bill strengthens aviation safety, security and environmental protection regulatory framework to ensure sustainability and stability of the civil-aviation industry.
tgt: Bili e matlafatsa polokeho ya bofofisi, tshireletso le moralo wa bolaodi ba tshireletso ya tikoloho ho netefatsa boteng ba moshwelella le botsitso ba indaseteri ya bofofisi ya setjhaba.

src: The amendments include, amongst others, a provision for the operational independence of the aircraft accident and incident investigation provision for the establishment of the Aviation Safety Investigation Board.
tgt: Dihlomathiso di kenyeletsa, hara tse ding, tumello bakeng saboikemelo ba ditshebetso tsa dikotsi tsa difofane le dipatlisiso tsa dikotsi tumello bakeng sa ho thehwa ha Boto ya Diphuputso tsa Polokeho ya Bofofisi.

src: It further amends and inserts certain definitions in the Act.
tgt: Hape e hlomathisa le ho kenya ditlhaloso tse itseng ka hara Molao ona.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the Sectional Titles Amendment Bill of 2017 for public comment.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Dithaetlele tsa Dikarolo tsa Bodulo ya selemo sa 2017bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.

src: The amendments update the working, functioning, application and administration of the Sectional Titles Act, 1986 (Act 95 of 1986).
tgt: Dihlomathiso di ntlafatsa mosebetsi, tshebediso, ho sebediswa le tsamaiso ya Molao wa Dithaetlele tsa Dikarolo tsa Bodulo, wa selemo sa 1986 (Molao wa bo-95 wa 1986).

src: The current Sectional Titles Act of 1986 bestows certain rights on owners of sections in sectional titles scheme.
tgt: Molao wa Dithaetlele tsa Dikarolo tsa Bodulo wa selemo sa 1986 o fana ka ditokelo tse itseng ho beng ba bodulosekemeng sa dithaetlele tsa dikarolo tsa thepa ya bodulo.

src: The proposed amendment Bill proposes regulations of these rights in a meaningful manner.
tgt: Sehlomathiso sa Bili se sisintsweng se etsa tshitshinyo ya melawana ya ditokelo tsena ka mokgwa o nang le moelelo.

src: Cabinet approved the Communal Land Tenure Bill of 2017 to be published for public comment.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Thuo ya Mobu ke Badudi ya selemo sa 2017 hore e phatlalatswe bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.

src: The Bill seeks to protect owners of communal land, particularly the vulnerable in rural communities.
tgt: Bili e reretswe ho sireletsa beng ba lefatshe la badudi,ka ho qolleha ba kotsing dibakeng tsa mahae.

src: Upcoming events.
tgt: Diketsahalo tse tlang.

src: President Zuma will attend the 5th Southern African Customs Union (SACU) Summit to be held in Swaziland on 23 June 2017.
tgt: Moporesidente Zuma o tla kenela Seboka sa bohlanosa Kopano ya Aforika e Borwa ya Makgetho a Madiboho (SACU) se tla tshwarelwa Swaziland ka la 23 Phuptjane 2017.

src: The one-day summit will be attended by Heads of State and Government of the SACU member states, which include South Africa, Botswana, Lesotho, Namibia and Swaziland.
tgt: Seboka sena sa letsatsi le le leng se tla kenelwa ke Dihlooho tsa Dipuso le Mmuso tsa ditho tsa dipuso tsa SACU, tse kenyeletsang Aforika Borwa, Botswana, Lesotho, Namibia le Swaziland.

src: The summit will discuss various issues related to regional trade and industrialisation and work programme.
tgt: Seboka sena se tla tshohla dintlha tse fapafapaneng tse amanang le kgwebisano ya lebatowa le kaho ya diindaseteri le lenaneo la WEBTOKEN tla sheba botjha dintlha tsa tumellano ya SACU le dipehelo tsa tshupiso, ho thusa ka ntshetsopele ya meruo ya WEBTOKEN kaSACU hore mebaraka e eketsehileng bakeng sa thepa le ditshebeletso ho tswa lebatoweng di ka sireletswa ka ditherisano tsa kgwebisano tse tswellangtse reretsweng ho tswellisa pele kopano e matla ya lebatowa le kontinente.

src: It will also review some aspects of the SACU agreement and its terms of reference, so as to facilitate development of SACU WEBTOKEN is through SACU that increased markets for goods and services from the region can be secured through the various ongoing trade negotiations that are aimed at advancing greater regional and continental integration.
tgt: Jwaloka ka karolo e tswelang pele ya Imbizo ya twantsho ya ditlolo tsa molao, Moporesidente Zuma o tla nka leeto la Lenaneo la Bodisa la Boporesidente la Siyahlola ho ya Lusikisiki, ho la Kapa Botjhabela ka Moqebelo, 24 Phuptjane 2017.

src: As part of the continuing crime-fighting Imbizo, President Zuma will undertake a Siyahlola Presidential Monitoring Programme visit in Lusikisiki, Eastern Cape on Saturday, 24 June 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho tshehetsa Mokete wa Knysna Oyster le Marathone wa Knysna tse tlang.

src: Cabinet encourages South Africans to support the upcoming Knysna Oyster Festival and the Knysna Marathon.
tgt: Ona ke o mong wa mekete e tummeng haholo o amang haholo barati ba dipapadi le malapa.

src: This is one of the most popular festivals with huge appeal to sports lovers and families.
tgt: Bankakarolo kaofela ba sebetsa mmoho ho netefatsa hore Knysna e sebetsa ka botlalo le ho bula bakeng sa kgwebo.

src: Mandela Day calls on all of us, every day, to make the world a better place.
tgt: Letsatsi la Mandela le ipiletsa ho rona bohle, letsatsi ka leng, ho etsa lefatshe tulo e betere.

src: The theme for Mandela Day on 18 July, is #ActionAgainstPoverty.
tgt: Mookotaba wa Letsatsi la Mandela ka la 18 Phupu, ke #ActionAgainstPoverty.

src: Making every day a Mandela Day celebrates Madiba’s life and legacy in a sustainable way that will bring about enduring change.
tgt: Ho etsa letsatsi ka leng hore e be Letsatsi la Mandela ke ho keteka bophelo le lefa la Madiba ka tsela ya moshwelella e tla tlisa phethoho ya nako e telele.

src: Condolence message.
tgt: Melaetsa ya matshediso.

src: Cabinet joins President Zuma in extending condolences:to the Minister of Higher Education and Training, Dr Blade Nzimande, and his family on the passing of his mother, Mrs Nozipho Nzimande.
tgt: Kabinete e ipapisa le Moporesidente Zuma ka ho fetisetsa matshediso:• ho Letona la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello, Ngaka Blade Nzimande, le lelapa la hae ka ho hlokahala ha mmae,Mofumahadi Nozipho Nzimande.

src: The much-loved Mama Nzimande turned 90 years old last month.
tgt: Mama Nzimande ya neng a ratuwa haholo o ne a qeta dilemo tse 90 kgweding e fetileng.

src: She warmly received South African Communist Party and African National Congress activists in her home during the difficult period of the violence that engulfed Pietermaritzburg in KwaZulu-Natal and surrounding areas during the late 1980s and early 1990s.
tgt: O ne a amohela ka mofuthu balwanedi ba tokoloho ba South African Communist Party (SACP) le ba African National Congress (ANC) lapeng la hae nakong ya merusu e neng e aparetse Pietermaritzburg ho la KwaZulu-Natal le dibaka tse mabapi nakong ya dilemo tsa ho qetela tsa bo-1980 le tse qalang ka bo-1990.• ka ho hlokahala haLord Joel Joffe.

src: on the passing on of Lord Joel Joffe.
tgt: Lord Joffe, ya hlokahetseng a na le dilemo tse 85, e ne e le leqwetha la tshireletso nyeweng ya Rivonia le ya Little Rivonia.

src: Lord Joffe, who died at the age of 85, was a defence attorney in the Rivonia and Little Rivonia trials.
tgt: O tshireleditse ka sebete balwanedi ba ntwa ya mmuso wa kgethollo, le ho etsa nyehelo e matla porojekeng ya demokerasi ka hara Aforika Borwa.• ho batho ba Namibia ka ho hlokahala ha Monghadi Toivo ya Toivo, molwanedi wa diphethoho tsa ntwa ya tokolohoho la Namibia le ho ba molwanedi kgahlanong le mmuso wa kgethollo.

src: He bravely defended anti-apartheid activists, making an immense contribution to the project of democracy in South WEBTOKEN the people of Namibia on the passing on of Mr Toivo ya Toivo, a revolutionary in the struggle for freedom in Namibia and an anti-apartheid activist.
tgt: Letona la Dikgokahanyo Ayanda Dlodlo o tla emela mmuso wa Aforika Borwa semmuso lepatong le tla etsahala ka Moqebelo, wa la 24 Phuptjane Melaetsa ya thoholetso.

src: Communications Minister Ayanda Dlodlo will officially represent the government of South Africa at the funeral that will take place on Saturday, 24 June Congratulatory message.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsasetsebi sa sebopeho sa lefatshe Tshiamo Legoale ya entseng nalane ka ho ba moAforika Borwa wa pele wa ho rweswa kgau ya ho ba Mampodi wa Matjhaba wa FameLab bakeng sa porojeke e fupuditseng ho sebedisa koro bakeng sa ho kotula gauta ho tswa ditutudung tsa merafo.

src: Cabinet congratulates geologist Tshiamo Legoale who made history by being the first South African to be crowned the FameLab International Champion for a project that researched a method of using wheat to harvest gold from mine dumps.
tgt: Legoaleke mokgola-molemo wa mananeo a dibasari a mmuso mme haufinyana tjena o hapile kgau ho Mokete wa Saense wa Cheltenham o neng tshwaretswe United Kingdom.

src: Legoale is a beneficiary of one of government’s bursary programmes and she recently won the award at the Cheltenham Science Festival held in the United Kingdom.
tgt: Kabinete e lakaletsa Sehlopha sa Aforika Borwa tsohle tse molemo bakeng sa Dipapadi tsa Batjha tsa Commonwealth tsa selemo sa 2017 tse tlang tse tla tshwarelwa Nassau, ho la Bahamas ho tloha ka la 19 ho isa ka la 23 Phupu 2017.Dipapading tsena ke moo Sehlopha sa Aforika Borwa se thotseng maemo a bobedi tafoleng ya dimedale, ka palohohle ya dimedale tse 35, dipapading tsa selemo sa 2015 Apia, ho la Samoa.

src: Cabinet wishes Team SA all the best for the upcoming 2017 Commonwealth Youth Games in Nassau, Bahamas from 19 to 23 July 2017.The Games, which are held every four years, saw Team SA take second place on the medal table, with a total of 35 medals, in the 2015 games in Apia, Samoa.
tgt: Dipapadi tsa Batjha tsa Commonwealth e dula e le ketsahalo e bopeletsweng le dinaledi tsa rona tsa kamoso.

src: The Commonwealth Youth Games remains an integral event for our future stars.
tgt: Sehlopha sa Aforika Borwa ke kgothatso ho batjha hore ba itahlele ka setotswana dipapading jwaloka mokgwa wa ho fetola maphelo a bona hore e be a betere.

src: Cabinet met at the Sefako M Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse in Pretoria on Tuesday, 1 August Cabinet Decisions South Africa commemorates Women’s Month in August, as a tribute to more than 20 000 women who marched to the Union Buildings on 9 August 1956 in protest against the extension of pass laws to women.
tgt: Kabinete e ile ya kopanela Tlung ya Baeti ya Moporesidente ya Sefako M Makgatho Pretoria, ka Labobedi, mohla la 1 Phato Diqeto tsa Kabinete.

src: The National Women’s Day celebrations will take place at Galeshewe Stadium, Kimberley in the Northern Cape.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e keteka Kgwedi ya Basadi ka Phato, e le tlotlo ho basadi ba kahodimo ho 20 000 ba ileng ba hwantela Union Buildings ka la 9 Phato 1956, ba ipelaetsa kgahlanong le katollelo ya melao ya dipasa hore e ye basading.

src: Cabinet approved the theme for this year’s celebrations as “Year of OR Tambo: Women united in moving South Africa forward.” Cabinet calls on South Africans to use the month of August to celebrate the role of women in our society.
tgt: Meketjana ya Letsatsi la Naha e tla tshwarelwa Lebaleng la Dipapadi la Galeshwewe, Kimberley Kapa Leboya.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the three-year programme to be rolled out by the Moral Regeneration Movement (MRM).
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse mookotaba wa meketjana ya monongwaha e le “Selemo sa OR Tambo: Basadi ba momahane ho ntshetsa Aforika Borwa pele.” Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho sebedisa kgwedi ya Phato ho keteka seabo sa basadi setjhabeng sa rona.

src: The MRM is mandated to facilitate, encourage and coordinate the programme that seeks to restore the moral fibre of our society.
tgt: Kabinete e ile ya hlajwa malotsana ka lenaneo la dilemo tse tharo le tla etsuwa ke Mokgatlo wa Tsosoloso ya Boitshwaro (MRM).

src: Cabinet approved the three-year operational programme of the MRM and a phased approach of mainstreaming the moral regeneration programme within government.
tgt: MRM e filwe matla a ho nolofatsa, ho kgothaletsa le ho hlophisa lenaneo le habileng ho kgutlisa boitshwaro bo botle ba setjhaba sa habo rona.

src: Cabinet approved that South Africa submits its bid to host the 2023 Rugby World Cup (RWC).
tgt: Mokgatlo ona o habile ho tsosolosa moya wa Ubuntu/Botho o sebedisa mehlodi ya mmuso le ya setjhaba.

src: This will once again afford South Africa an opportunity to showcase the country to the international community.
tgt: Sena se tla boela se fa Aforika Borwa monyetla wa ho bapatsa naha matjhabeng.

src: South Africa has previously hosted world-class events such as the All Africa Games, Cricket World Cup, 2010 FIFA World Cup and many international conferences.
tgt: Nakong e fetileng Aforika Borwa e se e kile ya tshwara dipapadi tsa maemo a hodimo tse kang Dipapadi tsa Aforika Yohle, Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Kherikete, 2010 FIFA World CupTM esita le diboka tse ngata tsa matjhaba.

src: As the country we have learnt from these past experiences particularly the costs overruns and collusion which accompanied 2010.
tgt: Re le naha, re ithutile boholo malebeleng ana a nako e fetileng, haholoholo dipheteletso tsa ditjeo le bononnori bo amanang le 2010.

src: As a result of this, government refused to sign an open-ended blank cheque which led to South Africa withdrawing its bid to host the Common wealth GamesCabinet was apprised on the spin-offs from such an event.
tgt: Ka lebaka lena, Aforika Borwa e hanne ho tekena sekepele sa tjhelete se se nang kgutlo, se entseng hore Aforika Borwa e hule boiketo ba yona ba ho tshwara Dipapadi tsa-Commowealth.

src: South Africa already has the requisite infrastructure to host the tournament without allocating a budget for infrastructure development.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e se ntse e na le meralo ya motheo e hlokehang bakeng sa ho tshwara thonamente, ntle le ho aba bajete ya kaho ya meralo ya motheo.

src: Sports is said to be one of the most effective drivers of nation-building and the rugby sports programmes would enhance social cohesion.
tgt: Dipapadi di nkuwa e le enngwe ya dintho tse sebetsang hantle ka hofetisisa kahong ya setjhaba, mme mananeo a dipapadi tsa rabi a tla ntlafatsa momahano ya setjhaba.

src: The programmes to be rolled out throughout the country leading to 2023 will leave a lasting legacy for the development of rugby in underprivileged communities.
tgt: Mananeo a tla nanabetswa naha ka bophara ditlhophisong tse lebisang ho 2023 a tla siya lefa la nako e telele bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya rabi dibakeng tse futsanehileng.

src: Cabinet has approved the overall proposed package for this tournament which is an economic bid which would minimise the demands on the fiscus as well as stimulate economic activity employment and empowermentThe tournament will contribute to stimulating our economy by supporting government priorities, especially as it relates to preferential procurement and adherence to the Sport Transformation Charter and the sharing of the profits derived.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse kakaretso ya ditshisinyo tse entsweng bakeng sa thonamente ena, e leng boiketo ba moruo bo tla fokotsa ditlhokeho ditjheleteng bo be bo sututse tlhahiso ya mesebetsi le matlafatso tshebetsong ya moruo.

src: The event will further boost our tourism and hospitality sector.
tgt: Thonamente e tla kenya letsoho ho sututsweng ha moruo wa rona ka ho tshehetsa dintho tsa mmuso tse ka sehloohong, haholoholo hobane e amana le phumantsho le tsitlallelo tse qollotsweng Tokomaneng ya Phetoho Dipapading.

src: Cabinet approved the establishment of the Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) on WRC 2023.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse ho thewa ha Komiti ya Matona a Kopaneng (IMC) ho tsa RWC ya 2023.

src: The IMC will direct the bidding process for the RWC 2023 and ensure the country benefits economically from this event.
tgt: IMC e tla tataisa mosebetsi wa boiketo bakeng sa ho tshwara RWC ya 2023 e be e netefatse hore naha e fola molemo wa moruo thonamenteng ena.

src: The Minister of Sport and Recreation, Mr Thulas Nxesi, will hold a separate media briefing to unpack the bidding process.
tgt: Letona la tsa Dipapadi le Boithabiso, Monghadi Thulas Nxesi, o tla ba le puisano e lehlakoreng le ba mehlodi ya ditaba ho manolla tsa mosebetsi wa boiketo.

src: Cabinet approved the Draft Intellectual Property (IP) Policy of South Africa – Phase I (2017) for publication in the Government Gazette for public comments.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse Leano la Nakwana la Seruuwa sa Tlhalefo (IP) la Aforika Borwa – Mokgahlelo wa I (2017) hore le phatlalatswe Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.

src: This responds to the National Development Plan’s call for greater emphasis on innovation, improved productivity, more intense pursuit of a knowledge economy, and better exploitation of comparative and competitive advantages.
tgt: Sena se arabela kgoeletsong ya Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) ya bohlokwa ba tshibollo, tlhahiso e ntlafetseng, ho hahamalla pejana tsebong ya moruo, le tshebediso e betere ya melemo ya papiso le tlhodisano.

src: The IP Policy is an important policy instrument in promoting innovation, technology transfer, research and development, creative expression, consumer protection, industrial development and more broadly, economic growth.
tgt: Leano la IP ke sesebediswa sa bohlokwa sa leano phahamisong ya tshibollo, phetisetso ya tsebo ya theknoloji, phuputso le ntshetsopele, boiponahatso ba boqapi, tshireletso ya bareki, ntshetsopele ya diindasteri esita le kgolo ya moruo ka bobatsi.

src: Cabinet approved the Draft Green Transport Strategy to be published for public comments.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse Lewa la Nakwana la Dipalangwang tse sa senyeng Tikoloho hore le phatlalatswe bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.

src: This strategy will form the cornerstone of policy development within the transport sector regarding the lowering of the GHG emissions.
tgt: Leano lena le tla bopa tshiya ya ntshetsopele ya leano kahara lekala la tsa dipalangwang, mabapi le ho kokobetswa ha kunkelo ya Dikgase tse Amanang le Tikoloho (GHG).

src: The aim of this strategy is to minimize the adverse impact of transport on the environment while addressing current and future transport demands based on sustainable development principles.
tgt: Sepheo sa leano lena ke ho kokobetsa ditlamorao tse mpe tse bakwang ke dipalangwang tikolohong, ha ka ho le leng le ntse le rarolla ditlhokeho tsa jwale le tsa kamoso ho ya ka mekgwatsamaiso ya ntshetsopele ya nako e telele.

src: Transport systems form the backbone of South Africa’s socio-economic activities by enabling the movement of people and goods.
tgt: Mekgwatsamaiso ya dipalangwang ke tshiya ya diketsahalo tsa moruo kahisanong ya Aforika Borwa, ka ho thusa ho tsamaisa batho le thepa.

src: However, emissions from the transport sector account for 10.8% of the country’s total greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, with road transport being responsible for 91.2% of these GHG emissions.
tgt: Leha ho le jwalo, kunkelo e tswang lekaleng la dipalangwang e etsa 10.8% ya palo yohle ya kunkelo ya GHG, ka dipalangwang tsa mebileng tse bakileng 91.2% ya kunkelo ena ya GHAforika Borwa e intshitse sehlabelo sa ho etsa bonnete ba hore e fihlella pehelo ya ho fokotsa kunkelo ya GHG ka 34% selemong sa 2020 le ka 42% selemong sa 2025.Kabinete e ananetse hore Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae le ka bula hape mosebetsi wa dikopobotjha bakeng sa maZimbabwe ao hajwale a nang le Tumello e Kgethehileng, katlasa maemo a itseng.

src: The initial Special Dispensation for Zimbabweans was approved in April 2009 to document Zimbabwean nationals who were in South Africa illegally.
tgt: Selekane se Kgethehileng sa sethathong sa maZimbabwe se ile sa ananelwa ka Mmesa 2009 ho ngodisa batho ba Zimbabwe ba neng ba le Aforika Borwa ntle le molao.

src: Their permits expire on the 31 December 2017.
tgt: Ditumello tsa bona di fellwa ke nako ka la 31 Tshitwe 2017.

src: The Minister of Home Affairs, ProfHlengiwe Mkhize, will hold a separate briefing to explain the conditions and the process to be followed once the reapplication opens.
tgt: Letona la Merero ya Lehae, Moporofesara Hlengiwe Mkhize, o tla tshwara puisano e lehlakoreng ho hlalosa maemo le methati e tla latelwa hang ha dikopobotjha di bulwa.

src: Cabinet approved the South African Mint Company’s designs for the 2017 commemorative colour coins series: Flowers and Birds of the Cape West Coast Biosphere Reserve.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse meralo ya Khamphane ya Minti wa Aforika Borwa bakeng sa mmala wa 2017 wa ho keteka lethathama la tjhelete e lewana: Dipalesa le Dinonyana tsa Serapa sa Tikoloho ya Lebopo la Bophirimela ba Kapa.

src: This is an addition to the commemorative and circulation coin ranges to be issued in Bills.
tgt: Hona ke keketso mefuteng ya tjhelete e lewana ya ho keteka, e tla ntshuwa ka DIbili.

src: Cabinet approved publication of the Deeds Registries Amendment Bill of 2017 for public comments.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse phatlalatso ya Bili ya Sehlomathiso ya Poloko ya Direkoto tsa Phetiso ya Thepa ya 2017 bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.

src: It amends the Deeds Registries Act, 1937 (Act 47 of 1937), so as to improve and enhance application and implementation of the Act.
tgt: E hlomathisa Molao wa Poloko ya Direkoto tsa Phetiso ya Thepa, 1937 (Molao wa 47 wa 1937), e le ho ntshetsapele le ho ntlafatsa tshebediso le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Molao.

src: The Bill will also streamline and enhance the administration and registration of deeds.
tgt: Bili e tla boela e tsitsisa ebile e ntlafatsa tsamaiso le ngodiso ya phetiso ya thepa.

src: Condolences Cabinet expressed its condolences to the families of the two soccer fans who lost their lives during the stampede at the FNB Stadium on Saturday, 29 July 2017.
tgt: Melaetsa ya matshedisoKabinete e fetiseditse matshediso a yona ho ba malapa a balatedi ba babedi ba bolo ya maoto ba hlokahetseng nakong ya setha se wele Lebaleng la FNB ka Moqebelo, mohla la 29 Phupu 2017.

src: President Jacob Zuma has constituted a Ministerial Committee of Enquiry, headed by Minister Nxesi, to investigate the circumstances that led to this tragedy.
tgt: Moporesidente o kgobokantse Komiti ya Dipatlisiso ya Matona, e etelletsweng pele ke Letona Nxesi, ho fuputsa maemo a lebisitseng koduweng ena.

src: Cabinet met at the Union Buildings in Pretoria.
tgt: Kabinete e ne e kopane Union Buildings ho la Pretoria.

src: As we celebrate Women's Month, Cabinet wishes Ms Getrude Shope well in her 92th birthday.
tgt: Ha re ntse re keteka Kgwedi ya Basadi, Kabinete e lakaletsa Mofumahadi Getrude Shope tse molemo letsatsing la hae la tswalo la dilemo tse MmaShope, jwaloka ha a ne a tsejwa, ke thatohatsi ya ntwa ya tokoloho le tokoloho ya basadi ka ho qolleha.

src: MmaShope, as she is affectionately known, is a doyen of the struggle for liberation and for women emancipation in particular.
tgt: Ke moamohedi wa Isithwalandwe/Seaparankwe, e leng tlotla e kgolohadi e kileng ya fanwa ke African National Congress (ANC) ho ba entseng nyehelo e babatsehang le boinehelo ntweng ya tokoloho.

src: She is a recipient of Isithwalandwe/Seaparankwe, the highest honour awarded by the African National Congress to those who made an outstanding contribution and sacrifice to the liberation struggle.
tgt: Kabinete hape e fetiseditse ditakalaletso tsa yona tse molemo ho Mofumahadi Zondeni Veronica Sobukwe letsatsing la hae la tswalo la dilemo tse Aforika Borwa ke naha e betere ka lebaka la boinehelo bo entsweng ke basadi ba mofuta wa hae.

src: Cabinet also extended its well wishes to Ms Zondeni Veronica Sobukwe on her 90th birthday.
tgt: Ha naha e ntse e keteka Kgwedi ya Basadi tlasa mookotaba “Selemo sa OR Tambo: Basadi ba Kopane Bakeng sa ho Ntshetsa Aforika Borwa Pele”, Kabinete e imatahanya le maAforika Borwa kaofela mabapi le ho tlotla basadi ba sebete ba ileng ba hwantela Union Buildings ka selemo sa 1956 ho ipelaetsa ka melao ya dipasa.

src: South Africa is a better country through the sacrifices played by women of her WEBTOKEN the country celebrates Women's Month under the theme “The Year of OR Tambo: Women United in Moving South Africa Forward”, Cabinet joins all South Africans in honouring the brave women who marched to the Union Buildings in 1956 to protest the pass WEBTOKEN the spirit of OR Tambo’s ‘Flowers of the Revolution’ statement, we commemorate the role of women as pioneers of the women's movement in this country, recognising that when you empower a woman, you empower the WEBTOKEN a country we have achieved a lot in the field of women empowerment.
tgt: Ka moya wa OR Tambo wa pehelo ya ‘Flowers of the Revolution’, re hopola karolo e bapetsweng ke basadi jwaloka baetapele ba mokgatlo wa basadi ka hara naha ena, re ananela hore ha o matlafatsa mosadi, o matlafatsa setjhaba.

src: Prior to 1994 Parliament had a mere 2,7% representation of women, and following the first democratic elections, women representation in the National Assembly stood at 27,7%.
tgt: Pele ho selemo sa 1994 Palamente e ne e na le feela 2,7% ya boemedi ba basadi, mme kamora dikgetho tsa pele tsa demokerasi, boemedi ba basadi ka hara Kopano ya Setjhaba bo ne bo eme ho 27,7%.

src: In 1999 that figure increased to 30% and then to 32,7% in 2004.
tgt: Ka selemo sa 1999 palo eo e nyolohetse ho 30% mme yaba e nyolohela ho ya ho 32,7% ka selemo sa 2004.

src: After the 2009 national elections women representation reached 42%.
tgt: Kamora dikgetho tsa naha tsa selemo sa 2009 boemedi ba basadi bo fihletse 42%.

src: Women Ministries now comprise 43% of the Cabinet.
tgt: Mafapha a eteletsweng pele ke Basadi hajwale a etsa 43% ya WEBTOKEN na le basadi ba bangata maemong a boetapele mme ho na le dibopeho tse ding tsa mmuso tse teng bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa boemo ba basadi.

src: We have many women in leadership positions and government structures are in place to improve the status of women.
tgt: Hajwale re na le Lefapha la Basadi ka hara Kantoro ya Moporesidente.

src: South Africans across the board have worked very well to participate in this commemoration.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa ho phatlalla le dikarolo tsohle a sebeditse hantle bakeng sa ho nka karolo sehopotsong sena.

src: Government’s progressive policies continue to prioritise the empowerment of women, particularly those living in rural areas, who often bear the harsh realities of poverty.
tgt: Maano a mmuso a hatetseng pele a tswela pele ho beha sehlohlolong matlafatso ya basadi, ka ho qolleha ba dulang dibakeng tsa mahae, bao hangata ba lokelang ho mamella bofutsana.

src: As we celebrate the progress we have made in the emancipation of women, Cabinet reminds the country of one of the woman anti-apartheid activists who was killed on this day in 1982.
tgt: Ha re ntse re keteka kgatelopele eo re e entseng mabapi le ho lokollwa ha basadi, Kabinete e hopotsa naha ka e mong wa basadi eo e neng e le molwanedi kgahlanong le kgethollo ya ileng a bolawa ka la 17 Phato 1982.

src: Ruth First was brutally killed by a letter bomb sent to her in Mozambique.
tgt: Ruth First o ile a bolawa ka sehloho ka qhomane ya lengolo le neng le romeletswe ho yena ha a ne a le Mozambique.

src: She paid the ultimate sacrifice in her relentless pursuit of freedom for the people of South Africa.
tgt: O lefile ka bophelo ba hae ba boinehelo ha a ne a tsitlalletse tokoloho ya batho ba Aforika Borwa.

src: Gender-based violence.
tgt: Tlhekefetso ya Dikgoka tse amanang le Bong (GBV).

src: The harms and dangers of patriarchy which result in the violence against women and children should be fought by all of us as a society.
tgt: Ditlhokofatso le dikotsi tsa matla a bonna tse qetellang ka dikgoka kgahlanong le basadi le bana di tshwanela ho lwantshwa ke rona kaofela jwaloka setjhaba.

src: The law-enforcement agencies and the criminal justice system must deal decisively against the perpetrators.
tgt: Makala a qobello ya molao le tsamaiso ya toka ya botlokotsebe a tshwanela ho sebetsa ka matla kgahlanong le baetsi ba diketso tsena.

src: SADC Summit.
tgt: Seboka sa Ntshetsopeleng ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC).

src: South Africa, as incoming chair of the Southern African Development Community (SADC), is hosting the 37th Ordinary SADC Summit of Heads of State and Government from 9 to 20 August 2017 under the theme: “Partnering with the Private Sector in Developing Industry and Regional Value Chains”.South Africa will use its position to strategically advance the country’s national interests as outlined in the National Development Plan (NDP), drive regional and continental industrialisation and integration to boost the implementation of Africa Agenda 2063 of the African Union (AU).
tgt: Aforika Borwa, jwaloka modulasetulo ya tla nka marapo a SADC, e tla tshwara Seboka sa bo-37 se Tlwaelehileng sa SADC sa Dihlooho tsa Dipuso le Mebuso ho tloha ka la 9 ho isa ka la 20 Phato 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “Re theha Selekane le Lekala la Poraefete mabapi le ho Ntshetsa pele Diindaseteri le Mathathama a Dikgwebo a Lebatowa”.Aforika Borwa e tla sebedisa maemo a yona ho tla ka mawa a tla ntshetsapele ditabatabelo tsa naha jwaloka ha di tekilwe ho Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP), ho kganna ho thehwa ha diindaseteri tsa lebatowa le tsa kontinente le kopano bakeng sa ho matlafatsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenaneo la Aforika la 2063 la Kopano ya Aforika (AU).

src: Agenda 2063 is the strategic framework for the socio-economic transformation of the continent over the next 50 years.
tgt: Lenaneo la 2063 ke moralo wa lewa bakeng sa diphethoho tsa moruo wa kahisano wa kontinente bakeng sa dilemo tse 50 tse tlang.

src: It builds on and seeks to accelerate the implementation of past and existing continental initiatives for growth and sustainable development.
tgt: Le ahella hodima le ho batla ho akofisa ho kenngwa tshebetsong maikitlaetso a fetileng le a teng a kontinente bakeng sa kgolo le ntshetsopele ya moshwelella.

src: Three potential growth paths, namely agro-processing, mineral beneficiation and downstream processing value chains, have been identified.
tgt: Metjha e meraro ya bokgoni ba kgolo, e leng ho tswellisa dihlahiswa tsa temo, bokgolamolemo ba diminerale le mathathama a moruo a tswellisang dihlahiswa bathong ba maemong a tlase, e se e hlwauwe.

src: The summit will also pay tribute to the outgoing President José Eduardo dos Santos of Angola, who will be stepping down after 37 years as President and leading his country out of a protracted civil war.
tgt: Seboka hape se tla lebisa hlompho ho Moporesidente ya tlohelang marapo José Eduardo dos Santos wa Angola, ya tla beng a theoha setulo kamora dilemo tse 37 jwaloka Moporesidente le ho etella pele naha ya hae ka ho e ntsha ka hara ntwa ya nako e telele ya bana ba mpa.

src: Deputy President Ramaphosa, in his capacity as the SADC Facilitator to the Kingdom of Lesotho, will also table a report to the SADC Double Troika Summit taking place in Pretoria on 18 August, where the Lesotho Government is also expected to table a reforms roadmap.
tgt: Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Ramaphosa, maemong a hae jwaloka Mothusi wa SADC Boreneng ba Lesotho, le yena o tla teka tlaleho ho Makala a Mabedi a Seboka se tla tshwarelwa Pretoria ka la 18 Phato, moo Mmuso wa Lesotho o lebeletsweng hape ho teka mokgwa wa ho fihlella diphethoho.

src: This follows the consultations between the Deputy President with the new government, leaders of opposition parties, the college of chiefs and civil society stakeholders in the Kingdom, charting the path for the full implementation of SADC decisions on constitutional and security sector reforms.
tgt: Sena se latela ditherisano pakeng tsa Motlatsi wa Moporesidente le mmuso o motjha, baetapele ba mekga ya bohanyetsi, mokgatlo wa marena le bankakarolo ba setjhaba ka kakaretso ka hara Borena bona, e le ho kgatha tema bakeng sa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ka botlalo ha diqeto tsa SADC tsa diphethoho tsa molaotheo le tsa lekala la polokeho.

src: Cabinet welcomes the outcomes from President Jacob Zuma hosting President Ellen Johnson Sirleaf of the Republic of Liberia, during a State Visit.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela sephetho sa kamohelo ya Moporesidente Jacob Zuma ya Moporesidente Ellen Johnson Sirleaf wa Riphabliki ya Liberia, nakong ya Leeto la Puso.

src: Both countries agreed to look into improving an enabling environment to ease the manner of doing business in our respective countries.
tgt: Dinaha ka bobedi di dumellane ka ho shebana le ho ntlafatsa tikoloho e kgontshang bakeng sa ho bebofatsa mokgwa wa kgwebisano ka hara dinaha tsena.

src: Cabinet encourages more private sector companies to invest in Liberia.
tgt: Kabinete e kgothaletsa dikhamphani tse ngata tsa lekala la poraefete ho tsetela ka hara Liberia.

src: The parties also agreed to finalise the signing of a Visa Waiver Agreement for Holders of Diplomatic and Official Passports.
tgt: Bobedi bona hape bo dumellane ho phethela ho saenela Pebofatso ya Dipehelo tsa Tumellano ya Divisa bakeng sa Beng ba Diphasepoto tsa Sedipolomate le tsa Semmuso.

src: They also agreed to speed up discussions and finalisation of other bilateral instruments on agriculture, tourism, health, energy water and sanitation amongst others.
tgt: Hape bo dumellane ka ho potlakisa dipuisano le ho phethelwa ha disebediswa tse ding tsa dinaha ka bobedi mabapi le temo, bohahlaudi, bophelo bo botle, eneji, metsi le tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere hara tse ding.

src: Cabinet congratulates the people of Rwanda on the holding of a peaceful election that saw the re-election of President Paul Kagame.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa batho ba Rwanda mabapi le ho ba le dikgetho tse tletseng kgotso moo ho bonahetseng ho kgethwa hape ha Moporesidente Paul Kagame.

src: The conclusion of yet another successful poll in Africa is a clear indication that democratic advances continue across the continent.
tgt: Ho phethelwa hape ha dikgetho tse atlehileng ka hara Aforika ke letshwao le hlakileng la kgatelopele ya demokerasi e ntseng e tswela pele ho phatlalla le kontinente.

src: Cabinet also joined the AU in congratulating Kenya for conducting successful elections.
tgt: Kabinete hape e imatahantse le AU mabapil ho thoholetsa Kenya ka ho tshwara dikgetho tse atlehileng.

src: It is now incumbent on all citizens in Kenya to accept the results of the elections and to work towards national unity in the country.
tgt: Jwale ho se ho le matsohong a baahi bohle ba Kenya ho amohela sephetho sa dikgetho le ho tswela pele ho sebeletsa bonngwe ba setjhaba ka hara naha.

src: BRICS.11 President Zuma will today, 17 August 2017, preside over the official launch of the African Regional Centre of the Brazil, Russia,India, China and South Africa (BRICS) New Development Bank (NDB) at the Michelangelo Hotel, Sandton.
tgt: BRICMopresidente Zuma kajeno, ka la 17 Phato 2017, o tla etella pele ho thakgolwa semmuso ha Banka e Ntjha ya Ntshetsopele (NDB) ya Setsi sa Lebatowa sa Aforika sa Brazil, Russia, India, China le Aforika Borwa (BRICS) Hoteleng ya Michelangelo, Sandton.

src: The launch of the African Regional Centre will showcase the NDB’s service offering, highlighting the bank’s potential role in the area of infrastructure and sustainable development in emerging and developing countries.
tgt: Ho thakgolwa ha Setsi sa Lebatowa sa Aforika se tla pepesa ditshebeletso tse fanwang ke NDB, ho hlakisa bokgoni ba karolo ya banka mabakeng a ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo le ya moshwelella ka hara dinaha tse ntseng di thuthuwa le ho tswela pele.

src: South Africa is among the BRICS member countries that adopted a Seven-Point Action Plan focused on expanding industrial cooperation, at a BRICS Industry Ministers meeting held in Hangzhou, China.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e hara dinaha tsa ditho tsa BRICS tse amohetseng Moralo wa Tshebetso wa Dintlha tse Supileng o tsepamisitseng maikutlo hodima katoloso ya tshebedisano-mmoho ya diindaseteri, kopanong ya BRICS ya Matona a Diindaseteri e neng e tshwaretswe Hangzhou, China.

src: These countries will further cooperate in fields such as the development of new industrial infrastructure, technology development and innovation, and small and medium-sized enterprises.
tgt: Dinaha tsena di tla boela di sebedisane mmoho mapatlelong a kang a ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo ya diindaseteri, ntshetsopele le ntlafatso ya thekenoloji, le dikgwebo tse nyenyane le tse mahareng.

src: Communication Ministers from the BRICS group also participated in a round-table, with the group publishing a Ministerial Declaration on Information Technology, that BRICS nations will step up cooperation on information security, as digital communication technology plays an increasingly important role in driving economic growth.
tgt: Matona a Dikgokahanyo ho tswa sehlopheng sa BRICS le ona a nkile karolo kopanong ya bohlokwa, moo sehlopha sena se ileng sa phatlalatsaTumellano ya Matona ya Thekenoloji ya Dikgokahanyo, ditjhaba tsa BRICS di matlafatsa tshebedisano-mmoho mabapi le polokeho ya tlhahisoleseding, kaha thekenoloji ya dikgokahanyo tsa dijithale e ntse e eketsa ho bapala karolo ya bohlokwa mabapi le ho kganna kgolo ya moruo.

src: Cabinet thanks the former Governor of the South African Reserve Bank, Mr Tito Mboweni, for his professionalism and dedication during the two-year period that he served as a non-executive director of the BRICS NDNational Treasury Director-General, Mr Dondo Mogajane, will take WEBTOKEN cohesion.
tgt: Kabinete e leboha Mmusisi wa mehleng wa Banka ya Risefe ya Afrika Borwa, Monghadi Tito Mboweni, bakeng sa boporofeshenale le boitelo ba hae nakong ya dilemo tse pedi tseo a sebeditseng ka tsona jwaloka motsamaisi eo e seng wa phethahatso wa BRICS NDMotsamaisikakaretso wa Lefapha la naha la Matlotlo, Monghadi Dondo Mogajane,o tla nka marapo ao.

src: Cabinet condemns recent acts of racism by some individuals in our society.
tgt: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe diketsahalo tsa haufinyana tjena tsa semorabe ke batho ba bang ka hara setjhaba sa rona.

src: Such behaviour goes against the ethos of our constitutional rights, responsibilities and values, and has no place in our democratic society.
tgt: Boitshwaro bo jwalo bo kgahlanong le dipehelo tsa boitshwaro tsa ditokelo tsa rona tsa molaotheo wa rona, maikarabelo le dintle, mme seo ha se na sebaka ka hara setjhaba sa rona sa demokerasi.

src: Cabinet commends the management of private companies that deal swiftly with racism, indicating that racism is a scourge in society, and has to always be fought in the quest to entrench social cohesion and heal the pains of the past.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa botsamaisi ba dikhamphani tsa poraefete tse sebetsanang ka potlako le semorabe, tse bontshang hore bosemorabe ke kgoba ka hara setjhaba sa rona, mme kamehla bo lokela ho lwantshwa bakeng sa ho batlana le mekgwa ya ho thathiselletsa momahano ya setjhaba le ho fodisa mahlaba a nako e fetileng.

src: We all have a responsibility to act swiftly whenever racism and discrimination occurs within our society.
tgt: Bohle re na le boikarabelo ba ho sebetsa ka potlako ha bosemorabe le kgethollo di etsahala ka hara setjhaba sa bo rona.

src: We all have a responsibility to build a new nation as envisaged after the first democratic elections.
tgt: Bohle re na le boikarabelo ba ho aha setjhaba jwaloka ha ho ne ho lakaditswe kamora dikgetho tsa pele tsa demokerasi.

src: Cabinet raised its concern about the state of job losses in the country, particularly in the retail and mining sectors.
tgt: Kabinete e hlahisitse matshwenyeho a yona mabapi le maemo a tahlehelo ya mesebetsi ka hara naha, ka ho qolleha makaleng a dithekiso le merafo.

src: However, it welcomed the efforts made by the mining sector to engage in dialogue that seek to save jobs.
tgt: Leha ho le jwalo, e amohetse mekutu e etswang ke lekala la merafo ya ho kena dipuisanong tse reretsweng ho baballa mesebetsi.

src: The recent approval of Lonmin’s application to acquire Anglo Platinum‘s 42,5% stake in Pandora – a joint venture between Lonmin and Anglo Platinum – is welcomed.
tgt: Ho tjhaellwa monwana ha haufinyana tjena ha kopo ya Lonmin ya ho fumantshwa 42,5% ya seabo sa Anglo Platinum ho Pandora – e leng boiteko bo kopanetsweng pakeng tsa Lonmin le Anglo Platinum – ho amohetswe.

src: This joint venture has in turn saved more than 3 000 jobs and is a relief, especially in the current global economic climate.
tgt: Boiteko bona bo kopanetsweng ka nqa e nngwe bo pholositse mesebetsi e fetang 3 000 mme sena se a imolla, haholoholo maemong a hajwale a moruo wa lefatshe.

src: Government remains committed to creating an environment that is conducive to economic growth and job creation.
tgt: Mmuso o dula o itlamme bakeng sa ho bopa tikoloho e loketseng kgolo ya moruo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi.

src: Cabinet welcomed the court decision that reaffirmed the prerogative of the government to make policy decisions and directives by dismissing with costs an application by the Metal Recyclers Association of South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e amohetse qeto ya lekgotla e thathiselleditseng botjha tokelo ya mmuso ya ho etsa diqeto tsa maano le ditaelo ka ho fedisa ka ditjeho kopo ya Mokgatlo wa Bahlabolli Botjha ba Dimetale wa Aforika Borwa.

src: The Constitutional Court dismissed an application by local exporters of scrap metal for leave to appeal the judgement of the High Court of South Africa and the Supreme Court of Appeal.
tgt: Lekgotla la Molaotheo le nyahladitse kopo ya baromelli ka ntle ba lehae ba metale o sebedisitsweng ya ho ipeletsa kgahlanong le kahlolo ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Aforika Borwa le Lekgotla le Leholo la Maipiletso.

src: The Court has upheld the State’s scrap metal export provisions known as price-preference for domestic foundries, mini-mills and secondary smelters scrap metal.
tgt: Lekgotla le tiiseditse pehelo ya Puso ya thekisetso ya ka ntle ya metale o sebedisitsweng e tsebahalang jwaloka monyetla wa ditheko bakeng sa bahlahisi ba tshepe, malwala a manyenyane le baqhibidihisi ba metale o sebedisitsweng.

src: It provides for a price discounted by 20% to international prices before qualifying for an export permit.
tgt: E fana ka hore theko e nyehliswe ka 20% papisong le ditheko tsa matjhaba pele ho tshwaneleho ya tumello ya thekisetso ya ka ntle.

src: This policy will help to reindustrialise the country’s economy and create jobs.
tgt: Leano lena le tla thusa bakeng sa ho e tsa hore moruo wa naha e be wa diindaseteri le o hlahisang mesebetsi.

src: Cabinet welcomed the commitment by the Canadian Government to cooperate with South Africa in border management.
tgt: Kabinete e amohetse boitlamo ba Mmuso wa Canada ba ho sebetsa mmoho le Aforika Borwa bolaoding ba meedi.

src: This came after the Minister of Home Affairs, ProfHlengiwe Mkhize, met with her Canadian counterpart Minister of Immigration, Refugees and Citizen Mr Ahmed Hussen this week.
tgt: Sena se tlile kamora hoba Letona la Merero ya Lehae, Moporofesara Hlengiwe Mkhize, a kopane le wa mphato wa hae waCanada eo e leng letona la Bofalli, Baphaphathehi le Baahi, Monghadi Ahmed Hussen bekeng ena.

src: This exchange will further strengthen the existing relationship between the two countries.
tgt: Phapanyetsano ena e tla tswela pele ho matlafatsa dikamano tse teng pakeng tsa dinaha tsena tse pedi.

src: Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.

src: Cabinet approved the Mandate Paper for the 2018 Budget.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Pampiri ya Thomo bakeng sa Ditekanyetso tsa selemo sa 2018.

src: This will further drive the implementation of the NDThe paper strengthens the alignment of the budget to the Medium Term Strategic Framework.
tgt: Sena se tla tswela pele ho kganna ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha NDPampiri ena e matlafatsa matahanyo ya ditekanyetso ho Moralo wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng (MTSF).

src: It establishes a systematic basis for making choices among competing priorities within limited resources.
tgt: E theha motheo o hlohlomisitsweng bakeng sa ho etsa maikgethelo hara dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tse hlodisanang ka hara mehlodi e haellang.

src: The Minister in The Presidency, Mr Jeff Radebe, will hold a media briefing at a later stage.
tgt: Letona Kantorong ya Boporesidente, Monghadi Jeff Radebe, o tla tshwara kopano ya boraditaba ha mmamorao.

src: Cabinet approved the Coastal and Marine Tourism Implementation Plan, developed under the auspices of the Operation Phakisa Oceans Economy.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Moralo wa ho Kenya Tshebetsong Bohahlaudi ba Mabopong le Mawatleng, o hlahisistsweng tlasa bodisa ba Moruo wa Mawatle wa Operation Phakisa.

src: The plan will uplift tourism in the ocean economy.
tgt: Moralo ona o tla hodisa bohahlaudi moruong wa mawatle.

src: It will grow a world-class and sustainable coastal and marine tourism destination that leverages South Africa’s competitive advantages in nature, culture and heritage.
tgt: O tla hodisa sebaka sa bohahlaudi ba mabopong le mawatleng sa maemo a hodimo a lefatshe le sa moshwelella se tla tsitsisa menyetla ya Aforika Borwa ya tlhodisano ho tsa tlhaho, setso le botjhaba.

src: The Minister of Tourism, Ms Tokozile Xasa, will hold a separate media briefing to unpack this plan.
tgt: Letona la Bohahlaudi, Mofumahadi Tokozile Xasa, o tla tshwara kopano e kgethehileng ya boraditaba bakeng sa ho nama ka moralo ona.

src: Cabinet approved South Africa’s participation in the Second International Indian Ocean Expedition for 2017 – 2020.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bonkakarolo ba Aforika Borwa ho Leeto la Bobedi la Matjhaba la Lewatle la India bakeng sa selemo sa 2017 – 2020.

src: The participation will support South Africa’s Chairpersonship of the Indian Ocean Rim Association in 2017/18.South Africa will use its research vessel SA Agulhas II to conduct marine research while training and building scientific capacity for South Africa and East Africa.
tgt: Bonkakarolo bo tla tshehetsa Bodulasetulo ba Aforika Borwa ba Mokgatlo wa Lewatle la India wa Rim ka 2017/18.Aforika Borwa e tla sebedisa sekepe sa diphuputso SA Agulhas II ho etsa diphuputso tsa lewatleng ka ho le leng e ntse e rupella le ho hodisa bokgoni ba tsa saense bakeng sa Aforika Borwa le seboka sa dinaha tse ka botjhabela ba Aforika.

src: The gathering of basic long-term environmental data and information will place the developing countries of the Indian Ocean Rim in a better position to conserve the integrity of its ocean and to find ways to unlock their respective potential ocean economies to improve the lives of their citizens.
tgt: Pokello ya motheo ya nako e telele ya datha le tlhahisoleseding ka tsa tikoloho e tla beha dinaha tse ntseng di tswela pele tsa Rim ya Lewatle la India maemong a matle a ho baballa bokgabane ba lewatle la yona le ho thola ditsela tsa ho utulla bokgoni ba meruo ya tsona ka ho latelana bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa maphelo a baahi ba tsona.

src: Cabinet was apprised on the Chemicals and Waste Economy Phakisa Labs initiative, which is scheduled to commence in August 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka boikitlaetso ba Dilaboratori tsa Phakisa tsa Moruo wa Dikhemikhale le Matlakala, bo reretsweng ho qala ka Phato 2017.

src: This forms part of the country’s intervention to manage the threats to the environment and human health caused by chemicals and waste.
tgt: Sena se bopa karolo ya boitshunyako ba naha bakeng sa ho laola ditshoso tsa tikoloho le boitekanelo ba batho tse bakwang ke dikhemikhale le WEBTOKEN tla tswela pele ho fana ka monyetla bakeng sa hore indaseteri ya dikhemikhale ya Aforika Borwa e hlwaye dibaka tsa tlhahiso tse amahanngwang le Dikhemikhale tse Hlwekileng (moralo wa dihlahiswa tsa dikhemikhale le metjha e fokotsang kapa ho fedisa ho hlahiswa ha dintho tse kotsi).

src: It will provide a further opportunity for the South African chemical industry to identify manufacturing niches that are associated with Green Chemistry (the design of chemical products and processes that reduce or eliminate the generation of hazardous substances).
tgt: Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka dikopo tse ngata mabapi le ho sekaseka botjha meedi ya diporofense ho tswa baduding ba diporefense tse fapafapaneng.

src: Cabinet was briefed on a number requests to redetermine the provincial boundaries from communities in various provinces.
tgt: Hara dibaka tse amehang ke Masepala wa Lehae wa Elias Motsoaledi, Masepala wa Lehae wa Marblehall le Masepala wa Lehae wa Matatiele.

src: Amongst the areas affected are Elias Motsoaledi Local Municipality, Marblehall Local Municipality and Matatiele Local Municipality.
tgt: Badudi bana ba hlahisitse mabaka a mangata bakeng sa dikopo tsena, a kang sebaka sa sebopeho sa tlhaho le phihlello ya ditshebeletso.

src: The requests were received by the Municipal Demarcation Board and Department of Corporative Governance.
tgt: Dikopo di amohetswe ke Boto ya Tsheho ya Meedi ya Bomasepala le Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba (COGTA).Meedi ya diporofense e tekilwe ka hara dipehelo tsa Molaotheo.

src: Provincial boundaries are provided for in the Constitution.
tgt: Tshekatsheko leha e kaba efe ya dikopo tse jwalo e lokelwa ho etswa ho itshetlehilwe hodima moralo wa molaotheo.

src: Cabinet agreed that a process to redetermine the boundaries, which include Matatiele, be instituted.
tgt: Kabinete e dumellane hore motjha wa ho sekaseka botjha meedi, o kenyeletsang Matatiele, o kenngwe tshebetsong.

src: This parliamentary process will also include public participation as required by the Constitution and the law.
tgt: Motjha ona wa palamente hape o tla kenyeletsa bonkakarolo ba setjhaba jwaloka ha ho batleha ho ya ka Molaotheo le Molao.

src: Upcoming events.
tgt: Diketsahalo tse tlang.

src: Cabinet reiterates President Zuma’s call, reminding members of the public to nominate persons from all walks of life deserving to receive the country’s highest honours, the National Orders, in April next year.
tgt: Kabinete e boeletsa kgoeletso ya Moporesidente Zuma, ya ho hopotsa ditho tsa setjhaba ho thonya batho ho tswa ka makgalo oohle a bophelo ba tshwanelehang ke ho amohela ditlotlo tse kgolo ka ho fetisisa, Ditlotlo tsa Naha, ka Mmesa selemong se tlang.

src: The ceremony honours South Africans and eminent foreign nationals who have excelled in various fields.
tgt: Mokete ona o tlotla maAforika Borwa le melata e hlahelletseng ka mahetla e ipabotseng ka makgabane mapatlelong a fapafapaneng.

src: Nominations forms are available on The Presidency’s website (WEBTOKEN), Thusong Service Centres, municipal offices and constituency offices.
tgt: Diforomo tsa dithonyo di a fumaneha websaeteng ya Kantorong ya Boporesidente (WEBTOKEN), Ditsheng tsa Ditshebeletso tsa Thusong, dikantorong tsa bomasepala le dikantorong tsa mekga ya dipolotiki.

src: A short motivation of the person nominated should be attached.
tgt: Ho lokela ho kenyeletswa kgothatso e kgutshwanyane ka motho ya thonngwang.

src: The 2018 National Orders nominations will close on 31 August 2017.
tgt: Dithonyo tsa Ditlotlo tsa Naha tsa selemo sa 2018 di tla kwallwa ka la 31 Phato 2017.

src: The Department of Science and Technology will host the 2017 South African Women in Science Awards (WISA).
tgt: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji le tla tshwara mokete wa selemo sa 2017 wa Dikgau tsa Basadi ba Aforika Borwa ka hara tsa Saense (WISA).

src: The awards recognise the achievements of prominent scientists and create a platform for the motivation of women scientists participating in research.
tgt: Dikgau di ananela diphihlello tsa bommasaense ba hlahelletseng ka mahetla le ho hlahisa lepatlelo bakeng sa ho kgothatsa basadi ba tsa saense ba nkang karolo diphuputsong.

src: The WISA will be hosted under the theme: “Women’s economic empowerment in the changing world of work”, which is in line with the United Nations Commission on the Status of women priority theme for 2017.
tgt: WISA e tla tshwarwa tlasa mookotaba: “Matlafatso ya basadi moruong lefatsheng le ntseng le fetoha la mosebetsi”, o tsamaelanang le mookotaba wa Khomishene ya Matjhaba a Kopaneng ya Maemo a Basadi bakeng sa selemo sa 2017.

src: Cabinet thanks the members the Fifth National House of Traditional Leaders (NHTL) whose terms come to an end.
tgt: Kabinete e leboha ditho tsa Ntlo ya Bohlano ya Baetapele ba Botjhaba (NHTL) eo nako ya yona ya tshebetso e fihlang qetellong.

src: The NHTL is a body composed of traditional leaders who are delegates from the provincial houses of traditional Leaders of South Africa, representing the provincial houses at national level.
tgt: NHTL ke setheo se bopilweng ka baetapele ba botjhaba bao e leng kemedi ho tswa matlong a diporofense a Baetapele ba Botjhaba ba Aforika Borwa, ba emelang matlo a diporofense boemong ba naha.

src: The group comprised of both outgoing members of the NHTL and members who have been re-elected to serve for one more term.
tgt: Sehlopha sena se bopilwe ka ditho ka bobedi tse tlohelang marapo tsa NHTL le ditho tse kgethuweng hape ho sebetsa bakeng sa sehla se seng hape.

src: They represent traditional leadership and their communities and promote the role of traditional leadership within the constitutional dispensation.
tgt: Ba emetse boetapele ba botjhaba le badudi ba bona le ho hodisa karolo e bapalwang ke boetapele ba setso ka hara tsamaiso ya molaotheo.

src: Cabinet joined President Zuma in thanking Kgosi PP Maubane (Chairperson), Ikosi SE Mahlangu (Deputy Chairperson) and the entire membership of the House.
tgt: Kabinete e imatahantse le Moporesidente Zuma mabapi le ho leboha Morena PP Maubane (Modulasetulo), Morena SE Mahlangu (Motlatsi wa Modulasetulo) le ditho kaofela tsa Ntlo ena.

src: Cabinet extends a warm welcome to the in-coming members of the Sixth NHTL and those of the seven provincial houses.
tgt: Kabinete e fetisa maikutlo a mofuthu a kamohelo ho ditho tse tla nka marapo a NHTL ya Botshelela le ba matlo a supileng a diporofense.

src: Messages.
tgt: Melaetsa.

src: Cabinet congratulates Ms Senamile Masango who became the first African woman to conduct the first African-led experiment at the European Organisation for Nuclear Research laboratory in Switzerland.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa Mofumahadi Senamile Masango eo e bileng mosadi wa pele wa Aforika ya entseng teko ya pele e eteletsweng pele ke maAforika laboratoring ya Diphuputso tsa Nutleleya ya Mokgatlo wa Yuropa (CERN) ho la Switzerland.

src: She was part of a group of student researchers from the University of the Western Cape studying the isotope selenium-70 to better understand how its nuclei shape relates to its energy levels.
tgt: E ne e le karolo ya moifo wa bafuputsi ba baithuti ho tswa Yunivesithing ya Kapa Bophirima ba ithutang ka isotope selenium-70 bakeng sa ho utlwisisa hantle kamoo sebopeho sa dinyutleleya di amanang le maemo a tsona a eneji.

src: Cabinet congratulates People Opposing Women Abuse (POWA), who have developed an App that helps survivors of gender-based violence, in distress or imminent danger, to have access to integrated and coordinated services.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa mokgatlo wa Batho ba Kgahlanong le Tlhekefetso ya Basadi (POWA), o hlahisitseng App e thusang mahlatsipa a dikgoka tse itshetlehileng hodima bong, a tlasa kgatello ya maikutlo kapa kotsing e ka nnang ya hlaha, ho fihlella ditshebeletso tse kopanetsweng le tse hokahantsweng.

src: With a link to the Department of Social Development’s Command Centre, the App can link to other services like the police and social workers, who can be able to identify the location where the message originates.
tgt: Moo ho ka hokahanwang le Setsi sa Taolo sa Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba, App ena e ka hokelwa ho ditshebeletso tse ding tse kang sepolesa le basebeletsi ba kahisano, ba ka kgonang ho hlwaya sebaka sa moo molaetsa o hlahang teng.

src: Through a press of a panic button on the mobile, a victim will be linked to the Command Centre.
tgt: Ka ho tobetsa konopo ya letshoho selefounung, lehlatsipa le tla hokelwa ho Setsi sa Taolo.

src: This collaboration between government and non-governmental organisations will go a long way towards fighting the scourge of abuse.
tgt: Tshebedisano ena e pakeng tsa mmuso le mekgatlo eo e seng ya mmuso e tla sebetsa ka matla bakeng sa ho lwantsha kgoba ena ya tlhekefetso.

src: Cabinet congratulates Team South Africa for their outstanding achievements on the track and field at the International Association of Athletics Federations World Championships in London.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa Sehlopha sa Aforika Borwa bakeng sa diphihlello tsa bona tse babatsehang mabelong a Bompodi ba Lefatshe ba Difedereishene tsa Diatleletiki tsa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba London.

src: Caster Semenya won gold in the 800m and bronze in the women’s 1 500m, in the process breaking her personal best record.
tgt: Caster Semenya o hapile gauta ho 800m le boronse lebelong la basadi la 1 500m, mme hona moo a roba rekoto ya hae e ntle ka ho fetisisa.

src: Semenya has done the country proud and amidst the negativity, she remains strong and resilient.
tgt: Semenya o entse naha motlotlo le hara dipuo-puo tse seng monate, o dula a ntse a le matla le ho itseka.

src: She follows in the footsteps of Zola Budd, Natalie du Toit, the paralympian, and Penny Heyns, the swimmer.
tgt: O latela menyabuketsong ya Zola Budd, Natalie duToit, wa dipharalimpiki, le Penny Heyns, wa sesesi.

src: Wayde van Niekerk won gold in the men’s 400m and silver in the 200m.
tgt: Wayde van Niekerk o hapile gauta lebelong la banna la 400m le silifera ho la 200m.

src: A special word of gratitude to the coach, Ms Anna Botha.
tgt: Lentswe le ikgethang la teboho le lebiswa ho mokwetlisi, Mofumahadi Anna Botha.

src: Luvo Manyonga won gold medal with his leap of 8.34m in the men’s long-jump final, Ruswahl Samaai won bronze in the men’s long jump, and Akani Simbine came fifth-place in the men’s 100m final.
tgt: Luvo Manyonga o hapile medale wa gauta ka ho tlola bolele ba 8.34m ho makgaola-kgang a ho tlolela hole ha banna, Ruswahl Samaai o hapile boronse ho tloleleng hole ha banna, le Akani Simbine ya nkileng maemo a bohlano lebelong la makgaola-kgang la 100m.

src: Their performances showcased the sporting prowess of our nation, which is an inspiration and motivation to all South Africans, especially young budding athletes.
tgt: Ditshebetso tsa bona di pepesitse boitsebelo ba dipapadi ba setjhaba sa rona, e leng tshusumetso le kgothatso ho maAforika Borwa kaofela, haholoholo ho maatlelete a ntseng a tla a thuthua.

src: These athletes did our nation proud and carried our national flag with distinction.
tgt: Maatlelete ana a entse setjhaba sa rona motlotlo le ho fofisa folakga ya rona ya setjhaba ka ho ikgetha.

src: We call on South Africans to continue supporting all our national teams, as well as our sportsmen and women.
tgt: Re ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ho tswela pele ho tshehetsa dihlopha tsa rona kaofela tsa naha, hammoho le boradipapadi le bommadipapadi ba rona.

src: They are an embodiment of our great nation, and we have no doubt that they will inspire other young people to follow in their footsteps.
tgt: Ke sesupo sa setjhaba sa rona se matla, mme ha re qea-qee hore ba tla susumetsa batjha ba bang hore ba latele menyabuketsong ya bona.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokela ho tiisetswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.

src: Mr AD Matseke as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Broadband Infraco, with effect from 1 September 2017 to 30 August 2022.
tgt: Monghadi AD Matseke jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) wa Broadband Infraco, ho tloha ka la 1 Loetse 2017 ho isa ka la 30 Phato 2022.

src: Extension of the fixed-term contract of the current CEO of Broadband Infraco, Ms PV Kwele, by three months, from 1 September to 30 November 2017.
tgt: Katoloso ya konteraka e tsitsitseng ya CEO ya hajwale ya Broadband Infraco, Mofumahadi PV Kwele, ka dikgwedi tse tharo, ho tloha ka la 1 Loetse ho isa ka la 30 Pudungwana 2017.

src: Reappointment of Mr Ian van Niekerk as the Chief Financial Officer of Broadband Infraco.
tgt: Ho thonngwa hape ha Monghadi Ian van Niekerk jwaloka Mohlanka e Moholo wa Ditjhelete (CFO) wa Broadband Infraco.

src: Dr Moshibudi Priscilla Rampedi as the CEO of the South African National Biodiversity Institute.
tgt: Ngaka Moshibudi Priscilla Rampedi jwaloka CEO ya Setheo sa Naha sa Diphapang ho tsa Tlhaho sa Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet met at Tuynhuys in Cape Town.
tgt: Kabinete e ne ekopane Tuynhuys ho la Motse Kapa.

src: Cabinet welcomed the outcomes of the 37th Southern African Development Community (SADC) Ordinary Summit of Heads of State and Government held in South Africa from 9 to 20 August 2017 under the theme: “Partnering with the Private Sector in Developing Industry and Regional Value Chains”.The summit focused on the implementation of the SADC Industrialization Strategy and Roadmap to accelerate economic growth and development in the region.
tgt: Kabinete e amohetse diphetho tsa Seboka se Tlwaelehileng sa bo-37sa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) sa Dihlooho tsa Dipuso le Mebuso se neng se tshwaretswe Aforika Borwa ho tloha ka la 9 ho isa ka la 20 Phato 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “Re theha Selekane le Lekala la Poraefete mabapi le ho Ntshetsapele Diindaseteri le Mathathama a Dikgwebo a Lebatowa”.Seboka se ne se tsepamisitse maikutlo hodima ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lewa la kaho ya Diindaseteri le Mmapa wa SADC ho akofisa kgolo ya moruo le ntshetsopele ka hara lebatowa.

src: The strategy seeks to change the structure of the economies of the region and promotes value-addition with focus on agro-processing, mineral beneficiation and pharmaceuticals.
tgt: Lewa lena le rerile ho fetola sebopeho sa meruo sa lebatowa le ho hodisa keketseho ya boleng ho tsepamisitswe maikutlo hodima tswelliso ya dihlahiswa tsa temo, bokgolamolemo ba diminerale le meriana.

src: The summit emphasized the need to have concrete outcomes that leverage on our national endowments.
tgt: Seboka se tobokeditse tlhokeho ya ho ba le diphetho tse tiileng tse tsitsisang ding tsa rona tsa naha.

src: Cabinet joins President Jacob Zuma in thanking His Majesty King Mswati III, the outgoing Chairperson of the SADC, for his valuable contribution and leadership, as South Africa assumes the role of chair of the SADC from August 2017 to August 2018.
tgt: Kabinete e ipapisa le Moporesidente Jacob Zuma mabapi le ho leboha Motlotlehi Morena Mswati III, Modulasetulo ya tlohelang marapo wa SADC,mabapi le nyehelo ya hae ya bohlokwa le boetapele, ha Aforika Borwa e nka bodulasetulo ba SADC ho tloha kaPhato 2017 ho isa ka Phato 2018.

src: Cabinet salutes all women, and extends heartfelt thanks to those who participated in celebrating and commemorating women as we close Women’s Month, under the theme: “The Year of OR Tambo: Women United in Moving South Arica Forward”.Although women have made important gains in South Africa, more needs to be done and government programmes will continue to prioritise the involvement of women in developing our communities, the economy and country.
tgt: Kabinete e hlompha basadi bohle, le ho fetisa diteboho tse tebileng ho ba nkileng karolo mabapi le ho keteka le ho hopola basadi jwaloka ha re kwala Kgwedi ya Basadi, tlasa mookotaba: “Selemo sa OR Tambo: Basadi ba Kopane mabapi le ho Ntshetsa Aforika Borwa Pele”.Leha basadi ba entse dikuno tsa bohlokwa ka hara Afrika Borwa, se sa le sengata se lokelang ho etswa mme mananeo a mmuso a tla tswela pele ho beha ka sehlohlolong ho kenyeletswa ha basadi mabapi le ho ntshetsa pele metse ya bo rona, moruo le naha.

src: Women still continue to face unacceptable levels of abuse and violence, poverty, unemployment.
tgt: Basadi ba ntse ba tswela pele ho tobana le maemo a sa amoheleheng a tlhekefetso le dikgoka, bofuma le tlhokeho ya mesebetsi.

src: Cabinet noted the Poverty Trends Report released by Statistics South Africa and will engage with it.
tgt: Kabinete e lemohile Tlaleho ya Mekgwa ya Bofumae lokolotsweng ke Lefapha la Dipalopalo la Aforika Borwa (StatsSA) mme e tla e sekaseka.

src: Cabinet reiterated its commitment to its pro-poor programmes, particularly as it relates to children coming from poor households.
tgt: Kabinete e boeleditse boitlamo ba yona ba mananeo a ho sebeletsa bafutsana, ka ho qolleha bana ba tswang malapeng a futsanehileng.

src: Over the last 23 years, government has increased the social grants programme to poor and vulnerable communities from 2, 7 million to 17 million people.
