tgt: Bakeng sa ho tiisa moya wa bojalefa, Kabinete e amohela tumellano e saennweng pakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le Tanzania, e reretsweng ho baballa nalane ya ntwa ya tokoloho.

src: During World Tourism Day, different countries and cultures celebrate a multiplicity of region-based activities such as the promotion of special tariffs and/or broadening access to facilities, mass-based free access to parks and gardens, and various engagements with stakeholders.
tgt: UN e fafielletse ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Porojeke ya Ditsela tse Lebisang Boikemelong ka hara Aforika.

src: South Africa has been successful in promoting tourism through its various attractive facilities such as our parks, blue flag beaches, and the world accredited heritage sites.
tgt: Ka ho ketekwa ha moya wa bonngwe le tshebedisano-mmoho hara mekgatlo ya tokoloho ya Aforika mme e tla baka ho ahuwa ha museamo, laeborari le dibaka tsa polokelo ya nalane.

src: As a tourist destination, South Africa faces the prospects of growing its transversal tourism sectors to enable massive economic potential through the so-called traditional dominant tourism economic sectors.
tgt: Aforika Borwa, tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Bohahlaudi, Mofumahadi Tokozile Xasa, e nkile karolo ho Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Bohahlaudi (27 Loetse 2017) le ho Kgwedi ya Bohahlaudi, tlasa mookotaba, “Bohahlaudi ba Moshwelella – Sesebediswa sa Ntshetsopele”.

src: These include rural, medical, agro and cultural tourism.
tgt: Sena se fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa ho tshehetsa diphethoho leanong, ditlwaelong tsa dikgwebo le boitshwaro ba basebedisi ba bohahlaudi, tse lebisitseng ho lekala la bohahlaudi la moshwelella, le ka nyehelang ka matla mabapi le ho fihlellwa ha di-SDNakong ya Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Bohahlaudi, dinaha le ditso tse fapaneng di keteka bongata ba diketsahalo tse itshetlehileng mabatoweng tse kang kgothaletso ya dikepele tse ikgethang le/kapa ho batalatsa ho fihlella dibaka, ho dumellwa ho kena ka bongata mahala diphakeng le dirapeng, le dipuisano tse fapafapaneng le bangkakarolo.

src: Antiretroviral pricing agreementCabinet welcomes the ground-breaking pricing agreement reached by the Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, in collaboration with a number of international organisations, to accelerate the availability of the first affordable single-pill HIV-treatment WEBTOKEN is estimated that the price reduction will result in savings of up to R.7 billion over the next six years.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e atlehile bakeng sa ho hodisa bohahlaudi ka dibaka tsa yona tse fapafapaneng tse nang le kgohedi tse kang diphaka tsa rona, mabopo a rona a lewatle a maemo a hodimo, le ditsha tsa bojalefa tse tjhaelletsweng monwana ke lefatshe.

src: This will enable South Africa to enrol more patients on treatment.
tgt: Bokgoni ba Bohahlaudi ba ho amohela basebetsi e dula e le sebetsa se seholo kgahlanong le tlhokeho ya mesebetsi.

src: The pricing agreement makes the medicine Dolutegravir, which is recommended by the World Health Organization, more affordable for governments in low and middle-income WEBTOKEN light of the pricing agreement, the Department of Health plans to introduce the new fixed-dose combination of three drugs, Tenofovir, Lamivudine and Dolutegravir in April 2018.Cabinet calls on all sexually active South Africans, especially youth, to continue to live a healthy life which adopts preventative measures such as continuously practising safer sex by abstaining, being faithful and condomising, and regularly testing for HIV.
tgt: Jwaloka sebaka sa bohahlaudi, Aforika Borwa e tobane le kgonahalo ya ho hodisa makala a yona a parolang le makala a mang a moruo ho kgonahatsa bokgoni bo matla ba moruo ka makala a mang a mehleng eo esale a le ka sehloohong a moruo.

src: HealthCabinet welcomes the unveiling of the new wing of the Cecilia Makiwane Hospital in Mdantsane, East London.
tgt: Ana a kenyeletsa bohahlaudi ba dibaka tsa mahae, tsa bongaka, tsa temo le tsa botjhaba.

src: It is a milestone towards the implementation of the National Health Insurance that will result in the provision of quality healthcare, particularly to poor communities.
tgt: Tumellano ya ho beha ditheko tsa meriana ya HIKabinete e amohela tumellano e etsang pale ya ditefello e fihlelletsweng ke Letona la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, ka tshebedisano le mekgatlo e mengata ya matjhaba, ho akofisa boteng ba mokgahlelo wa pele wa pidisi e le nngwe ya kalafo ya HIHo akanngwa hore ho fokotswa ha tefello ho tla baka dipoloko tse ka fihlang ho R.7 bilione dilemong tse tsheletseng tse tlang.

src: This world-class tertiary hospital is an investment to realise the National Development Plan’s (NDP) vision and the UN’s SDGs of universal healthcare.
tgt: Tumellano ya ditefello e etsa hore moriana wa Dolutegravir, o kgothaletswang ke Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle (WHO), o kgonahale bakeng sa mebuso ya dinaha tsa lekeno le tlase le le mahareng.

src: The 526-bed hospital is supported by an integrated system that will optimise delivery of quality healthcare.
tgt: Ho ya ka tumellano ya ditefello, Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle le rera ho tsebahatsa motswako wa ho nowa ho tsitsitseng ha meriana e meraro, Tenofovir, Lamivudine le Dolutegravir ka Mmesa 2018.

src: It applies technological innovation to reduce patient waiting times, improve diagnosis and enables a quicker health intervention in patients.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela a a seng a le maemong a ho kena ho tsa thobalano, ka ho qolleha batjha, ho tswela pele ho phela bophelo bo itekanetseng ba ho amohela mekgwa ya thibelo e kang ho dula ba kena thobalanong e bolokehileng ka ho ikgula thobalanong, ho tshepahala le ho sebedisa dikgohlopo, le ho kenela diteko tsa HIV kgafetsa.

src: As we revitalise public health infrastructure, we are also expanding opportunities for local communities to improve their lives through job creation and local enterprise WEBTOKEN Development MonthCabinet calls on South Africans to continue to uplift those less fortunate than themselves ahead of Social Development Month in WEBTOKEN Development Month is held annually to commemorate the many strides the country has made, in providing social assistance to the poor and the most vulnerable in South Africa.
tgt: Ke mokolokotwane o lebisitseng ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha Inshorense ya Naha ya Bophelo bo Botle e tla baka hore ho be le phano ya tlhokomelo ya kalafo ya boleng, ka ho qolleha ho badudi ba futsanehileng.

src: President Zuma will officially launch the commemoration of Social Development Month on Friday, 29 September 2017.Cabinet warmly wishes all senior citizens and older persons a happy Older Persons Day, which will be commemorated on Sunday, 1 October 2017.South Africans are encouraged to use October month to recognise the role and prime sacrifice older persons made in attaining freedom in our country.
tgt: Sepetlele sena sa dithuto tse hodimo sa maemo a lefatshe ke matsete a ho fihlella tjhebelopele ya Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) le di-SDG tsa UN tsa tlhokomelo ya kalafo ya lefatshe.

src: Social grants bring financial relief to millions of households and working together with government uplifts the vulnerable so that their living conditions improve with dignity.
tgt: E sebedisa ntjhafatso ya thekenoloji ho fokotsa dinako tsa badudi tsa ho ema, e ntlafatsa ho hlahlojwa le ho thusa ka boitshunyako bo potlakileng ba kalafo bakeng sa bakudi.

src: The programme reaches approximately six million beneficiaries every year through the Integrated Mobile Outreach Programme, the Annual Thusong Service Centre Week and other Government Communication and Information System (GCIS) platforms.
tgt: Kgwedi ya Ntshetsopele ya Kahisano e tshwarwa selemo ka seng ho hopola menyabuketso e mengata e entsweng ke naha, mabapi le ho fana ka thuso ya kahisano ho ba fumanehileng le ba tsietsing haholo ka hara Aforika Borwa.

src: Through this programme, government continues to redress the imbalances of the past by bringing quality public services closer to communities previously marginalised from the mainstream of socio-economic development.
tgt: Moporesidente Zuma o tla thakgola semmuso sehopotso sa Ntshetsopele ya Kgwedi ya Kahisano ka Labohlano, 29 Loetse 2017.

src: Thusong Service Centres also empower communities with the necessary skills and training to better their lives, through existing partnerships with government, parastatals and the private sector.
tgt: Kabinete e lakaletsa ka mofuthu maqheku kaofela le batho ba hodileng Letsatsi le monate la Batho ba hodileng, le tla hopolwa ka Sontaha sa, la 1 Mphalane 2017.

src: Cabinet reiterates the call to communities to continue using Thusong Service Centres to access basic services such as Home Affairs, Labour, Justice, South African Social Security Agency and the Road Accident Fund.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho sebedisa kgwedi ya Mphalane ho ananela karolo le sehlabelo sa bohlokwa se entsweng ke batho ba hodileng mabapi le ho fihlella tokoloho ka hara naha ya bo rona.

src: MyanmarCabinet is concerned about the plight of Rohingya civilians who have fled their homes in Myanmar.
tgt: Ke mosebetsi wa baahi mmoho ba bo rona, e seng feela mmuso, ho fana ka tlhokomelo e eketsehileng ho maqheku a rona le dihlopha tse tsietsing.

src: South Africa supports the statement by UN Secretary-General, Mr António Guterres, who emphasised the responsibility of the Government of Myanmar to provide security to all affected communities, and further request for humanitarian agencies to be granted access to communities in need of assistance and protection.
tgt: Lenaneo la Mmuso wa Aforika Borwa la dithuso tsa setjhaba le thehilwe hodima tumelo e tiileng ya hore dithuso tsa polokeho ya setjhaba ke tokelo ya motheo ya botho mme di bohlokwa bakeng sa ho kgutlisa seriti sa baahi ba yona.

src: Cabinet urges all parties to end the violence to avoid further human suffering and appeals that situation in the Rakhine State be resolved with the ambit of the law.
tgt: Dithuso tsa setjhaba di imolla mathata a ditjhelete a dimilione tsa malapa mme ka ho sebetsa mmoho le mmuso di matlafatsa ba tsietsing hore maemo a bona a bophelo a ntlafale a be le seriti.

src: Launch of the Bakoena Ba Mopeli customary law bookCabinet applauds the launch of the book, Bakoena Ba Mopeli Customary Law of Succession and Genealogy, as a milestone achievement for traditional leadership in South Africa.
tgt: Mmuso o phethetse ka katleho Beke ya Selemo ka seng ya selemong sena ya Thusong Service Centre, e etsahetseng ho tloha ka la 18 ho isa ka la 22 Loetse 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “Selemo sa OR Tambo – Re Ntshetsapele Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, tse Mahareng le tse Kgolo ho di-Thusong Service Centre”.

src: The Minister of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, Mr Des van Rooyen, and His Majesty King Letsie III, the Head of State of the Kingdom of Lesotho, attended the event on Monday, 25 September 2017.The Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs started documenting the history of 13 Kingships/Queenships in 2011.
tgt: Sena se bopile karolo ya Kgwedi ya Tshebeletso ya Mmuso le ho kgothaletsa Lenaneo la Thusong ka ho pepesa lenaneo le kopanetsweng la ho fihlella dibaka ka dibaka le bokgabane ba lona mabapi le ho arabela ditlhoko tsa baahi.

src: This book will assist in understanding the history of Bakoena Ba Mopeli and succession genealogy in order to preserve our history.
tgt: Di-Thusong Services Centre di tlisa mokeke wa ditshebeletso tsa mmuso le tlhahisoleseding haufi le batho.

src: Cabinet decisionsSouthern African Development Community (SADC) protocolCabinet approved the ratification of the SADC Protocol on Environmental Management for Sustainable Development, by Parliament.
tgt: Lenaneo lena le fihlella bakgolamolemo ba akanngwang ho dimilione tse tsheletseng selemo ka seng ka Lenaneo le Kopanetsweng la Phihlello ya Dibaka ka Dibaka la Phihlello, Beke ya Selemo ka seng ya Thusong Service Centre le mapatlelo a mang a Tsamaiso ya Dikgokahanyo le Tlhahisoleseding ya Mmuso (GCIS).

src: The objective of the protocol is to promote sustainable use and transboundary management of the environment, which is of interest to SADC member states.
tgt: Ka lenaneo lena, mmuso o tswela pele ho lokisa ho se lekalekane ha nako e fetileng ka ho tlisa ditshebeletso tsa boleng haufi le badudi bao pele ba neng ba qheletswe ka thoko ntshetsopeleng e tlwaelehileng ya moruo wa kahisano.

src: This is aligned to the NDP, which prioritises the deepening of integration of the SADC region as well as ensuring environmental sustainability and an equitable transition to a low-carbon economy.
tgt: Di-Thusong Service Centre hape di matlafatsa badudi ka maitsebelo le thupello e hlokehang bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa maphelo a bona, ka bolekane bo teng le mmuso, ditheo tse thuswang ke mmuso le lekala la poraefete.

src: Partnership for Action on the Green Economy Ministerial ConferenceCabinet approved the hosting of the Partnership for Action on the Green Economy Ministerial Conference in September 2018.
tgt: Kabinete e boeletsa kgoeletso ya yona ho badudi ho tswela pele ho sebedisa di-Thusong Service Centre ho fihlella ditshebeletso tse kang tsa Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae, la Mesebetsi, la Toka, Lekala la Aforika Borwa la Dithuso tsa Setjhaba (SASA) le Letlole la Dikotsi tsa Mebila (RAF).

src: Umngeni Water BoardIn order to stabilise the governance issues of the Board Cabinet endorsed the appointment of the Interim Board whilst the Minister is expediting the process to appoint the fully fledged Umngeni Water Board.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e tshehetsa pehelo ya Mongodi-Kakaretso wa UN, Monghadi António Guterres, ya tobokeditseng boikarabelo ba Mmuso wa Myanmar ba ho fana ka tshireletso ho badudi bohle ba amehang, le hape ho kopa makala a thekolohelo ya botho ho fumantshwa phihlello ya badudi ba hlokang thuso le tshireletso.

src: Cabinet was satisfied with the work that the Minister was doing in stabilising the Umngeni Water Board.
tgt: Kabinete e kgothaletsa mahlakore kaofela ho fedisa merusu le ho thibela ho tswela pele ha tshotleho ya batho le ho ipiletsa hore boemo ka hara Puso ya Rakhine bo rarollwe ho itshetlehilwe hodima molao.

src: Cabinet calls on all to work together to ensure the country’s transport infrastructure benefits all and encourages road users to take responsibility and apply road safety as part of their daily lives.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa kaofela a lokela ho tshwela ka mathe botlokotsebe bo kang bona bo tshosang lekala la rona le dulang le hola la bohahlaudi.

src: The national launch is being held at Sinaba Stadium in Daveyton in the City of Ekurhuleni on 29 September WEBTOKEN in the transport sector are stimulating development and creating jobs as part of South Africa’s Nine-Point Plan, which aims to grow the economy and create much-needed jobs.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa ho thakgolwa ha buka, Bakoena Ba Mopeli Customary Law of Succession and Genealogy, jwaloka phihlello ya mokolokotwane bakeng sa boetapele ba setso ka hara Aforika Borwa.

src: South Africa to host the 2nd Session of the South Africa-Zimbabwe Bi-National Commission (BNC)President Jacob Zuma will host his Zimbabwean counterpart, His Excellency President Robert Mugabe, who will be in South Africa on 03 October 2017 on the occasion of the 2nd Session of the South Africa-Zimbabwe BNThe Agreement establishing the BNC was signed in April 2015 and inaugurated in October 2016 in Harare, Zimbabwe.
tgt: Letona la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba, Monghadi Des van Rooyen, le Motlotlehi Morena Letsie III, Hlooho ya Puso ya Borena ba Lesotho, ba ne ba kenetse ketsahalo ena ka Mantaha wa, la 25 Loetse 2017.

src: South Africa and Zimbabwe have good bilateral political, economic and social relations underpinned by strong historical ties dating back many years.
tgt: Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba le qadile ho hlophisa ditokomane tsa nalane ya dikarolo tse 13 tsa Borena/Bofumahadi ka selemo sa 2011.

src: MessagesBirthday – Mama Winnie Madikizela-MandelaCabinet joins the rest of the country in wishing Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, affectionately known as the Mother of the Nation, a happy birthday as she turned 81 on Tuesday, 26 September 2017.Mama Madikizela-Mandela is one of South Africa’s most celebrated liberation icons.
tgt: Sepheo sa porothokhole ke ho kgothaletsa taolo ya tikoloho e parolang le meedi, e leng tabatabelo ya ditho tsa dipuso tsa SADAforika Borwa, jwaloka Modulasetulo wa SADC ho tloha ka Phato 2017 ho isa ka Phato 2018, e itlama ho matlafatsa mekutu ya lebatowa ya ho baballa mehlodi ya tlhaho ya ho parola le meedi le ho kgothaletsa ntshetsopele ya moshwelella ka hara lebatowa la SADSena se matahantswe le NDP, e behileng ka sehlohlolong ho tebisa kopanelo ya lebatowa la SADC hammoho le ho netefatsa paballo ya moshwelella ya tikoloho le diphethoho tse lekalekanang tse lebisang moruong wa khabone e tlase.

src: Earthquake in MexicoCabinet joins President Zuma in extending condolences to President Enrique Peña Nieto of the United Mexican States and to the people of Mexico following the devastating earthquake, tsunami and hurricane, which resulted in more than 225 deaths and severe destruction to infrastructure.
tgt: Ke lenaneo la UN le kopanyang mmoho botsebi ho tswa Makaleng a mahlano a UN e leng Lenaneo la Tikoloho la UN Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Basebetsi (ILO) Lenaneo la Ntshetsopele la UN Mokgatlo wa Ntshetsopele ya Diindaseteri wa UN le Setheo sa Thupello le Diphuputso.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: Ho tshwara Pitso ya Matona ho tla ntshetsapele lenaneo lena, ka lapeng le kontinenteng ya Aforika, la kgolo e kenyeletsang mabapi le ho amohela motjha wa khabone e tlase le wa moruo o itsekang.

src: Cabinet approved the appointment of the Interim Board of the Umgeni Water Board:Ms Ziphozethu Mathenjwa (Chairperson)Ms Nompumelelo ChamaneMr Visvin ReddyMr David DikokoMs Zodwa ManaseAdv Tshidi Hatashe andMr Midiavhathu Tshivhase.
tgt: Boto ya Metsi ya Umngeni.1 Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka maemo a Boto ya Metsi ya Umngeni e leng ya bobedi e kgolohadi ka hara naha e nang le boleng selemo ka seng ba se ka fetang R2,4 bilione le ditekanyetso tsa Ditjeho tsa Tjhelete ya Sehlooho e fetang R7 bilione.

src: Members to serve on the Takeover Regulation Panel:Mr Sandile Bubele Siyaka (second term)Mr Ntshengedzeni Anthony Michael Tshivhase (second term)Mr Christopher Ewing (second term)Mr Ebrahim Aboobaker Moolla (second term)Ms Nonzukiso Zukie Siyotula andMs Nocamagu Nomfundo Mbulawa.
tgt: Kabinete hape e tsebisitswe ka dipuisano tseo lefapha la metsi le tsamaiso ya dikgwerekgwere le neng le di tshwere le batsetedi ba lona.2 Bakeng sa ho tsitsisa dintlha tsa taolo tsa Boto, Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho thonngwa ha Boto ya Nakwana ha Letona le ntse le akofisa motjha wa ho thonya ka ho phethahala Boto ya Metsi ya Umngeni.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 18 October 2017, at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.
tgt: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, la 18 Mphalane 2017, Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.

src: Media Freedom Day.
tgt: Letsatsi la Tokoloho ya Boraditaba.

src: Cabinet joins South Africans in commemorating Media Freedom Day on Thursday, 19 October 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e imatahanya le maAforika Borwa mabapi le ho hopola Letsatsi la Tokoloho ya Boraditaba ka Labone, 19 Mphalane 2017.

src: Media played a critical role in the fight against apartheid, exposing atrocities and brutality committed by the apartheid regime.
tgt: Boraditaba ba bapetse karolo e hlokolosi ntweng e neng e le kgahlano le mmuso wa kgethollo, ba pepesa sehloho le bokgopo bo entsweng ke mmuso wa kgethollo.

src: This year marks 40 years since the apartheid regime banned progressive newspapers such as the World, the Weekend World and the Voice.
tgt: Selemo sena se tshwaya dilemo tse 40 esale mmuso wa kgethollo o thibela dikoranta tse neng di pepesa kgethollo tse kang the World, the Weekend World le the Voice.

src: Today, media freedom is firmly entrenched in South Africa’s Constitution and remains a fundamental feature of our developing nation.
tgt: Kajeno, tokoloho ya boraditaba e kenyeleditswe ka matla ka hara Molaotheo wa Aforika Borwa le ho dula e le letshwao la motheo la setjhaba sa bo rona se tswelang pele.

src: Cabinet further encourages South Africans to continue to promote access to information and use the right of media freedom responsibly to help build a united, non-racial, non-sexist, democratic and prosperous South Africa for all.
tgt: Kabinete ho feta moo e kgothaletsa maAforika Borwa ho tswela pele ho kgothaletsa phumantsho ya tlhahisoleseding le ho sebedisa tokelo ya tokoloho ya boraditaba ka boikarabelo ho thusa ho aha Aforika Borwa e kopaneng, e hlokang semorabe, e sa kgetholleng ho ya ka bong, ya demokerasi le e tswang pele bakeng sa bohle.

src: Oceans Economy.
tgt: Moruo wa Mawatle.

src: Cabinet commends President Jacob Zuma in delivering a progress report to stakeholders on the implementation of Operation Phakisa for the Oceans Economy and calls on all stakeholders to continue partnering with government to unlock the economic potential of our oceans.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa Moporesidente Jacob Zuma mabapi le ho fana ka tlaleho ya kgatelopele ho bankakarolo ka ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Operation Phakisa bakeng sa Moruo wa Mawatle le ho ipiletsa ho bankakarolo bohle ho tswela pele ho aha selekane le mmuso bakeng sa ho bula bokgoni ba moruo ba mawatle a rona.

src: The Oceans Economy has already contributed about 4.4% to South Africa’s Gross Domestic Product and the President’s report to stakeholders strongly demonstrates the concerted effort and support of all government partners tapping into the vast potential.
tgt: Moruo wa Mawatle o se o nyehetse se ka etsang 4.4% ho Palohohle ya Dihlahiswa tsa Naha (GDP) tsa Aforika Borwa mme tlaleho ya Moporesidente ho bankakarolo e bontsha ka matla mekutu e kopanetsweng le tshehetso bakeng sa balekane bohle ba mmuso ba itahletseng ka setotswana ka hara bokgoni bona bo batsi.

src: Oceans Economy projects have so far unlocked a combined R.6 billion in investment from government and the private sector, and have created more than 6 500 jobs.
tgt: Diporojeke tsa Moruo wa Mawatle ho fihlela mona di se di butse matsete a kopaneng a R.6 bilione ho tswa mmusong le lekaleng la poraefete, le ho bopa mesebetsi e fetang 6 500.

src: The largest investment in the Oceans Economy, facilitated through government incentives, was directed to infrastructure development, mainly ports, manufacturing, boatbuilding, aquaculture and scientific surveys in the oil and gas sector.
tgt: Matsete a maholo ka ho fetisisa Moruong wa Mawatle, a hlahisitsweng ka ditsiane tsa mmuso, a lebisitswe ho ntshetsopele ya meralo ya motheo, haholo maemakepe, ho tsa tlhahiso, kaho ya dikepe, kgodiso ya diphedi tsa lewatle le diphuputso tsa saense le lekala la kgase.

src: Government plans to establish the single largest boatbuilding facility in southern Africa.
tgt: Mmuso o rera ho theha sebaka se le seng se seholohadi sa kaho ya dikepe ka hara Aforika e ka borwa.

src: The KwaZulu-Natal Boatbuilding Park in the Port of Durban will harvest potential from new investment, exports and job creation.
tgt: Phaka ya Kaho ya Dikepe ya KwaZulu-Natal ka hara Boemakepe ba Durban e tla kotula bokgoni ho tswa matseteng a matjha, diyantle le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi.

src: State visit to Zambia.
tgt: Leeto la Puso ho ya Zambia.

src: Cabinet welcomes the outcomes from President Zuma’s State Visit to the Republic of Zambia from 12 to 13 October 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela diphetho tsa Leeto la Puso la Mopresidente Zuma la ho etela Riphabliki ya Zambia ho tloha ka la 12 ho isa ka la 13 Mphalane 2017.

src: Interactions between President Zuma and his Zambian counterpart Edgar Lungu strengthened existing good political, economic and cultural relations between the two countries, underpinned by strong historical ties dating back from the years of the liberation struggle.
tgt: Dipuisano pakeng tsa Moporesidente Zuma le wa mphato wa hae wa Zambia Edgar Lungu di matlafaditse dikamano tse ntle tse ntseng di le teng tsa sepolotiki, tsa moruo le tsa botjhaba pakeng tsa dinaha ka bobedi, tse hlakiswang ke maqhama a matla a nalane ya dilemo tsa ntwa ya tokoloho.

src: The two Heads of State officially opened the OR Tambo National Heritage site in Chelstone, Lusaka, in honour of OR Tambo’s contribution to the liberation struggle of southern Africa.
tgt: Dihlooho tsa Dipuso tse pedi tsena di butse semmuso setsha sa Naha sa Bojalefa sa OR Tambo Chelstone, ho la Lusaka, mabapi le ho tlotla nyehelo ya OR Tambo ntweng ya tokoloho ya Aforika e ka borwa.

src: Zambia remains one of South Africa’s top trading partners in the region and the continent.
tgt: Zambia e dula e le e nngwe ya balekane ba ka sehloohong ba kgwebisano le Aforika Borwa ka hara lebatowa le ka hara kontinente.

src: Economic cooperation between South Africa and Zambia continues to grow, with South African exports to Zambia amounting to approximately R30 billion in 2016.
tgt: Tshebedisano ho tsa moruo pakeng tsa Aforika Borwa le Zambia e tswela pele ho hola, ka diyantle tsa Aforika tse yang Zambia tse akantsweng ho fihla ho R30 bilione ka selemo sa 2016.

src: The two countries cooperate in a variety of areas, including trade and investment, science and technology, defence, agriculture, environment, energy and health.
tgt: Dinaha tsena tse pedi di sebedisana mmoho dibakeng tse fapafapaneng, ho kenyeletswa kgwebisano le matsete, saense le thekenoloji, tshireletso, temo, tikoloho, eneji le bophelo bo botle.

src: Working visit to Nigeria.
tgt: Leeto la tshebetso ho ya Nigeria.

src: Cabinet congratulates President Zuma on being honoured with a statue and a street being named after him in Nigeria, during a working visit to strengthen socio-economic relations and other cooperations.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa Moporesidente Zuma mabapi le ho tlotlwa ka seemahale le hore mmila o rehellwe ka yena Nigeria, nakong ya leeto la tshebetso bakeng sa ho matlafatsa dikamano tsa moruo wa kahisano le mabaka a mang a tshebedisano.

src: The Imo State Governor, Rochas Okorocha, conferred on President Zuma the Imo Merit Award, the highest award in the State conferred on those who have made a difference in the development of their communities.
tgt: Mmusisi wa Puso ya Imo, Rochas Okorocha, o tlotlile Moporesidente Zuma ka Kgau ya Tlhompho ya Imo, e leng kgau e kgolo ka ho fetisisa Pusong eo le ho abelwa ba entseng phapang ntshetsopeleng ya badudi ba habo bona.

src: 17th Indian Ocean Rim Association Council of Ministers (IORA) Meeting.
tgt: Kopano ya bo-17 ya Rim ya Lekgotla la Matona a Dikgaolo tsa Lewatle la India (IORA).

src: South Africa assumed Chair of the IORA during the 17th meeting held in Durban from 14 to 18 October 2017.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e nkile Bodulasetulo ba IORA nakong ya kopano ya bo-17 o tshwaretsweng Durban ho tloha ka la 14 ho isa ka la 18 Mphalane 2017.

src: South Africa’s theme for its tenure is “Uniting the Peoples of Africa, Asia, Australasia and the Middle East through Enhanced Cooperation for Peace, Stability and Sustainable Development”.
tgt: Mookotaba wa Aforika bakeng sa nako ya yona ya bodulasetulo o re “Re kopanya Batho ba Aforika, Asia, Australasia le Botjhabela bo Hare ka Tshebedisano e Matlafetseng bakeng sa Kgotso, Botsitso le Ntshetsopele ya Moshwelella”.

src: Cabinet has reiterated its commitment through this chairpersonship to further regional cooperation in areas such as the blue economy women economic empowerment small, medium and micro enterprise promotion youth empowerment, and cooperation in academics, science and technology.
tgt: Kabinete e boeleditse boitlamo ba yona ka bodulasetulo bona ho ntshetsa pele tshebedisano ya lebatowa mabakeng a kang a moruo wa mawatle matlafatso ya basadi moruong kgodiso ya dikgwebo tse nyenyane, tse mahareng le tse kgolo matlafatso ya batjha, le tshebedisano ho tsa thuto, saense le thekenoloji.

src: Annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank.
tgt: Dikopano tsa selemo ka seng tsa Letlole la Matjhaba la Ditjhelete (IMF) le Banka ya Lefatshe.

src: Cabinet was briefed by the Minister of Finance, Mr Malusi Gigaba, following South Africa’s participation at the 2017 IMF and World Bank annual meetings, which took place from 13 to 15 October 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ke Letona la Ditjhelete, Monghadi Malusi Gigaba, ho latela bonkakarolo ba Aforika Borwa dikopanong tsa selemo ka seng tsa 2017 tsa IMF le Banka ya Lefatshe, tse neng di tshwerwe ho tloha ka la 13 ho isa ka la 15 Mphalane 2017.

src: The meetings provided an opportunity to assess international progress on development issues and inform South Africa’s own initiatives for socio-economic development, inclusive growth, employment creation and poverty alleviation.
tgt: Dikopano di fane ka monyetla wa ho lekola kgatelopele ya matjhaba mabapi le dintlha tsa tswelopele le ho hlakisa maikitlaetso a Aforika Borwa bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano, kgolo e kenyeletsang, tlhahiso ya mesebetsi le phediso ya bofuma.

src: Cabinet was further briefed on the meeting Minister Gigaba held with sovereign credit rating agencies and investors to reaffirm South Africa’s current policies and approach to fiscal discipline.
tgt: Kabinete hape e tsebisitswe mabapi le kopano e neng e tshwerwe ke Letona Gigaba le makala a ikemetseng a tekolo ya mekitlane le batsetedi ho tiisetsa botjha maano a hajwale a Aforika Borwa le katamelo ya boitshwaro bo botle ba tshebediso ya ditjhelete tsa mmuso.

src: Cabinet is satisfied with the reassurance given to investors on government’s plans to grow the economy and government’s commitment to address governance issues in our state-owned entities.
tgt: Kabinete e kgotsofetse ka tiisetso botjha e fuweng batsetedi mabapi le meralo ya mmuso ya ho hodisa moruo le boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho sebetsana le dintlha tsa taolo dikgwebong tsa rona tsa mmuso.

src: The Medium Term Budget Policy Statement will be tabled in Parliament, Cape Town, on 25 October and will outline government’s spending plans over the next three years.
tgt: Pehelo ya Leano la Ditekanyetso tsa Nako e Bohareng (MTBPS) e tla tekwa Palamenteng, Motse Kapa, ka la 25 Mphalane mme e tla hlakisa meralo ya mmuso ya tshebediso ya ditjhelete dilemong tse tharo tse tlang.

src: Infrastructure development.
tgt: Ntshetsopele ya Meralo ya Motheo.

src: Cabinet applauded the massive boost in government’s infrastructure development with the official handover of three bridges in Botlokwa in Limpopo by President Zuma on 17 October 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholeditse matlafatso e kgolo mabapi le ntshetsopele ya mmuso ya meralo ya motheo ka ho nehelana semmuso ka marokgo a mararo Botlokwa ho la Limpopo ke Moporesidente Zuma ka la 17 Mphalane 2017.

src: The South African National Roads Agency constructed the Botlokwa bridges, which consist of one road bridge and two pedestrian bridges on the N1 between Polokwane and Makhado.
tgt: Lekala la Mebila ya Naha la Aforika Borwa le ahile marokgo a Botlokwa, e leng borokgo bo le bong ba makoloi le a mabedi a ditaaso hodima mmila wa N1 pakeng tsa Polokwane le Makhado.

src: Cabinet is positive that this project will significantly improve travelling conditions and safety for all road users in the area.
tgt: Kabinete e dumela hore porojeke ena e tla ntlafatsa haholo maemo a ho tsamaya le polokeho bakeng sa basebedisi kaofela ba mebila sebakeng seo.

src: Small and medium enterprises.
tgt: Dikgwebo tse nyenyane le tse mahareng.

src: Cabinet commends the Department of Small Business Development for co-hosting this year’s China International Small and Medium Enterprises (SME) Fair, as it contributes to unlocking the Chinese market for South Africa’s small businesses and cooperatives.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane bakeng sa ho tshwara mmoho Dipontsho tsa Matjhaba tsa Tjhaena tsa Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane le tse Mahareng (SME) tsa selemong sena, kaha di nyehela bakeng sa ho bula mmaraka wa Tjhaena bakeng sa dikgwebo tse nyenyane le dikoporasi tsa Aforika Borwa.

src: The SME Fair is taking place in Guangzhou, China from 10 to 27 October 2017.
tgt: Dipontsho tsa di-SME di tshwaretswe Guangzhou, ho la Tjhaena ho tloha ka la 10 ho isa ka la 27 Mphalane 2017.

src: Small businesses are the heartbeat of our economy and engine for economic growth and job creation in South Africa, and our participation in the trade fair promoted market access and opportunities to grow businesses.
tgt: Dikgwebo tse nyenyane ke motso wa moruo wa rona le motjhini bakeng sa kgolo ya moruo le tlhahiso ya mesebetsi ka hara Aforika Borwa, mme bonkakarolo ba rona dipontshong tsena tsa kgwebo bo kgothaleditse phihlello ya mmaraka le menyetla ya ho hodisa dikgwebo.

src: Cabinet is confident that this demonstrates government’s commitment to the goal of promoting and sustaining entrepreneurship.
tgt: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore sena se bontsha boitlamo ba mmuso morerong wa ho kgothaletsa le ho baballa moshwelella boetapele ba dikgwebo.

src: Investing in small businesses will help the country respond to current socio-economic challenges.
tgt: Ho tsetela dikgwebong tse nyenyane ho tla thusa naha ho arabela diphephetso tsa hajwale tsa moruo wa kahisano.

src: Tourism.
tgt: Bohahlaudi.

src: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the National Tourism Monitors Programme in Soweto, on Tuesday, 17 October 2017, which aims to enhance the visitor experience as well as improve the safety of tourists.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela ho thakgolwa ha Lenaneo la Naha la Balebedi ba Bohahlaudi Soweto, ka Labobedi, 17 Mphalane 2017, le reretsweng ho matlafatsa boiphihlelo ba baeti hammoho le ho matlafatsa polokeho ya bahahlaudi.

src: The Department of Tourism, in partnership with the Gauteng Tourism Authority, launched the programme in Vilakazi Street, which is the only street in the world boasting the residence of two Nobel Laureates – former President Nelson Mandela and Archbishop Emeritus Desmond Tutu.
tgt: Lefapha la Bohahlaudi, ka bomphato le Bolaodi ba Bohahlaudi ba Gauteng, le thakgotse lenaneo lena Seterateng sa Vilakazi, e leng sona feela seterata lefatsheng se ikgantshang ka bodulo ba Baamohedi ba babedi ba Kgau ya Kgotso ya Nobel – Moporesidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela le Archbishop Emeritus Desmond Tutu.

src: This programme is aligned to the National Development Plan (NDP) goals and aims to create employment for 200 youth, who will be trained to become monitors at tourism destinations for a 36-month period.
tgt: Lenaneo lena le matahantswe le maikemisetso a Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) mme le rerile ho hlahisa mesebetsi bakeng sa batjha ba 200, ba tla rupellwa ho ba balebedi ba dibaka tsa bohahlaudi bakeng sa nako ya dikgwedi tse Kabinete e kgothaletsa beng ba dikgwebo le badudi ba Gauteng ho sebetsa mmoho le balebedi ho ntlafatsa polokeho ya bahahlaudi le ho qhaneha bokgoni ba moruo ho tswa indasetering ena.

src: Science and technology.
tgt: Saense le Thekenoloji.

src: Cabinet welcomes and congratulates the scientists who participated in the South African Astronomical Observatory (SAAO) and the Southern African Large Telescope (SALT) telescopes exploration.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela le ho thoholetsa borasaense ba nkileng karolo ho diphuputso tsa ditheleskhoupu tsa Bolekodi ba Dinaledi ba Aforika Borwa (SAAO) le Thelesekhoupu e Kgolo ya Aforika e Borwa (SALT).

src: This resulted in an unprecedented international collaboration to investigate the origin of the first detection of gravitational waves produced by two colliding neutron stars.
tgt: Sena se bakile tshebedisano ya matjhaba e so kang e ba teng esale ho batlisisa motso wa temoho ya pele ya maqhubu a lefatshe a hlahisitsweng ke dinaledi tse pedi tsa dinyotrone ha di thulana.

src: The collision also resulted in a kilonova explosion of light.
tgt: Ho thulana hape ho bakile ho phatloha ha kganya ha kilonova.

src: A kilonova is an astronomical event that occurs in a binary system when two neutron stars or a neutron star and a black hole merge into each other.
tgt: Kilonova ke ketsahalo ya dinaledi e etsahalang mokgweng wa maemo a mabedi ha dinaledi tse pedi tsa nyotrone kapa naledi ya nyotrone le lesoba le letsho di kopana.

src: The discovery marks the birth of a new era in astrophysics, the first cosmic event observed in both gravitational waves and light.
tgt: Tshibollo ena e tshwaya tswalo ya sehla se setjha ho tsa astrofisiksi, e leng ketsahalo ya pele ya sepakapakeng e kileng ya lekolwa ho ka bobedi maqhubu a lefatshe le kganya.

src: SALT and other SAAO telescopes have provided some of the very first data in what is turning out to be one of the most-studied astrophysical events ever.
tgt: Ditheleskhoupu tsa SALT le SAAO di fanne ka datha e nngwe ya pele ho seo se bonahalang e le ketsahalo eo ho ithutwang ka yona ka ho fetisisa ya astrofisiksi.

src: SALT and SAAO are among the 70 ground- and space-based observatories that observed the cataclysmic explosion of two colliding neutron stars, immediately after their gravitational shock waves were detected by the United States-based Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory and the European-based Virgo detector.
tgt: SALT le SAAO di hara dibaka tsa tekolo ya dinaledi tse fumanwang fatshe le sebakeng tse 70 tse kileng tsa lekola ho phatloha ha sebakeng ha dinaledi tse pedi tsa nyotrone, hang feela kamora maqhubu a tsona a ho thothomela ha lefatshe a ne a lemohuwa ke Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory ya Amerika le Virgo detector ya Yuropa.

src: World Festival of Youth and Students.
tgt: Mokete wa Lefatshe wa Batjha le Baithuti.

src: Russia is hosting the 2017 World Festival of Youth and Students from 14 to 22 October 2017, which is being attended by more than 20 000 young people from 150 countries.
tgt: Russia e tla tshwara Mokete wa Lefatshe wa Batjha le Baithuti wa 2017 ho tloha ka la 14 ho isa ka la 22 Mphalane 2017, e kenetsweng ke batjha ba fetang 20 000 ba tswang dinaheng tse 150.

src: The purpose of the festival is to bring together the youth of the world community around the idea of justice, the strengthening of international relations, and the development of inter-ethnic and intercultural relations.
tgt: Sepheo sa mokete ke ho bokella mmoho batjha ba lefatshe mabapi le mohopolo wa toka, ho matlafatsa dikamano tsa matjhaba, le ho ntshetsapele dikamano tsa merabe e kopaneng le botjhaba bo kopanetsweng.

src: Child protection.
tgt: Tshireletso ya bana.

src: Cabinet has expressed concern following disturbing reports of crimes against children, the most recent one being the alleged sexual assault of more than 80 pupils at the AB Xuma Primary School in Orlando, Soweto by a scholar patrol guard.
tgt: Kabinete e hlahisitse matshwenyeho a yona ho latela ditlaleho tse nyarosang tsa ditlolo tsa molao kgahlanong le bana, tsa moraorao ka ho fetisisa e leng moo ho belaellwang tlhekefetso ka motabo ya baithuti ba fetang 80 ba Sekolo sa Poraemari sa AB Xuma Orlando, ho la Soweto ke molebedi wa sekolo.

src: The provincial department is commended for the prompt response by removing, with immediate effect, the senior management of the school, bringing on board social workers and instituting an investigation by an independent body.
tgt: Lefapha la porofense le thoholetswa bakeng sa karabelo e potlakileng ka ho tlosa hanghang, bolaodi bo ka sehloohong ba sekolo seo, ho tlisa basebeletsi ba setjhaba le ho etsa dipatlisiso ka tshebediso ya lekala le ikemetseng.

src: Cabinet calls on all communities in South Africa to work together to protect all children from any form of danger and abuse, and to partner with local police to keep our communities safe.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi bohle ka hara Aforika Borwa ho sebetsa mmoho bakeng sa ho sireletsa bana bohle kgahlanong le sebopeho sefe kapa sefe sa kotsi kapa tlhekefetso, le ho sebetsa le sepolesa bakeng sa ho etsa hore metse ya rona e bolokehe.

src: Examinations.
tgt: Ditlhatlhobo.

src: Cabinet is confident that end-of-year school examinations will proceed without interruption following this week’s mass demonstration led by the South African Democratic Teachers’ Union (SADTU).
tgt: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore ditlhatlhobo tsa mafelo a selemo tsa dikolo di tla tswela pele ntle le tshitiso ho latela boipilaetso ba bongata bo neng bo eteletswe pele ke Mokgatlo wa Basebetsi wa Matitjhere wa Aforika Borwa (SADTU).

src: SADTU handed over a memorandum to the Minister of Basic Education, Ms Angie Motshekga, who has committed to resolving issues of concern as speedily as possibly.
tgt: SADTU e fanne ka memorandamo ho Letona la Thuto ya Motheo, Mofumahadi Angie Motshekga, ya itlammeng ho rarolla dintlha tsa ngongoreho kapele kamoo ho ka kgonehang.

src: It is important that all stakeholders work together to create a conducive environment to better enable learners to focus on learning and their examiniations.
tgt: Ho bohlokwa hore bankakarolo kaofela ba sebetse mmoho bakeng sa ho bopa tikoloho e nepahetseng e tla thusa baithuti ho tsepamisa maikutlo thutong le ditlhatlhobong tsa bona.

src: Storms.
tgt: Difefo.

src: Cabinet expresses sincere condolences to the loved ones of those who lost their lives during the recent storms in some parts of the country.
tgt: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona a tebileng ho baratuwa ba ba hlokahetseng nakong ya difefo tsa haufinyana tjena dikarolong tse ding tsa naha.

src: Cabinet also extends its gratitude to all volunteers, civil-society organisations, communities, relief-aid workers and the Disaster Management teams for assisting those affected.
tgt: Kabinete hape e fetisetsa diteboho tsa yona ho baithaopi bohle, mekgatlo ya setjhaba, badudi, basebeletsi ba dithuso le dihlopha tsa Taolo ya Dikoduwa bakeng sa ho thusa ba amehileng.

src: The Minister of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, Mr Des van Rooyen, in his capacity as the head of the National Disaster Management Centre in South Africa, visited areas affected by storms and heavy rains in the eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality in KwaZulu-Natal on 13 October 2017 and Mogale City Local Municipality in Gauteng on 16 October WEBTOKEN a result of the heavy rains and storms that battered many parts of the country, 19 lives were lost and over 20 people injured.
tgt: Letona la Puso e Kopanetsweng le Merero ya Botjhaba, Monghadi Des van Rooyen, boemong ba hae jwaloka hlooho ya Setsi sa Naha sa Taolo ya Dikoduwa ka hara Aforika Borwa, o etetse dibaka tse anngweng ke difefo le dipula tse matla ka hara Masepala o Moholo wa eThekwini KwaZulu-Natal ka la 13 Mphalane 2017 le Masepala wa Lehae wa Mogale City Gauteng ka la 16 Mphalane 2017.Ka lebaka la dipula tse matla le difefo tse ruthuthileng dikarolo tse ngata tsa naha, ho hlokahetse batho ba19 mme batho ba fetang 20 ba lemetse.

src: Minister van Rooyen also visited the recent incidences in Philippi in the Western Cape where six family members, including three children, lost their lives due to the fire that ravaged three informal houses and a tuckshop.
tgt: Letona van Rooyen hape le etetse sebaka sa diketsahalo tsa Philippi ho la Kapa Bophirima moo ditho tse tsheletseng tsa lelapa, ho kenyeletswa bana ba bararo, di ileng tsa hlokahala ka lebaka la mollo o haitseng mekhukhu e meraro le lebenkele.

src: Life Esidimeni.
tgt: Life Esidimeni.

src: Cabinet acknowledges the start of the Life Esidimeni alternative dispute resolution process as what could be the beginning of closure for families of patients who died.
tgt: Kabinete e ananela ho qala ha motjha wa tharollo ya dikgang wa Life Esidimeni jwaloka se ka nnang ya ba qalo ya ho qeta taba ena bakeng sa malapa a bakudi ba hlokahetseng.

src: Cabinet expresses full confidence in retired Constitutional Court Deputy Chief Justice Dikgang Moseneke, who is presiding over the matter and sincerely wishes family members strength as they observe what must be a difficult account of this tragedy.
tgt: Kabinete e hlahisa tshepo e felletseng ho Motlatsi wa Moahlodi e Moholo wa Lekgotla la Molaotheo ya behileng meja fatshe Dikgang Moseneke, eo e leng modulasetulo wa taba ena le ho lakaletsa ditho tsa malapa matla ho tswa botebong ba dipelo jwaloka ha e lemoha seo e tlamehang e le bopaki ba boima ba masisapelo ana.

src: The investigation should not only assist in bringing closure to these affected families but also serve to provide lessons to government in general.
tgt: Dipatlisiso ha di a lokela feela ho thusa ba malapa a amehang hore ba thobehe maikutlo empa hape di lokela ho hlahisetsa mmuso dintho kaofela tseo o lokelang ho ithuta tsona.

src: Government is committed to providing quality services to all South Africans.
tgt: Mmuso o itlametse ho fana ka ditshebeletso tsa boleng ho maAforika Borwa kaofela.

src: Avian Influenza.
tgt: Ntaramane ya Avian.

src: Cabinet has been assured that the Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (DAFF) is undertaking consistent surveillance on farms across the country in an effort to prevent the spread of the Avian Influenza (HPAI) H5N8 outbreak.
tgt: Kabinete e netefaleditswe hore Lefapha la Temo, Meru le Ditlhapi (DAFF) le ikitlaeditse ho etsa tekolo ya ka dinako tsohle mapolasing ho phatlalla le naha e le mokutu wa ho thibela ho nama ha ho runya ha Ntaramane ya Avian (HPAI) H5Melatsitsi ya ntaramane ya avian e sibollotswe dinonyaneng.

src: The strain of avian influenza has been detected in birds.
tgt: Kabinete e kgothaletsa setjhaba ho tlohela ho tshwarana le dinonyana tse kulang kapa tse shweleng mme se se leke ho fepa dinonyana tse hlaha empa ba ka mpa ba tlaleha dinonyane tseo ba belaelang hore di a kula ho balaodi ba lehae.

src: Attacks on police.
tgt: Ditlhaselo tsa Mapolesa.

src: Cabinet condemns the attack on six South African Police Service members in Vanderbijlpark in Gauteng on 10 October 2017 by members of the community.
tgt: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe tlhaselo ya ditho tse tsheletseng tsa ditho tsa Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) Vanderbijlpark ho la Gauteng ka la 10 Mphalane 2017 ke ditho tsa badudi.

src: The law-enforcement agencies are mandated to protect society from any act of criminality.
tgt: Makala a qobello ya molao a fuwe thomo ya ho sireletsa setjhaba ketsong efe kapa efe ya botlokotsebe.

src: Therefore, no amount of anger can justify anyone attacking the law-enforcement agencies.
tgt: Kahoo, ha ho kgalefo e ngata hakae e ka dumeletsehang ya hore mang kapa mang o lokela ho hlasela makala a qobello ya molao.

src: Cabinet urges members of that community to work with the police to apprehend criminal elements and help make South Africa safer for all.
tgt: Kabinete e kgothaletsa ditho tsa badudi ho sebetsa mmoho le sepolesa ho tshwara ditlokotsebe le ho thusa ho etsa Aforika Borwa e bolokehe bakeng sa bohle.

src: Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.

src: Social Housing Programme.
tgt: Lenaneo la Matlo la Setjhaba.

src: Cabinet was apprised on the findings and recommendations of the Impacts and Implementation Evaluation of the Social Housing Programme and the improvement plan, with a view of overcoming apartheid spatial patterns by improving spatial location and urban integration of housing projects.
tgt: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka diphetho le dikgothaletso tsa Tekolo ya Dikgahlamelo le ho Kenngwa Tshebetsong ha Lenaneo la Matlo a Setjhaba le moralo wa ntlafatso, ka morero wa ho lwantsha dipaterone tsa phano ya dibaka tsa mmuso wa kgethollo ka ho ntlafatsa maemo a dibaka le ho kopanya bodulo ba metse ya ditoropo ba diporojeke tsa matlo.

src: The programme offers affordable rental accommodation for low and middle-income households in neighborhoods where market conditions would otherwise exclude them or allocate inadequate housing.
tgt: Lenaneo lena le fana ka bodulo bo kgonehang ba kgiro bakeng sa malapa a lekeno le tlase le le mahareng dibakeng tseo maemo a mmaraka a neng a tla ba qhelela ka thoko kapa ho ba abela bodulo bo sa lokang.

src: This is the only programme that gears debt financing considers long-term financial sustainability of projects and creates a virtuous financial cycle with tenants paying rentals and social-housing institutions paying rates, taxes and service charges to municipalities.
tgt: Lena ke lona lenaneo feela le thusang ka ditjhelete tsa mokitlane le nkelang hloohong ho ba teng ha nako e telele bokgoni ba moshwelella ba diporojeke mme le bopa motsamao o motle wa tjhelete moo bahiri ba lefang rente le moo ditheo tsa matlo di lefang sekgahla sa tshebediso, makgetho le ditefello tsa tshebeletso ho bomasepala.

src: This report assists the relevant departments in further improving their respective operational plans.
tgt: Tlaleho ena e thusa mafapha a amehang ho ya pele ho ntlafatsa meralo ya yona ya tshebetso ka ho latelana.

src: The full report will be placed on the website of the Department of Performance Monitoring and Evaluation (WEBTOKEN).
tgt: Tlaleho e felletseng e tla manehwa websaeteng ya Lefapha la Merero, Bodisa le Tekolo ya Tshebetso (WEBTOKEN).

src: National Youth Service (NYS).
tgt: Tshebeletso ya Naha ya Batjha (NYS).

src: Cabinet approved the revised and improved NYS Programme Framework as part of developing young people as active citizens of South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lenaneo la Moralo la NYS le shebuweng botjha le ho ntlafatswa jwaloka karolo ya ho ntshetsa pele batjha jwaloka badudi ba mahlahahlaha ba Aforika Borwa.

src: The NYS is an enabler for young people in South Africa to become active citizens of the country and contribute positively to the country’s development while achieving personal and professional development.
tgt: NYS ke sethusi bakeng sa batjha ka hara Aforika Borwa hore e be baahi ba mahlahahlaha ba naha le ho nyehela ka bokgabane ntshetsopeleng ya naha ka ho le leng ba fihlella ntshetsopele ya bo bona le ya seporofeshenale.

src: This will involve young people participating in activities that benefit local communities while developing their abilities through service and learning so that their opportunities to successfully enter labour markets and become entrepreneurs are bolstered.
tgt: Sena se tla kenyeletsa batjha hore ba nke karolo mesebetsing e tswelang badudi ba lehae molemo ha e ntse e ntshetsa pele bokgoni ba bona ka tshebeletso le ho ithuta hore menyetla ya bona ya ho kenella mebarekeng ya mesebetsi le ho ba baetapele ba dikgwebo e matlafale.

src: 3rd African Forum for Agricultual Advisory Services Extension Week.
tgt: Foramo ya bo-3 ya Aforika ya Beke ya Katoloso ya Ditshebeletso tsa Boeletsi tsa Temo.

src: Cabinet approved the hosting of the 3rd African Forum for Agricultural Advisory Services Extension Week, which will be held in KwaZulu-Natal from 30 October to 3 November 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tshwarwa ha Foramo ya bo-3 ya Aforika ya Katoloso ya Ditshebeletso tsa Boeletsi ba Temo, e tla tshwarelwa KwaZulu-Natal ho tloha ka la 30 Mphalane ho isa ka la 3 Pudungwana 2017.

src: The event is aligned to the NDP and identifies food security as a means to address the triple challenge of unemployment, poverty and inequality.
tgt: Ketsahalo e matahantswe le NDP le ho hlwaya kanetso ya dijo jwaloka tsela ya ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse tharo tsa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi, bofuma le ho se lekalekane.

src: The theme is: “Scaling up climate smart agriculture: integrating youth, women, and the digital revolution”, and the event will be held under the leadership of the DAFF, in collaboration with the South African Society for Agricultural Extension and the African Forum for Agricultural Advisory Services.
tgt: Mookotaba o re: “Re ntlafatsa mokgwa wa temo wa tlelaemete wa maemo: ho kopanya batjha, basadi, le diphethoho ho tsa dijithale”, mme ketsahalo eo e tla tshwarwa tlasa boetapele ba DAFF, ka tshebedisano le Mokgatlo wa Aforika Borwa wa Katoloso ya Temo le Foramo ya Aforika ya ditshebeletso tsa Boeletsi ba tsa Temo.

src: This continental network for Agricultural Extension and Advisory Services (AEAS) in Africa provides a platform for mutual learning and innovation among AEAS providers across Africa and the world.
tgt: Marangrang ana a kontinente bakeng sa Katoloso ya Temo le Ditshebeletso tsa Boeletsi (AEAS) ka hara Aforika a fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa ho ithuta ho kopanetsweng le ntlafatso hara bafani ba AEAS ho phatlalla le Aforika le lefatshe.

src: The NDP also advocates for an improvement in skills development and training in the agricultural sector, including the training of a new cadre of extension practitioners who will respond effectively to the needs of smallholder farmers.
tgt: NDP hape e kgothaletsa ntlafatso ya ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo le thupello lekaleng la temo, ho kenyeletswa le thupello ya lebotho le letjha la balemisi ba tla arabela ka bokgabane ditlhokong tsa dihwai tse nyenyane.

src: World Wine Trade Group.
tgt: Sehlopha sa Lefatshe sa Kgwebisano ya Veine.

src: In contributing to the removal of trade barriers, Cabinet was briefed on South Africa’s Chairship of the World Wine Trade Group from April 2017 to May 2018.
tgt: Bakeng sa ho nyehela ho tlosweng ha ditshita tsa kgwebisano, Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka bodulasetulo ba Aforika Borwa ba Sehlopha sa Lefatshe sa Kgwebisano ya Veine ho tloha ka Mmesa 2017 ho isa Motsheanong 2018.

src: As chair, South Africa will host the annual meeting of the World Wine Trade Group in Cape Town from 1 to 3 November 2017.
tgt: Jwaloka modulasetulo, Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara kopano ya selemo ka seng ya Sehlopha sa Lefatshe sa Kgwebisano ya Veine Motse Kapa ho tloha ka la 1 ho isa ka la 3 Pudungwana 2017.

src: The group aims to facilitate international trade in wine through information sharing, discussion of regulatory issues in wine markets and joint actions for the removal of trade barriers.
tgt: Sehlopha se rerile ho thusa ka kgwebisano ya matjhaba ka veine ka ho arolelana tlhahisoleseding, ho buisana ka dintlha tsa taolo mebarakeng ya veine le diketso tse kopanetsweng tsa ho tlosa ditshita tsa kgwebisano.

src: Emerging producers and exports of the South African wine industry benefit from South Africa’s participation.
tgt: Bahlahisi ba ntseng ba runya le diyantle tsa indaseteri ya veine ya Aforika Borwa ba kgola molemo bonkakarolong ba Aforika Borwa.

src: This contributes to the Nine-Point Plan and the NDP, which seek to revitalise the agriculture and agro-processing value chain.
tgt: Sena se nyehela ho Moralo wa Dintlha tse Robong le NDP, tse rerileng ho hlasimolla botjha lethathama la boleng la temo le tswelliso ya dihlahiswa tsa temo.

src: In the wine sector, the aim is to increase the area under wine production, support smallholder producers and target certain markets for export growth.
tgt: Lekaleng la temo, sepheo ke ho eketsa sebaka se tlasa tlhahiso ya veine, ho tshehetsa bahlahisi ba banyenyane le ho sheba mebaraka e itseng bakeng sa kgolo ya diyantle.

src: 5th Annual Meeting of ID4AFRICA Movement.
tgt: Kopano ya bo-5 ya Selemo ka Seng ya Mokgatlo wa ID4Africa.

src: Cabinet approved South Africa’s hosting of the 5th Annual Meeting of the ID4Africa Movement in 2019.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana hore Aforika Borwa e tshware Kopano ya bo-5 ya Selemo ka Seng ya Mokgatlo wa ID4Africa ka selemo sa 2019.

src: ID4Africa is a multi-stakeholder movement that promotes the transparent and responsible adoption of digital identity for driving socio-economic development in Africa.
tgt: ID4Africa ke mokgatlo wa bankakarolo ba bangata o kgothaletsang kamohelo e bonaletsang le e nang le boikarabelo ya boitsebiso ba dijithale bakeng sa ho kganna ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano ka hara Aforika.

src: Discussions will seek to improve the way civil registration and vital statistics data is collected, coordinated and analysed, making available reliable information to policymakers.
tgt: Dipuisano di reretswe ho ntlafatsa tsela eo boingodiso ba setjhaba le datha ya dipalopalo tsa bohlokwa di bokellwang, di hokahangwang le ho hlophollwa ka yona, ho etsa hore ho be le tlhahisoleseding e tshepahalang bakeng sa baetsi ba maano.

src: Hosting this conference will assist South Africa to realise some of the objectives of the NDP and create awareness of the strategic value for the South African identity systems such as the live capture system for passport and smart identity document (ID) cards.
tgt: Ho tshwara pitso ena ho tla thusa Aforika Borwa ho fihlella merero e meng ya NDP le ho bopa temoso ya molemo wa lewa bakeng sa ditsamaiso tsa Aforika Borwa tsa boitsebiso tse kang tsamaiso ya ho sebetsana le diphasepoto le ditokomane tsa dikarete tsa thekenoloji tsa boitsebiso (ID).

src: It will also positively mobilise other countries in the region to appreciate the benefits of the smart ID card.
tgt: Hape e tla hlokomedisa dinaha tse ding ka hara lebatowa ho ananela melemo ya dikarete tsa tsa boitsebiso.

src: National crime statistics.
tgt: Dipalopalo tsa Naha tsa Botlokotsebe.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the national crime statistics for the period 1 April 2016 to 31 March 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka dipalopalo tsa naha tsa botlokotsebe bakeng sa nako ya la 1 Mmesa 2016 ho isa ho la 31 Hlakubele 2017.

src: The annual crime statistics enables government to monitor key crime fighting targets, as set out in the Medium Term Strategic Framework 2014-2019.
tgt: Dipalopalo tsa selemo ka seng di thusa mmuso ho beha leihlo dibaka tse ka sehloohong tsa botlokotsebe tse lokelang ho lwantshwa, jwaloka ha ho tekilwe ho Moralo wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng (MTSF) wa 2014-2019.

src: The crime statistics are used as an early-warning mechanism to strengthen the crime-prevention operations and strategies of various departments.
tgt: Dipalopalo tsa botlokotsebe di sebediswa jwaloka mokgwa wa temoso wa pele ho matlafatsa ditshebetso tsa thibelo ya botlokotsebe le mawa a mafapha a fapafapaneng.

src: Cabinet has approved the release of the report by the Minister of Police, Mr Fikile Mbalula.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho lokollwa ha tlaleho ya Letona la Sepolesa, Monghadi Fikile Mbalula.

src: Upcoming Events.
tgt: Diketsahalo tse tlang.

src: OR Tambo Centenary Celebration.
tgt: Mokete wa Dilemo tse Lekgolo wa OR Tambo.

src: Cabinet is pleased that preparations for the centenary celebration of the birth of OR Tambo are at an advanced stage and calls on all South Africans to continually familiarise themselves with the legacy of our Struggle icon, the role he played in our liberation, and his values which still guide us today.
tgt: Kabinete e thabisitswe ke hore boitokisetso ba mokete wa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa tswalo ya OR Tambo bo se bo le pele le ho ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tswela pele ho itlwaetsa lefa la qhoku ya rona ya Ntwa ya tokoloho, karolo eo a e bapetseng tokolohong ya rona, le dipehelo tsa hae tse ntseng di re tataisa le kajeno.

src: President Zuma declared 2017 the Year of OR Tambo under the theme: “Life and Legacy of OR Tambo” and he will, on Thursday, 19 October 2017, unveil a life-size statue of OR Tambo at the OR Tambo International Airport in Ekurhuleni, Gauteng.
tgt: Moporesidente Zuma o tsebisitse selemo sa 2017 e le Selemo sa OR Tambo tlasa mookotaba: “Bophelo le Lefa la OR Tambo” mme, ka Labone, la 19 Mphalane 2017, o tla bula seemahale sa boholo bo lekanang le bophelo ba nnete ba OR Tambo Boemafofaneng ba Matjhaba ba OR Tambo Ekurhuleni, ho la Gauteng.

src: South Africans are encouraged to join in centenary celebrations, which will culminate on 27 of October in Mbizana, Eastern Cape, which was the birth place of this Struggle icon 100 years ago.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho kenela mekete ya dilemo tse lekgolo, e tla fihlella sehlohlolo ka la 27 Mphalane Mbizana, ho la Kapa Botjhabela, e leng tulo ya tswalo ya qhoku ena ya Ntwa dilemong tse 100 tse fetileng.

src: Government continues to build on OR Tambo’s legacy since 1994, and our many gains as South Africans must be celebrated and defended.
tgt: Mmuso o tswela pele ho ahella hodima lefa la OR Tambo ho tloha ka selemo sa 1994, le dikuno tse ngata tsa rona jwaloka maAforika Borwa di lokela ho ketekwa le ho tshireletswa.

src: The Inter-Ministerial Committee tasked to prepare for the centenary celebrations, chaired by Minister Jeff Radebe, will on Friday, 20 October 2017, brief the media on the state of readiness.
tgt: Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona e fuweng mosebetsi wa ho lokisetsa mekete ya dilemo tse lekgolo, tlasa bodulasetulo ba Letona Jeff Radebe, e tla tsebisa boraditaba ka boemo ba boitokisetso ka Labohlano, 20 Mphalane 2017.Melaetsa.

src: Somalia attack.
tgt: Tlhaselo Somalia.

src: Cabinet strongly condemns the recent bomb attack outside a hotel in Mogadishu, Somalia.
tgt: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ka matla tlhaselo ya bomo haufinyana tjena ka ntle ho hotele ya Mogadishu, ho la Somalia.

src: At least 300 people were reportedly killed and hundreds more left injured.
tgt: Ho tlalehilwe hore bonyane batho ba 300 ba hlokahetse mme ba bang ba balwang ka makgolo ba lemetse.

src: Cabinet expresses condolences to the loved ones of those who perished in the heinous attack on innocent people.
tgt: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso ho baratuwa ba batho ba hlokahetseng tlhaselong ena e sehloho ya batho ba se nang molato.

src: Condolences to the Lubisi family.
tgt: Matshediso ho lelapa la Lubisi.

src: Cabinet also expresses its heartfelt condolences to the Director-General in The Presidency, Dr Cassius Lubisi, following the loss of his wife, Ms Lumka Lubisi, earlier this month.
tgt: Kabinete hape e fetisetsa matshediso a yona a tswang boteng ba pelo ho Motsamaisi-Kakaretso Kantorong ya Moporesidente, Ngaka Cassius Lubisi, ho latela ho hlokahala ha mohatsae, Mofumahadi Lumka Lubisi, pejana kgweding ena.

src: Cabinet wishes the family strength during this difficult time of grief.
tgt: Kabinete e lakaletsa lelapa matla nakong ena e boima ya mahlomola.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokela ho netefatswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.

src: Deputy Director-General (DDG): Training Management and Delivery, National School of Government, Mr S Manana Chief Financial Officer, Department of Public Works (DPW), Ms R Sadiki Divisional Head: Construction Management in the DPW, Mr B Mokhothu DDG: Public Finance in the Department of National Treasury, Dr MP Modise DDG: Hospital Tertiary Health Services and Human Resource Development, Department of Health, Dr WW Chitha Executive Director of the Centre for Public Service Innovation, Ms TE Rabebe Interim Board of the Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa:Advocate Tintswalo Annah Nana Makhubele (SC) – (Chairperson)Dr Natalie SkeepersProfJohn Maluleke andMs Magdelene Cheryl Reddy.
tgt: Motlatsi wa Motsamaisi-Kakaretso (DDG): Bolaodi ba Thupello le Phano, Sekolothupello sa Naha sa Mmuso, Monghadi S Manana Mohlanka e Moholo wa Ditjhelete, Lefapha la Mesebetsi ya Setjhaba (DPW), Mofumahadi R Sadiki Hlooho ya Lekala: Bolaodi ba Kaho ho DPW, Monghadi B Mokhothu DDG: Ditjhelete tsa Mmuso ho Lefapha la Matlotlo a Naha, Ngaka MP Modise DDG: Ntshetsopele ya Ditshebeletso tse Phahameng tsa Ditshebeletso tsa Kalafo tsa Dipetlele le Kgiro ya Basebetsi, Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle, Ngaka WW Chitha Motsamaisi wa Phethahatso wa Setsi sa Ntjhafatso sa Tshebeletso ya Mmuso, Mofumahadi TE Rabebe Boto ya Nakwana ya Lekala la Bapalami ba Diterene la Aforika Borwa (Prasa):Moatefokate Tintswalo Annah Nana Makhubele (SC) – (Modulasetulo)Ngaka Natalie SkeepersMoporofesara John Maluleke leMofumahadi Magdelene Cheryl Reddy.

src: Board of the South African Airways: Mr JB Magwaza – (Chairperson)Ms Nolitha Fakude – (Deputy Chairperson)Mr Geoff RothschildMs Tinyiko MhlariMr Ahmed Bassa andMr Martin Kingston.
tgt: Boto ya Tshebeletso ya Difofane ya Aforika Borwa:Monghadi JB Magwaza – (Modulasetulo)Mofumahadi Nolitha Fakude – (Motlatsi wa Modulasetulo)Monghadi Geoff RothschildMofumahadi Tinyiko MhlariMonghadi Ahmed Bassa leMonghadi Martin Kingston.

src: Cabinet met at Tuynhuys in Cape Town.
tgt: Kabinete e kopane Tuynhuys Motse Kapa.

src: Medium Term Budget Policy Statement (MTBPS) 2017 Cabinet welcomes the MTBPS delivered by the Minister of Finance, Mr Malusi Gigaba, in Parliament, Cape Town, last week.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela MTBPS e tshetlehilweng ke Letona la Ditjhelete, Monghadi Malusi Gigaba, Palamenteng, Motse Kapa, bekeng e fetileng.

src: The adjustment budget continues to drive inclusive growth and fiscal consolidation whilst protecting and promoting social expenditure in education, health, basic infrastructure and social security, which many fellow South Africans rely on to enjoy a better life.
tgt: Ditekanyetso tsa ditokiso di tswela pele ho kganna kgolo e kenyeletsang le matlafatso ya ditjhelete tsa mmuso ka ho le leng ho tshireletsa le ho kgothaletsa ditshenyehelo tsa setjhaba mabapi le thuto, boitekanelo, meralo ya motheo ya mantlha le tshireletso ya setjhaba, tseo maAforika Borwa a bo rona a itshetlehileng hodima tsona hore ba natefelwe ke bophelo bo betere.

src: In a constrained fiscal space, government’s commitment to meet challenges in South Africa is demonstrated by interventions to grow township and rural economies, strengthen good governance at state-owned companies, as well as the additional significant allocation of funding higher education.
tgt: Maemong a tsitsipano a moruo, boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho mekamekana le diphephetso ka hara Aforika Borwa bo bontshwa ka maitshunyako a ho hodisa meruo ya makeishene le ya dibaka tsa metse ya mahae, ho matlafatsa taolo e hlwahlwa dikhamphaning tsa mmuso, hammoho le kabo ya tlatsetso e bonahalang ya ho thusa thuto e phahameng ka matlole.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to join increased efforts to grow the economy.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho kenela mekutu e eketsehileng ya ho hodisa moruo.

src: Labour Force Survey.
tgt: Tekolo ya Lebotho la Basebetsi.

src: Cabinet appreciates the recently released Quarterly Labour Force Survey for the third quarter of 2017, which showed that unemployment remained unchanged from the previous quarter at 27.7%.
tgt: Kabinete e ananela Tekolo ya Kotara ka Nngwe ya Lebotho la Basebetsi e lokolotsweng haufinyana tjena bakeng sa kotara ya boraro ya selemo sa 2017, e bontshang hore sekgahla sa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi se dutse se sa fetoha ho tloha kotareng e fetileng moo e neng e le 27.7%.

src: The employment gains recorded in the formal sector of 187 000 over the quarter, the informal sector and agriculture sector recorded employment losses of 71 000 and 25 000 respectively.
tgt: Ho rekotuwe dikuno tsa kgiro lekaleng la mmuso tse etsang 187 000 nakong ya kotara, lekaleng leo e seng la mmuso le lekaleng la temo a rekotile tahlehelo ya mesebetsi ya 71 000 le 25 000 ka tatelano.

src: Government remains committed to doing everything possible to deal with the unemployment challenges and calls on the private sector to do their part.
tgt: Mmuso o dula o iteletse ho etsa sohle se ka kgonehang ho sebetsana le diphephetso tsa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi le ho ipiletsa lekaleng la poraefete ho bapala karolo ya lona.

src: Centenary of Oliver Reginald Tambo.
tgt: Mokete wa Dilemo tse Lekgolo wa Oliver Reginald Tambo.

src: Cabinet thanks all South Africans for celebrating the centenary of Struggle stalwart OR Tambo, which culminated in celebration on the Friday, 27 October 2017 at Nkantolo Village in the Eastern Cape.
tgt: Kabinete e leboha maAforika Borwa kaofela bakeng sa ho keteka dilemo tse lekgolo tsa mohale wa Ntwa ya Tokoloho OR Tambo, o fihletseng sehlohlolo ka mokete wa Labohlano, la 27 Mphalane 2017 Motsaneng wa Nkantolo ho la Kapa Botjhabela.

src: As part of the centenary celebrations, President Jacob Zuma officiated over improvement projects, including:The hand-over of the Ludeke Dam in Mbizana, which was built as part of the Greater Mbizana Regional Bulk Water Supply Scheme by the Department of Water and SanitationA visit to the Nyameni family in Ludeke Village where the President switched on electricity, as part of the broader government rural electrification programme in Mbizana and surrounding areasBicycles distributed to learners at OR Tambo Technical High School, as part of the Department of Transport’s Shova Kalula programme, which supports learners who walk more than three kilometres to schoolThe donation of computers to learners in the Vukuzenzele Special School for children with disabilities, led by the Minister of Communications, Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane.
tgt: Jwaloka karolo ya mekete ya dilemo tse lekgolo, Moporesidente Jacob Zuma o ne a eteletse pele diporojeke tsa ntlafatso, tse kenyeletsang:Phano ya Letamo la Ludeke Mbizana, le ahilweng e le karolo ya Sekema sa Lebatowa le Leholo la Phepelo ka Bongata ya Metsi la Mbizana ke Lefapha la Metsi le Tsamaiso ya DikgwerekgwereLeeto la ho ya lelapeng la Nyameni Motsaneng wa Ludeke moo Moporesidente a ileng a hotetsa motlakase, e le karolo ya lenaneo la mmuso le pharaletseng la ho hokela motlakase dibakeng tsa mahae Mbizana le dibakeng tse mabapiDibaesekele tse abetsweng baithuti Sekolong sa Tekginiki se Phahameng sa OR Tambo, e le karolo ya lenaneo la Lefapha la Dipalangwang la Shova Kalula, le tshehetsang baithuti ba tsamayang sebaka sa dikilomithara tse fetang tse tharo ho ya sekolongNyehelo ya dikhompyutha Sekolong se Ikgethang sa Vukuzenzele bakeng sa bana ba nang le boqhwala, e neng e eteletswe pele ke Letona la Dikgokahanyo, Mmamoloko Kubayi-Ngubane.

src: Crime Statistics Cabinet appeals to all South Africans and communities to partner with law-enforcement agencies to combat crime.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela le badudi ho ipapisa le makala a qobello ya molao ho lwantsha botlokotsebe.

src: The crime statistics released recently by the Minister of Police, Mr Fikile Mbalula, have indicated some areas where we made progress in combating crime and some areas where crime levels remain high.
tgt: Dipalopalo tsa botlokotsebe tse lokolotsweng haufinyana tjena ke Letona la Sepolesa, Monghadi Fikile Mbalula, di bontshitse dibaka tse ding moo re entseng kgatelopele mabapi le ho lwantsha botlokotsebe le dibaka tse ding moo maemo a botlokotsebe a ntseng a dutse a phahame.

src: Cabinet is convinced that it is only through working together that we can all benefit from creating safer communities that are able to develop.
tgt: Kabinete e kgodisehile hore ke ka feela ho sebetsa mmoho hore re le kaofela re ka kgonang ho kgola molemo ka ho bopa metse e bolokehileng e kgonang ho tswela pele.

src: The crime statistics assist government and the South African Police Service to monitor key targets and serve as an early-warning mechanism to strengthen the crime-prevention operations and strategies.
tgt: Dipalopalo tsa botlokotsebe di thusa mmuso le Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa (SAPS) ho beha leihlo dibaka tse ka sehlohlolong le ho sebetsa jwaloka mokgwa wa ho lemosa nako e sa le teng bakeng sa ho matlafatsa ditshebetso tsa thibelo ya botlokotsebe le mawa.

src: It is part of the crime-prevention strategy to ensure that all people in the country are and feel safe.
tgt: Ke karolo ya lewa la thibelo ya botlokotsebe ho netefatsa hore batho bohle ka hara naha ba bolokehile le ho ikutlwa ba le jwalo.

src: Gender-based violence (GBV).
tgt: Dikgoka tse itshetlehileng hodima bong (GBV).

src: Cabinet reiterates its condemnation of the sexual abuse of women and children, irrespective of the alleged perpetrators’ societal positions.
tgt: Kabinete e boeletsa ho tshwela ka mathe ha yona ha tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana, ho sa tsotellwe maemo a baetsi ba diketso tse jwalo setjhabeng.

src: Cabinet encourages victims to report these heinous crimes to law-enforcement authorities, who must investigate allegations of GBV and act firmly within the ambit of the law to ensure that justice is served.
tgt: Kabinete e kgothaletsa mahlatsipa ho tlaleha diketsahalo tsena tse mpe ho baetapele ba qobello ya molao, ba lokelang ho batlisisa dipelaello tsa GBV le ho sebetsa ka matla ka hara lepatlelo la molao ho netefatsa hore toka e ya phethahatswa.

src: The 16 Days of Activism for No Violence Against Women and Children campaign is approaching and Cabinet has approved this year’s theme: “Count me In: Together Moving a Non-Violent South Africa Forward”.
tgt: Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 a Diketso tsa Thibelo ya Dikgoka Kgahlanong le Basadi le Bana le a atamela mme Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana mookotaba wa selemong sena: “Mpalleng le nna: Mmoho re Ntshetsapele Aforika Borwa e Hlokang Dikgoka”.

src: Cabinet also calls on citizens to educate one another on the rights of women and children, and on the various recourse mechanisms that exist to help victims of violence.
tgt: Kabinete hape e ipiletsa ho baahi ho rutana ka ditokelo tsa basadi le bana, le ka mekgwa e meng ya thuso e teng bakeng sa ho thusa mahlatsipa a dikgoka.

src: The 16 Days of Activism Campaign is a United Nations (UN) campaign, which takes place annually from 25 November (International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women) to 10 December (International Human Rights Day).
tgt: Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 a Diketso tsa Thibelo ke letsholo la Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN), le etsahalang selemo ka seng ho tloha ka la 25 Pudungwana (Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Phediso ya Dikgoka Kgahlanong le Basadi) ho isa ka la 10 Tshitwe (Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Ditokelo tsa Botho).

src: South Africans are encouraged to actively join advocacy and awareness-raising programmes in their respective communities and sectors.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho itahlela ka setotswana mananeong a tsebiso le ho hlahisa temoso metseng ya bona le makaleng a fapaneng ka ho latelana.

src: Tourism Transformation Summit.
tgt: Seboka sa Diphethoho tsa Bohahlaudi.

src: Cabinet calls on all stakeholders to support the tourism sector’s transformation initiatives as it potentially benefits the economy by empowering disadvantaged communities and driving employment growth.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bankakarolo kaofela ho tshehetsa maikitlaetso a lekala la bohahlaudi a diphethoho kaha sena se hlahisa bokgoni ba ho tswela molemo moruo ka ho matlafatsa badudi ba hlokang menyetla le ho kganna kgolo ya mesebetsi.

src: The Department of Tourism hosted the National Tourism Transformation Summit on 30 and 31 October 2017 under the theme: “Tourism for All: Transform, Grow and Sustain”, which saw the release of the State of Sector Transformation Report and the launch of the Tourism Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (B-BBEE) Portal and Tourism Transformation Fund.
tgt: Lefapha la Bohahlaudi le ne le tshwere Seboka sa Naha sa Diphethoho tsa Bohahlaudi ka la 30 le la 31 Mphalane 2017 tlasa mookotaba: “Bohahlaudi bakeng sa Bohle: Fetola, Hola le ho Baballa”, moo ho ileng ha lokollwa Tlaleho ya Boemo ba Diphethoho tsa Lekala le ho thakgolwa ha Lepatlelo la Matlafatso e Pharaletseng ya Batho ba Batsho Moruong (B-BBEE) la Bohahlaudi le Letlole la Diphethoho tsa Bohahlaudi.

src: State Visit by President Macky Sall of Senegal.
tgt: Leeto la Puso la Moporesidente Macky Sall wa Senegal.

src: Cabinet welcomes the State Visit by the President of the Republic of Senegal, His Excellency Macky Sall on 20 October 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela Leeto la Puso la Moporesidente wa Riphabliki ya Senegal, Motlotlehi Macky Sall ka la 20 Mphalane 2017.

src: South Africa and Senegal exchanged views on critical regional and global issues and signed agreements in several areas.
tgt: Aforika Borwa le Senegal di fapanyetsane mehopolo mabapi le dintlha tse hlokolosi tsa lebatowa le tsa lefatshe le ho saena ditumellano dintlheng tse mmalwa.

src: The two countries enjoy cordial bilateral political, economic and social relations underpinned by strong historical ties dating back to the years of the liberation struggle.
tgt: Dinaha tse pedi tsena di na le dikamano tsa kutlwano tsa sepolotiki, tsa moruo le tsa kahisano tse tiiseditsweng ka maqhama a matla a nalane a ballwang dilemong tse fetileng tsa ntwa ya tokoloho.

src: The signing of a Memorandum of Understanding on the twinning of Robben Island (used by the racist apartheid regime to incarcerate freedom fighters) and Gorée Islands (the route through which African people were shipped out for a life of slavery) further cements our countries’ cultural and historic ties as the 1987 Dakar Talks is commemorated.
tgt: Ho saenwa ha Memorandamo wa Kutlwano (MoU) mabapi le ho nyalanya Sehlekehleke sa Robben (se neng se sebediswa ke mmuso wa kgethollo ho kwalla balwanedi ba tokoloho) le Dihlekehleke tsa Gorée (motjha oo ka ona batho ba Aforika ba neng ba tsamaiswa ka dikepe ho iswa bophelong ba bokgoba) se tswela pele ho matlafatsa maqhama a botjhaba le a nalane ha ho hopolwa Dipuisano tsa Dakar tsa selemo sa Leeto la Kemedi ya Indonesia Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet welcomes the visit to South Africa by Sultan Husain Abubakar Syah of Tidore in Indonesia.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela leeto la Sultan Husain Abubakar Syah wa Tidore ho la Indonesia ka hara Aforika Borwa.

src: The Tidore delegation included Muhammad Amin Farouk, a descendant of Tuan Guru, a freedom fighter who was captured by the Dutch and sent to Robben Island in 1780.
tgt: Kemedi ya Tidore e ne e kenyeleditse Muhammad Amin Farouk, wa leloko la Tuan Guru, molwanedi wa tokoloho ya ileng a hapjwa ke ma-Dutch le ho romelwa Sehlekehlekeng sa Robben ka selemo sa 1780.

src: Tuan Guru (Imam Abdullah ibn Qadi Abdussalam) and three of his companions were imprisoned for about 12 years and thereafter kept in exile in the Cape, where he contributed greatly to the development of the local community and the building of the first mosque.
tgt: Tuan Guru (Imam Abdullah bin Qadi Abdussalam) le bomphato ba hae ba bararo ba ile ba kwallwa bakeng sa dilemo tse 12 mme kamora moo ba behwa palehong ho la Kapa, moo a nyehetseng haholo bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya badudi ba lehae le kahong ya moske wa pele.

src: A number of South Africans trace their family history to him.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a mmalwa a na le dikamano tsa lelapa le yena.

src: The delegation visited the National Assembly and the National Council of Provinces where they were welcomed by the presiding officers, Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa and Economic Development Minister Ebrahim Patel.
tgt: Kemedi e etetse Seboka sa Naha (NA) le Lekgotla la Naha la Diporofense (NCOP) moo ba amohetsweng ke badula ditulo, Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa le Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo Ebrahim Patel.

src: The visit highlighted the common history of colonial rule and the centuries-old fight for national liberation by the people of Indonesia and South Africa.
tgt: Leeto lena le hlakisitse nalane e tshwanang ya puso ya bokoloniale le ntwa ya dilemo tse balwang ka makgolo a dilemo ya tokoloho ya setjhaba ya batho ba Indonesia le Aforika Borwa.

src: Today we celebrate trade, tourism and other economic links between the two countries.
tgt: Kajeno re keteka maqhama a kgwebisano, bohahlaudi le a mang pakeng tsa dinaha tse pedi tsena.

src: End-of-year examinations.
tgt: Ditlhatlhobo tsa mafelo a selemo.

src: Cabinet is satisfied that the end-of-year examinations currently taking place at schools and other learning institutions are going ahead unhindered.
tgt: Kabinete e kgotsofetse hore ditlhatlhobo tsa mafelo a selemo hajwale di tswela pele dikolong le dikahong tse ding tsa thuto ntle le tshitiso.

src: Education is one of the key drivers towards a better future for all in the country.
tgt: Thuto ke e nngwe ya ditsela tsa bohlokwa tsa ho kgannela setjhaba bokamosong bo betere bakeng sa bohle ka hara naha.
