src: Parents and guardians are urged to continue to give the necessary support to learners during this period.
tgt: Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba kgothaletswa ho tswela pele ho fana ka tshehetso e batlehang ho baithuti nakong ena.

src: The Department of Basic Education’s catch-up programmes and other initiatives have assisted learners affected by protests during the year and a positive outcome is expected.
tgt: Mananeo a Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo a ho kgaoletsa nako e senyehileng le maikitlaetso a mang a thusitse baithuti ba anngweng ke matsholo a boipelaetso hara selemo mme ho lebeletswe sephetho se setle.

src: Social cohesion.
tgt: Momahano ya setjhaba.

src: Cabinet commends the law-enforcement agencies and the collaboration from the communities who helped secure the conviction of Willem Oosthuizen and Theo Jackson.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa makala a qobello ya molao le tshebedisano ya badudi ba thusitseng ka ho tshwarwa ha Willem Oosthuizen le Theo Jackson.

src: The two forced Victor Mlotshwa into a coffin and threatened to pour petrol on him.
tgt: Bobedi bona bo qobelletse Victor Mlotshwa ho kena ka lekaseng la bafu le ho mo tshosa ka ho mo tshela ka peterole.

src: The judgement demonstrates that South African laws are firm in protecting the rights of all citizens.
tgt: Kahlolo e bontsha hore melao ya Aforika Borwa ke e tiileng bakeng sa ho sireletsa ditokelo tsa baahi ba yona bohle.

src: Cabinet further affirms the right of all South Africans to engage in peaceful protest as part of our constitutional democracy.
tgt: Kabinete e boetse e tiisa tokelo ya maAforika Borwa kaofela ya ho kenela matsholo a boipelaetso a kgotso jwaloka ha karolo ya demokerasi ya molaotheo e tjho.

src: However, rights prescribed in the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996 are not absolute and must not infringe on the democratic rights of others.
tgt: Leha ho le jwalo, ditokelo tse tekilweng ka hara Molaotheo wa Aforika Borwa wa selemo sa 1996 di na le tekanyetso mme ha di a lokela ho hatikela ditokelo tsa demokerasi tsa ba bang.

src: Cabinet condemns the blocking of public roads, displaying of symbols of past oppression and destruction of national symbols which are a reflection of our hard-earned democracy.
tgt: Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe ho kwalwa ha ditsela tsa setjhaba, ho pepesa matshwao a kgatello ya mehleng le ho senngwa ha matshwao a naha a bontshang demokerasi ya rona e lwanetsweng ka thata.

src: Cabinet is committed to its role to build a cohesive society for all and calls on all citizens to play their part responsibly and in the spirit of working together to build a united, non-racist, non-sexist, democratic and prosperous South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e itlametse karolo ya yona ya ho aha setjhaba se momahaneng bakeng sa bohle le ho ipiletsa ho baahi kaofela ho bapala karolo ya bona ka boikarabelo le ka moya wa ho sebetsa mmoho ho aha Aforika Borwa e kopaneng, e hlokang semorabe, e sa kgetholleng ho ya ka bong, ya demokerasi le e tswetseng pele.

src: Cabinet Decisions.
tgt: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.

src: Cabinet approved the 2015/16 Report on State of Local Government in South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Tlaleho ya Boemo ba Mebuso ya Lehae ka hara Aforika Borwa ya 2015/16.

src: The report outlines progress made in implementing the Back to Basics (B2B) Programme, a plan of action to ensure delivery of basic services, good governance and sound financial management.
tgt: Tlaleho ena e teka kgatelopele e entsweng mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lenaneo la Hare Kgutleleng Sethathong (B2B), e leng moralo wa tshebetso wa ho netefatsa phano ya ditshebeletso tsa motheo, taolo e hlwahlwa le bolaodi ba ditjhelete bo kgabane.

src: The report highlights areas of challenges and provides a base for the implementation of the second phase of the B2B Programme.
tgt: Tlaleho ena e hlakisa dibaka tsa diphephetso le ho fana ka motheo bakeng sa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha mokgahlelo wa bobedi wa Lenaneo la B2Tlaleho e tla tekelwa Palamente.

src: Cabinet supported the proposed amendments of the three B-BBEE Sector Codes.
tgt: Kabinete e tsheheditse dihlomathiso tse sisintsweng tsa Dikhoutu tse tharo tsa Lekala la B-BBEDihlomathiso tsena di tobana le diphephetso tsa lekala lena le mathata a diphethoho tseo ka ho le leng di neng di sa tlo sebetswa ka botlalo ka dikhoutu tse tlwaelehileng.

src: The three sectors are in Agriculture, Finance and Construction.
tgt: Makala ana a mararo ke a Temo, Ditjhelete le Kaho.

src: The proposed amendments have been canvassed with the relevant stakeholders.
tgt: Dihlomathiso tse sisinngwang di sekasekilwe le bankakarolo ba amehang.

src: All the amended sector codes will be gazetted.
tgt: Dikhoutu kaofela tsa makala tse fetotsweng di tla kenngwa koranteng ya mmuso.

src: Cabinet approved the National e-Strategy and its publication in the Government Gazette.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana mohopolo wa Lewa la Naha la tsa Inthanetele ho phatlalatswa ha ona Koranteng ya Mmuso.

src: It was published in April 2017 for public comments.
tgt: O phatlaladitswe ka Mmesa 2017 bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.

src: The e-strategy articulates a shared vision and paradigm shift from information society to a knowledge economy and WEBTOKEN addresses challenges, including a digital divide between the rich and poor, between racial groups, different geographical locations and gender WEBTOKEN provides a platform for South Africans to integrate technology, which is relevant and related towards advancing development and economic prosperity for the benefit of society as a whole.
tgt: Mohopolo wa Lewa la Naha la tsa Inthaneteo hlakisa tjhebelopele e arolelanwang le ho sutha tlwaelong ya ho ba setjhaba sa tlhahisoleseding ho ya moruong le setjhabeng sa tsebo.

src: It will bring digital transformation to the public services and enable the provision of improved quality of services whilst tapping into digital technologies.
tgt: O fana ka lepatlelo bakeng sa maAforika Borwa ho kenella ho tsa thekenoloji, e leng se hlokahalang le ho amana mabapi le ho ntlafatsa ntshetsopele le nala moruong molemong wa setjhaba ka kakaretso.

src: The strategy targets, amongst others, fragmentation of e-government initiatives and duplication of processes, databases, large-scale system incompatibilities and inefficiencies.
tgt: Lefapha la Meralo ya Dikgokahanyo le Ditshebeletso tsa Poso le tla fana ka tlhahisoleseding e batsi mabapi le lewa lena.

src: It will also increase the usage of information and communications technology (ICTs), foster innovation in technologies and applications for e-Government.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lewa le Mmapa wa Naha wa Ditshebeletso tsa Mmuso ka Inthanete, hore le phatlalatswe Koranteng ya Mmuso.

src: Cabinet approved the ICT Small, Medium and Micro-sized Enterprises (SMME) Development Strategy.
tgt: Le tla tlisa diphethoho tsa dijithale ditshebeletsong tsa setjhaba le ho thusa ka phano ya boleng bo ntlafaditsweng ba ditshebeletso ha ka ho le leng le tla be le kenella ka hara dithekenoloji tsa dijithale.

src: This is a sector-specific intervention to address challenges facing SMMEs operating in the ICT sector.
tgt: Lewa lena hara tse ding, le tobile, ho arohanngwa ha maikitlaetso a Ditshebeletso tsa Mmuso ka Inthanete le ho iphetapheta ha metjha, didathabeisi, tsamaiso e ngata e sa tsamaelaneng le ho hloka bokgoni.

src: The strategy proposes interventions to accelerate the development and growth of small enterprises in the ICT sector, while facilitating an increase in the levels of uptake and usage of ICTs by the general small business sector.
tgt: Hape le tla eketsa tshebediso ya thekenoloji ya tlhahisoleseding le dikgokahanyo (di-ICT), le tla matlafatsa ntjhafatso dithekenolojing le ditshebedisong tsa Ditshebeletso tsa Mmuso ka Inthanete.

src: The strategy aims to support start-up ICT enterprises, strengthen existing enterprises and extend support to potentially viable SMMEs.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lewa la Ntshetsopele la ICT la Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, tse Mahareng le tse Kgolo (di-SMME).

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the Report on the Evaluation of the National School Nutrition Programme.
tgt: Bona ke boitshunyako bo tobileng makala bakeng sa ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse tjamelaneng le di-SMME tse sebetsang ka hara lekala la ICT.

src: This a government programme with an annual budget of R.5 billion resulting in nine million children from poor communities receiving a daily nutritious meal at school.
tgt: Lewa lena le lohotha maitshunyako a ho akofisa ntshetsopele le kgolo ya dikgwebo tse nyenyane ka hara lekala la ICT, ha ka nqa e nngwe le thusa ka keketseho maemong a kamohelo le tshebediso ya di-ICT ke lekala le akaretsang la dikgwebo tse nyenyane.

src: The report provides areas of effective implementation and some areas that need improvement.
tgt: Lewa lena le rerile ho tshehetsa dikgwebo tse ntjha tsa ICT, ho matlafatsa dikgwebo tse ntseng di le teng le ho atolosa tshehetso ho di-SMME tse nang le bokgoni ba kgolo.

src: South Africa’s membership in the IMO Council contributes to employment growth derived from the Operation Phakisa: Oceans Economy.
tgt: Kabinete e tshehetsa boiketo ba Aforika Borwa ba ho kgethwa hape ho botho ba dilemo tse pedi ba Lekgotla la Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Merero ya Mawatle (IMO).

src: The amendment seeks to phase down HFCs (the Kigali Agreement), which are some of the greenhouse gasses contributing to the depletion of the ozone layer.
tgt: Botho ba Aforika Borwa ho Lekgotla la IMO bo nyehela ho kgolo ya mesebetsi e bakuwang ke Operation Phakisa: ya Moruo wa Mawatle.

src: South Africa is already a signatory to the Montreal Protocol.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tsebahatswa Palamenteng ha Sehlomathiso ho Porothokhole ya Montreal mabapi le Dinthwana tse Senyang Moalo wa Ozouno ho kenyeletsa dihaedroflorokhabone (di-HFC).

src: Cabinet also approved the introduction into Parliament the ratification of the Minamata Convention on Mercury.
tgt: Sehlomathiso sena se rerile ho fokotsa di-HFC (Tumellano ya Kigali), e leng dikgase tse ding tse kotsi tse nyehelang ho phokotseho ya Moalo wa Ozouno.

src: It provides opportunities for the protection of vulnerable groups, especially those staying in areas where there is mining activity, against the adverse consequences of mercury on the environment and human health.
tgt: E fana ka menyetla bakeng sa tshireletso ya dihlopha tse kotsing, haholoholo ba dulang dibakeng tseo ho tsona ho nang le mesebetsi ya merafo, kgahlanong le ditlamorao tse kotsi tsa sekete tikolohong le boitekanelong ba batho.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the Report of the Commission of Inquiry into Higher Education and Training in the Republic of South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka Tlaleho ya Khomishene ya Dipatlisiso tse mabapi le Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello ka hara Riphabliki ya Aforika Borwa.

src: The Presidential Fiscal Committee will sit soon to interrogate financial implications.
tgt: Komiti ya Kantoro ya Moporesidente ya Ditjhelete e tla kopana ho hlantholla dikateng tsa yona tsa tshusumetso ya ditjhelete.

src: The Department of Higher Education and Training will have to review relevant policies and legislation, where necessary.
tgt: Lefapha la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello le tla lokela ho sheba botjha maano a amehang le molao, moo ho hlokahalang.

src: President Zuma will release the report to the public soon and the President’s spokesperson, Dr Bongani Ngqulunga, will make an announcement regarding this matter.
tgt: Moporesidente Zuma o tla lokollela setjhaba tlaleho ena haufinyana mme sebueledi sa Moporesidente, Ngaka Bongani Ngqulunga, o tla etsa tsebiso mabapi le taba ena.

src: Cabinet approved the National Minimum Wage Bill effecting the minimum wage to the lowest paid workers in the South African Labour Market.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Naha ya Moputso o Tlase e tla etsa hore ho lefuwe moputso o tlase bakeng sa basebeletsi ba lefuwang ka tlase ka ho fetisisa ka hara Mmaraka wa Basebetsi wa Aforika Borwa.

src: The Bill calls for every worker to be paid a wage that is no less than the national minimum wage.
tgt: Bili e ipiletsa hore mosebeletsi e mong le e mong a lefuwe mokgolo o seng ka tlase ho moputso o tlase wa Naha.

src: Once this Bill takes effect employers will be expected to pay their workers no less than the national minimum, which is to be adjusted annually.
tgt: Hang ha bili ena e qala ho sebetsa bahiri ba tla lebellwa ho lefa basebeletsi ba bona ho seng ka tlase ho moputso wa naha o tlase, o lokelang ho eketswa selemo ka seng.

src: Cabinet also approved the submission to Parliament of the Basic Conditions of Employment Amendment Bill of 2017.
tgt: Kabinete hape e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa Palamenteng ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Maemo a Motheo a Kgiro ya 2017.

src: This amends the Basic Conditions of Employment Act, 1997 (Act 75 of 1997) to ensure it provides for the Minimum Wage Bill.
tgt: Sena se fetola Molao wa Maemo a Motheo a Kgiro, 1997 (Molao wa bo-75 wa selemo sa 1997) ho netefatsa hore o tla sebetsa ho ya ka Bili ya Moputso o Tlase.

src: Cabinet approved the submission to Parliament of the Labour Relations Amendment Bill of 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa Palamenteng ha Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Dikamano tsa Basebetsi ya 2017.

src: The Bill is a culmination of consultation with all the relevant stakeholders.
tgt: Bili ena ke ditlamorao tsa ditherisano le bankakarolo kaofela ba amehang.

src: It addresses, amongst others, picketing procedures, the protracted strikes and arbitration advisory structures.
tgt: E sebetsana le, hara tse ding, metjha ya ho piketa, diteraeke tsa nako e telele le dibopeho tsa boeletsi ba bonamodi.

src: Cabinet approved the submission to Parliament of the Local Government: Municipal Structures Amendment Bill of 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa Palamenteng ha tse amanang le Mebuso ya Lehae: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Dibopeho tsa Bomasepala ya 2017.

src: This amends the Local Government: Municipal Structures Act, 1998 (Act 117 of 1998).The Bill seeks to strengthen intergovernmental and democratic governance arrangements.
tgt: Sena se fetola se amanang le Mebuso ya Lehae: Molao wa Dibopeho tsa Bomasepala, 1998 (Molao wa bo-117 wa selemo sa 1998).Bili e rerile ho matlafatsa ditlhophiso tsa ka hara mmuso le taolo ya demokerasi.

src: It also seeks to address issues around the administration and management of municipal elections, and to promote the effective and efficient implementation of the Act, as well as to strengthen oversight and governance in municipalities.
tgt: Hape e rerile ho sebetsana le dintlha tse amanang le tsamaiso le bolaodi ba dikgetho tsa bomasepala, le ho kgothaletsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ho hlwahlwa le ho kgabane ha Molao ona, hammoho le ho matlafatsa bodisa le taolo ka hara bomasepala.

src: Cabinet approved for the submission to Parliament of the Electronic Deeds Registration Systems Bill of 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho kenngwa Palamenteng ha Bili ya Mekgwa ya Elektroniki ya Boingodiso ba Ditokomane tsa Matlo ya 2017.

src: The Bill has already gone through public WEBTOKEN allows for the development of an electronic deeds registration system (e-DRS), for the processing of deeds, to effect the registration of large volumes of deeds as necessitated by Governments’ land reform initiatives.
tgt: E sebetsa bakeng sa ntshetsopele ya mokgwa wa elektroniki wa boingodiso ba ditokomane tsa matlo (e-DRS), bakeng sa ho tswellisa ditokomane tsa matlo, ho ntlafatsa boingodiso ba methamo e meholo ya ditokomane tsa matlo jwaloka ha e bakwa ke maikitlaetso a Mmuso a tlhabollo ya mobu.

src: As part of promoting the use of ICTs to build an inclusive economy, Cabinet approved the iKamva National e-Skills Institute Bill of 2017 (iNeSI Bill) to be gazetted for public consultation and comment.
tgt: Jwaloka karolo ya ho kgothaletsa tshebediso ya di-ICT ho aha moruo o kenyeletsang, Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bili ya Setheo sa Naha sa iKamva ya Maitsebelo ho tsa Inthanete ya 2017 (Bili ya iNeSI) hore e kenngwe koranteng ya mmuso bakeng sa ditherisano le tshwaelo.

src: The iNeSI Bill provides for the establishment of iNeSI as a public entity with its own enabling legislation, to address the e-skills shortage that hinders investment, socio-economic development and capacity development in the country.
tgt: Bili ya iNeSI e fana ka hore ho thehwe iNeSI e le setheo sa setjhaba ka molao wa sona o se dumellang, bakeng sa ho tobana le kgaello ya Maitsebelo ho tsa Inthanete e sitisang matsete, ntshetsopele ya moruo wa kahisano le bokgoni ba ntshetsopele ka hara naha.

src: This will establish ICT production hubs in each province, which will then assist iNeSI to develop and design relevant programs and training material, promote and undertake innovative research, and provide research capacity to postgraduate students.
tgt: Sena se theha dibaka tsa tlhahiso ya ICT porofenseng ka nngwe, ebe e ba se tla thusa iNeSI ho hlahisa le ho rala mananeo a batlehang le thepa ya thupello, ho kgothaletsa le ho etsa diphuputso tsa ntlafatso, le ho fana ka bokgoni ba diphuputso ho baithuti ba etsang dithuto tsa kamora dikgerata.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the Postal Services Amendment Bill in the Government Gazette for public comment.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Ditshebeletso tsa Poso Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa tshwaelo ya setjhaba.

src: 124 of 1998.The Bill provides for the restructuring of the postal sector in general to contribute to the provisions of universal access to innovative e-services while continuing to provide quality and secure traditional postal services.
tgt: Sena se fetola Sehlomathiso sa Molao wa Ditshebeletso tsa Poso wa bo-124 wa selemo sa 1998.Bili e fana ka ho boptjwa botjha ha lekala la poso ka kakaretso bakeng sa ho nyehela dipehelong tsa phihlello ya lefatshe ya Ditshebeletso tsa Inthanete tsa ntlafatso ha ka nqa e nngwe ho tswelwa pele ho fana ka ditshebeletso tsa poso tsa boleng le tse bolokehileng tsa mehleng.

src: This contributes to equality and human dignity through access to information and affordable postal services, which facilitate social development and improve the quality of life for individuals and communities.
tgt: Sena se nyehela bakeng sa tekatekano le seriti sa botho ka phumantsho ya tlhahisoleseding le ditshebeletso tsa poso tse kgonehang, tse thusang ka ntshetsopele ya kahisano le ntlafatso ya boleng ba bophelo bakeng sa batho ka bo mong le badudi.

src: Upcoming eventsCabinet also acknowledged some of the upcoming events in the government calendar.
tgt: Diketsahalo tse tlangKabinete hape e ananetse tse ding tsa diketsahalo tse tlang khalendareng ya mmuso.

src: Presidential Siyahlola Monitoring Programme.
tgt: Lenaneo la Boporesidente la Bodisa la Siyahlola.

src: President Zuma is scheduled to visit the Steve Biko Academic Hospital in Tshwane on Friday, 3 November 2017 to monitor the delivery of healthcare services as part of the Presidential Siyahlola Monitoring Programme.
tgt: Moporesidente Zuma o rerile ho etela Sepetlele sa Dithuto sa Steve Biko Tshwane ka Labohlano, 3 Pudungwana 2017 ho beha leihlo ditshebeletso tsa phano ya tlhokomelo ya kalafo e le karolo ya Lenaneo la Boporesidente la Siyahlola.

src: The hospital is one of the best performing public hospitals in the country and is named after Steve Bantu Biko, the late liberation struggle hero and former medical student at the then University of Natal (now called University of KwaZulu-Natal).President Zuma’s visit is part of the ongoing government monitoring programme that aims to address challenges facing public hospitals and to improve the healthcare system in the country, which is one of government’s key priorities.
tgt: Sepetlele sena ke se seng sa dipetlele tsa setjhaba se sebetsang hantle ka ho fetisisa ka hara naha le ho rehellwa ka Steve Bantu Biko, e leng mofu eo e neng e le mohale wa ntwa ya tokoloho le moithuti wa mehleng wa dithuto tsa bongaka wa Yunivesithi ya Natal (eo hajwale e bitswang Yunivesithi ya KwaZulu-Natal).Leeto la Moporesidente Zuma ke karolo ya lenaneo le tswellang la ho beha leihlo le reretsweng ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse tobaneng le dipetlele tsa mmuso le ho ntlafatsa tsamaiso ya tlhokomelo ya kalafo ka hara naha, e leng e nngwe ya dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa mmuso.

src: National Disability Rights Awareness Month.
tgt: Kgwedi ya Naha ya Temoso ya Ditokelo tsa Batho ba nang le Boqhwala.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to support National Disability Rights Awareness Month between 3 November and 3 December 2017, which also coincides with the International Day of Persons with Disabilities.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tshehetsa Kgwedi ya Naha ya Temoso ya Ditokelo tsa Batho ba nang le Boqhwala pakeng tsa 3 Pudungwana le 3 Tshitwe 2017, eo hape e tsamaelanang le Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Batho ba nang le Boqhwala.

src: South Africans are encouraged to raise awareness and protect the rights of people with disabilities, while recognising the gains that have been made to address challenges faced by people with disabilities.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho phahamisa temoso le ho sireletsa ditokelo tsa batho ba phelang ka boqhwala, ha ka ho le leng ho ananelwa dikuno tse entsweng bakeng sa ho sebetsana le diphephetso tse tobaneng le batho ba phelang ka boqhwala.

src: National Local Economic Development Conference.
tgt: Pitso ya Naha ya Ntshetsopele ya Moruo wa Lehae.

src: The Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs and Department of Small Business Development will convene the first National Local Economic Development Conference on 9 and 10 November 2017 in Gauteng.
tgt: Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba le Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane a tla epa Pitso ya pele ya Naha ya Ntshetsopele ya Moruo wa Lehae ka la 9 le 10 Pudungwana 2017 Gauteng.

src: The conference is a strategic platform for dialogue between public and private sector on topical and critical issues relating to stimulating local economies by creating an enabling environment to achieve inclusive economic development.
tgt: Pitso ena ke lepatlelo la lewa bakeng sa dipuisano pakeng tsa lekala la mmuso le la poraefete mabapi le dintlha tse ka sehlohoong le tse hlokolosi tse amanang le ho hlasimolla meruo ya lehae ka ho bopa tikoloho e kgontshang ho fihlella ntshetsopele ya moruo o kenyeletsang.

src: Messages.
tgt: Melaetsa.

src: Cabinet welcomes the announcement of over one billion US dollar to be invested over several months in the South African Economy in technology, education and agribusiness.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ya didolara tsa Amerika tse fetang bilione tse tla tsetelwa bakeng sa dikgwedi tse mmalwa moruong wa Aforika Borwa ho tsa thekenoloji, thuto le kgwebo ya tsa temo.

src: This was announced by Ambassador Harold Doley, Jr, the Governor of the African Development Bank.
tgt: Sena se ile sa tsebiswa ke Lenqosa Harold Doley, Jr, e leng Mmusisi wa Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Aforika.

src: Cabinet congratulates Dr Nono Simelela on her appointment as World Health Organisation (WHO) Assistant Director-General.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa Ngaka Nono Simelela ka ho thonngwa e le Mothusi wa Motsamaisi-Kakaretso wa Mokgatlo wa Bophelo bo Botle wa Lefatshe (WHO).

src: Dr Simelela will head the WHO Family, Women, Children and Adolescents Division from 13 November 2017.
tgt: Ngaka Simelela o tla etella pele Lekala la WHO le Sebetsang ka tsa Malapa, Basadi, Bana le Batjha ho tloha ka la 13 Pudungwana 2017.

src: She is the first African woman to become a gynaecologist in South Africa.
tgt: Ke mosadi wa pele wa moAforika wa ho ba Ngaka ya Mopepisi ka hara Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet welcomes the announcement by World Rugby that has recommended South Africa as the preferred country to host the 2023 Rugby World Cup tournament.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ya Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Rakbi ya ho kgothaletsa hore Aforika Borwa ke naha ya thatohatsi ya ho tshwara tlhodisano ya Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rakbi wa selemo sa 2023.

src: Cabinet also commends the work of the Minister of Sport and Recreation, Mr Thulas Nxesi, Deputy President Ramaphosa and the South African Rugby Union bid team.
tgt: Kabinete hape e thoholetsa mosebetsi wa Letona la Dipapadi le Boithapollo, Monghadi Thulas Nxesi, Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Ramaphosa le moifo wa boiketo wa Kopano ya Rakbi ya Aforika Borwa.

src: World Rugby will announce the final decision on 15 November 2017.
tgt: Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Rakbi o tla etsa tsebiso ya ho qetela ka la 15 Pudungwana 2017.

src: Cabinet congratulates all participants and winners of the 15th Annual Public Sector Innovation Awards.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa bankakarolo bohle le bahlodi ba Dikgau tsa bo-15 tsa Selemo ka Seng tsa Ntlafatso ya Lekala la Mmuso.

src: These awards recognise successful and effective service-delivery initiatives that have been achieved through the application of innovative approaches, methodologies and tools.
tgt: Dikgau tsena di ananela maikitlaetso a phano ya ditshebeletso a atlehileng le ho ba hlwahlwa ka ho sebedisa dikatamelo tse ntjhafatsang, mekgwa le disebediswa.

src: Cabinet congratulates SuperSport United FC for reaching the finals of the CAF Confederation Cup after beating Tunisian side Club Africa 3-1 and 4-2 on aggregate.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa SuperSport United FC bakeng sa ho fihla ho makgaolakgang a Mohope wa CAF Confederation kamora ho hlola sehlopha sa Tunisia sa Club Africa 3-1 le 4-2 ka palohare.

src: The team generally known as Matsatsantsa will meet TP Mazembe in the second-tier continental club competition final next month.
tgt: Sehlopha ka kakaretso se tsejwang ka hore ke Matsatsantsa se tla kopana le TP Mazembe mokgahlelong wa bobedi wa dihlopha tsa kontinente wa makgaolakgang a tlhodisano ena kgweding e tlang.

src: Cabinet expressed its condolences to the family and friends of Ian McLeod, whose passing was a loss to South African football.
tgt: Kabinete e fetiseditse matshediso a yona ho lelapa le metswalle ya Ian McLeod, eo ho hlokahala ha hae e leng tahlehelo papading ya bolo ya Aforika Borwa.

src: He became the first South African to referee at a FIFA World Cup tournament, when he officiated in the 1998 global showpiece in France.
tgt: E bile moletsaphala wa pele wa moAforika Borwa tlhodisanong ya Mohope wa Lefatshe wa FIFA, ha e ne e le mohlanka ya sebetsang dipapading tsa lefatshe tsa selemo sa 1998 ho la Fora.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: DithonyoDithonyo kaofela di lokela ho netefatswa ka mangolo a thuto le tumello e amehang.1 Batsamaisi ho Boto ya Koporasi ya Inshorense ya Mokitlane wa Diyantle ya South Africa SOC Limited:a. Mofumahadi Lerato Herriette Mothae leb.

src: Directors to the Board of the Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Limited:a. Ms Lerato Herriette Mothae andb.
tgt: Ditho tsa dinako tsohle tsa Lekgotla la Naha la Dinyewe tsa Basebedisi:a. Mofumahadi Hazel Viloshni Devraj leb.

src: Ms Sisa Mayekiso.
tgt: Moatefokate John Rinton Simpson.

src: Full-time members to the National Consumer Tribunal:a. Ms Hazel Viloshni Devraj andb.
tgt: Ho thonngwa hape ha ditho tse pedi tsa nakwana tsa Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Phehisano:a. Moporofesara Imraan Valodia leb.

src: Adv John Rinton Simpson.
tgt: Monghadi Anton Roskan.

src: Reappointment of two part-time members of the Competition Tribunal:a. ProfImraan Valodia andb.
tgt: Boto ya Lekgotla la Diphuputso tsa Disaense tsa Botho:a. Moporofesara Mvuyo Tom – (Modulasetulo)b. Moporofesara Lindiwe Zunguc.

src: Ms Nasima Badshad.
tgt: Mofumahadi Nasima Badshad.

src: ProfHaroon Bhoratf.
tgt: Moporofesara Haroon Bhoratf.

src: ProfShireen Hassimg.
tgt: Moporofesara Shireen Hassimg.

src: Ms Precious Nompumelelo Sibiyah.
tgt: Mofumahadi Precious Nompumelelo Sibiyah.

src: ProfMark Bussaini.
tgt: Moporofesara Mark Bussaini.

src: Adv Roshan Dehal andj.
tgt: Moatefokate Roshan Dehal lej.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 15 November 2017 at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.
tgt: Kabinete e Kopane ka Laboraro, la 15 Pudungwana 2017 Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.

src: Cabinet welcomes Ford Motor Company’s R3-billion investment into the Silverton Plant, Pretoria, Gauteng.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela matsete a Khamphani ya Makoloi ya Ford a R3 bilione ka hara Polante ya Silverton, Pretoria, Gauteng.

src: This investment will result in the creation of direct and indirect jobs due to the expected increased production of its Ford Ranger model.
tgt: Matsete ana a tla baka hore ho boptjwe mesebetsi e otlolohileng le e meng ya tlatsetso ka lebaka la keketseho e lebeletsweng ya tlhahiso ya motlolo wa yona wa Ford Ranger.

src: Such investments affirm the work that we continue to do as government in growing the economy and addressing the challenges of unemployment.
tgt: Matsete ana a tiisetsa mosebetsi oo re tswelang pele ho o etsa jwaloka mmuso mabapi le ho hodisa moruo le ho sebetsana le diphephetso tsa tlhokeho ya mosebetsi.

src: Through government’s R.8 billion incentive scheme in Automotive Production and Development Programme, R.5 billion private investments have been unlocked.
tgt: Ka sekema sa mmuso sa ditsiane tsa R.8 bilione ka hara Tlhahiso ya Makoloi le Lenaneo la Ntshetsopele, ho buletswe matsete a poraefete a R.5 bilione.

src: These include the announcement by Toyota to manufacture their new Toyota Hilux and Fortuner models as part of R.1billion investment.
tgt: Tsena di kenyeletsa tsebiso ya Toyota ya ho etsa dimotlolo tsa yona tse ntjha tsa Toyota Hilux le Fortuner e le karolo ya matsete a etsang R.1 bilione.

src: Also, BMW plans to construct a R6 billion state-of-the-art body shop.
tgt: Hape, BMW e rera ho aha lebenkele la maemo a hodimo a etsang R6 billone a ditopo tsa makoloi.

src: The Beijing Automobile International Corporation plans to invest R11 billion in an automotive manufacturing plant in South Africa.
tgt: Koporasi ya Matjhaba ya Makoloi ya Beijing e rera ho tsetela R11 bilione polanteng ya tlhahiso ya makoloi ka hara Aforika Borwa.

src: 2017 Tax Season.
tgt: Sehla sa Lekgetho sa 2017.

src: Cabinet extends its gratitude to all taxpayers who have already submitted their tax returns for the 2016/17 tax year.
tgt: Kabinete e fetisetsa diteboho ho balefi bohle ba lekgetho ba seng ba kentse ditokomane tsa bona tsa lekgetho bakeng sa selemo sa lekgetho sa 2016/17.

src: The revenue generated from income tax ensures government has the capacity to provide much-needed services and social support to millions of less fortunate South Africans.
tgt: Kuno e fehlilweng ke lekgetho la lekeno e netefatsa hore mmuso o na le bokgoni ba ho fana ka ditshebeletso tse batlehang haholo le tshehetso ya kahisano ho dimilione tse hlokang menyetla tsa maAforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet reminds taxpayers that the deadline for submission is Friday 24 November 2017 and encourages them to submit their tax returns.
tgt: Kabinete e hopotsa balefi ba lekgetho hore letsatsi la ho qetela la ho kenya ditokomane tsa lekgetho ke Labohlano la 24 Pudungwana 2017 le ho ba kgothaletsa ho kenya ditokomane tsa bona.

src: Inaugural National Local Economic Development (LED) Conference.
tgt: Pitso ya Naha ya ho Thakgolwa ha Ntshetsopele ya Moruo wa Lehae (LED).

src: Cabinet is pleased with the outcomes of the recently held National LED Conference.
tgt: Kabinete e thabile mabapi le diphetho tsa Pitso ya Naha ya LED e neng e tshwerwe haufinyana tjena.

src: It was held under the leadership of the Minister of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, Mr Des van Rooyen and the Minister of Small Business Development, Ms Lindiwe Zulu.
tgt: E ne e tshwerwe tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Puso e Kopanetsweng le Merero ya Botjhaba, Monghadi Des van Rooyen le Letona la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane, Mofumahadi Lindiwe Zulu.

src: It presented an opportunity to craft a new South African Local Economic Development agenda guided by the National Development Plan (NDP) priorities.
tgt: E hlahisitse monyetla wa ho rala lenaneo le letjha la LED ya Aforika Borwa le tataiswang ke dintlha tse ka sehlohlolong tsa Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP).

src: Its outcomes included the launch of the first Economic Development Council of South Africa (EDCSA), which aims to professionalise the economic development sector.
tgt: Diphetho tsa yona di kenyeleditse ho thakgolwa ha Lekgotla la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo la Aforika Borwa (EDCSA) la pele, le rerileng ho etsa hore lekala la ntshetsopele ya moruo e be la seporofeshenale.

src: As a professional body, the EDCSA will manage and monitor the professional conduct of the many practitioners who participate in the different development initiatives.
tgt: Jwaloka setheo sa seporofeshenale, EDCSA e tla tsamaisa le ho beha leihlo boitshwaro ba seporofeshenale ba bankakarolo ba bangata ba teng maikitlaetsong a fapaneng a ntshetsopele.

src: Cabinet noted also the historic launch of the Global Entrepreneurship Week (GEW) at 22 on Sloane, a new start-up campus, on the 10th of November 2017, in which the Minister of Small Business Development, Ms Lindiwe Zulu, hosted World entrepreneurship luminary, Sir Richard Branson.
tgt: Kabinete hape e ananetse ho thakgolwa ho etsang nalane ha Beke ya Lefatshe ya Boetapele ba Dikgwebo (GEW) nomorong ya 22 ho la Sloane, e leng khempase e ntjha ya qalo, ka la 10 Pudungwana 2017, moo Letona Zulu a neng a amohetse kwakwariri ya lefatshe ya baetapele ba dikgwebo, Monghadi Richard Branson.

src: The campus is the first one opened by the Global Entrepreneurship Network – offering direct and virtual support services to entrepreneurs throughout Africa as well as access to an international network of mentors, investors and entrepreneurial support organisations.
tgt: Khempase ena ke ya pele ya ho bulwa ke Marangrang a Boetapele ba Dikgwebo ba Lefatshe.

src: During Global Entrepreneurship Week, roughly 10 million participants take part in 35,000 events, activities and competitions in more than 165 countries around the world.
tgt: E fana ka ditshebeletso tsa tshehetso ka kotloloho le ka inthanete ho phatlalla le Aforika hammoho le phumantsho ya matjhaba ya marangrang a batataisi, batsetedi le mekgatlo ya tshehetso ya baetapele ba dikgwebo.

src: Heher Commission Report.1 Cabinet noted the release on Monday, 13 November 2017 of the Report of the Commission of Inquiry into the Feasibility of making High Education and Training Fee-free in South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse ho lokollwa ka Mantaha, 13 Pudungwana 2017 ha Tlaleho ya Khomishene ya Dipatlisiso mabapi le Kgonahalo ya ho etsa hore Thuto e Phahameng le Thupello e be mahala ka hara Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to study the report and its implications for the country while the recommendations are being considered by government.2 The President will make a pronouncement on the report in due course after processing by the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Higher Education Funding and the Presidential Fiscal Committee.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho hlahloba tlaleho ena le ditlamorao tsa yona bakeng sa naha ha dikgothaletso tsa teng di ntse di sekwasekwa ke mmuso.

src: Government remains determined to resolve the barriers to access higher education, and looks forward to concluding a sustainable solution for higher education funding.
tgt: Moporesidente o tla etsa tsebiso ka tlaleho ena ha nako e ntse e tsamaya kamora ho sekwasekwa ke Komiti e Kopanetsweng ya Matona ya Matlole a Ditjhelete tsa Thuto e Phahameng le Komiti ya Ditjhelete ya Boporesidente.

src: Drought.
tgt: Komello.

src: The current dam levels in the country remain a concern as there is more evaporation than rainfall.
tgt: Maemo a hajwale a matamo ka hara naha e dula e le matshwenyeho kaha ho na le moyafalo e ngata ho feta pula.

src: The fact that South Africa has not received sufficient rainfall to recharge our water sources to adequate levels means that the country is not yet out of the drought situation.
tgt: Taba ya hore Aforika Borwa ha e so fumane pula e lekaneng ho tsosolosa mehlodi ya rona ya metsi ho fihlella maemong a nepahetseng ho bolela hore naha hae e so tswe ka hara boemo ba komello.

src: Forecasts predict that the country will only receive its major rainfall from the beginning of January 2018.
tgt: Bolepi bo bonela pele hore naha e tla fumana feela pula e ngata ho tloha maqalong a Pherekgong 2018.

src: Cabinet wishes to assure the public that national, provincial and local government are cooperating and working together to ensure South Africa does not run out of water.
tgt: Kabinete e lakatsa ho netefaletsa setjhaba hore mmuso wa naha, mebuso ya diporofense le ya lehae e a thusana le ho sebetsa mmoho ho netefatsa hore Aforika Borwa ha e fellwe ke metsi.

src: Cabinet encourages everyone to play their part in saving and using water wisely and sparingly.
tgt: Kabinete e kgothaletsa mang le mang ho bapala karolo ya hae mabapi le ho baballa le ho sebedisa metsi ka bohlale le ka hloko.

src: Zimbabwe.1 Cabinet supports the intervention by President Jacob Zuma, in his capacity as Chair of SADC in response to the Zimbabwean situation.
tgt: Kabinete e tshehetsa boitshunyako ba Moporesidente Jacob Zuma, boemong ba hae jwaloka Modulasetulo wa Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC) ho arabela maemong a Zimbabwe.

src: He has sent Special Envoys, Minister of Defence and Military Veterans Ms Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula and State Security Minister, Adv Bongani Bongo.
tgt: O rometse Baemedi ba Ikgethang, Letona la Tshireletso le Mekaubere ya Ntwa, Mofumahadi Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula le Letona la Tshireletso ya Puso, Moatefokate Bongani Bongo.

src: They are to meet with President Robert Mugabe and the Zimbabwean Defence Force.
tgt: Ba tla kopana le Moporesidente Robert Mugabe le Sesole sa Tshireletso sa Zimbabwe.

src: Thereafter proceed to brief President João Lourenço as the Chairperson of the SADC Organ on Politics, Defence and Security.
tgt: Kamora moo, ba tla tsebisa Moporesidente wa Angola João Lourenço boemong ba hae jwaloka Modulasetulo wa Lekala la Dipolotiki, Tshireletso le Polokeho la SADKantoro ya Moporesidente e tla fana ka tse ntseng di etsahala mabapi le taba ena.

src: Square Kilometre Array (SKA).
tgt: Sekwere Kilomithara sa Array (SKA).

src: Cabinet welcomes the economic and social development achievements derived from the focused investment in social development in the region of the SKA South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela diphihlello tsa ntshetsopele ya moruo le kahisano lebatoweng la SKA ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Communities neighbouring the SKA area continue to benefit through better education and training projects, investment in small businesses and increased job opportunities.
tgt: Badudi ba dulang haufi le sebaka sa SKA ba tswela pele ho kgola molemo ka diporojeke tsa thuto le thupello e betere, matsete dikgwebong tse nyenyane le menyetla ya mesebetsi e eketsehileng.

src: The Department of Science and Technology, under the leadership of the Minister of Science and Technology, Ms Naledi Pandor, will hold a public-participation programme to celebrate achievements with the communities around Carnarvon, Northern Cape from 16 to 19 November 2017.Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji, tlasa boetapele ba Letona la Saense le Thekenoloji, Mofumahadi Naledi Pandor, o tla tshwara lenaneo la bonkakarolo ba setjhaba ho keteka diphihlello le badudi ba dibaka tse bapileng le Carnarvon, ho la Kapa Leboya ho tloha ka la 16 ho isa ka la 19 Pudungwana 2017.Diqeto tsa Kabinete.

src: Second performance quarterly progress reports for 2017/1.
tgt: Ditlaleho tsa Bobedi tsa Kgatelopele ya tshebetso ya kotara ka nngwe bakeng sa 2017/1.

src: Cabinet was apprised on the second performance quarterly progress reports for 2017/18 (July to September 2017) by all the five clusters.
tgt: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka Ditlaleho tsa Bobedi tsa Kgatelopele ya kotara ka nngwe bakeng sa 2017/18 (Phupu ho isa ka Loetse 2017) ke dikarolo kaofela tse hlano.

src: This forms part of Cabinet’s broad monitoring and evaluation of the Programme of Action derived from the Medium Term Strategic Framework (MTSF) 2014 to 2019.
tgt: Sena se bopa karolo ya lenaneo le pharaletseng la Kabinete la bodisa le tekolo ya Lenaneo la Tshebetso le itshetlehileng hodima Moralo wa Lewa la Nako e Bohareng (MTSF) la selemo sa 2014 ho isa ho sa 2019.

src: The Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation and the Ministerial Cluster Committees will conduct media briefings to unpack the progress of these reports.
tgt: Lefapha la Merero, Bodisa le Tekolo ya Tshebetso le dikomiti tsa Karolo ya Matona di tla bitsa dikopano tsa boraditaba ho pahlolla kgatelopele ya ditlaleho tsena.

src: The GCIS will coordinate the media briefings and publish the schedule on WEBTOKEN in due course.
tgt: GCIS e tla hokahanya dikopano tsa boraditaba le ho phatlalatsa lenaneo la tsona ho WEBTOKEN ha nako e ntse e tsamaya.

src: Update on address harvesting initiative and assignment of addresses.
tgt: Ho behwa sehlohlolong mabapi le maikitlaetso a ho kgwahlapisa diaterese le phano ya diaterese.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the progress report on the implementation of the Constitutional Court Judgement to assign addresses to the voters roll.
tgt: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka tlaleho ya kgatelopele mabapi le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Kahlolo ya Lekgotla la Molaotheo ya ho fana ka diaterese lenaneong la bakgethi.

src: Cabinet appreciated the full compliance with the six monthly progress reports submitted to the Constitutional Court.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse boimatahanyo ka botlalo le ditlaleho tsa kgatelopele ya dikgwedi kang tse tsheletseng tse iswang Lekgotleng la Molaotheo.

src: To date the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), working with other state agencies has attained almost 75% success in collecting the addresses of potential voters.
tgt: Ho fihlela lena Khomishene e Ikemetseng ya Dikgetho (IEC), ka ho sebedisana le makala a mang a puso, e fihlelletse katleho ya se ka fihlang ho 75% mabapi le ho bokella diaterese tsa batho ba ka nnang ba kenela dikgetho.

src: Cabinet was also briefed on the planned programme by the SAPO to assist those who do not have physical addresses.
tgt: Kabinete e tsebisitswe hape ka lenaneo le rerilweng ke Kantoro ya Poso ya Aforika Borwa (SAPO) ho thusa ba hlokang diaterese tsa bodulo.

src: Cabinet is pleased with the progress and the collaborative work conducted by SAPO, the IEC and other state agencies on the assignment of addresses project.
tgt: Kabinete e thabisitswe ke kgatelopele le ketso ya tshebedisano e entsweng ke SAPO, IEC le makala a mang a puso mosebetsing wa porojeke ya diaterese.

src: Cabinet further calls on those who have not updated their addresses to do so during the next voter registration week in March 2018.Upcoming events.
tgt: Kabinete e boela e ipiletsa ho ba so kang ba lokisa diaterese tsa bona ho etsa jwalo nakong ya beke ya boingodiso bo tlang ba bakgethi ka Hlakubele 2018.Diketsahalo tse tlang.

src: Fourth session of the South Africa-Botswana Binational Commission (BNC).
tgt: Tulo ya bone ya Khomishene ya Dinaha tse pedi (BNC) ya Aforika Borwa-Botswana.

src: President Jacob Zuma will undertake a working visit to participate in and co-chair the Fourth Session of the South Africa-Botswana BNC to be held in Gaborone, Botswana on Friday, 17 November 2017.
tgt: Moporesidente Zuma o tla nka leeto la tshebetso bakeng sa ho nka karolo le ho ba modulasetulo mmoho ho Tulo ya Bone ya BNC ya Aforika Borwa-Botswana e tla tshwarelwa Gaborone, ho la Botswana ka Labohlano, 17 Pudungwana 2017.

src: South Africa and Botswana meet annually at the level of the Heads of State within the framework of the BNC to review bilateral cooperation and discuss issues of common interest.
tgt: Aforika Borwa le Botswana di kopana selemo ka seng boemong ba Dihlooho tsa Dipuso ka hara moralo wa BNC ho sheba botjha tshebedisano ya bobedi bona le ho tshohla dintlha tse amang dinaha ka bobedi.

src: The two countries enjoy cordial relations which are informed by cultural ties and geographical proximity.
tgt: Dinaha ka bobedi di na le dikamano tse kgahlisang tsa kutlwano tse bontshwang ke maqhama a botjhaba le bohaufi ba dinaha tsena.

src: They cooperate on a number of issues including, transport, trade and investment, health, environmental issues etc.
tgt: Di sebedisana mabakeng a mangata a kenyeletsang, dipalangwang, kgwebisano le matsete, bophelo bo botle, mabaka a tikoloho, jwalojwalo.

src: South Africa is one of Botswana’s major trading partners, with several South African companies operating in that country.
tgt: Aforika Borwa ke e nngwe ya balekane ba baholo ba kgwebisano le Botswana, ka dikhamphani tse batlang di ba ngata tsa Aforika Borwa tse sebetsang ka hara naha eo.

src: Angolan State President visit.
tgt: Leeto la Moporesidente wa Puso ya Angola.

src: President Zuma will host his Excellency, the President of the Republic of Angola, João Lourenço, for a historic State Visit to South Africa from 23 November 2017.
tgt: Moporesidente Zuma o tla amohela Motlotlehi, Moporesidente wa Riphabliki ya Angola, João Lourenço, bakeng sa Leeto la Puso le etsang nalane ka hara Aforika Borwa ho tloha ka la 23 Pudungwana 2017.

src: This will be his first state visit to our country after his inauguration.
tgt: Sena e tla be e le Leeto la hae la Puso la pele ka hara naha ya rona kamora hoba a hlomamiswe.

src: The two countries have historical and fraternal ties dating back from the days of the liberation struggle when Angola housed and supported South African liberation cadres in various camps in that country.
tgt: Dinaha ka bobedi di na le maqhama a nalane le a bomphato a ballwang dilemong tse fetileng tsa ntwa ya tokoloho ha Angola e ne e bolokile le ho tshehetsa balwanedi ba tokoloho ba Aforika Borwa dikampong tse fapafapaneng ka hara naha eo.

src: Trade and economic cooperation between the two countries has grown substantially, to the extent that South Africa is Angola’s number one trading partner on the continent.
tgt: Kgwebisano le tshebedisano ho tsa moruo pakeng tsa dinaha ka bobedi e ho hotse haholo, ho fihlella moo Aforika Borwa e leng molekane wa mantlha wa Angola ka hara kontinente.

src: Many South African companies are conducting business in Angola in a variety of sectors including construction, mining, housing, retail, food and beverages, hotels and leisure, banking and medical services.
tgt: Dikhamphani tse ngata tsa Aforika Borwa di tsamaisa kgwebo ka hara Angola makaleng a fapafapaneng a kenyeletsang, a kaho, merafo, matlo, mabenkele, dijo le dino, dihotele le boikgathollo, dibanka le ditshebeletso tsa bongaka.

src: During his visit João Lourenço will also host a Lecture on 24 November 2017 at OR Tambo Building in Pretoria.
tgt: Nakong ya leeto la hae, Moporesidente Lourenço hape o tla tshwara Kopano ya Thuto ka Labohlano, la 24 Pudungwana 2017 moahong wa OR Tambo ho la Pretoria.

src: 16 Days of Activism.
tgt: Matsatsi a16 a Thibelo ya Diketso tsa Dikgoka.

src: Cabinet joins all South Africans who are taking a stand against women and child abuse.
tgt: Kabinete e imatahanya le maAforika Borwa kaofela a emang kgahlanong le Diketso tsa dikgoka ho basadi le tlhekefetso ya bana.

src: The 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children campaign is taking place between 25 November and 10 December 2017.
tgt: Matsatsi a 16 a letsholo la Thibelo ya Diketso tsa Dikgoka kgahlanong le Basadi le Bana le tla etsahala pakeng tsa la 25 Pudungwana le la 10 Tshitwe 2017.

src: This is the 19th year of the campaign in South Africa and it will continue under the theme: “Count Me In: Together Moving a Non-Violent South Africa Forward”.
tgt: Sena ke selemo sa bo-19 sa letsholo lena ka hara Aforika Borwa mme le tla tswela pele tlasa mookotaba: “Mpalleng le Nna: Mmoho re Ntshetsapele Aforika Borwa e Hlokang Dikgoka”.

src: President Zuma will launch the 16 Days of Activism campaign in the Eastern Cape on Saturday, 25 November 2017.
tgt: Moporesidente Zuma o tla thakgola letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 a Thibelo ya Dikgoka ho la Kapa Botjhabela ka Moqebelo, wa la 25 Pudungwana 2017.

src: It will focus on the continued roll-out of National Dialogues, which encourage people to talk about the scourge of gender-based violence.
tgt: Le tla tsepamisa maikutlo hodima phano e tswellang ya Dipuisano tsa Naha, tse kgothaletsang batho ho bua ka kgoba ya dikgoka tse itshetlehileng hodima bong.

src: This will be preceded by International Men’s Day on Sunday, 19 November 2017, which calls on men to play their part in building a safer and more socially cohesive society.
tgt: Sena se tla etellwa pele ke Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Banna ka Sontaha, sa la 19 Pudungwana 2017, le ipiletsang ho banna ho bapala karolo ya bona mabapi le ho aha setjhaba se bolokehileng le sa kahisano e momahaneng.

src: The Department of Justice and Constitutional Development will undertake the second community radio campaign under its Let’s Talk Justice series, which brings government services to people by providing listeners with an opportunity to engage with officials on topical issues.
tgt: Lefapha la Toka le Ntshetsopele ya Molaotheo le tla hlophisa letsholo la bobedi la diradio tsa badudi tlasa letoto la tsona la Let’s Talk Justice, le tlisang ditshebeletso tsa mmuso bathong ka ho neha bamamedi monyetla wa ho buisana le bahlanka ba mmuso ka ditaba tse ka sehloohong.

src: The launch of a Sexual Offences Court during the campaign will also ensure better access to the justice system.
tgt: Ho thakgolwa ha Lekgotla la Dinyewe la Ditlolo tsa Molao tsa Motabo nakong ya letsholo hape ho tla netefatsa phumantsho e betere ya tsamaiso ya toka.

src: Cabinet is confident that by working together we can end the cycle of abuse.
tgt: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore ka ho sebetsa mmoho re ka qeta motsamao wa tlhekefetso.

src: Through our collective efforts we can act to prevent abuse while ensuring a safer society for women and children.
tgt: Ka mekutu ya rona e kopanetsweng re ka sebetsa ho thibela tlhekefetso ha ka nqa e nngwe re netefatsa setjhaba se bolokehileng bakeng sa basadi le bana.

src: All people in South Africa are urged to wear a white ribbon as a symbolic pledge towards eliminating this scourge from our society.
tgt: Batho bohle ba Aforika Borwa ba kgothaletswa ho apara ribone tse tshweu e le letshwao la boitlamo bakeng sa ho fedisa kgoba ena ka hara setjhaba.

src: Cabinet calls on all in society to participate in Red Ribbon Friday activations ahead of World AIDS Day on 1 December and up until the end of that month.
tgt: Boitokisetso ba Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDKabinete e ipiletsa setjhabeng kaofela ho nka karolo ho qaleng ha mesebetsi ya Labohlano la Ribone e Kgubedu pele ho Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS ka la 1 Tshitwe le ho fihla mafelong a kgwedi eo.

src: Wearing a red ribbon is a symbol of solidarity and commitment to the fight against HIV and AIDWorld AIDS Day is an opportunity for every community to unite in the fight against HIV, show support for people living with HIV and remember those who have passed on.
tgt: Ho apara diribone tse kgubedu ke letshwao la bonngwe le boitlamo mabapi le ntwa kgahlanong le HIV le AIDLetsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS ke monyetla bakeng sa motse ka mong ho ikopanya ntweng e kgahlanong le HIV, ho bontsha tshehetso bakeng sa batho ba phelang ka HIV le ho hopola ba hlokahetseng.

src: This year’s event will be held under the theme: “My Right to Know My Status, Prevention Is My Responsibility”, which links to the global theme: “The Right to Health”.
tgt: Ketsahalo ya selemong sena e tla tshwarwa tlasa mookotaba: “Tokelo ya ka ya ho Tseba Maemo a Ka, Thibelo ke Boikarabelo ba ka”, e hokahanang le mookotaba wa lefatshe: “Tokelo ya Bophelo bo Botle”.

src: This bolsters implementation of South Africa’s National Strategic Plan for HIV, Tuberculosis and Sexually-Transmitted Illnesses 2017 - 2022 (NSP), which is a key pillar in South Africa’s progress towards achieving universal healthcare as reflected in the NDP, which promotes a healthier, stronger and more equitable nation.
tgt: Sena se matlafatsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Lewa la Morero wa Naha la AIDS la Aforika Borwa, Lefuba le mahloko a Tshwaetsanang ka Motabo 2017 - 2022 (NSP), e leng tshiya ya bohlokwa kgatelopeleng ya Aforika Borwa e lebisitseng phihlellong ya tlhokomelo ya kalafo ya lefatshe jwaloka ha e hlahella ho NDP, e kgothaletsang setjhaba se itekanetseng, se matla le se nang le tekatekano.

src: National Imbizo Focus Week.
tgt: Beke ya Naha ya Imbizo ya hoTsepamiso ya Maikutlo.

src: Cabinet calls on communities to join participation in the upcoming 7th National Imbizo Focus Week, expected to be held from 27 November to 3 December 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho badudi ho kenela ho nka karolo bekeng e tlang ya Beke ya Naha ya Tsepamiso ya Maikutlo ya bo-7, e lebeletsweng ho tshwarwa ho tloha ka la 27 Pudungwana ho isa ka la 3 Tshitwe 2017.

src: Under the leadership of the GCIS, this platform promotes interactive engagements between members of the Executive and communities.
tgt: Tlasa boetapele ba GCIS, lepatlelo lena le kgothaletsa dipuisano tse kopanetsweng pakeng tsa ditho tsa Phethahatso le badudi.

src: It is taking place within the context of the centennial of Oliver Reginald Tambo, who advocated for gender equality.
tgt: E etsahala ka hara mohopolo wa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa Oliver Reginald Tambo, ya neng a kgothaletsa tekatekano ya bong.

src: The activities are aimed to support the 16 Days of Activism campaign.
tgt: Diketsahalo tsena di reretswe ho tshehetsa letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 a Ntwa kgahlanong le Dikgoka le Tlhekefetso ya Basadi le Bana.

src: Events will be placed on the national calendar and shared on the government website (WEBTOKEN).Bills.
tgt: Diketsahalo di tla manehwa khalendareng ya naha le ho arolelanwa websaeteng ya mmuso (WEBTOKEN).Dibili.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of a notice in terms of section 74(5) of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya tsebiso ho ya ka karolo 74(5) ya Molaotheo wa Riphabliki ya Aforika Borwa wa selemo sa 1996.

src: The aim is to initiate a national and provincial consultation process for purposes of effecting changes to provincial boundaries in respect of the Matatiele Local Municipality in the Eastern Cape and certain areas of Ba Ga Mothibi in North West.
tgt: Morero ka sena ke ho qala tsamaiso ya ditherisano tsa naha le diporofense ka merero ya ho tlisa diphethoho meeding ya diporofense mabapi le Masepala wa Lehae wa Matatiele ho la Kapa Botjhabela le dibakeng tse itseng tsa Ba Ga Mothibi ho la Leboya Bophirima.

src: The intended redetermination of the provincial boundaries emanates from the communities of the areas in question who wish to be relocated to neighboring provinces.
tgt: Maikemisetso ka ho ralwa botjha ha meedi ya diporofense ho hlahisitswe ke badudi ba dibaka tse boletsweng ba batlang ho kgutlisetswa diporofenseng tse mabapi.

src: Messages.
tgt: Melaetsa.

src: Cabinet congratulates France as the preferred host of the 2023 Rugby World Cup and thanks government’s delegation, headed by Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa, Sport and Recreation Minister Thulas Nxesi and the South African Rugby Union, for the work done in promoting South Africa’s bid to host the event.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa naha ya Fora jwalo ka thatohatsi e tla tshwara Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rakbi wa selemo sa 2023 le ho leboha kemedi ya mmuso, e neng e eteletswe pele ke Motlatsi wa Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa, Letona la Dipapadi le Boithapollo Thulas Nxesi le Kopano ya Rakbi ya Aforika Borwa, bakeng sa mosebetsi wa ho kgothaletsa boiketo ba Aforika Borwa ba ho tshwara ketsahalo ena.

src: Cabinet congratulates Minister Pandor, who was awarded the Outstanding Educator Award.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa Letona Pandor, ya abetsweng Kgau ya Titjhere e ka Sehlohlolong.

src: The award was presented to Minister Pandor by the Chancellor of the University of South Africa, former President Thabo Mbeki.
tgt: Kgau ena e ile ya nehwa Letona Pandor ke Motjhanselara wa Yunivesithi ya Aforika Borwa, Moporesidente wa mehleng Thabo Mbeki.

src: The Outstanding Educator Award, one of four categories, acknowledges the contribution of any outstanding educator who has excelled in or advanced teaching, learning, skills development and/or research in their area of expertise.
tgt: Kgau ya Titjhere e ka Sehlohlolong, e leng e nngwe ya mekgahlelo e mene, e ananela nyehelo ya titjhere leha e le efe e ipabotseng kapa e ntsheditseng pele ho ruta, ho ithuta, ntshetsopele ya maitsebelo le/kapa diphutso lekaleng la yona la botsebi.

src: Cabinet commends the work done by the South African Astronomical Observatory, which is part of the Wide Angle Search for Planets consortium of planet hunters who have detected three new planets.
tgt: Kabinete e babatsa mosebetsi o entsweng ke Seteishene sa Aforika Borwa sa Tsebo ya Dinaledi, e leng karolo ya moifo wa ditsomi tsa dipolanete wa Wide Angle Search for Planets o sibollotseng dipolanete tse tharo tse ntjha.

src: Cabinet congratulates the participants and winners of the 2017 Govan Mbeki Awards, which honour those in the construction sector who have excelled in the delivery of houses.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa bankakarolo le bahlodi ba Dikgau tsa selemo sa 2017 tsa Govan Mbeki, tse tlotlang batho ba lekala la kaho ba ipabotseng ka phano ya matlo.

src: Cabinet convened for its last 2017 meeting at the Union Buildings in Pretoria.
tgt: Kabinete e bokane bakeng sa kopano ya ho qetela ya selemo sa 2017 Union Buildings ho la Pretoria.

src: Cabinet DecisionsCabinet approved the National Tourism Sector Strategy (NTSS) 2016-2026 for implementation.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Lewa la Naha la Lekala la Bohahlaudi (NTSS) 2016-2026 bakeng sa ho kenngwa tshebetsong.

src: The NTSS is anchored on five strategic pillars, namely marketing, facilitation of ease of access for tourists, enhance visitor experience, destination management and broad-based benefits.
tgt: NTSS e thehilwe hodima ditshiya tse hlano tsa lewa, e leng ho le bapatsa, ho thusa ka phihlello e bobebe bakeng sa bahahlaudi, ho matlafatsa boiphihlelo ba baeti, bolaodi ba dibaka tsa ketelo le melemo e pharalletseng.

src: The full document is available on the Department of Tourism’s website: www.
tgt: Tokomane ka botlalo e fumaneha websaeteng ya Lefapha la Bohahlaudi: WEBTOKEKabinete e tjhaelletse monwana moralo bakeng sa ho thehwa ha Khamphani ya Naha ya Marangrang a Pharalletseng.

src: Cabinet approved the framework for the establishment of a National Broadband Network Company.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana phatlalatso ya Lewa la Moralo wa Leano la Boqhwala bakeng sa Tsamaiso ya Thuto le Thupello ya kamora Materiki bakeng sa ditshwaelo tsa setjhaba.

src: It will be formed out of the merger of Sentech and Broadband Infraco.
tgt: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka sephetho sa ho Shejwa botjha ha Lenaneo la ho Thusa Boraditekesi ka Ditjhelete le hlophisitsweng ho tloha ka Pudungwana 2015 ho fihla ka Loetse 2016.

src: This will facilitate the roll-out of the interdependent elements in a coordinated manner and create a national broadband champion.
tgt: Lenaneo lena ke karolo ya Lewa la Dipalangwang tsa Setjhaba le Bataletseng, le reretsweng ho fana ka tsamaiso e kopanetsweng le ho ba hlwahlwa ha dipalangwang ka hara Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet approved the First Annual Progress Report on Implementation of the White Paper on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (WPRPD).
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ntlha ya hore ho be le dipuisano le mosebetsi o mongata le mafapha a amehang pele Lefapha la Naha la Dipalangwang le ka kenya tshebetsong katamelo e hlabollotsweng botjha.

src: The report covers the period from 1 January to 31 December 2016.The report gives a high-level assessment of the extent to which government departments have started embedding the policy directives of WPRPD into their respective planning, budgeting, and service delivery and reporting systems.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho lokollelwa setjhaba ha kgatiso ya bo-8 ya Ditshupane tsa Ntshetsopele (2016).

src: The programme is part of the broader Public Transport Strategy, which aims to provide an integrated safety and efficient transport system in South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Bolaodi bo Botjha ba Tshebetso le Tsamaiso ya Ntshetsopele ya Dihlooho tsa Mafapha, bo bontshang ka nepo kgokahano pakeng tsa motho ka bo mong le tshebetso ya setheo ka kakaretso.

src: Cabinet approved that more consultation and work must be done with relevant departments before the National Department of Transport can embark on the revised approach.
tgt: E tla qala ho sebetsa ka la1 Mmesa Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho tsebahatswa le ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Moralo wa Sekema sa ho Thaothwa ha Dirutehi tsa Tshebeletso ya Mmuso.

src: The Development Indicator Report focuses on South Africa’s development since democracy and monitors implementation of the National Development Plan Vision 2030.Cabinet approved measures to strengthen the management of discipline of public servants in relation to officials conducting business with organs of state.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa phatlalatso ya Ditsebiso tse latelang Koranteng ya Mmuso tse amanang le Tokiso ya Dikahlolo tsa Makgotla a Dinyewe, e reretsweng ho eketsa phihlello ya toka bakeng sa batho ba neng ba qheletswe ka thoko pele le metsana ya mahae e sa tholeng ditshebeletso tse lokelang.

src: It gives effect to the Public Service Regulations 2016, which prohibits public servants from conducting business with the State.
tgt: Tokiso ena e diterekeng tsa bomaseterata Freistata le Kapa Leboya, le ho tloswa ha Ditereke tsa Bomaseterata tse itseng ho Karolo ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Dinyewe la Gauteng le ho di beha tlasa bodisa ba Karolo ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Dinyewe la Leboya Bophirima.

src: From 1 March, National Treasury, supported by the Department of Public Service and Administration (DPSA), will monitor all new registrations on the online Central Supplier Database against the Persal System.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana Melawana ya Melao ya Bonamodi ho ya ka dipehelo tsa Molao wa Tshireletso ya Matsete, 2015 (Molao wa bo-22 wa selemo sa 2015).

src: Cabinet approved the New Performance Management and Development System for Heads of Department, which accurately reflects the link between individual and organisational performance.
tgt: Melawana ena e fana ka hore motsetedi ya nang le kgang mabapi le mohato o nkuweng ke mmuso o amang matsete, ho kopa Lefapha la Dikgwebo le Diindaseteri (dti) ho kenella ka mokgwa wa bonamodi o ka bang teng.

src: It comes into effect on 1 April 2018.Cabinet approved the introduction and implementation of the Public Service Graduate Recruitment Scheme Framework.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana ho bitswa le ho tshwarwa ha dipitso tse latelang:Pitso ya Ditherisano ya Naha ya Lenaneo la Ntshetsopele ya Basebeletsi ba Badudi ya selemo sa 2018 ke DPSA.

src: The Minister of Public Service and Administration will also align this framework to the Youth Employment Service Programme.
tgt: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji le tla buisana le Komiti ya Tsamaiso ya Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Saense ka kgonahalo ya ho tshwara pitso ena.

src: Cabinet approved for the publication of the following Notices in the Government Gazette relating to the Rationalisation of Courts Jurisdiction, which aims to increase access to justice for previously marginalised and under-serviced rural villages.
tgt: Dipuisano tsa Boemo bo Phahameng tsa 2017 tsa Kopano ya Aforika (AU), e tla tshwarwa ke DPSA ho tloha ka la 6 ho isa ka la 8 Tshitwe Kabinete e tjhaelletse monwana bakeng sa meralo ya letoto la dikhoine tsa sehopotso tsa babokelli le potoloho hore di ntshuwe ka selemo sa 2018.Meralo ya dikhoine, le diphatlalatso tsa tsona, di tla hatiswa Koranteng ya Mmuso: 2018 2oz, 22-dikharate tsa gauta tsa Krugerrand 2018 24-dikharate tsa gauta tsa letoto la dikhoine tsa Natura (Kgolo ya Sube – Archosauria) 2018 24-dikharate tsa letoto la dikhoine tsa gauta tsa R1 (Dihahabi tsa Aforika Borwa – kgudu)2018 khoine ya ditshepe tse pedi ya R5 e potolohang (Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela)2018 24-dikharate tsa letoto la dikhoine tsa Protea tsa gauta le steling sa silifera (Bophelo ba Mohale – Nelson Mandela)2018 letoto la steling sa silifera sa Korone ya R2 le letoto la Teke ya 2 ½ (Ditshibollo tsa Aforika Borwa – Ditshwantsho tsa mahlasedi a X-ray tse entsweng ka khompyutha le 2018 letoto la dikhoine tse kentsweng mebala tsa steling sa silifera (Dinonyana le Dipalesa tsa Resefe ya Tlhaho ya Waterberg).Dintlha tsa Hajwale.

src: The rationalisation is in magisterial districts in the Free State and Northern Cape, and the removal of certain Magisterial Districts from the Gauteng Division of the High Court and placing them under the jurisdiction of the North West Division of High Court.
tgt: Sephetho sa Palohohle ya Dihlahiswa tsa Naha (GDP)Kabinete e thabisitswe ke kgolo ya moruo wa Afrika Borwa o hotseng ka sekgahla sa 2% tsa selemo ka seng kotareng ya boraro ya selemo sa 2017, ho tloha ho phahameng ho shebuweng botjha ha 2.8% kotareng ya bobedi.

src: The stronger-than-expected performance was mainly due to continued strong growth in the agriculture sector, which contributed percentage points to overall growth on the back of per cent quarter-on-quarter growth.
tgt: Lekala la motlakase ke lona le hulanyang maoto ka ho fetisisa, le theohile ka 5.5%.

src: Strong performance in agriculture, which has seen three consecutive quarters of robust growth, was due to higher production of field crops (such as maize) in summer rainfall areas and horticultural products.
tgt: Kgolo bakeng sa dintho tse sebediswang malapeng ya 2.6% ke ka lebaka haholo la ho reka thepa ya nako e telele, e bakileng keketseho ya dintlha tsa diphesente tse tsa keketseho ya 2.6%.

src: Mining and manufacturing also contributed to the growth recorded, with mining and quarrying increasing by 6.6% and contributing percentage points to growth.
tgt: Kgolo ena e neng e sa lebellwa le ho shejwa botjha ho phahameng ha sephetho sa kgolo ya kotara ya bobedi e bolela hore kgolo e ka fihla ho 0.9% ka selemo sa 2017.Sena se ka hodimo ho feta 0.7% e neng e lebeletswe nakong ya Pehelo ya Leano la Ditekanyetso tsa Nako e Bohareng (MTBP).

src: Government needs to ensure that this growth momentum is maintained by continuing to implement the 14 confidence-boosting measures that build on improving consumer confidence and can restore business confidence.
tgt: Le reretswe ho bopa tikoloho e nepahetseng ka ho fana ka sebaka sa boikopanyo bakeng sa batsetedi hore ba fumane ditshebeletso tsohle bakeng sa ho akofisa diporojeke le ho fokotsa metjha e mengatangata ya mmuso ha motho a qala kgwebo.

src: InvestSA One-Stop ShopCabinet welcomes the launch of the InvestSA One-Stop Shop in KwaZulu-Natal by President Jacob Zuma as part of efforts to improve the ease of doing business in South Africa.
tgt: Dikamano tsa Aforika Borwa le AngolaKabinete e amohela ditumellano tse saennweng nakong ya Leeto la Puso Aforika Borwa la Moporesidente wa Angola João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço.

src: It aims to create a conducive environment by providing a focal point of contact for investors to obtain all services to fast-track projects and reduce government red-tape when starting a business.
tgt: Ho saennwe ditumellano tse latelang: Memorandamo wa Kutlwano (MoU) mabapi le ho boptjwa ha Khomishene ya Boporesidente ya Dinaha tse Pedi, MoU wa Tshebedisano Lepatlelong la Tikoloho, Ditataiso tsa ho Kenngwa Tshebetsong ha pebofatso ya phumantsho ya divisa, Porothokhole ya Tshebedisano ya Sepolesa le Tumellano ya Thusano Mabakeng a Tsamaiso ya Makgetho a Madiboho.

src: South Africa-Angola relationsCabinet welcomes the agreements signed during the State Visit to South Africa by Angolan President João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço.
tgt: Seboka sa Bohlano sa AU le Kopano ya Yuropa (EU)Kabinete e amohela sephetho sa Seboka sa Bohlano sa AU le ESeboka sena se fanne ka monyetla bakeng sa Aforika Borwa ho matlafatsa mawa a dikamano tsa moruo le bodiplomate ka dipuisano tse fapafapaneng sebokeng sena le diketsahalong tse ka thoko tse kang Foramo ya Kgwebo le Seboka sa Batjha, ka ho tsepamisa maikutlo hodima kgolo ya moruo e kenyeletsang kgiro ya batjha le boetapele ba dikgwebo.

src: The following agreements were signed: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on the creation of a Presidential Binational Commission, MoU on Cooperation in the Field of Environment, Implementation Guidelines for the visa waiver, Protocol on Police Cooperation and an Agreement on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Customs Matters.
tgt: Kgwebisano ya Bokgoba ya Bafalli ba batho batsho ba maAforikaKabinete e imatahanya le badudi ba matjhaba mabapi le ho tshwela ka mathe ditlaleho tsa ho fantiswa ha bafalli ba batho batsho ba maAforika ho la Libya jwaloka makgoba.

src: Fifth AU-EU SummitCabinet welcomes outcomes from the Fifth Summit of the AU-European Union (EU).
tgt: Diketso tse jwalo tse hlokang botho di kgahlanong le mehopolo ya AU, le disebediswa tse amehang tsa Aforika le tsa matjhabeng, ho kenyeletswa Tjhata ya Aforika le Ditokelo tsa Botho le tsa Batho.

src: The summit provided an opportunity for South Africa to enhance strategic economic and diplomatic relations through various engagements in the summit and in side events such as the Business Forum and Youth Summit, with a focus on inclusive economic growth, youth employment and entrepreneurship.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela tsebiso ka ba ka sehloohong ya hore ba tla hlophisa mokgwa wa dipalangwang le phalliso ho la Tripoli bakeng sa baphaphathehi le bafalli ba hlokang tshireletso ya matjhaba.

src: Outbreak of ListeriosisCabinet appeals to all people to take the necessary precaution – such as washing their hands before preparing food and avoiding raw or uncooked foods – to curb the spread of Listeriosis, whilst investigations continue to establish the source of the bacteria.
tgt: Lefu lena le bakwa ke baktheria e fumanwang mobung, metsing, dimeleng le dihlahisweng tsa lebese tse sa hlwekisiswang, mme le ka baka matshwao ao e kang ke a ntaramane e kopaneng le letshollo.

src: The disease is caused by a bacteria found in soil, water, vegetation and non-pasteurised dairy products, and may result in flu-like symptoms with diarrhoea.
tgt: Le ka phekolwa ka katleho ka diantibayothiki, haeba e ka hlokomelwa ka nako.

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to continue using water sparingly as the country still continues to experience drought/.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa kaofela ho tswela pele ho sebedisa metsi ka paballo kaha naha e ntse e tswela pele ho ba ka hara komello.

src: Notwithstanding the recent rains, the dam levels nationally continue to decline.
tgt: Ho sa tsotellwe dipula tse ntseng di na, maemo a matamo a ntse a tswela pele ho theoha ka hara naha.

src: This is due to the high temperatures as well as that we did not as yet have consistent rains.
tgt: Sena ke ka lebaka la dithempheretjha tse hodimo hammoho le hore ha re so fumane dipula tse tsitsitseng.

src: Cabinet is encouraged by the progressive negotiations with the highly indebted municipalities towards finding a solution to the municipal debt.
tgt: Kabinete e kgothatswa ke ditherisano tse hatetseng pele le bomasepala ba kolotang haholo tse lebisitseng tharollong ya sekoloto sa bomasepala.

src: BillsCabinet approved the submission to Parliament of following Bills.1 Social Assistance Amendment Bill of 2017.The Bill provides improved benefits with respect to child support grants for orphaned and vulnerable children, including those residing in child-headed households.2 Property Practitioners Bill of 2017 The Bill repeals the current Estate Agency Affairs Act, 1976 (Act 112 of 1976).
tgt: Sehlomathiso sa Bili ya Dithuso tsa Kahisano ya selemo sa 2017Bili ena e fana ka melemo e ntlafaditsweng mabapi le dithuso tsa mmuso tsa ditshehetso tsa ditjhelete bakeng sa bana ba dikgutsana le ba tsietsing, ho kenyeletswa le ba dulang malapeng a eteletsweng pele ke bana.

src: It creates an enabling regulatory environment to enhance economic activity within the real estate industry while also addressing a need to ensure transformation in the sector.3 National Qualifications Framework Amendment Bill of 2016The Bill strengthens the current National Qualifications Framework Act, 2008 (Act 67 of 2008).
tgt: Bili ya Ditsebi tsa Thepa ya Matlo ya selemo sa 2017Bili e fedisa Molao wa hajwale wa Merero ya Makala a Matlo, 1976 (Molao wa bo-112 wa selemo sa 1976).

src: It introduces measures to deal with issues of misrepresentation and imposes consequences on persons who misrepresent their qualifications or organisations that issue qualifications that are invalid.4 International Crimes Bill of 2017The Bill provides an improved legislative framework to deal with international crimes committed in South Africa and across our border.
tgt: E bopa tikoloho e kgontshang bolaodi bakeng sa ho matlafatsa mosebetsi wa moruo ka hara indaseteri ya matlo ha hape e sebetsana le tlhokeho ya ho netefatsa diphethoho ka hara lekala lena.

src: He has served the country with distinction as a South African Ambassador to Russia and as Chairperson of the South African Nuclear Energy Corporation.
tgt: Majoro Seitebatso Pearl Block ka ho hapa Kgau ya Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ya Moemedi wa Selemo wa Bong ka hara Sesole.

src: President Zuma had declared a Special Provincial Official Funeral for him.4 The family and friends of Struggle stalwart and ex-Robben Island prisoner, Mr Eddie Daniels, who recently passed away.
tgt: Kgau ena e ananela boitelo le mekutu ya mmaballi wa kgotso mabapi le ho kgothaletsa dipehelo ka hara Lekgotla la Tshireletso la UN ho ya ka Tumellano ya 1325, e ipiletsang ho mekga yohle e lwanang ho tshireletsa basadi le banana kgahlanong le tlhekefetso ka motabo le dikgoka tse itshetlehileng hodima bong.

src: He will be remembered for his selfless dedication and service to the people of South Africa.5 The family of Minister of Defence and Military Veterans, Ms Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, on the passing away of her father, Mr Douglas Mapisa.
tgt: Ladysmith Black Mambazo, ba fumaneng dithonyo tse pedi bakeng sa Dikgau tsa Grammy tsa selemo sa 2018.

src: He passed away at the Cecilia Makiwane Hospital in East London at the age of 96.Upcoming EventsCommemoration of Nelson MandelaCabinet joins South Africans in commemorating the fourth anniversary of Nelson Mandela's passing on 5 December 2013.
tgt: Ya pele ke ya mokgahlelo wa Alebamo e Ipabotseng ka ho Fetisisa ya Mmino wa Lefatshe bakeng sa Alebamo ya bona ya Shaka Zulu Revisited: Mokete wa Sehopotso wa bo-30, mme ya bobedi ke ya mokgahlelo ho Alebamo e Ipabotseng ka ho Fetisisa ya Bana bakeng sa Songs of Peace & Love for Kids & Parents Lefatsheng ka Bophara.

src: In 2018 the country will mark the centenary of the life of Mandela and all South Africans are encouraged to join in the year-long celebration as we pay tribute to one of Africa’s greatest sons.
tgt: Chad Le Clos, ka ho ba sesesi sa pele sa monna naheng ya rona sa ho hapa letoto la dikola tsa Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Disesi wa FINRe motlotlo ka diphihlello tsa hae hape re na le tshepo ya hore o tla tswela pele ho emela Aforika Borwa ka boqhetseke.

src: Cabinet thanks all South Africans for their participation in the various OR Tambo commemoration events across the country and looks forward to the same level of participation as we remember our icon, Madiba.
tgt: SuperSport United, ka ho fihlella makgaolakgang a Mohope wa Bolaodi ba Bolo wa Aforika.

src: Festive Season Cabinet wishes all South Africans a joyous and safe festive season.
tgt: Mofumahatsana wa Aforika Borwa, Demi-Leigh Nel-Peters, ka ho rweswa sekola sa Mofumahatsana wa Mmabotle Lefatsheng ka bophara tlhodisanong ya bo-66 ya bommabotle haufinyana tjena ho la Amerika (USA).

src: The Minister of Transport, Mr Joe Maswanganyi, launched the Arrive Alive campaign on the 5 December in Bela-Bela, Limpopo.
tgt: Ngaka Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, ya abetsweng Kgau ya Lifetime Achievement ke Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Baetapele ba Basadi ba Dipolotiki.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 28 February 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.
tgt: Kabinete e ile ya kopana ka Laboraro, mohla la 28 Hlakola 2018, Tuynhuys, Motse Kapa.

src: Issues in the environment.
tgt: Tse jang motse.

src: National Budget Speech.
tgt: Puo ya Ditekanyetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Naha.

src: Cabinet appreciates the overwhelming confidence expressed in the 2018 National Budget which was tabled in Parliament, Cape Town, last week.
tgt: Kabinete e ananela boitshepo bo tlokomang bo bonahaditsweng ke Ditekanyetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Naha tsa 2018 tse ileng tsa tekwa Palamenteng, Motse Kapa, bekeng e fetileng.

src: In the recent spirit of renewal that has gripped our great nation, Cabinet calls on all South Africans to partner with government to grow our economy and create much-needed jobs.
tgt: Maemong a moraorao a ntjhafatso a hlwibitseng setjhaba sa habo rona se kgabane, Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho maAforika Borwa ohle ho ikamahanya le mmuso ho hodisa moruo wa rona esita le ho thea mesebetsi ena e hlokehang ka ho fetisisa.

src: The reduction in expenditure of R85 billion over the next three years demonstrates government’s commitment to fiscal consolidation and the prudent allocation of resources to grow the economy.
tgt: Phokotso ya tshebediso ya tjhelete e kaalo ka R85 bilione nakong ya dilemo tse tharo tse tlang, e bontsha boikitlaetso ba mmuso ho bokellweng ha ditjhelete esita le kabong e hlokolotsi ya mehlodi ya ho hodisa moruo.

src: The steps announced to slow the pace of debt accumulation and contain the budget deficit greatly improve our fiscal framework and give South Africans confidence in the future prospects of our economy.
tgt: Dikgato tse tsebisitsweng tsa ho sisithehisa sekgahla sa keketseho ya mekitlane esita le ho kgina kgaello ya ditekanyetso tsa ditjhelete, di ntlafatsa moralo wa rona wa tsa ditjhelete ka bokgabane ebile di fa maAforika Borwa boitshepo matsapeng a bokamoso ba moruo wa rona.

src: Cabinet is resolute that the interventions will reflect in our country’s economic growth, affirm its economic standing and safeguard its investment grade status.
tgt: Kabinete e kgodisehile hore bokenadipakeng bo tla bonahala kgolong ya moruo wa rona, bo tiise boemo ba moruo bo be bo tshireletse maemo a ho theoha ha botsetedi.

src: The 2018 National Budget supports the poor in our society through a comprehensive social assistance programme and fee-free tertiary education for students from poor households.
tgt: Ditekanyetso tsa Ditjhelete tsa Naha tsa 2018 di tshehetsa bafutsana setjhabeng sa rona ka lenaneo le phethahetseng la thusetso ya setjhaba, le thuto ya boemo bo phahameng ya mahala bakeng sa baithuti ba tswang malapeng a futsanehileng.

src: As a response to the concern raised on the Value-Added Tax (VAT) increases proposed, Cabinet is considering expanding the list of basic goods that are zero-rated on VANelson Mandela Centenary.
tgt: Ho arabela dingongorehong tse hlahisitsweng mabapi le dikeketseho tse sisintsweng tsa Lekgetho la Boleng bo Ekeditsweng (VAT), Kabinete e lohotha ho atolla lenane la disebedisuwa tsa mantlha tse sa angweng ke VADilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela.
