tgt: Maqosa ana a laetswe hore a hohele botsetedi ka tsela e tsepameng ebile e le e ditjeo di tlase.

src: The investment drive will culminate in a major investment conference towards the end of the year to raise more than R1 trillion in new investments over five years.
tgt: Tjantjello ena ya botsetedi e tla fihla sehlohlolong ka ho tshwarwa ha seboka se seholo sa botsetedi ho ella mafelong a selemo, ho bokella tjhelete e kahodimo ho R1 trillion botseteding bo botjha ka dilemo tse hlano.

src: Launch of Gauteng’s InvestSA One-Stop Shop.
tgt: Kgakolo ya Setsi sa Gauteng sa Ntho Tsohle tsa Botsetedi ba Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet strongly encourages local and international investors to use the Provincial One-Stop Shop investment facilities being launched around the country – the latest being Gauteng’s One-Stop Shop.
tgt: Kabinete e kgothaletsa ka matla batsetedi ba lapeng le ba matjhaba hore ba sebedise ditsi tsa botsetedi tsa Ntho Tsohle tsa Diporofense, tse ntseng di kgakolwa ho potoloha le naha – moo sa morarorao e leng Setsi sa Ntho Tsohle sa Gauteng.

src: The InvestSA One-Stop Shop is a presidential programme to promote and facilitate investment in South Africa.
tgt: Setsi sa Ntho Tsohle tsa Botsetedi sa Aforika Borwa ke lenaneo la moporesidente la ho bapatsa le ho nolofatsa botsetedi Aforika Borwa.

src: Already, the InvestSA One-Stop Shop has been successfully implemented in KwaZulu-Natal and the Western Cape.
tgt: Hajwale, Setsi sa Ntho Tsohle tsa Botsetedi sa Aforika Borwa se se se kentswe tshebetsong ka katleho KwaZulu-Natal le Kapa Bophirima.

src: One-Stop Shop investment centres are being rolled out in all the provinces, and will be used to coordinate and incorporate the special economic zones, provincial investment agencies, local authorities and the relevant government departments involved in regulatory, registration, permits and licensing matters.
tgt: Ditsi tsa Ntho Tsohle tsa Botsetedi di ntse di fanwa diporofenseng tsohle, mme di tla sebedisetswa ho hlophisa le ho momahanya mabatowa a kgethehileng a moruo, ditheo tsa botsetedi ba diporofense, makgotla a lehae le mafapha a tshwanelehileng a mmuso a amehang ho tsa taolo, ngodiso, mangolo a tumello le ditaba tsa dilaesense.

src: New Post Office-SASSA Post Bank cards.
tgt: Dikarete tse ntjha tsa Posong tsa-SASSA tsa Banka ya Posong.

src: Cabinet welcomes the successful pilot roll-out of new South African Social Security Agency (SASSA) cards at selected post offices in the Western Cape to allow social-grant beneficiaries to swap existing cards for the new South African Post Office (SAPO)-SASSA Postbank cards.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela katleho ya ho bula madiboho ya phano ya dikarete tse ntjha tsa Lekgotla la Tshireletso ya Setjhaba la Aforika Borwa (SASSA) diposong tse kgethilweng Kapa Bophirima, ho dumella majalefa a ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba ho fapanya dikarete tsa bona tsa hajwale hore ba fumane tse ntjha tsa Posong ya Aforika Borwa (SAPO)-SASSA tsa Banka ya Posong.

src: Social-grant recipients and cardholders are still able to use their existing cards until December 2018, but Cabinet encourages beneficiaries to swap their old cards by visiting their nearest SASSA or SAPO from 2 May until the end of September Higher Education.
tgt: Baamohedi ba ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba le beng ba dikarete ba ntse ba kgona ho sebedisa dikarete tsa bona tsa hajwale ho fihlela ka Tshitwe 2018, empa Kabinete e kgothalletsa majalefa ho ya fapanya dikarete tsa bona tsa kgale ka ho etela SASSA kapa SAPO tsa bona tse haufi ho tloha ka la 2 Motsheanong ho fihlela mafelong a Lwetse Thuto e Phahameng.

src: Cabinet welcomes the progress being made in the implementation of free education as detailed by the Minister of Higher Education and Training.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela kgatelopele e etswang ho kenngweng tshebetsong ha thuto ya mahala jwalokaha ho tobokeditswe ke Letona la Thuto e Phahameng le Thupelo.

src: The announcement of a significant increase in baseline allocation to NSFAS from R9,849 billion 2017/18 to R35,321 billion in 2020/21 demonstrates Governments commitment to assisting students from poor and working class households.
tgt: Phatlalatso ya keketso ya bohlokwa kabong ya motheo ya tjhelete ya NSFAS ho tloha ho R9,849 bilione ka 2017/18 ho ya ho R35,321 bilione ka 2020/21, e bontsha boikitlaetso ba Mmuso ho thuseng baithuti ba tswang malapeng a kojwana di mahetleng esita le a mokgahlelo wa basebetsi.

src: SMME Support Programme.
tgt: Lenaneo la Tshehetso la Dikgwebo tse nyenyane, tse mahareng le tse nyanenyane (SMME).

src: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the Employment Promotion through the small, medium and micro-sized enterprise (SMME) Support Programme, which is a partnership between the Department of Small Business Development (DSBD) and the European Union.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela kgakolo ya Phahamiso ya Khiro ka Lenaneo la Tshehetso ya diSMME, leo e leng selekane dipakeng tsa Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyane (DSBD) le Kopano ya Dinaha tsa Yuropa (EU).

src: It will support SMMEs through business development services, assist them with access to markets, improve their access to finance, and help ease the administrative and regulatory burden on small businesses.
tgt: Le tla tshehetsa diSMME ka ditshebeletso tsa ntshetsopele ya kgwebo, le di thuse ka phihlello mebarakeng, le ntlafatse phihlello ya tsona ho tsa ditjhelete, le be le thuse ho fokotsa boima ba tsamaiso le taolo dikgwebong tse nyenyane.

src: Science and Technology.
tgt: Saense le Thekenoloji.

src: Cabinet commends all those involved in the realisation of ZACUBE-2, which is Africa’s largest and most advanced cube satellite.
tgt: Kabinete e rorisa bohle ba kentseng letsoho botenng ba ZACUBE-2, e leng sathalaete ya tjhubu e kgolokgolo ebile e le e hatetseng pele ka ho fetisisa Aforika.

src: The 4kg ZACUBE-2 satellite – which was developed by the Cape Peninsula University of Technology (CPUT) and the French South African Institute of Technology, and managed by the South African National Space Agency – was funded by the Department of Science and Technology.
tgt: Sathalaete ena ya boima ba 4kg ya ZACUBE-2 – e hlahisitsweng ke Yunivesithi ya Thekenoloji ya Hlohleng ya Kapa (CPUT) le Setheo sa Thekenoloji sa Fora le Aforika Borwa, se laolwang ke Lekgotla la Sepakapaka sa Naha la Aforika Borwa – se filwe ditjhelete ke Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji.

src: It is the second nanosatellite to be developed at the CPUThe cube satellite has been sent to India for launching into space.
tgt: Ke nano-sathalaete ya bobedi e hlahisitsweng ke CPUSathalaete ena ya tjhubu e rometswe Indiya hore e tle e romelwe sepakapakeng.

src: It will help gather data to unlock economic growth in the oceans economy.
tgt: E tla thusa ho bokella lesedi la ho utolla kgolo ya moruo moruong wa mawatleng.

src: The nanosatellite will assist in addressing the needs of the Operation Phakisa Oceans Economy programme and also help track marine activity along South Africa’s coast and proactively detect forest fires.
tgt: Nano-sathalaete ena e tla thusa ho rarolla ditlhoko tsa lenaneo la Moruo wa Mawatleng wa Operation Phakisa esita le ho thusa ho lemoha tshebetso ya diphedi tsa mawatleng ho thathika le mabopo a Aforika Borwa esita le ho lemoha mello ya meru pele e etsahala.

src: KwaZulu-Natal Mining Indaba.
tgt: Indaba ya Merafo ya KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Cabinet welcome the outcome of the two-day KwaZulu-Natal Mining Indaba, where delegates deliberated on issues that will help in transforming the sector and unlock mining value-chain opportunities in the province.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela sephetho sa Indaba ya Merafo ya KwaZulu-Natal ya matsatsi a mabedi, moo baromuwa ba neng ba tshohla ditaba tse tla thusa ho fetola lekala le ho utolla menyetla ya lethathama la merafo porofenseng eo.

src: Mining is one of the key sectors that can assist us to transform our economy and Cabinet has called on the mining companies, labour and communities to strengthen relations in order for mining to be sustainable.
tgt: Lekala la merafo ke le leng la makala a bohlokwa a ka re thutsang ho fetola moruo wa rona mme Kabinete e ipileditse ho dikhamphane tsa merafo, basebetsi le setjhaba ho matlafatsa maqhama hore tshebetso ya merafo e tle e be le botsitso ka nako e telelele.

src: Cabinet decisions Cabinet approved the Monitoring and Evaluation Framework for the National Youth Policy (NYP) 2015-2020.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse Moralo wa Bodisa le Tlhahlobo bakeng sa Leano la Naha la Batjha (NYP) 2015-2020.

src: The framework provides for accountability and efficiency in the achievement of the NYP 2020 objectives.
tgt: Moralo ona o fana ka sebopeho sa boikarabello le tshebetso e ntle katlehong ya sepheo sa NYP sa 2020.

src: The policy aims to improve performance and enhance service delivery, particularly to the programmes of the youth.
tgt: Leano le habile ho ntlafatsa tshebetso le ho matlafatsa phano ya ditshebeletso, haholoholo mananeong a batjha.

src: Cabinet approved the hosting of the Annual Africa Month Programme for May 2018 under the theme: “A Year of Nelson Mandela – Building a Better Africa and a Better World”.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse ho tshwarwa ha Lenaneo la Kgwedi ya Aforika la Selemo le Selemo bakeng sa Motsheanong 2018 tlasa mmokotaba o reng: “Selemo sa Nelson Mandela – Ho Aha Aforika e Betere le Lefatshe le Betere”.

src: The month of May celebrates the achievements made in the development of Africa.
tgt: Kgwedi ya Motsheanong e keteka dikatleho tse entsweng ntshetsopeleng ya Aforika.

src: The events culminate in Africa Day on 25 May, which is a day declared by the African Union and celebrated in Africa.
tgt: Diketsahalo di fella ka Letsatsi la Aforika mohla la 25 Motsheanong, e leng letsatsi le phatlaladitsweng ke Kopano ya Dinaha tsa Aforika (AU) mme le ketekwa Aforika.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the report and interventions made on the status of sexual exploitation, abuse and serious misconduct cases against the deployed South African National Defence Force (SANDF) members that support the UN Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
tgt: Kabinete e tsebisitswe ka tlaleho le bokenadipakeng bo entsweng boemong ba dinyewe tsa tlatlapo ya motabo, tlhekefetso le boitshwaro bo bobe kgahlanong le ditho tsa Lebotho la Sesole sa Naha la Aforika Borwa (SANDF) tse rometsweng ho ya tshehetsa Letsholo la Tsitsiso la Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) ho la Democratic Republic of Congo.

src: Whilst Cabinet was satisfied with interventions made in addressing these abuses, it condemns in the strongest possible terms any form of sexual abuse and acts of misconduct by the SANDF members in the mission areas.
tgt: Leha Kabinete e kgotsofaditswe ke bokenadipakeng bo entsweng ho rarolla ditlhekefetso tsena, e seolla ka matla mofuta ofe kapa ofe wa tlhekefetso ya motabo le diketso tsa boitshwaro bo bobe ba ditho tsa SANDF dibakeng tseo ba rometsweng ho tsona.

src: A team was deployed to investigate all the reported allegations.
tgt: Ho rometswe sehlopha ho ya batlisisa ka diqoso tsohle tse tlalehilweng.

src: Although some of the cases have been finalised, others are already at the stage of military trials.
tgt: Leha dinyewe tse ding di se di phethetswe, tse ding di se di le mokgahlelong wa dinyewe tsa sesole.

src: All these investigations have been conducted through the military legal process in a transparent and accountable manner.
tgt: Dipatlisiso tsena tsohle di entswe ka tshebetso ya semolao ya sesole ka mokgwa o nang le ponaletso le boikarabello.

src: South Africa will as usual continue to react swiftly when dealing with such incidences.
tgt: Aforika Borwa, jwaloka tlwaelo, e tla tswelapele ho arabela ka potlako ha e sebetsana le diketsahalo tse jwalo.

src: Ill-discipline and criminal behaviour in the ranks of the SANDF is despised and will not be tolerated.
tgt: Boitshwaro bo bobe le ditlolo tsa molao dithong tsa SANDF di hloilwe mme di ke ke tsa mamellwa.

src: Those found to have transgressed will be dealt with through the Code of Conduct and Military Disciplinary Code.
tgt: Bao ba fumanwang ba di tlotse ba tla sebetswa ka Molawana wa Boitshwaro le Molawana wa Kgalemo wa Sesole.

src: Cabinet further supported the finalisation of the Military Disciplinary Bill, which seeks to deal with overall discipline in the SANDF, including strengthening the definition of sexual exploitation and the minimum sanction increased to 10 years.
tgt: Kabinete e boetse ya tshehetsa phethelo ya Bili ya Kgalemo ya Sesole, e habileng ho sebetsana le kgalemo ka kakaretso ho SANDF, ho akga le matlafatso ya tlhaloso ya tlatlapo ya motabo le keketso ya kotlo e tlase hore e be dilemo tse Dibili.

src: Cabinet approved for the publication of the Control of Tobacco Products and Electronic Delivery Systems Bill of 2017 in the Government Gazette for public comments.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse ho phatlalatswa ha Bili ya Taolo ya Dihlahiswa tsa Kwae le Mekgwatsamaiso ya Phetiso ya Elektroniki ya 2017 Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa tlhahiso ya maikutlo a setjhaba.

src: The Bill repeals the Tobacco Products Control Act, 1993 (Act 83 of 1993) so as to promote public health and to align the South African tobacco control law with the World Health Organisation Framework Convention on Tobacco Control.
tgt: Bili ena e hlakola Molao wa Taolo ya Dihlahiswa tsa Kwae, 1993 (Molao wa 83 wa 1993) e le ho kgothaletsa bophelo bo botle ba setjhaba le ho nyalanya molao wa taolo ya kwae wa Aforika Borwa le Tumellano ya Moralo wa Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Bophelo bo Botle Taolong ya Kwae.

src: It addresses key areas relating to indoor public areas, display of tobacco products at point of sale, use of electronic devices and the introduction of plain packaging of tobacco products.
tgt: O rarolla dintlha tsa bohlokwa tse kahare tse amanang le dibaka tsa setjhaba, pepeso ya dihlahiswa tsa kwae dibakeng tsa thekiso, tshebediso ya disebediswa tsa elektroniki le tsebiso ya dipakethe tse sa takwang tsa dihlahiswa tsa kwae.

src: Cabinet approved for the publication of the Integrated Framework Bill of 2018 to be published in the Government Gazette for public comments.
tgt: Kabinete e ananetse phatlalatso ya Bili ya Moralo o Kopantsweng wa 2018 hore e hatiswe Koranteng ya Mmuso bakeng sa tlhahiso ya maikutlo a setjhaba.

src: The Bill seeks to achieve coordinated and integrated planning across all spheres of government, which are mutually reinforcing and work cohesively to promote more effective implementation of the National Development Plan (NDP).Institutionalising planning is in line with the NDP and seeks to give effect to the commitment in the Medium Term Strategic Framework 2014-2019 to establish mechanisms and capacity within the State to undertake long-term development planning.
tgt: Bili e habile ho fihlella thero e hlophisitsweng ebile e le e kopantsweng makaleng ohle a mmuso, a fepelanang a bile a sebetsa ka momahano ho kgothaletsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ha Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) ka bokgabane.

src: It will promote a more coordinated and responsive State that would be more effective in promoting the structural changes required for inclusive growth, and for developing the country’s human resource base and a stronger democracy.
tgt: Tlwaetso ya merero e tsamaisana le NDP mme e habile ho tiisa boikitlaetso bo Moralong wa Lewa la Nako e Mahareng wa 2014-2019, ho thea ditsela le bokgoni kahara Naha ho etsa thero ya ntshetsopele ya nako e telelele.

src: Upcoming events Freedom DayCabinet commends all South Africans and sectors who are in various ways participating in the current Freedom Month celebrations.
tgt: E tla phahamisa Naha e hlophisitsweng haholwanyane e bile e le e arabelang, e tla sebetsa hantle le ho feta ho phahamiseng diphetoho tsa sebopeho tse hlokehang bakeng sa kgolo e kenyeletsang ba bangata, esita le bakeng sa ho ntshetsa pele motheo wa naha wa basebetsi le demokrasi e matlanyana.

src: National Orders are the highest awards that South Africa bestows, through the President, on citizens and members of the international community who have contributed meaningfully towards making the country a free, democratic and successful nation united in its diversity.
tgt: Letsatsi la TokolohoKabinete e rorisa maAforika Borwa ohle le makala a nang le seabo ka tsela tse fapaneng meketeng ya morao ya Kgwedi ya Tokoloho.

src: May Day celebrationsCabinet calls on all workers around the country to join in celebrating the Workers’ Day on Tuesday, 1 May 2018 and to reflect on the gains of workers’ rights since the dawn of democracy.
tgt: Moporesidente Ramaphosa o tla fana ka puo ya sehlooho moketeng wa Letsatsi la Naha la Tokoloho mohla la 27 Mmesa 2018 Lebaleng la Ngaka Petrus Molemela Bloemfontein, Freistata tlasa mookotaba o reng: “Selemo sa Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela: mathuleng a temoho e tletseng ya tokoloho ya rona ka phetoho e potlakileng ya moruo wa kahisano”.Ketsahalo ena e tla latelwa ke Mokete wa Dikgau tsa Naha wa 2018 ka Moqebelo wa la 28 Mmesa 2018 Pretoria, moo Moporesidente Ramaphosa a tla abela baamohedi ba tshwanehileng ka Tlotlo ya Baobab, Tlotlo ya Ikhamanga, Tlotlo ya Luthuli le Tlotlo ya Bomphato ya OR Tambo.

src: This day serves as a reminder that workplaces should be safe and that employers must do more to ensure the safety of their workers, especially in the mining sector.
tgt: Ditlotlo tsa Naha ke dikgau tse phahameng ka ho fetisisa tseo Aforika Borwa e di abang, ka Moporesidente, ho baahi le ditho tsa dibaka tsa matjhaba tse kentseng letsoho ka bokgabane ho etseng hore naha e be e lokolohileng, setjhaba sa demokrasi le katleho e kopaneng ka ho se tshwane ha yona.

src: Cabinet also expressed its heartfelt sympathy to the families, friends and colleagues of the six miners who were burnt to death when the bus taking them to work was set alight by a petrol bomb thrown by unknown attackers.
tgt: Mekete ya Letsatsi la MotsheanongKabinete e etsa kgoeletso ho basebetsi bohle ho potoloha le naha hore ba ikamahanye le ho keteka Letsatsi la Basebetsi ka Labobedi mohla la 1 Motsheanong 2018 mme ba nahane ka dikatleho tsa ditokelo tsa basebetsi haesale ho tloha mathwasong a demokrasi.

src: Cabinet called on community members to assist the police in their quest to swiftly crack this case.
tgt: Letsatsi lena ke sehopotso sa hore dibaka tsa tshebetso di tlameha ho bolokeha le hore bahiri ba lokela ho etsa haholwanyane ho netefatsa polokeho ya basebetsi ba bona, haholoholo lekaleng la merafo.

src: MessagesCabinet congratulates:1.
tgt: MelaetsaKabinete e lebohisa:1.

src: Ndebele artist Esther Mahlangu, who received an honorary doctorate from the University of Johannesburg in recognition of her outstanding contribution to South African indigenous arts and culture.
tgt: Monono wa moNdebele Esther Mahlangu, ya filweng lengolo la bongaka la tlotla Yunivesithing ya Johannesburg ho ananela nyehelo ya hae e tswileng matsoho bononong le botjhabeng ba Aforika Borwa.

src: Team South Africa who held our flag high at the Commonwealth Games on Australia's Gold Coast, when they finished sixth with a total of 37 medals (13 gold, 11 silver and 13 bronze).
tgt: Sehlopha sa Aforika Borwa se phahamiseditseng folakga ya rona hodimo Dipapading tsa Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Selekane ho la Gold Coast Australia, ha se ne se phethela se le boemong ba botshelela ka palo yohle ya dikgau tse 37 (kgauta tse 13, silifera tse 11 le boronse tse 13).

src: Their success is a result of hard work, determination and perseverance.
tgt: Katleho ya bona e tlisitswe ke ho sebetsa ka thata, boikitlaetso le mamello.

src: This is an inspiration to young athletes and reaffirms that sport is part of the social fabric that binds us together as South Africans.
tgt: Hona ke kgothatso ho baatlelete ba batjha mme e tiisa botjha nnete ya hore dipapadi ke karolo ya mmopo wa setjhaba o re tlamahanyang re le maAforika Borwa.

src: Top achievers who won gold medals include:Caster Semenya – women’s 800m and 1500mLuvo Manyonga – men’s long jumpNdodomzi Ntutu – men’s T12 100mHenri Schoeman – men’s triathlonTatjana Schoenmaker – women’s 100m and 200m breaststrokeChad le Clos – men’s 50m, 100m and 200m butterflyCameron van der Burgh – men’s 50m breaststrokeAkani Simbine – men’s 100m andMartin Erasmus – men’s 97kg wrestling freestyle.
tgt: Ba kahodimodimo ba ba hapileng dikgau tsa kgauta ba akga:Caster Semenya – 800m le 1500m ya basadiLuvo Manyonga – ho qhomela hole ha bannaNdodomzi Ntutu – T12 100m ya bannaHenri Schoeman –triathlon ya bannaTatjana Schoenmaker – 100m le 200m ho breaststroke ya basadiChad le Clos – 50m, 100m le 200m tsa banna ho butterfly ya bannaCameron van der Burgh – 50m ho breaststroke ya bannaAkani Simbine – 100m ya banna leMartin Erasmus – 97kg wrestling freestyle ya banna.

src: Profssor Sibongile Muthwa and Dr Geraldine Fraser-Moleketi on their recent inauguration as vice-chancellor and chancellor respectively of the Nelson Mandela University.
tgt: Moporofesara Sibongile Muthwa le Ngaka Geraldine Fraser-Moleketi ka tlhomamiso ya bona ya haufinyane e le motlatsi wa motjhanselara le motjhanselara ka tatelano, ba Yunivesithi ya Nelson Mandela.

src: Team South Africa for winning three awards at the 10th Global Entrepreneurship Congress in Istanbul, Turkey in April 2018, in recognition for the country’s commitment and dedication to advancing SMMEs.
tgt: Sehlopha sa Aforika Borwa ka ho hapa dikgau tse tharo Mmokeng wa bo10 wa Bohwebi ba Lefatshe Istanbul, Turkey ka Mmesa 2018, ho ananeleng boitlamo le boikitlaetso ba naha ho ntshetseng pele diSMMLefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Kgwebo tse Nyenyane, hammoho le molekane wa lona, 22 on Sloane, e leng khamphase e kgolo ho fetisisa Aforika ya dikgwebo tse qalang, le hapile Kgau ya Selemo ya Naha ya Bohwebi Lefatsheng.

src: The Department of Small Business Development with its partner, 22 on Sloane, Africa’s largest start-up campus, won the Global Entrepreneurship Country of the Year Award.
tgt: Sehlopha sa Aforika Borwa se boetse sa hapa Kgau ya Bomampodi ba Letshwao la Boitsebahatso le Bomampodi ba Diphuputso, e ananelang dinaha tsa Kgokelano ya Bohwebi Lefatsheng ho tswa lefatsheng ka bophara.

src: Team South Africa also won the Brand Champions and Research Champions Award, which recognises Global Entrepreneurship Network countries from around the world.
tgt: DithonyoDithonyo tsohle di itshetlehile netefatsong ya mangolo a thuto le kamohelo e loketseng.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 9 May 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape TownIssues in the environment.
tgt: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro la, 9 Motsheanong 2018, Tuynhuys, Motse KapaDintlha tsa Hajwale.

src: Gender-based violence (GBV).
tgt: Tlhekefetso e Amanang le Batho ba Bong bo Itseng (GBV).

src: Cabinet reiterates its condemnation of violence against women and children, and calls on all of us in our respective formations to take a stand in stopping violence against women, children and the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual and Transgender communities.
tgt: Kabinete e boeletsa kgalemo ya yona ya tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana, mme e re kgothaletsa bohle mafapheng a rona a fapaneng hore re nke mehato kgahlano le tlhekefetso ya basadi, bana le ditjhaba tsa Basadi ba ratanang le basadi, Banna ba ratanang le banna, Batho ba ratanang le batho ba bong ka bobedi le Batho ba sa ikamahanyeng le bong ba bona ba tlhaho.

src: It is the duty of every South African to educate one another on the rights of women and children, and on the various recourse mechanisms that exist to help victims of violence.
tgt: Ke mosebetsi wa moAfrika Borwa e mong le e mong ho ruta ba bang ka ditokelo tsa basadi le bana, le ka mekgwa e fapaneng e teng ho thusa mahlasipa a tlhekefetso.

src: Cabinet welcomes the decision by the South Gauteng High Court to sentence convicted murderer Sandile Mantsoe to 32 years in prison for the murder of his ex-girlfriend Karabo Mokoena.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela qeto ya Lekgotla le Phahameng la Gauteng Borwa ya ho ahlolela mmolai ya fumanweng molato Sandile Mantsoe ho hlola dilemo tse 32 tjhankaneng bakeng sa polao ya kgarebe ya hae ya mehleng Karabo Mokoena.

src: Other cases such as the discovery of the body of 10-year-old Katlego Joja in Mamelodi West, east of Pretoria and the killing of Zolile Khumalo, by a former student, at the Mangosuthu University of Technology in Durban, is testimony to the continuing challenges we face as a nation.
tgt: Dikgetsi tse ding tse jwalo ka ho fumanwa ha setopo sa Katlego Joja ya dilemo di 10 ho la Mamelodi Bophirima, botjhabela ho Pretoria le polao ya Zolile Khumalo, ke mmelaelwa eo e leng moithuti wa mehleng, Yunivesithing ya Theknoloji ya Mangosuthu ho la Durban, ke sesupo sa mathata a tswellang ho re phepetsa jwalo ka naha.

src: Cabinet extends its heartfelt condolences to the Joja and Khumalo families.
tgt: Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho lelapa la Joja le la Khumalo.

src: While justice and the law-enforcement agencies are seized with ensuring that the perpetrators do not go unpunished, as a society we all have a role to play in stopping these crimes.
tgt: Ha mekgatlo ya toka le tshebetso ya molao di shebane le ho netefatsa hore batlodi ba molao ba fumana kotlo tse ba loketseng, rona jwalo ka setjhaba re na le karolo eo re lokelang ho e bapla ho emisa bonokwane bona.

src: South Africans are encouraged to actively join advocacy and awareness-raising programmes in their respective communities and sectors.
tgt: MaAfrika Borwa a kgothaletswa ho ikakgela ka setotswana maneneong a tshehetso le ho atolosa tsebo ditjhabeng le makaleng a bona.

src: Cabinet also encourages victims to report these heinous crimes to law-enforcement authorities, who must investigate allegations of GBV and act firmly within the ambit of the law to ensure that justice is served.
tgt: Kabinete e kgothaletsa mahlasipa ho tlaleha ditlolo tsena tsa molao tse soto ho ditheo tsa molao, tse tlamehang ho batlisisa ditlaleho tsena tsa GBV le ho nka mehato e tiileng e molaong ho netefatsa hore ba fihlela toka.

src: In a separate but related issue, the United Nations (UN) General Assembly proclaimed 13 June as International Albinism Awareness Day.
tgt: Tabeng e fapaneng empa e amanang, Lekgotla le Akaretsang la Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNGA) le phatlaladitse la 13 Phuptjane e le Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Tsebisahatso ka Boswefe.

src: The campaign aims to raise awareness about people living with albinism who are fully protected by the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.
tgt: Letsholo lena le ikemiseditse ho atolosa tsebo mabapi le batho ba phelang le boswefe ba sireleditsweng ka botlalo ke Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Afrika Borwa wa 1996.

src: It is the duty of all South Africans to educate themselves and others in the community on albinism so as to dispel myths and misconceptions.
tgt: Ke boikarabello ba maAfrika Borwa ohle ho ithuta le ho ruta ba bang setjhabeng ka boswefe ele ho fedisa ditumelo tse seng nnete le tse fosahetseng.

src: This will alleviate the trauma experienced by people with albinism and their families.
tgt: Hona ho tla fokotsa masisapelo ao batho ba nang le boswefe le malapa a bona ba fetang ho ona.

src: International Association of Athletics Federations (IAAF) decision.
tgt: Qeto ya Difedereishene tsa Mekgatlo ya Matjhaba ya Diatlelete (IAAF)2.1 Kabinete e hlahisitse matshwenyeho a yona mabapi le diketsahalo tse amanang le melawana ya IAAF.2 Kabinete e amohela mosebetsi o etswang ke Lefapha la Dipapadi le Boikgathollo la Afrika Borwa, le taba ya hore phanele ya maemo a hodimo ya ditsebi makaleng a amanang a tsa bongaka le molao e se e kopantswe ke lefapha.

src: Cabinet welcomes the work being done by the Department of Sport and Recreation South Africa and, the fact that a high level panel of experts in the related fields of medicine and law were assemble by SRSThis panel will study these regulations closely and interrogate the scientific evidence that the IAAF had relied upon.
tgt: Phanele ena e tla hlahloba melawana ena ka hloko mme e manolle bopaki ba saense boo IAAF e itshetlehileng ho bona.

src: It will evaluate all available research & scientific evidence as well as related ethical issues and use the outcome to challenge these regulations in the appropriate forums.
tgt: E tla lekola bopaki bohle bo teng ba dipatlisiso le saense hammoho le dintlha tse amehang tsa boitshwaro le ho sebedisa sephetho ho phephetsa melawana ena diforamong tse loketseng.3 Kabinete e kgothaletsa maAfrika Borwa ho tshehetsa diatlelete tsohle tse ka anngwang ke melawana ena mona lapeng le lefatsheng ka bophara.

src: Situation in North West.
tgt: Boemo Leboya Bophirima.

src: Cabinet was presented with the report by the Inter-Ministerial Task Team (IMTT) on North West.
tgt: Kabinete e ile ya fuwa tlaleho ya Sehlopha sa Tshebetso sa Matona a Mafapha a Kopaneng (IMTT) mabapi le Leboya Bophirima.

src: The report provided the preliminary work that has been done in the last two weeks.
tgt: Tlaleho ena e fane ka mosebetsi wa ho qala o seng o entswe dibekeng tse pedi tse fetileng.

src: Cabinet was satisfied with the progress made by the IMTT in its efforts to stabilise the Province.
tgt: Kabinete e kgotsofaditswe ke kgatelopele e entsweng ke IMTT maitekong a yona a ho tlisa botsitso Porofenseng.

src: The IMTT, led by Minister in The Presidency, Dr Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, will remain seized with the North West issues.
tgt: IMTT, e etelletsweng pele ke Letona le Kantorong ya Mopresidente, Ngaka Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma, e tla dula e shebane le ditaba tsena tsa Leboya Bophirima.

src: A detailed media briefing on the outcomes of this work by the IMTT will be held in the North West next week.
tgt: Tlaleho e felletseng mabapi le diphetho tsa mosebetsi ona wa IMTT e tla fanwa ho la Leboya Bophirima bekeng e tlang.

src: Japan-Africa Public-Private Economic Forum.
tgt: Foramo ya Moruo wa Lekala la Setjhaba le la Poraefete ya Japane le Afrika.

src: President Cyril Ramaphosa delivered a keynote address at the inaugural Japan-Africa Public-Private Economic Forum held at the Sandton Convention Centre from 3 to 4 May 2018.
tgt: Mopresidente Cyril Ramaphosa o fane ka puo ya sehlooho Foramong ya pele ya Moruo wa Lekala la Setjhaba le la Poraefete ya Japane le Afrika e neng e tshwaretswe Sandton Convention Centre ho tloha ka la 3 ho isa la 4 Motsheanong 2018.

src: The forum was co-hosted by South Africa, together with the government of Japan and the Japan External Trade Organization.
tgt: Foramo e ne e boetse e tsamaiswa ke Afrika Borwa, hammoho le mmuso wa Japane le Mokgatlo wa Japane wa Kgwebo ya Kantle.

src: Cabinet welcomes the continued commitment that was made at the Tokyo International Conference on African Development in Nairobi, Kenya in 2016, which saw Japan pledging US$30 billion in Africa between 2016 and 2019.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela boitlamo bo tswellang bo entsweng Kopanong ya Matjhaba ya Tokyo ya Ntshetsopele ya Afrika ho la Nairobi, Kenya ka 2016, moo teng Japane e ileng ya itlama ho fana ka dibilione tse $30 tsa Amerika ho Afrika pakeng tsa 2016 le 2019.

src: More than 100 Japanese companies have a presence in Africa.
tgt: Ke dikhamphani tse fetang 100 tsa Japane tse leng teng Afrika.

src: United States (US) Steel and Aluminum Tariff increase.
tgt: Keketso ya Tefiso ya Tshepe le Aluminiamo ke naha ya Amerika.

src: Cabinet expresses its disappointment on the decision by the US not to exempt South Africa from the application of steel and aluminum duties.
tgt: Kabinete e swabisitse ke qeto ya Amerika ya hose behelle Afrika Borwa kathoko tefisong ya ditheko tsa tshepe le aluminiamo.

src: The South African Government will continue to engage with US authorities to find a mutually acceptable outcome.
tgt: Mmuso wa Afrika Borwa o tla tswelapele ho bua le ba matleng mmusong wa Amerika ho fumana sephetho se amohelehang ho mahlakore ka bobedi.

src: Cabinet also encourages domestic exporters to continue to lobby US buyers to apply for product exemptions, as South African companies export niche products and semi-processed products for further processing in the URevitalisation of Industrial Parks.
tgt: Kabinete e boetse e kgothaletsa dikgwebo tsa lehae tse rekisang thepa kantle ho naha ho tswelapele ho kopa bareki ba Amerika hore ba etse dikopo tsa dipehellothoko tsa dihlahiswa, kaha dikhamphani tsa Afrika Borwa di rekisa dihlahiswa tse ikgethileng le tse sebeditsweng ka karolo hore di lo sebetswa hape ha di fihla ho la Amerika.

src: Cabinet welcomes the completion of the first phase of the revitalisation of the Phuthaditjhaba Industrial Park in the Free State as an important milestone in implementing the Revitalisation of Industrial Parks Programme.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela phethelo ya mokgahlelo wa pele wa Phaka ya Indasteri ya Phuthaditjhaba Foreisetata jwalo ka mohato wa bohlokwa tshebetsong ya Lenaneo la Tsosoloso ya Diphaka tsa Indasteri.

src: The R50-million upgrades will attract more local entrepreneurs to set up their operations due to the improved infrastructure and security.
tgt: Dintlafatso tsa boleng ba R50 milione di tla hohela barekisi ba lehae hore ba thehe dikgwebo tsa bona mona ka lebaka la meaho e ntlafetseng le polokeho.

src: Investment.
tgt: Tsetelo.

src: Cabinet congratulates the partnership between the Department of Trade and Industry (the dti) and Aspen Pharmacare, which has resulted in the announcement of a R1-billion investment in the pharmaceutical drug plant in Port Elizabeth in the Eastern Cape.
tgt: Kabinete e lebohisa tshebedisanommoho e pakeng tsa Lefapha la Kgwebo le Indasteri (the dti) le Aspen Pharmacare, e ileng ya lebisa ho phatlalatso ya tsetelo ya R1 bilione femeng ya meriana ho la Port Elizabeth Kapa Botjhabela.

src: The pharmaceutical company benefited from the dti’s 12I Tax Incentive with a tax credit of about R209 million.
tgt: Khamphani ena ya meriana e unne molemo ho tswa ho Kgohelo ya Lekgetho ya dti 12I ka mokitlane wa lekgetho o ka fihlang ho R209 milione.

src: The opening of the facility will create 500 new jobs.
tgt: Ho bulwa ha setheo sena ho tla hlahisa mesebetsi e 500 e metjha.

src: This is a significant investment which is taking South Africa into a new level of manufacturing space and creating the necessary jobs that the country needs.
tgt: Ena ke tsetelo e kgolo e tlo phahamisetsa Afrika Borwa boemong bo botjha ba tlhahiso le ho theha mesebetsi e hlokehang eo naha e e hlokang.

src: Lower data costs.
tgt: Ditheko tse Fokotsehileng tsa Datha.

src: Cabinet welcomes the new rules proposed by the Independent Communications Authority of South Africa to improve regulations around data, SMS and voice services.
tgt: Kabinete e amohela melao e metjha e sisintsweng ke Bolaodi bo Ipusang ba Dikgokahanyo ba Aforika Borwa (Icasa) ho ntlafatsa melawana mabapi le datha, SMS le ditshebeletso tsa lentswe.

src: The changes are steps toward ensuring fairness in business practice around data pricing and ensure that consumers will not lose unused data.
tgt: Diphetoho tsena ke mehato e lebisang ho netefatsa toka kgwebong ya ditheko tsa datha le ho netefatsa hore bareki ha bana lahlehelwa ke datha e sa sebediswang.

src: The Market Inquiry being conducted by the Competition Commission will highlight and focus on additional measures, to ensure South African data prices support broader digital access and prepare us for the opportunities created by the Fourth Industrial Revolution.
tgt: Patlisiso ya Mmaraka e ntseng e etswa ke Khomishene ya Tlhodisano e tla toboketsa le ho tsepama hodima mehato e eketsehileng, ho netefatsa hore ditheko tsa datha tsa Afrika Borwa di tshehetsa phihlello e eketsehileng ya dijithale le ho re lokisetsa menyetla e thehwang ke Phetoho ya Bone ya Indasteri.

src: Mining Sector.
tgt: Lekala la Merafo.

src: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa in expressing sadness following the loss of lives of mineworkers at the Sibanye-Stillwater’s Driefontein Mine near Carletonville on the West Rand, and furthermore extends its condolences to the families and friends of the deceased.
tgt: Kabinete e momahana le Mopresidente Ramaphosa ho fetiseng maswabi a bona kamora tahlehelo ya maphelo a basebetsi ba merafong, Morafong wa Sibanye-Stillwater’s Driefontein haufi le Carletonville ho la West Rand, mme hape e fetisetsa matshediso a yona ho malapa le metswalle ya ba lahlehetsweng.

src: The Minister of Mineral Resources, Mr Gwede Mantashe, is expected to represent government at a memorial service to be held this week.
tgt: Letona la Dirashwa, Monghadi Gwede Mantashe, o lebelletswe ho emela mmuso tshebeletsong ya bofifi e tlo tshwarwa bekeng ena.

src: Cabinet urges the mining sector to fast-track their research that will assist us in the capability in detecting seismic activities in the mines and save lives.
tgt: Kabinete e kgothaletsa lekala la merafo ho potlakisa dipatlisiso tsa lona tse tla re thusa ka bokgoni ba ho fokisa diketsahalo tsa ho reketla ha lefatshe dimmaeneng le ho pholosa maphelo.

src: UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF).
tgt: Letlole la Bana la Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UNICEF).

src: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa in expressing appreciation for UNICEF’s support and cooperation in empowering the youth of South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete hammoho le Mopresidente Ramaphosa ba leboha tshehetso ya UNICEF le tshebedisanommoho ho matlafatseng batjha ba Afrika Borwa.

src: Executive Director of UNICEF, Ms Henrietta Fore, paid a courtesy call to President Ramaphosa on Monday, 7 May 2018.
tgt: Mookamedi wa Phethahatso wa UNICEF, Mofumahadi Henrietta Fore, o tshwere kopano ya semmuso ya sediplomate le Mopresitente Ramaphosa ka Mantaha wa la 7 Motsheanong 2018.

src: She outlined UNICEF's report on South Africa's initiatives in the areas of education, work skills development and economic opportunities for young people, especially for those between 10 and 18 years old.
tgt: O ile a hlalosa tlaleho ya UNICEF ya matsholo a Afrika Borwa dibakeng tsa thuto, ntshetsopele ya bokgoni ba mosebetsi le menyetla ya moruo bakeng sa batjha, haholo ba pakeng tsa dilemo tse 10 le UNICEF e ile ya thoholetsa maiteko a Afrika Borwa a ho theha menyetla bakeng sa batjha ho nka karolo ka moruong, mme ya tsebisa hore e ikemiseditse ho thusa dikolo tsa naha ya rona ka phano ya metsi le tlhwekiso.

src: UNICEF commended South Africa’s efforts to create opportunities for young people to participate meaningfully in the economy, and expressed willingness to assist our country’s schools with the provision of water and sanitation.
tgt: UNICEF e memme Afrika Borwa ho arolelana ka dipale tsa yona tsa katleho tsa matlafatso ya batjha jwalo ka karolo ya yona letsholo la lefatshe la ho ntlafatsa menyetla bakeng sa batjha – letshwao la nnete la hore maqhama a naha ya rona le UN aa matlafala.

src: Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Diqeto tsa Kabinete.

src: Cabinet approved the Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP) 2018/19 – 2020/21.
tgt: Kabinete e amohetse Morero wa Tshebetso wa Pholisi ya Diindasteri (IPAP) 2018/19 – 2020/21.

src: This is the 10th iteration of a rolling annual action plan aligned to successive three-year cycles of the Medium Term Expenditure Framework.
tgt: Ena ke pheto ya bo 10 ya morero o tswellang wa ketso o tsamaellanang le disaekele tse latellanang la dilemo tse tharo tsa Moralo wa Tshebediso wa Nako e Mahareng (MTEF).IPAP e lekotsweng botjha e fana ka kgutsufatso ya diphihlello tsa pholisi ya indasteri nakong ya dilemo tse robong tse fetileng.

src: The revised IPAP summarises the achievements of the industrial policy over the past nine years.
tgt: E fana ka manollo ya moruo ya moruo wa matjhaba le lehae o amanang le pholisi ya indasteri, e fana ka kgutsufatso ya diphepetso le dithibelo tsa ho kenngwa tshebetsong ho felletseng ha pholisi ya indasteri, hammoho le merero e meng ya sebaka le nako e fuweng makala a amehang.

src: Cabinet approved that the Tripartite Free Trade Area (TFTA) Agreement be tabled in Parliament for ratification.
tgt: Kabinete e amohetse hore Tumellano ya Dikarolo tse Tharo ya Kgwebo ya Mahala (TFTA) e hlahiswe Palamenteng bakeng sa kamohelo.

src: The agreement establishes the Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa, East African Community and Southern African Development Community.
tgt: Tumellano e theha Mmaraka o Tshwanang bakeng sa Afrika e Botjhabela le e Borwa, Setjhaba sa Afrika e Botjhabela le Ntshetsopele ya Dinaha tse ka Borwa ba Aforika (SADC).TFTA ke morero o etellwang pele ke Afrika o tshwayang mohato o matla wa ho hlola nalane ya kontinente ya bokoloniale ya dimmaraka tse nyane tse arohaneng, ka ho kgothaletsa ditsetelo tsa dinaha tsa Afrika le ho hohela tsetelo e eketsehileng e tswang kantle ho sebaka seo sa kgwebo ya mahala.

src: This TFTA is a key Africa-led project that marks a decisive step to overcome the continent’s colonial heritage of small fragmented markets, by promoting intra-African investments and attracting more foreign investment into the free trade WEBTOKEN a result of regional integration efforts and stable economies, there has been strong growth in intra-African investments.
tgt: Ka lebaka la diteko tsa tshebedisano ya lebatowa le meruo e tsitsitseng, ho bile le kgolo e matla matseteng a dinaha tsa Afrika pakeng tsa tsona.

src: Cabinet approved South Africa’s Third National Communication Report for submission to the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).The primary objective of the UNFCCC is to achieve the stabilisation of greenhouse gas concentrations in the atmosphere to a level that would prevent dangerous anthropogenic activities from interfering with the climate system.
tgt: Kabinete e amohetse Tlaleho ya Boraro ya Naha ya Afrika Borwa ya Kgokahanyo hore e nehelanwe ho Kopano ya Moralo wa UN wa Phetoho ya Tlelaemete (UNFCCC).Maikemisetso a mantlha a UNFCCC ke ho fihlella botsitso ba maemo a dikgase tsa ntlo ya dimela sebakeng hore a fihle boemong bo ka thibelang diketsahalo tse kotsi tsa se-anthrophojeniki hore di se kenakenane le sistimi ya tlelaemete.

src: South Africa’s report contains an analysis of its progress from the initial National Communication to the Second National Communication and subsequently the Third Communication Report, as reviewed by the international community and domestic stakeholders.
tgt: Tlaleho ya Afrika Borwa e na le manollo ya kgatelopele ya yona ho tloha Kgokahanyong ya sethathong ya Naha ho ya ho Kgokahanyo ya Bobedi ya Naha ho latelwa ke Kgokahanyo ya Boraro ya Naha, jwaloka ha e lekotswe botjha ke baamehi ba matjhaba le ba lehae.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Aquaculture Development Bill of 2018 to Parliament.
tgt: Kabinete e amohetse nehelano ya Bili ya Ntshetsopele ya Botshwasi ba Ditlhapi ya 2018 ho Palamente.

src: The Bill, which came out of full consultation with all the relevant stakeholders in the aquaculture sector, seeks to promote aquaculture development in the oceans economy.
tgt: Bili ena, e tswang tshekatshekong e felletseng le baamehi bohle lekaleng la botshwasi ba ditlhapi, e ikemiseditse ho ntlafatsa ntshetsopele ya botshwasi ba ditlhapi moruong wa mawatle.

src: It provides, amongst others, the institutional arrangements of the sector sets out the licensing and permitting requirements for aquaculture and the establishment of the aquaculture development zones.
tgt: Hara tse ding, e fana ka ditlhophiso tsa setsi bakeng sa lekala e fana ka ditlhoko tsa ho fumana laesense le tumello bakeng sa botshwasi ba ditlhapi le ho thehwa ha dibaka tsa ntshetsopele tsa botshwasi ba ditlhapi.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Occupational Health and Safety Bill of 2018 to Parliament.
tgt: Kabinete e amohetse nehelano ya Bili ya Bophelo bo Botle le Polokeho Mosebetsing ya 2018 ho Palamente.

src: The Bill amends the Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 (Act 85 of 1993).
tgt: Bili ena e fetola Molao wa Bophelo bo Botle le Polokeho Mosebetsing, 1993 (Molao wa 85 wa 1993).

src: Once adopted, the Bill will ensure greater protection of workers in respect of injuries and diseases at the workplace.
tgt: Hang ha o amohetswe, Billi e tla netefatsa tshireletso e eketsehileng ya basebetsi mabapi le dikotsi le malwetse mosebetsing.

src: The Bill establishes a clearly defined Health and Safety Management System and is in line with international best practice.
tgt: Bili e theha Sistimi e hlalositsweng ka ho hlaka ya Tsamaiso ya Bophelo bo Botle le Polokeho mme e tsamaellana le ditlwaelo tse ntle tsa matjhaba.

src: It also provides for mandatory risk assessment to be conducted by the employer and a workplace-specific risk management plan developed and implemented to minimise the exposure of employees to risk.
tgt: E boetse e bua ka tekolo e tlamang ya kotsi hore e etswe ke mohiri le morero wa tsamaiso ya kotsi o reretsweng mosebetsing o hlahisitsweng le ho kengwa tshebetsong ho fokotsa pepeso ya bahiruwa ho kotsi.

src: Messages.
tgt: Melaetsa.

src: Congratulations.
tgt: Ditebohiso.

src: Cabinet congratulates President Ramaphosa, who has been invited by the International Labour Conference (ILO) Governing Body to co-chair the Global Commission on Future of Work.
tgt: Kabinete e lebohisa Mopresidente Ramaphosa, ya menngweng ke Setheo sa Puso ya Kopano ya Matjhaba ya Basebetsi (ILC) hore ebe badulasetulo hammoho le Khomishene ya Matjhaba ya Bokamoso ba Mosebetsi.

src: The President has also been invited to address the conference, which is celebrating 100 years of existence.
tgt: Mopresidente o boetse o menngwe ho bua kopanong eo, e ketekang kopano ya bo 100.

src: Whilst there he, will pay homage and honour the Centenary of former President Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Ha a le moo, o tla hopola le ho tlotla dilemo tse lekgolo tsa Mopresidente wa mehleng Nelson Mandela.

src: Cabinet thanks the Africa Group in the ILO governing body for leading the discussion in Geneva and appreciates the discussions held by the country’s ruling party in their local constituencies.
tgt: Kabinete e leboha Sehlopa sa Afrika se setheong sa puso sa Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba wa Basebetsi (ILO) bakeng sa ho etella pele puisano ho la Geneva mme e leboha dipuisano tse tshwerweng ke mokga o busang wa naha mabatoweng a yona a lehae.

src: Cabinet expresses condolences to the family and friends of the late former and first Minister of Finance of democratic South Africa, Mr Derek Keys, who played a significant role in the smooth handover of Treasury to a democratically elected government in 1994.
tgt: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso ho lelapa le metswalle ya Letona la mehleng ebile e le la pele la Ditjhelete la Afrika Borwa ya demokrasi, Monghadi Derek Keys, ya bapetseng karolo ya bohlokwahadi phetisong ya Lefapha la Ditjhelete ho ya ho mmuso o kgethilweng ka demokrasi ka Ramadan.

src: Cabinet extends well wishes to the Muslim community as they begin fasting for the holy month of Ramadan next week.
tgt: Kabinete e fetisa ditakaletso tse molemo ho setjhaba sa maMuslim ha se qala nako ya ho itima bakeng sa kgwedi e halalelang ya Ramadan bekeng e tlang.

src: During Ramadan, Muslims fast from sunrise to sunset, as they spend time deepening their spirituality.
tgt: Nakong ya Ramadan, maMuslim a itima ho tloha ha letsatsi le hlaha ho fihlela ha le dikela, ha ba ntse ba sebedisa nako eo ho tebisa tumelo ya bona.

src: Upcoming Events.
tgt: Diketsahalo tse Tlang.

src: President Ramaphosa will today, 10 May 2018, visit the Department of Defence and Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs (CoGTA) respectively, as part of his efforts to engage with senior leadership to ensure that the work of government is effectively aligned.
tgt: Kajeno ka la 10 Motsheanong 2018, Mopresidente Ramaphosa o tla etela Lefapha la Tshireletso le Lefapha la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba (CoGTA), jwalo ka karolo ya maiteko a hae a ho sebetsa mmoho le baetapele ba phahameng ho netefatsa hore mosebetsi wa mmuso o tsamaiswa ka nepo.

src: This visit is part of the President’s commitment announced in his maiden State of the Nation Address in February 2018 to visit every national department in this regard.
tgt: Ketelo ena ke karolo ya boitlamo ba Mopresidente bo phatlaladitsweng Puong ya hae ya pele ya Boemo ba Naha ka Hlakola 2018 ho etela lefapha ka leng la naha ka tsela ena.

src: Deputy President David Mabuza will today, 10 May 2018, address the 3rd Human Resource Development Council of South Africa Summit at Emperors Palace in Johannesburg under the theme: ‘Partnerships revitalising work and learning’.
tgt: Motlatsi wa Mopresidente David Mabuza, kajeno la 10 Motsheanong 2018, o tla fana ka puo Lekgotleng la Ntshetsopele ya Basebetsi la Afrika Borwa la bo 3 Emperors Palace, Johannesburg tlasa mookotaba: ‘Dikamano di tsosolosa mosebetsi le ho ithuta’.

src: The two-day summit will bring together key industry leaders, labour experts and academics to deliberate on various issues, including proposals to deal with youth unemployment, and advance empowerment and the Fourth Industrial Revolution.
tgt: Kopano ena ya matsatsi a mabedi e tla kopanya baetapele ba bohlokwa indastering, ditsebi tsa tsa basebetsi le barutehi ho sekaseka dintlha tse fapaneng, ho kenyeletswa ditshisinyo tsa ho sebetsana le tlhokeho ya mesebetsi batjheng, le ntshetsopele ya matlafatso le Phetolo ya Bone ya Indasteri.

src: Cabinet also reiterates the invitation to South Africans to join the year-long Centenary celebrations of Tata Nelson Mandela and Mama Albertina Sisulu, who helped build the foundation of the South Africa’s democracy we enjoy today.
tgt: Kabinete e boetse e boelletsa memo ho maAfrika Borwa hore a nke karolo diketekelong tsa dilemo tse lekgolo tsa Tata Nelson Mandela le Mama Albertina Sisulu, ba thusitseng ho aha motheo wa demokrasi ya Afrika Borwa e re natefelang kajeno.

src: The Inter-Ministerial Committee on the Nelson Mandela Centenary and Centenary of Albertina Sisulu launched the National Programme this week.
tgt: Komiti ya Mafapa a Fapaneng ya Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Nelson Mandela le Dilemo tse Lekgolo tsa Albertina Sisulu e qadile Lenaneo la Naha bekeng ena.

src: Details of the celebrations can be found on the government website (WEBTOKEN), where other upcoming government scheduled briefings/activities can also be found.
tgt: Dintlha tsa diketekelo tsena di ka fumanwa webosaeting ya mmuso (WEBTOKEN), moo diketsahalo/ditlaleho tse ding tse tlang di ka fumanwang le tsona.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 23 May 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.
tgt: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro la, 23 Motsheanong, Tuynhuys, Cape Town.

src: Gender-Based Violence (GBV).
tgt: Dintlha tsa Hajwale Tlhekefetso e Amanang le Batho ba Bong bo Itseng (GBV).

src: Cabinet strongly condemns the violence against women and children.
tgt: Kabinete e kgalema ka matla tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana.

src: The most recent cases of Nonkululeko Mpanza and Nompumelelo Mhlongo in Thokoza, Ekurhuleni Katlego Joja in Mamelodi, Tshwane Promise Mthembu in KwaZulu-Natal and Jabulile Nhlapo, the Unisa student, brings into sharp focus the level of violence that threatens the lives of our women and children.
tgt: Diketsahalo tsa moraorao tsa Nonkululeko Mpanza le Nompumelelo Mhlongo ho la Thokoza, Ekurhuleni Katlego Joja ho la Mamelodi, Tshwane Promise Mthembu wa KwaZulu-Natal le Jabulile Nhlapo, moithuti wa Unisa, di totobatsa boemo bo phahameng ba tlhekefetso bo phepetsang maphelo a basadi le bana ba rona.

src: Cabinet expresses its deepest condolences to the families and friends of these women and children.
tgt: Kabinete e fetisa matshediso a yona a tebileng ho malapa le metswalle ya basadi le bana bana.

src: The issue of crime against women and children requires all of us to actively be involved in fighting it.
tgt: Taba ya tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana e hloka hore bohle re itahlele ka setotswana twantshong ya yona.

src: Cabinet continues to strengthen law-enforcement agencies in the fight to stop GBAmongst the Bills approved in this last Cabinet is the Criminal Procedure Amendment Bill of 2018, which amends the Criminal Procedure Act, 1977 (Act 51 of 1977).
tgt: Kabinete e tswelapele ho matlafatsa ditsi tsa tshebetso ya molao tekong ya ho emisa GBHara Dibili tse amohetsweng Kabineteng ena ya ho qetela ke Bili ya Phetolo ya Tshebetso ya Tlhekefetso ya 2018, e fetolang Molao wa Tshebetso ya Tlhekefetso, 1977 (Molao wa 51 wa 1977).

src: The Bill will extend the list of sexual offences in respect of the prosecution and significantly it will allow the sexual cases to go before courts even after 20 years.
tgt: Bili e tla atolosa lethathamo la ditlolo tsa molao tsa thobalano mabapi le qoso mme, ho leng bohlokwa, e tla dumella dinyewe tse amanang le thobalano hore di ye kapela makgotla le kamora dilemo tse Meralo ena e eketsa hodima mehato e meng eo mmuso o seng o e kentse tshebetsong.

src: A total of 54 Thuthuzela Care Centres across the country have been opened to serve as a one-stop facility to reduce secondary victimisation and reduce the time of finalising sexual cases.
tgt: Ho se ho butswe Ditsi tsa Tlhokomelo tsa Thuthuzela tse 54 naheng ka bophara hore ebe ditsi tsa ditshebeletso tsohle ele ho fokotsa tlhekefetso ya mofuta wa bobedi le ho fokotsa nako e nkwang ho phethela dinyewe tse amanang le thobalano.

src: Government has set up 75 dedicated Sexual Offences Courts to deal decisively with sexual violence against women.
tgt: Mmuso o se o thehile Makgotla a Tlhekefetso ya Thobalano a 75 ho sebetsana ka kotloloho le ka matla le tlhekefetso kgahlano le basadi.

src: Furthermore, the South African Police Service has established 1 047 dedicated facilities for victims at police stations countrywide to accommodate and assist victims of GBChild Protection Week will be held from 27 May to 2 June 2018.
tgt: Ho feta moo, Tshebeletso ya Sepolesa ya Aforika Borwa e thehile ditsi tse 1 047 bakeng sa mahlasipa diteisheneng tsa sepolesa naha ka bophara bakeng sa bodulo le thuso ya mahlasipa a GBBeke ya Tshireletso ya Bana e tla tshwarwa ho tloha la 27 Motsheanong ho isa la 2 Phuptjane 2018.

src: Cabinet calls on parents, guardians and communities to work with law-enforcement agencies to protect our children.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho batswadi, bahlokomedi le setjhaba ho sebetsa mmoho le ditsi tsa molao ho sireletsa bana ba rona.

src: Cabinet reiterates that if you suspect your child is missing, you must immediately report to your nearest police station.
tgt: Kabinete e boetse e hlalosa hore ha o belaela hore ngwana wa hao o nyametse, tlalehela seteishene se haufi le wena sa sepolesa.

src: We must work together as a peace-loving and law-abiding society to tackle all crimes against women and children.
tgt: Re tlameha ho sebetsa mmoho jwalo ka setjhaba se ratang kgotso hape se ikobelang molao ho fedisa ditlolo tsohle tsa molao kgahlano le basadi le bana.

src: Cabinet calls on those aware of any crimes against children to contact the toll-free Childline on 0800 055 555 or Crime Stop on 086 0010.111.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bohle ba tsebang ka ditlolo dife kapa dife tsa molao kgahlano le bana hore ba letsetse mohala wa mahala wa Childline ho 0800 055 555 kapa wa Crime Stop ho 0860.0 Haeba o le mosadi ya mathateng, kapa o tseba ka mosadi e mong ya mathateng, nomoro ya mahala ya Setsi sa Taolo sa GBV ke 0800 428 428 kapa (0800 GBV GBV).

src: Cabinet calls on all of us to work together to do more to prevent violence against women and children, support survivors of abuse and bring perpetrators to justice.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho rona bohle hore re sebetseng mmoho ho etsa haholwanyane ho thibela tlhekefetso ya basadi le bana, ho tshehetsa mahlasipa a tlhekefetso le ho qosa batlodi bamolao.

src: It is the duty of everyone to report those who hurt, exploit and abuse women and children so that the perpetrators can be arrested and convicted.
tgt: Ke tshwanelo ya mang kapa mang ho tlaleha batho ba utlwisang bohloko, ba hanyapetsang le ho hlekefetsa basadi le bana hore batlodi ba molao ba tle ba tshwarwe le ho ahlolwa.

src: EconomyCabinet welcomes the positive growth in employment of two hundred and six thousand jobs reflected in the first quarter of 2018, from the latest Quarterly Labour Force Survey released by Statistics South Africa.
tgt: Moruo Kabinete e amohela kgolo e ntle ya khiro ya mesebetsi e 206 000 e bontshitsweng kotareng ya pele ya 2018, ho tswa Patlisisong ya moraorao ya Bahiruwa ya Kotara e ntshitsweng ke Lefapha la Dipalopalo la Aforika Borwa (stats SA).

src: The upswing in employment was driven by increases in six of the 10 industries.
tgt: Kgolo ena ya khiro e susumeditswe ke keketseho diindastering tse tsheletseng ho tse Sekgahla sa tlhokeho ya mesebetsi hara batjha, leha ho le jwalo, se ntse se phahame ho 52.4%, ka sekgahla sa monyelo sa 12.2% feela.

src: Cabinet calls on sectors of society to continue to pull together to tackle youth WEBTOKEN the spirit of ‘Thuma Mina – Send Me’ inspired by President Cyril Ramaphosa in his maiden State of the Nation Address in February 2018, Cabinet calls on all South Africans, in particular the private sector, to help create jobs and invest locally so that more South Africans can be drawn into the economy.
tgt: Tatelong ya mantswe a reng ‘Thuma Mina – Roma Nna’ e kgothaleditsweng ke Mopresidente Cyril Ramaphosa Puong ya hae ya pele ya Boemo ba Naha ka Hlakola 2018, Kabinete e ipiletsa ho maAforika Borwa ohle, haholo lekala la poraefete, ho thusa ho theha mesebetsi le ho tsetela kahare ho naha hore maAforika Borwa a mangata a tle a hohellwe kahare ho moruo.

src: EnergyCabinet welcomes as a milestone the launch of the Xina Solar One Concentrated Solar Power Project in the Northern Cape.
tgt: MatlaKabinete e amohetse kgatelopele ya tlhomamiso ya Xina Solar One Projeke ya Matla a Teteyaneng a Letsatsi ho la Kapa Leboya.

src: It is one of seven Concentrated Solar Power Projects under the Department of Energy’s Renewable Energy Independent Power Producer Procurement Programme.
tgt: Ke e nngwe ya Diprojeke tse supileng tsa Matla a Teteyaneng a Letsatsi e tlasa Lenaneo la Kgohelo ya Bahlahisi ba Matla ba Ikemetseng ya Matla a Ntjhafatswang la Lefapha la Eneji.

src: The Xina Solar One plant will provide clean energy to Eskom under a 20-year power purchase agreement.
tgt: Feme ya Xina Solar One e tla fana ka motlakase o hlwekileng ho Eskom tlasa tumellano ya theko ya matla ya dilemo tse Sena se tla fetolelwa ho malapa a 95 000 a maAforika Borwa a fumanang motlakase o hlwekileng, haholo nakong ya dihora tse sephethephethe.

src: Cabinet received a second report from the Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) on North West and is satisfied with the progress in stabilizing the province.
tgt: Leboya Bophirima Kabinete e amohetse tlaleho ya bobedi ho tswa ho Komite ya Mafapha a Kopaneng (IMC) mabapi le Leboya Bophirima mme e kgotsofetse ka kgatelopele ya ho tlisa botsitso porofenseng eo.

src: In its previous meeting, Cabinet approved that North West be placed under Section 100 (1) of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.
tgt: Kopanong ya yona e fetileng, Kabinete e dumetse hore Leboya Bophirima e bewe tlasa Karolo ya 100 (1) ya Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996.

src: Cabinet also increased the members of IMC with the Ministers of Basic Education Public Service and Administration Human Settlements Social Development Tourism Environmental Affairs and Transport.
tgt: Kabinete e boetse ya eketsa ditho tsa IMC ho kenyeletsa Letona la Thuto ya Motheo la Tshebeletso ya Mmuso le Taolo la Bodulo ba Batho la Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba la Bohahlaodi la Merero ya Tikoloho le la Dipalangwang.

src: The IMC was asked to do further work in the province and advise Cabinet on which of the provincial departments should be placed under Section 100 (1)
tgt: IMC e kopilwe ho etsa mosebetsi o eketsehileng porofenseng le ho eletsa Kabinete hore na ke mafapha a fe a porofense a lokelang ho bewa tlasa Karolo ya (1)

src: As a result of this work, Cabinet has approved that five of the provincial departments should be placed under Section 100 (1) :(1).
tgt: Ka lebaka la mosebetsi ona, Kabinete e dumetse hore mafapha a mahlano a porofense a bewe tlasa Karolo ya 100 (1) : (1) Kantoro ya Tonakgolo (2) Lefapha la Polokeho ya Setjhaba le Taolo ya Dipalangwang(3) Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le Ntshetsopele ya Dipapadi (4) Lefapha la Bophelo bo Botle le (5) Lefapha la Mesebetsi ya Mmuso le Ditsela.

src: Cabinet calls on the Israeli Defence Force to withdraw from the Gaza Strip and bring to an end the violent and destructive incursions into Palestinian territories.
tgt: Kabinete e amohetse Pholisi ya Thepa ya Kelello (IP) ya Riphaboliki ya Aforika Borwa-Mokgahlelo wa Pholisi e kenyelleditse ditlatsetso tse tswang ho dinehelano tsa baamehi le ditlhahiso.

src: Their routine actions present yet another obstacle to a permanent resolution to the conflict, which must come in the form of two states, Palestine and Israel, existing side-by-side and in peace.
tgt: E arabela pitso ya Morero wa Ntshetsopele ya Naha (NDP) ya kgatello e eketsehileng ho boiqapelo, tlhahiso e ntlafetseng le patlo e matlafetseng ya moruo o nang le tsebo.

src: Cabinet reiterates calls made by several member states of the United Nations for an independent inquiry into the killings, with a view to hold those responsible accountable.
tgt: Mokgahlelo wa I wa Pholisi ya IP o tlatselletswa hara tse ding ke Molaotheo, NDP, Morero wa Sehlooho wa Meriana ya Naha, Moralo wa Naha wa Pholisi ya Indasteri le dipehelo tse fapaneng tsa Morero wa Ketso wa Pholisi ya Indasteri.

src: Cash-In-Transit (CIT) heistsCabinet is deeply concerned by the resurgence of CIT heists and rejects this blatant criminality.
tgt: E tla sebetsa jwalo ka sesebediswa sa bohlokwa sa pholisi ho ntlafatseng boiqapelo, phetiso ya theknoloji, patlisiso le ntshetsopele, boitlhahiso ba bonono, tshireletso ya bareki, ntshetsopele ya indasteri, haholo kgolong ya moruo.

src: The PSEC will build on work done by the IMC – SOE that was formed in February 2015, chaired by the Deputy President.
tgt: Kabinete e amohetse ho tshwarwa ka kopanelo ha Kopano ya Matjhaba ya bo 10 ya Ditsi tsa Namolelo tsa Sesole, ke Kantoro ya Monamoledi wa Sesole, e hlophiseditsweng Mphalane 2018.

src: Cabinet approved the Intellectual Property (IP) Policy of the Republic of South Africa-Phase The policy has incorporated inputs from the stakeholder’s submissions and representations.
tgt: Ena ke ketsahalo ya selemo le selemo e hlophisitsweng ke Setsi sa Taolo ya Demokrasi ya Sesole, e thehilweng Geneva, Switzerland, mme e tla tshwarwa hammoho le Aforika lekgetlo la pele.

src: It responds to the National Development Plan’s (NDP) call for greater emphasis on innovation, improved productivity and more intense pursuit of a knowledge economy.
tgt: Bili ena e fetola Molao wa Merero ya Dikimi tsa Tshebeletso ya Bongaka wa 1998 (Molao wa 131 wa 1998) hore o nyalane le Sengolwa sa ho Lokisetsa Inshorense ya Naha ya Bophelo bo Botle (NHI) le Moralo wa Bili ya Letsete la NHBili hara tse ding, e ikemiseditse ho ntlafatsa taolo ya indasteri ya dikimi tsa tshebeletso ya bongaka le ho nyalanya moralo wa taolo ho diphetoho tse etsahetseng dilemong tse leshome tse fetileng lekaleng lena.

src: The IP Policy Phase I is informed among others by the Constitution, the NDP, the National Drug Master Plan, the National Industrial Policy Framework and the various iterations of the Industrial Policy Action WEBTOKEN will serve as an important policy instrument in promoting innovation, technology transfer, research and development, creative expression, consumer protection, industrial development and more broadly, economic growth.
tgt: Bili ena hape e tla boela e netefatsa hore baphedisuwa ba sireletswa hantle ho feta hape e phahamisa phihlello e betere ho ditjhelete tsa bophelo bo botle ba poraefete.

src: Cabinet approved the ratification of the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons by Parliament.
tgt: Kabinete e amohetse tsebiso ya Bili ya Phetolo ya Boikarabello ba Mmuso ya 2018 ho Palamente.

src: The Treaty is the culmination of humanitarian initiative on nuclear weapons launched in 2010.
tgt: Bili ena e fetola Molao wa Boikarabello ba Mmuso wa 1957.

src: It is a strategic intervention in the area of nuclear disarmament and the long-standing impasse in multilateral nuclear disarmament negotiations.
tgt: E kenyeletsa sebopeho sa tefo ya ditleleime tse kgahlano le Mmuso tse hlahileng ka lebaka la kalafo tse fosahetseng tsa batho ke mahlahana a Mmuso.

src: The amended convention is an important milestone in international efforts to improve the physical protection of nuclear materials and facilities by setting common standards of WEBTOKEN covers among others, the physical protection of nuclear material in domestic use, storage and transport, and the protection of nuclear materials and facilities against sabotage.
tgt: Ona ke mohato o mong maitekong a Aforika Borwa a ho kenya tshebetsong Pholisi ya Karabelo ya Naha ya Phetoho ya Tlelaemete ho phahamisa ntshetsopele e tswellang le ho kgotsofatsa tokelo ya tikoloho eseng kotsi ho bophelo bo botle le bo iketlileng, jwalo ka ha ho boletswe ho Molaotheo wa rona.

src: Cabinet approved the co-hosting of the 10th International Conference of the Ombud’s Institutions of the Armed Forces, by the Office of the Military Ombud, which is scheduled for October 2018.This is an annual event organised by the Centre for the Democratic Control of the Armed Forces, based in Geneva, Switzerland, and will for the first time be co-hosted in Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e amohetse tsebiso ya Bili ya Phetolo ya Mokgwatshebetso wa Botlokotsebe ya 2018, o fetolang Molao wa Mokgwatshebetso wa Botlokotsebe wa 1977 ho Palamente.

src: Cabinet approved the introduction of the Criminal Procedure Amendment Bill of 2018, which amends the Criminal Procedure Act of 1977 into Parliament.
tgt: Ditebohiso Kabinete e thoholetsa Vusumuzi Ndlovu ya tlileng boemong ba bosupa dikgaung tsa Sephehi sa Motjha sa Pellegrino tsa 2018 tse etsahetseng haufinyane ho la Milan.

src: Nelson Mandela Africa Day Centenary LecturePresident Ramaphosa will deliver the Nelson Mandela Africa Day Centenary Lecture at the Africa Renaissance Conference, on 24 May 2018 at the Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre in Durban.
tgt: Boto ya Bohahlaudi ba Aforika Borwa:a. Ngaka Tanya Ethel Abrahamse (o thontswe botjha)b. Monghadi Enver Duminy (o thontswe botjha)c. Mofumadi Michelle Julie Constant (o thontswe botjha)d. Monghadi Thebeetsile Ikalafeng (o thontswe botjha)e. Monghadi Yacoob Abba Omar (o thontswe botjha)f. Monghadi Monwabisi Peter Fandeso (Modulasetulo)g. Mofumahadi Pamela Bulelwa Yakoh.

src: The event forms part of the yearlong centenary commemorations of the lives of our first democratic President, Tata Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela and Struggle icon Mama Albertina Nontsikelelo Sisulu, which are taking place across the continent and the globe.
tgt: Mofumahadi Kathleen Elizabeth Rivett-Carnaci.

src: As a founding member of the Malombo Jazzmen, he was one of South Africa’s most talented musicians.
tgt: Monghadi Dinizulu Kumalo Percival Sechemane jwalo ka Mohlanka e Moholo wa Phethahatso (CEO) ya Rand Water.

src: Cabinet conveys condolences to the family and friends of Mr Sonwabo Eddie Funde who was the former South African Ambassador to Germany and Chairperson of the South African Broadcasting Corporation Board.
tgt: Leqwetha (Ngaka) Seswantsho Godfrey Lebeya jwalo ka Hlooho ya Naha ya Bolaodi ba Dipatlisiso tsa Botlokotsebe bo Phahameng.

src: Cabinet is deeply saddened following the deaths of two young girls who were killed after a wall collapsed in Durban.
tgt: Monghadi Goodman Ntandazo Vimba jwalo ka CEO ya Ejente ya Tshehetso ya Meaho ya Masepala Lefapheng la Kopanelo ya Puso le Merero ya Botjhaba.

src: CongratulationsCabinet commends Vusumuzi Ndlovu who came seventh in the Pellegrino Young Chef 2018 awards that recently took place in Milan.
tgt: Monghadi Lindokuhle Cedric Mkhumane jwalo ka Molaodikakaretso: Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo le Boitshebeletso, Lefapheng la Ntshepele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyane.

src: Cabinet congratulates the newly crowned International Boxing Federation (IBF)‚ World Boxing Association (WBA) Super and the Ring Magazine junior flyweight champion Hekkie "Hexecutioner" Budler, who became the first South African to hold two major world crowns simultaneously after winning the IBF and WBA junior-flyweight titles.
tgt: Monghadi Phakamani Hadebe jwalo ka Molaodi Phethahatso wa Sehlopha sa Eskom Holdings SOC Ltd (Eskom) le setho (Molaodi wa Phethahatso) wa Boto.

src: Ms Boitumelo Mosako as Chief Financial Officer at the Development Bank of South Africa.
tgt: Balaodi bao eseng ba phethahatso ho Boto ya South African Express:a. Mofumahadi Mmakeaya Magoro Tryphosa Ramano (Modulasetulo)b. Monghadi Ronald Ozzy Lamolac.

src: Dr Steven Thomas Cornelius.
tgt: Monghadi Thulani Matiki Norman Kgomod.

src: Ms Kathleen Elizabeth Rivett-Carnaci.
tgt: Monghadi Kugan Harikrishna Thaverf.

src: Mr Mohamed Baba andm.
tgt: Monghadi Ahmed Ismail Bassa lej.

src: Ms Nomzamo Bhengu (Department of Tourism representative).
tgt: Monghadi Trevor Abrahams (o thontswe botjha).

src: Mr Dinizulu Kumalo Percival Sechemane as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Rand Water.
tgt: Balaodi bao eseng ba phethahatso ho Boto ya Transnet:a. Monghadi Popo Molefe (Modulasetulo)b. Mofumahadi Mpho Emily Letlapec.

src: Mr Thulani Matiki Norman Kgomod.
tgt: Mofumahadi Ramasela Joyce Gandag.

src: Ms Thandiwe January-McLeane.
tgt: Profesara Edward Christian Kieswetterh.

src: Mr Kugan Harikrishna Thaverf.
tgt: Monghadi Aluwani Percy Ramabulanai.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 6 June 2018, at the Union Buildings, Pretoria.
tgt: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro la 6 Phuptjane 2018, Meahong ya Kopano, Pretoria.

src: Economy Cabinet has noted the decline of 2,2% in the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in the first quarter of 2018.
tgt: MoruoKabinete e lemohile phokotseho ya 2,2% ho Dihlahiswa Tsohle tsa Naha (GDP) kotareng ya pele ya 2018.

src: Statistics South Africa (StatsSA) released the figures this week.
tgt: Lefapha la Dipalopalo la Afrika Borwa (StatsSA) le ntshitse dipalo bekeng ena.

src: The agriculture, mining and manufacturing industries contributed to the decline in this first quarter.
tgt: Diindasteri tsa temo, dimmaene le tlhahiso di kentse letsoho phokolong ena kotareng ya pele.

src: Cabinet has mandated the Economic Cluster Ministers to urgently meet to discuss the way forward with regard to these figures.
tgt: Kabinete e laetse Sehlopha sa Matona a Moruo hore a kopane ka potlako ho sekaseka mehato ya ho ya pele mabapi le dipalo tsena.

src: The GDP results bring into sharp focus the need for all sectors of the country to work together to support South Africa’s local economy.
tgt: Diphetho tsa GDP di totobatsa tlhokeho ya hore makala ohle a naha a sebetse mmoho ho tshehetsa moruo wa lehae wa Afrika Borwa.

src: Business and labour need to continue to work with government in support of initiatives such as the Nine-Point Plan to stimulate economic growth and create much-needed jobs.
tgt: Makala a kgwebo le tshebetso a hloka ho tswelapele ho sebetsa le mmuso ho tshehetsa matsholo a jwalo ka Morero wa Dintlha tse Robong ho tsosolosa kgolo ya moruo le ho theha mesebetsi e hlokwang haholoholo.

src: One of its key pillars is the Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP), which focuses on increasing manufacturing, employment creation and exports.
tgt: E nngwe ya ditshiya tsa yona tsa mantlha ke Morero wa Tshebetso wa Pholisi ya Diindasteri (IPAP), e tsepameng hodima ho eketsa tlhahiso, theho ya mesebetsi le direkisetswa-ntle.

src: Cabinet is confident that the IPAP will help grow our industrial sector and economy.
tgt: Kabinete e na le tshepo ya hore IPAP e tla thusa ho hodisa lekala la rona la indasteri le moruo.

src: Later this year, government will host an International Investment Summit to profile South Africa as an investment destination.
tgt: Hamorao selemong sena, mmuso o tla tshwara Kopano ya Matjhaba ya Tsetelo ho hlahisa Afrika Borwa jwalo ka sebaka sa tsetelo.

src: The aim of the event is to work towards generating R1,2 trillion in new investments over the next five years, which will have a significant impact on economic growth and employment creation.
tgt: Sepheo sa ketsahalo ena ke ho sebeletsa ho hlahisa R1,2 trilione ka matsete a matjha dilemong tse hlano tse tlang, e leng se tlang ho ba le kgahlamelo ya bohlokwa ho kgolo ya moruo le theho ya mesebetsi.

src: Investments Cabinet welcomes the launch of a new world-class factory that manufactures information and communications technology products in East London in the Eastern Cape on 5 June 2018 by Yekani Manufacturing, a wholly black-owned company.
tgt: MatseteKabinete e amohela tlhomamiso ya feme ya maemo a lefatshe e etsang dihlahiswa tsa theknoloji ya tlhahisoleseding le dikgokahanyo ho la East London, Kapa Botjhabela ka la 5 Phuptjane 2018 ya Yekani Manufacturing, e leng khamphani ya batho ba batsho feela.

src: This R1-billion investment will create 1 000 new quality jobs in addition to the existing workforce of 450, mostly youth and women.
tgt: Letsete lena la R1 bilione le tla theha mesebetsi e 1 000 e metjha ya maemo kahodima palo ya basebetsi ba sentse ba le teng ba 450, bao boholo e leng batjha le basadi.

src: This investment has benefited from both the Special Economic Zone Infrastructure Incentive and the Black Industrialist Scheme (BIS).
tgt: Letsete lena le unne molemo ho tswa ho bobedi Letsholo la Sebaka se Kgethehileng sa Moruo le Morero wa Boraindasteri ba Batho ba Batsho (BIS).BIS e bone ha Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indasteri (dti) le dumela phano ya tshehetso ya dihlapiso ho boraindasteri ba batho ba batsho ba 103 nakong ya dilemo tse pedi tse fetileng tsa ditjhelete.

src: Forty-eight companies were also provided with market access support, eight of which are in the Eastern Cape.
tgt: Dikhamphani tse 48 le tsona di fuwe tshehetso ya phihlello ya mmaraka, mme tse robedi tsa tsona di Kapa Botjhabela.

src: National Minimum Wage (NMW)Cabinet welcomes the passing of the NMW Bill by the National Assembly.
tgt: Mokgolo o Tlase wa Naha (NMW)Kabinete e amohela kamohelo ya Bili ya NMW ke Seboka sa Naha (NA).

src: It expresses its appreciation to all stakeholders at the National Economic Development and Labour Council for their role in reaching this agreement.
tgt: E leboha baamehi bohle Lekgotleng la Ntshetsopele ya Moruo wa Naha le Tshebetso bakeng sa mosebetsi wa bona ho fihlelleng tumellano ena.

src: This begins a process towards narrowing the wage gap, especially for the low income earners.
tgt: Hona ho qala tshebetso e tla kwala sekgeo sa mokgolo, haholo bakeng sa batho ba kgolang tjhelete e nyane.

src: Approximately 6,4 million workers in South Africa will benefit once the Bill has been signed into law.
tgt: Ke basebetsi ba ka bang 6,4 milione Afrika Borwa ba tla una molemo hang ha Bili e fetotswe molao.

src: Cabinet, however, acknowledges that more work still needs to be done to close the wage disparities that still exist in the country.
tgt: Leha ho le jwalo, Kabinete e ananela hore ho ntse ho hlokahala mosebetsi o eketsehileng ho kwala sekgeo sa diphapano tsa mekgolo tse ntseng di le teng naheng ena.

src: The Bill will now be sent to the National Council of Provinces for concurrence before the President signs it into law.
tgt: Bili jwale e tla romelwa ho Lekgotla la Naha la Diprofense (NCOP) bakeng sa tumellano pele Mopresidente a e tekenela ho ba molao.

src: Basic servicesCabinet is pleased with the results of the Non-financial Census of Municipalities 2017 released by StatsSThe results showed more consumers have received free basic services such as electricity, water and sanitation in 2017 as compared with 2016.
tgt: Ditshebeletso tsa motheoKabinete e thabetse diphetho tsa Sensase e Seng ya Ditjhelete ya Dimasepala ya 2017 e ntshitsweng ke StatsSDiphetho di bontsha hore bareki ba bangata ho feta ba fumane ditshebeletso tsa mahala tsa motheo tse jwalo ka motlakase, metsi le tlhwekiso ka 2017 ha ho bapiswa le ka 2016.

src: Government remains committed to providing daily basic services to all its citizens, especially poor people.
tgt: Mmuso o ntse o ikemiseditse ho fana ka ditshebeletso tsa motheo tsa letsatsi le letsatsi ho baahi ba ona bohle, haholo batho ba kojwana di mahetleng.

src: The most recent water-related project is the R96-million Mhlathuze Water Project in Richards Bay in KwaZulu-Natal, which will deliver running tap water to more than 6 000 households.
tgt: Projeke ya moraorao e amanang le metsi ke Projeke ya Metsi ya Mhlathuze ya R96 milione ho la Richards Bay, KwaZulu-Natal, e tla fana ka metsi a phallang ho malapa a fetang 6 Ditshekatsheko tsa mekgolo tsa Tshebeletso ya SetjhabaKabinete e fumane tlaleho ho tswa ho Letona la Tshebeletso ya Mmuso le Taolo (DPSA) mabapi le ditshekatsheko tsa mekgolo tsa Tshebeletso ya Mmuso.

src: Cabinet appreciates the commitment by all stakeholders in finding an amicable solution that would benefit all role players.
tgt: Kabinete e leboha boitlamo ba baamehi bohle ya ho fumana tharollo e nang le kgotso e ka bang molemo ho bohle ba nkileng karolo.

src: Cabinet reaffirms government’s commitment to fully engage with labour so as to arrive at a workable deal for all involved.
tgt: Kabinete e tiisa boitlamo ba mmuso ba ho sebetsa ka botlalo le basebetsi ho fihlela tharollo e amohelehang ho bohle ba amehang.

src: Social grants Cabinet reassures beneficiaries of social grants that government will continue providing this important service, as mandated by the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.
tgt: Ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhabaKabinete e netefaletsa bajalefa bohle ba ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba hore mmuso o tla tswelapele ho fana ka tshebeletso ena ya bohlokwa, jwalo ka ha e laetswe ke Molaotheo wa Riphaboliki ya Afrika Borwa wa 1996.

src: Social grants will continue to be paid and the process to replace the old South African Social Security Agency (SASSA) card with the new one will continue until the end of September 2018.
tgt: Dithuso tsa setjhaba di tla tswelapele ho lefshwa mme tshebetso ya ho isa karete ya hao ya hajwale ya Lekala la Tshireletso ya Setjhaba la Aforika Borwa (SASSA) hore o fumane e ntjha e tla tswelapele ho fihlela qetellong ya Loetse 2018.Tshebedisanommoho e pakeng tsa SASSA le Kantoro ya Poso ya Afrika Borwa (SAPO) e hlahisa diphetho tse ntle ka ha bajalefa ba bangata ba ntse ba tla ho tla fetola dikarete tsa bona esale ho tloha ka Motsheanong 2018.Kabinete e kgothaletsa ditjhaba ho se natse melaetsa e mekgutshwane ya morao tjena e laelang bajalefa ba ditjhelete tsa dithuso tsa setjhaba hore ba ingodise botjha hore ba qobe ho se lefuwe.

src: The partnership between SASSA and the South African Post Office is yielding positive results as more beneficiaries have since May 2018 been coming forward to swap their cards.
tgt: Melaetsa e tjena e ferekanyang e batla ho tlisa pherekano hara batho ba sotlehileng le ho sitisa mmuso ho netefatsa hore dithuso tsa setjhaba di lefuwa bajalefa ntle le bothata.

src: North WestCabinet received a third progress report from the Inter-Ministerial Task Team (IMTT) on North West.
tgt: Leboya BophirimaKabinete e amohetse tlaleho ya boraro ya kgatelopele ho tswa ho Sehlopha sa Tshebetso sa Matona a Mafapha a Kopaneng (IMTT) mabapi le Leboya Bophirima.

src: Cabinet is satisfied with the progress made to operationalise the invoked Section 100(1)
tgt: Kabinete e kgotsofetse ka kgatelopele e entsweng ho kenya tshebetsong Karolo ya 100(1)

src: and
tgt: le

src: in the North West provincial departments.
tgt: e ntshitsweng ho mafapaha a porofense ya Leboya Bophirima.

src: It was further approved that the IMTT will onwards report to Cabinet once a month to enable the teams deployed in the province to continue with the work.
