tgt: Moralo wa Bili ya Tlhomathiso ya Naha ya Metsi Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana phatlalatso ya moralo wa Bili ya Tlhomathiso ya Naha ya Metsi hore setjhaba se ntshe maikutlo ka yona.

src: The Bill amends the National Water Act, 1998 (Act 36 of 1998).
tgt: Bili ena e lokisa Molao wa Naha wa Metsi wa 1998 (Molao 36 wa 1998).

src: These amendments will improve regulations and will ensure that the country’s water resources are well managed, protected and conserved.
tgt: Diphetoho tsena di tla ntlafatsa melawana mme di netefatse hore mehlodi ya metsi ya naha e laolwa, e sireletswe le ho baballwa hantle.

src: The Bill also makes proposals to eliminate the imbalances of the past relating to water allocation, and provides for effective and quicker internal dispute resolution mechanisms.
tgt: Setshwantsho sena sa molao se boetse se etsa ditshisinyo tse mabapi le ho fediswa ha ho se lekane kabong ya metsi ho bakilweng ke kgethollo, mme se fana ka metjha ya kahare ya ho rarolla dikgohlano e sebetsang hantle le ka potlako.

src: Appointments All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant clearance.
tgt: Khiro Mangolo a thuto a ba hirwang a a netefatswa mme ho netefatswe le hore ha ba e so ka ba tlola molao.

src: Mr Kuberndran Moodley as General Manager: Manufacturing and Engineering at the Government Printing Works.
tgt: Monghadi Kuberndran Moodley jwaloka Motsamaisi Kakaretso: Tlhahiso le Boenjeniri Mesebetsing ya Bohatisi ya Mmuso.

src: Mr Sihle Ngubane as General Manager: Operations Management at the Government Printing Works.
tgt: Monghadi Sihle Ngubane jwaloka Motsamaisi Kakaretso: Botsamaisi ba Ditshebetso Mesebetsing ya Bohatisi ya Mmuso.

src: Ms Mmolaeng Mooki as General Manager: Corporate Services at the Government Printing Works.
tgt: Mme Mmolaeng Mooki jwaloka Motsamaisi Kakaretso: Ditshebeletso tsa Tshehetso Mesebetsing ya Bohatisi ya Mmuso.

src: Appointment of non-executive directors to the Board of the South African Special Risk Insurance Association.
tgt: Khiro ya Balaodi bao e seng ba Phethahatso Botong ya Mokgatlo wa Inshorense ya Dikotsi tse Ikgethang wa Afrika Borwa.

src: Ms Deshnie Subbiah and.
tgt: Mme Deshnie Subbiah le.

src: Appointment of non-executive directors to the Board of the Development Bank of Southern Africa.
tgt: Khiro ya Balaodi bao e seng ba Phethahatso Botong ya Banka ya Ntshetsopele ya Afrika e Borwa.

src: Mr Bongani Nqwabana (reappointment).
tgt: Monghadi Bongani Nqwabana (o hirilwe hape).

src: Mr Petrus Matji (reappointment).
tgt: Monghadi Petrus Matji (o hirilwe hape).

src: Ms Pinkie Nqeto (reappointment).
tgt: Mme Pinkie Nqeto (o hirilwe hape).

src: Mr Jonathan Muthige.
tgt: Monghadi Jonathan Muthige.

src: Mr Barry Hore.
tgt: Monghadi Barry Hore.

src: Mr Joel Netshitenzhe ProfEdgar Pieterse and.
tgt: Monghadi Joel Netshitenzhe Profesa Edgar Pieterse le.

src: Upcoming Events.
tgt: Diketsahalo tse Tlang.

src: Transport Month This year’s Transport Month will be commemorated under the theme: “Siyakha - Building better infrastructure to grow South Africa”.
tgt: Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang selemong sena e tla ketekwa tlasa mookotaba: “Siyakha – Ho ahwa meralo e ntlafetseng ya ditshebeletso ho hodisa Afrika Borwa”.

src: Transport Month 2023 will focus on major investments in transport infrastructure, and a call to action to protect transport infrastructure from theft and vandalism.
tgt: Kgwedi ya Dipalangwang 2023 e tla tsepama matseteng a maholo meralong ya ditshebeletso ya dipalangwang, le boipiletso ba ho nka bohato ho sireletsa meralo ya ditshebeletso ya dipalangwang e se utsuwe le ho senngwa.

src: World Teachers’ Day South Africa will join the rest of the world in commemorating World Teachers’ Day on Thursday, 5 October 2023, under the theme: “The teachers we need for the education we want: The global imperative to reverse the teacher shortage”.
tgt: Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Matitjhere Afrika Borwa e tla ikamahanya le dinaha tse ding ho keteka Letsatsi la Lefatshe la Matitjhere ka Labone la la 5 Mphalane 2023, tlasa mookotaba: “Matitjhere ao re a hlokang bakeng la thuto eo re e batlang: Bohlokwa ba ho lwantsha kgaello ya matitjhere lefatsheng.” Sepheo ka letsatsi leo ke ho hlokomedisa, ho etsa hore batho ba utlwisise le ho ananela seabo sa bohlokwa sa matitjhere thutong le ntshetsopeleng lefatsheng ka bophara.

src: The day aims to raise awareness, understanding and appreciation for the vital contribution that teachers make to education and development across the globe.
tgt: Letsatsi lena le tsebahaditswe ke Mokgatlo wa Basebetsi wa Lefatshe le Mokgatlo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng wa tsa Thuto, Saense le Setso, ho keteka mosebetsi wa bohlokwa o etswang ke matitjhere.

src: Messages.
tgt: Melaetsa.

src: CongratulationsCabinet extended its congratulations and well-wishes to: General Bheki Cele, the Minister of Police, who received the Great Wall Commemorative Medal from the People’s Republic of China for the South African Police Service’s contribution to the broader law-enforcement cooperation between the two countries.
tgt: DitebohisoKabinete e thoholeditse le ho lebisa ditakaletso tse ntle ho:Mokgenerale Bheki Cele, Letona la Mapolesa, ya fumaneng Great Wall Commemorative Medal, China bakeng sa seabo sa Tshebeletso ya Mapolesa ya Afrika Borwa tshebedisanong ya dinaha tsena tse pedi ya ho kenngwa ha molao tshebetsong ka kakaretso.

src: Ms Angie Motshekga, the Minister of Basic Education, on being selected by the Secretary-General of the UN, Mr Antonio Guterres, to serve on a Global High-Level Panel to advise him on how countries can transform their education systems.
tgt: Mme Angie Motshekga, Letona la Thuto ya Motheo, ka ho kgethwa ke Mongodi e Moholo wa Matjhaba a Kopaneng, Monghadi Antonio Guterres, ho ba Moifong wa Lefatshe wa Boemo bo Hodimo o tla mo eletsa ka mekgwa eo dinaha di ka tlisang diphetoho mekgwatshebetsong ya thuto ya tsona.

src: The selection of Minister Motshekga into the high-level panel reflects her level of expertise in the field of education and is an expression of confidence on South Africa’s education trajectory.
tgt: Ho kgethelwa ha Letona ho ba moifong ona o hodimo ho bontsha boemo ba botsebi ba hae ho tsa thuto mme ho boetse ke sesupo sa tshepo ho tsa thuto Afrika Borwa.

src: The panel includes representatives from the International Labour Organization, the UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization’s Teacher Task Force, Global Teacher Unions and three education Ministers.
tgt: Moifo o kenyeletsa baemedi ba Mokgatlo wa Basebetsi wa Matjhaba, Mokgatlo wa Matitjhere wa Tshebetso wa Thuto, Saense le tsa Setso, Mekgatlo ya Lefatshe ya Matitjhere le Matona a Mararo a Thuto.

src: The panel was co-chaired by two former Presidents.
tgt: Baporesidente ba mehleng ba babedi e ne e le baduladitulo ba moifo.

src: Cape Town Film Studios, local actors and stunt performers, for their work on the Netflix series, One Piece, that rocketed to number one worldwide on the online streaming platform.
tgt: Ditudiyo tsa Cape Town Film, dibapadi tsa naha ena tsa ditshwantshiso le dibapadi tsa dikarolo tse kotsi, ka seabo sa bona filiming ya Netflix, One Piece, e fihlelletseng boemong ba pele lefatsheng ka bophara motjheng ona wa kgaso ya inthanete.

src: Van Ryn's Distillery, for being awarded the World's Best Brandy trophy for its 12-year-old potstill brandy at the 2023 International Spirits Challenge in London.
tgt: Sebaka sa Tsino sa Van Ryn, ka ho fumana kgau ya Boranti bo tswang pele Lefatsheng bakeng sa boranti ba yona bo tsinnweng habedi ba dilemo tse lshome le metso e mmedi, Tlhodisanong ya Matsina ya Matjhaba ya 2023 London.

src: Condolences Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of: Mr Aziz Goolam Hoosein Pahad (82), the former anti-apartheid activist who was the first South African democratic government Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs from 1994 to 2008.Lieutenant Commander Gillian Elizabeth Hector, Master Warrant Officer William Masela Mathipa, and Warrant Officer Class One Mmokwapa Lucas Mojela, who died in the line of duty while aboard the submarine, SAS Manthatisi, off Kommetjie in the Western Cape.
tgt: MatshedisoKabinete e lebisitse matshediso malapeng le metswalleng ya: Monghadi Aziz Goolam Hoosein Pahad (82), eo e neng e le moitseki kgahlano le mmuso wa kgethollo le eo e bileng Motlatsa-Letona la Ditaba tsa Kantle wa pele wa mmuso wa Demokrasi wa Afrika Borwa ho tloha ka 1994 ho ya ho 2008.

src: the 22 mineworkers from the Venetia Diamond Mine in Limpopo, who died in a road accident in Musina (Vhembe District).Ms Zoleka Mandela (43), author and activist, and the granddaughter of anti-apartheid heroes Nelson Mandela and Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.
tgt: Molefthenente Mokhomanda Gillian Elizabeth Hector, Master Warrant Officer William Masela Mathipa, le Warrant Officer Class One Mmokwapa Lucas Mojela, ba hlokahalletseng mosebetsing ba le sekepeng SAS Manthatisi, pela Kommetjie, Kapa Bophirima.

src: Issues in the environment 2023 Rugby World Cup Champions Cabinet congratulated the Springboks on their 2023 Rugby World Cup victory that made South Africa the only country to win the Rugby World Cup four (4) times and second to win the title back-to-back.
tgt: Maemo a Renang 2023 Bommampodi ba Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rugby Kabinete e ile ya lebohisa di-Springboks ka tlholo ya tsona ya Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rugby wa 2023 e ileng ya etsa hore Afrika Borwa e be yona feela naha e hapileng Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Rugby ka makgetlo a mane le ya bobedi ho hapa mohope oo ka ho latellana.

src: In the history of rugby in South Africa, this Springboks team is the most diverse in terms of the demographics representation of South Africa.
tgt: Historing ya rugby Afrika Borwa, sehlopha sena sa di-Springboks ke sona se nang le merabe e fapaneng ka ho fetisisa ho latela boemedi ba palo ya batho ya Afrika Borwa.

src: The composition of such a diverse team was not an act of coincidence, but a deliberate effort by the management and coaching staff of the Springboks to select an inclusive team.
tgt: Sebopeho sena sa sehlopha sa merabe e fapaneng hase ketso e iketsahalletseng feela, empa ke boiteko bo rerilweng ke basebetsi ba tsamaiso le ba kwetlisang ba di-Springboks ho kgetha sehlopha se kenyelletsang bohle.

src: That bold decision by then coach Rassie Erasmus and his team continues to demonstrate to South Africans and the rest of the world, that everyone with skill, if given a chance and support, can become great – an affirmation that we are Stronger Together.
tgt: Qeto eo e bontshang sebete sa mokwetlisi Rassie Erasmus le sehlopa sa hae e tswela pele ho bontsha Maafrika Borwa le lefatshe lohle, hore motho e mong le e mong ya nang le bokgoni, haeba a fuwa monyetla le tshehetso, a ka hlahella – le bopaki ba hore re Matla Mmoho.

src: Most importantly, the resilience and determination of the Springboks in the field of play is an embodiment of a true essence of being South African, that which makes this great nation rise against all odds and adversities to emerge victorious.
tgt: Sa bohlokwa le ho feta, mamello le boikemisetso ba di-Springboks lebaleng la dipapadi, ho phethahatsa moelelo wa nnete wa se bolelwang ke ho ba Moafrika Borwa, e leng se etsang hore naha ena e kgolo e eme kgahlanong le ditshitiso tsohle le mathata e le hore e hlahe e le mohlodi.

src: Some of the best players of this Springboks team have had to overcome personal adversities on their path to greatness.
tgt: Tse ding tsa dibapadi tse hlwahlwa tsa sehlopha sena sa di-Springboks di ile tsa lokela ho hlola mathata tseleng ya tsona e lebisang katlehong e kgolo.

src: Cabinet expressed its congratulations to Siyamtanda “Siya” Kolisi, the Springboks double World Cup-winning captain for leading the team to the Greatest of All Time (GOAT) status and the celebrations must go-on.
tgt: Kabinete e ile ya lebohisa Siyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, mokapotene wa di-Springboks tse hapileng ka makgetlo a mabedi Mohope wa Lefatshe bakeng sa ho etella pele sehlopha ho se lebisa boemong ba Greatest of All Time (GOAT) mme ho keteka ho lokela ho tswela pele.

src: AGOA Forum Cabinet had welcomed the confirmation by both the United States administration and congress on the intention to extend AGOA, which brings certainty to the investment community in the AGOA-eligible countries.
tgt: Foramo ya AGOA Kabinete e thabetse tiisetso ya botsamaisi ba Amerika le seboka ka boikemisetso ba tsona ba ho atollosa AGOA, e leng se tlisang bonnete ho setjhaba sa matsete sa dinaha tse tshwanelehang bakeng sa AGOKabinete e boetse ya amohela ho tshwarelwa ha Foramo ya AGOA ya 2023, lekgetlo la pele Johannesburg ho tloha ka la 2 – 4 Pudungwana 2023 moo ho bileng le bankakarolo ba emetseng dinaha tsa Afrika tse 32 ba tswang mmusong, kgwebong, mekgatlong ya setjhaba le mekgatlong ya basebetsi hammoho le baemedi ba mmuso wa Amerika.

src: Cabinet had also welcomed the hosting of the 2023 AGOA Forum in Johannesburg from the 2nd – 4th November 2023 with participants from 32 Africa countries from government, Business, civil society and organised labour for the first time and representatives of the United States government.
tgt: Kabinete kamehla e tiisa hore AGOA e fana ka monyetla wa hore Amerika e matlafatse maqhama a moruo le Afrika mme kahoo e lokela ho ekeletswa nako ya ho ba tshebetsong ka nako e bonahalang, e nang le moelelo, ho etsa hore e be le mosola le tshusumetso.

src: Cabinet has always asserted that AGOA provides an opportunity for the United States of America to strengthen its economic relationship with Africa and thus it must be extended for a meaningful period, enhanced to make it impactful and attractive.
tgt: Seboka sa Matona a Bohahlaodi a BRICS Kabinete e thabetse sephetho se atlehileng sa Seboka sa Matona a Bohahlaodi a BRICS sa 2023 se neng se tshwaretswe Cape Town, se ileng sa etsa hore dinaha tseo e leng ditho di sebedisane ka ho felletseng ho ntshetsa pele bohahlaodi ba ka hare ho BRICS, ho ntlafatsa ditsela bakeng sa motsamao o betere wa bohahlaudi le kgokahanyo hara dinaha tseo e leng ditho.

src: This will further strengthen South Africa’s tourism sector which is already showing signs of recovery.
tgt: Sena se tla matlafatsa le ho feta lefapha la Afrika Borwa la bohahlaodi le seng le ntse le bontsha matshwao a ho ntlafala.

src: For the first 8 months of 2023, the country saw million arrivals which represented a 63.4% increase from the same period in 2022.
tgt: Bakeng sa dikgwedi tsa pele tse 8 tsa 2023, naha e ile ya ba le baeti ba dimilione tse e leng se ileng sa bontsha keketseho ya dipersente tse ho tloha ho nako e tshwanang ka 2022.

src: Voter Registration The IEC has announced the 18th and 19th of November 2023 as a first voter registration weekend for the 2024 General Elections.
tgt: Ngodiso ya Dikgetho IEC e phatlaladitse la 18 le la 19 Pudungwana 2023 e le mafelobeke a pele a ho ingodisetsa ho kgetha bakeng sa Dikgetho tsa Kakaretso tsa 2024.

src: Cabinet is calling on all eligible voters to register to vote for the 2024 General Elections at your nearest voting stations.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho bohle ba tshwanelehang ho kgetha ho ingodisetsa ho kgetha bakeng sa Dikgetho tsa Kakaretso tsa 2024 diteisheneng tsa hao tsa ho kgetha tse haufinyane.

src: Online voter registration has been opened since February 2023 and citizens are urged to use the facility to register or update their details.
tgt: Ngodiso ya ho kgetha ya inthanete e butswe ho tloha ka Hlakola 2023 mme baahi ba koptjwa ho sebedisa setsi sena ho ingodisa kapa ho ntlafatsa dintlha tsa bona.

src: South Africans who have applied for their IDs are encouraged to visit their local Home Affairs office to collect them.
tgt: Maafrika Borwa a kentseng dikopo tsa di-ID a kgothalletswa ho etela ofisi ya Meroro ya Lehae ya sebakeng sa habo bona bakeng sa ho ya di nka.

src: There are more than 500 000 smart ID cards still to be collected atHome Affairs offices across the country.
tgt: Ho na le dikarete tsa di-smart ID tse fetang 500 000 tse lokelang ho latwa diofising tsa Merero ya Lehae naha ka bophara.

src: Electricity The Minister in the Presidency responsible for Electricity has provided a comprehensive briefing on electricity situation in the country.
tgt: Motlakase Letona ofising ya Mopresidente le ikarabellang bakeng sa Motlakase le fane ka dintlha tse hlakileng ka boemo ba motlakase naheng.

src: Cabinet applauded efforts by the Gauteng Provincial Government working with Eskom to restore electricity to areas in Gauteng that have been hit by black-outs due to the theft or damage to transformers.
tgt: Kabinete e ile ya thoholetsa boiteko ba Mmuso wa Profinse ya Gauteng o sebetsang le Eskom ho tsosollosa motlakase dibakeng tsa Gauteng tse nnileng tsa ba lefifing ka lebaka la boshodu kapa ho senyeha ha di-transformer.

src: Last night, six new electrical transformers were switched in Kagiso, in the West Rand area after communities were left without power for more than 3 years.
tgt: Bosiung bo fetileng, di-transformer tse tsheletseng tse ntjha tsa motlakase di ile tsa kenngwa Kagiso, sebakeng sa West Rand ka mora hore baahi ba sale ba se na motlakase ka dilemo tse fetang tse tharo.

src: Cabinet calls on these communities to protect the critical infrastructure from theft, vandalism and damage that is caused by illegal connections.
tgt: Kabinete e ipiletsa ho baahi bana hore ba sirelletse disebediswa tsena tsa bohlokwa boshodung, le tshenyong tse bakwang ke dikgokelo tse seng molaong.

src: Food Poisoning Cabinet is concerned by the spate of food poisoning of children from eating expired and contaminated foodstuff from spaza shops and street vendors.
tgt: Tjhefo ya Dijo Kabinete e tshwenyehile ka ho ata ha bana ba kudiswang ke tjhefo ya dijo eo ba e fumaneng ha ba ja dijo tse felletsweng ke nako le tse silafetseng tseo ba di rekileng mabenkeleng a spaza le ho barekisi ba seterateng.

src: Cabinet is encouraged by the law enforcement efforts to enforce food safety compliance.
tgt: Kabinete e kgothaditswe ke boiteko ba tshebetso ya molao ba ho tiisa hore ho latelwa melao ya polokeho ya dijo.

src: International Migration Workshop with Mayors and Traditional leaders Cabinet was briefed about the international migration workshop hosted by the Department of Home Affairs with the participation of the DSBD, COGTA, Human Settlements and traditional leaders and mayors from metro and district municipalities that focused on curbing effects of illegal immigration, including the operations of spaza shops.
tgt: Seboka sa Matjhaba se Buang ka Diketso tsa ho Falla se Kwetlisang Boramotse le Marena Kabinete e ile ya tsebiswa ka Seboka sa Matjhaba se Buang ka Diketso tsa ho Falla se Kwetlisang Boramotse le Marena se neng se tshwerwe ke Lefapha la Merero ya Lehae ka bonkakarolo ba Lefapha la Ntshetsopele ya Dikgwebo tse Nyenyanane, Lefapha la Puso ya Kopanelo le Ditaba tsa Borena Lefapha la Bodulo ba Batho le marena le boramotse ho tswa bomasepaleng ba ditoropo le ba ditereke, se neng se tsepamisitswe ho ditlamorao tse bakwang ke ho falla ho seng molaong, ho kenyelletsa tsamaiso ya mabenkele a spaza.

src: Key outcomes include the introduction of omnibus by-laws to address challenges relating to the enforcement of business by-laws by municipalities and traditional authorities.
tgt: Sephetho se ka sehloohong se akaralletsa ho kenyelletswa ha melawana ya dintho tse fapaneng bakeng sa ho lokisa mathata a amanang le phethahatso ya melawana ya kgwebo ke bomasepala le balaodi ba setso.

src: There will be immediate joint inspections of businesses, in particular spaza shops by the departments of labour, health, small business development and the Home Affairs immigration inspectorate teams, to enforce compliance with applicable laws An audit of spaza shops in villages and townships, and mechanisms to register them by both traditional leaders and municipalities will be undertaken.
tgt: Ho tla ba le ditlhahlobo tsa hanghang tse kopanetsweng tsa dikgwebo, ka ho kgetheha tsa mabenkele a spaza ke mafapha a mosebetsi, a bophelo bo botle, a ntshetso pele ya dikgwebo tse nyenyane le dihlopha tsa tlhahlobo ya ho falla tsa Merero ya Lehae, bakeng sa ho qobella boikamahanyo le melao e sebetsang.

src: There are also efforts to support traditional authorities to keep a record of foreign nationals in their communities.
tgt: Tlhahlobo ho mabenkele a spaza metseng le makeisheneng, le mekgwa ya ho a ngodisa e tla sebediswa ke baetapele ba setso le bomasepala.

src: Business licencing legislation is being amended to support all those who wish to trade in the informal sector.
tgt: Ho boetse ho na le boiteko ba ho tshehetsa balaodi ba setso ho boloka tlaleho ya batho ba tswang kantle ho naha metseng ya bona.

src: Integrated Crime Fighting Cabinet commends the SAPS for dealing a massive blow to international drug syndicates following the discovery of cocaine valued at R80 million which were seized on 20 October 2023 at a warehouse at the Dube Trade Port within the King Shaka International Airport.
tgt: Molao wa laesense ya kgwebo o fetotswe bakeng sa ho tshehetsa bohle ba lakatsang ho hweba mafapheng a sa laolweng ke mmuso.

src: Two days prior the seizure, another R70 million worth of cocaine was also seized from a container at the Durban Harbour.
tgt: Ntwa ya Kopanelo Kgahlanong le Botlokotsebe Kabinete e babatsa SAPS ka kotlo e kgolo ho mekgatlo ya matjhaba ya dithethefatsi ka mora ho fumana khokheine ya boleng ba dimilione tse R80 tse ileng tsa tshwarwa ka la 20 Mphalane 2023 ntlong ya polokelo Boemakepeng ba Dube Trade ka hare ho Boemafofane ba Matjhaba ba King Shaka.

src: Cabinet applauds the SAPS for their work in disrupting and dismantling transnational organised crime that poses a significant threat to our communities and the nation.
tgt: Kabinete e thoholetsa SAPS bakeng sa mosebetsi wa bona wa ho sitisa le ho senya tlolo ya molao e hlophisitsweng ya matjhabeng e leng tshokelo e kgolo ho setjhaba sa habo rona le ho naha.

src: Operation Safer Festive Season is already yielding results with police arresting over 140 suspects, including an alleged illegal mining kingpin, and seizing unlicensed firearms.
tgt: Letsholo la Tshireletseho Nakong ya Matsatsi a Phomolo le se ntse le beha ditholwana ka ho tshwara ha mapolesa babelaellwa ba fetang 140, ho kenyelletsa le eo ho thweng ke nkokonono ya morafo o seng molaong, le ho hapuwa ha dithunya tse se nang laesense.

src: Presidential Oversight Visit Cabinet welcomed the Presidential Oversight Visit to the Emfuleni Municipality, which followed-up on engagements with the community during the District Development Model visit of 2022.
tgt: Ketelo ya ho Hlahloba ya Mopresidente Kabinete e thabetse Ketelo ya ho Hlahloba ya Mopresidente Masepaleng wa Emfuleni, e ileng ya latelwa ke dikopano le setjhaba nakong ya ketelo ya Mohlala wa Ntshetsopele ya Ditereke ya 2022.

src: The 2022 visit to Emfuleni identified issues of poor infrastructure maintenance by the municipality Through the intervention of the Department of Water and Sanitation, there has been notable progress in addressing water and sanitation infrastructure challenges that had resulted in the collapse of the Vaal Waste Water system.
tgt: Ketelo ya 2022 Emfuleni e qoollotse mathata a tlhokomelo e mpe ya ditshebeletso ke masepala.

src: Work has been undertaken to improve water supply, the proper functioning of the waste water infrastructure and thus eliminating the problem of the sewer effluent that run running on the streets and people’s yards.
tgt: Ka ho kenella ha Lefapha la Metsi le Bohlweki, ho bile le tswelopele e bonahalang tabeng ya ho rarolla mathata a ditshebeletso tsa metsi le bohlweki tse felletseng ka ho putlama ha tsamaiso ya Metsi a Ditshila Vaal.

src: Noted progress during the visit include improvements in critical bulk pipelines and water pump stations, resurfacing and resealing of roads, and a massive rollout of streetlights to improve lighting and safety.
tgt: Mosebetsi o entswe bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa phano ya metsi, tshebetso e nepahetseng ya tsamaiso ya metsi a ditshila mme kahoo ha fediswa bothata ba metsi a dikgwerekgwere tse ditshila a mathang diterateng le dijareteng tsa batho.

src: Roadmap for the Freight Logistics System in South Africa The Department of Transport has commenced consultations on the Roadmap for the Freight Logistics System in South Africa, as part of measures to address the challenges facing the freight and logistics sector and the strengthening of South Africa’s economic recovery efforts.
tgt: Tswelopele e hlokomelehang nakong ya ketelo ena e kenyelletsa ntlafatso diphaepheng tse ngata tsa bohlokwa le diteisheneng tsa ho pompa metsi, ho ntjhafatswa le ho tiiswa ha ditsela, hammoho le tlhahiso e kgolo ya mabone a seterateng bakeng sa ho ntlafatsa kganya le polokeho.

src: Infrastructure Development and Maintenance Cabinet welcomed the progress being made with infrastructure development and maintenance with the completion of 36 rural bridges under the Welisizwe Rural Bridges, and the construction underway on 20 projects in human settlements, roads, and water.
tgt: Leano Bakeng sa Tsamaiso ya Thepa Afrika Borwa Lefapha la Dipalangwang le tswetsepele ho qala dipuisno ka Leano le mabapi le Tsamaiso ya Thepa Afrika Borwa, e le karolo ya mehato ya ho rarolla mathata ao lefapha la tsamaiso ya thepha le tobanang le ona le ho matlafatsa boiteko ba ho ntlafatsa moruo wa Afrika Borwa.

src: Relaunch of South African Airways (SAA) international routes Cabinet welcomed the relaunch of SAA international routes with the re-introduction of its intercontinental flight to São Paulo, Brazil, which also marked the return of the long-haul service out of Cape Town and Johannesburg.
tgt: Ntshetsopele ya Mehaho le Tlhokomelo Kabinete e thabetse tswelopele e entsweng ho ntshetsopele ya mehaho le tlhokomelo ka ho phethwa ha kaho ya marokgo a mahaeng a 36 tlasa Welisizwe Rural Bridges, le kaho e ntseng e tswelapele diprojekeng tse 20 dibakeng tsa bodulo ba batho, ditseleng le metsi.

src: The return of SAA in the international routes will contribute directly in driving growth in international travel to the country, and growth of the tourism sector after the ravages of the Covid-19 pandemic.
tgt: Ho Thakgolwa Botjha ha Ditsela tsa Matjhaba tsa South African Airways (SAA) Kabinete e thabetse ho thakgolwa botjha ha ditsela tsa matjhaba tsa SAA ka ho kenyelletsa botjha maeto a sefofane dikhonthinenteng tse ding a yang São Paulo, Brazil, e leng se boetseng sa tshwaya ho kgutla ha tshebeletso ya nako e telele ka ntle ho Cape Town le Johannesburg.

src: South Africa launches the largest drone in Africa Cabinet congratulated the Defence and aerospace company Milkor on their successful launch of the Milkor 380 unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), which places South Africa among the countries that continue to make strides in drone technology.
tgt: Ho kgutla ha SAA ditseleng tsa matjhaba ho tla tlatsetsa ka ho toba kgolong ya ketelo ya matjhabeng naheng ya rona, le ho kgolo lefapheng la bohahlaodi ka mora tshenyo e bakilweng ke sewa sa COVID-19.

src: The Milkor 380 is the largest drone built in Africa and it will be used by the defence industry for combat, border control, conservation efforts including to combat poaching.
tgt: Afrika Borwa e Thakgotse Drone e Kgolo ka ho Fetisa Afrika Kabinete e lebohisitse ba Sesole le khampani ya difofane ya Milkor ka katleho ya yona ya ho thakgola sefofane se sa hlokeng ho palangwa hore se fofiswe (UAV) sa Milkor 380, e leng se behang Afrika Borwa hara dinaha tse tswelang pele ho etsa kgatelo pele theknolojing ya di-drone.

src: Matric and Year-end schools examinations Cabinet welcomed the smooth start to the 2023 National Senior Certificate (matric) exams, which commenced on 30 October 2023.
tgt: Milkor 380 ke drone e kgolo ka ho fetisisa e entsweng Afrika mme e tla sebediswa ke masole ha ho na le dintwa, ha ba disa moedi, ha ba disa dimela le diphoofolo tse hlaha, ho kenyelletsang twantso ya ho tsoma ho seng molaong.

src: Parents and guardians are encouraged to continue to support learners during this critical period.
tgt: Ditlhahlobo tsa Metriki le tsa Sekolo tsa Qetellong ya Selemo Kabinete e thabetse qalo e tsamaileng ka thello ya ditlhahlobo tsa 2023 tsa National Senior Certificate (metriki), tse qadileng ka la 30 Mphalane 2023.

src: Cabinet also sends its well wishes to all the learners who will be sitting for their year-end exams.
tgt: Batswadi le bahlokomedi ba kgothalletswa ho tswela pele ba tshehetsa baithuti nakong ena ya bohlokwa.

src: Cabinet decisions The Situation in Palestine Cabinet is disappointed by the refusal of the Israeli government to respect international law and its continued undermining of the United Nations resolutions for the implementation of a ceasefire with impunity.
tgt: Diqeto tsa Kabinete Boemo Palestina Kabinete e swabisitswe ke ho hana ha mmuso wa Iseraele ho hlompha molao wa matjhaba le ho tswela pele ho nyenyefatsa diqeto tsa Matjhaba a Kopaneng bakeg sa ho kenya tshebetsong ho emisa ntwa ntle ho kotlo.

src: The humanitarian corridors for the people of Palestine remain closed with dire consequences for children, women and innocent civilians.
tgt: Ditsela tsa ho baleha bakeng sa batho ba Palestina di ntse di thibetswe ka phello ya ditlamorao tse bohloko bakeng sa bana, basadi le baahi ba se nang molato.

src: The genocidal airstrikes by the government of Israel on the people of Palestine, continue with rising death toll that include women and children.
tgt: Ditlhaselo tsa batho ba Palestina ka difofane tsa mmuso wa Iseraele, di tswelapele mme palo ya batho ba shwang e a eketseha mo e kenyelletsang basadi le bana.

src: In the last two days, the world have sat helplessly and watched as intensifying airstrikes on Gaza and the West Bank have destroyed schools, health facilities, ambulances and civilian infrastructure and supposedly safe roads travelling to the South of Gaza.
tgt: Matsatsing a mabedi a fetileng, lefatshe le ile la sheba ho se letho leo le ka se etsang le shebelletse ha tlhaselo ya difofane e ba matla ho Gaza le ho West Bank moo dikolo, dipetlele, diambulense le mahae a baahi hammoho le ditsela tseo ho thweng di sireletsehile tse yang ka Borwa ho Gaza di thuntshwa.

src: For these, the Cabinet has decided to recall all South African diplomats from Tel Aviv for consultation.
tgt: Bakeng sa dintlha tsena, Kabinete e entse qeto ya ho bitsa bodiplomate bohle ba Afrika Borwa ho tswa Tel Aviv ho tla hlalosa hore hantlehantle ke eng se etsahalang mono.

src: Cabinet has also noted with disquiet the continuing disparaging remarks of the Israeli’s ambassador to South Africa, Mr. Eliav Belotsercovsky, against South Africans, the leadership of South Africa both in and outside government including civil society who are speaking against the holocaust being committed by the Israeli government against the Palestinians.
tgt: Kabinete e boetse e hlokometse dipuo tse nyenyefatsang tse tswelang pele tsa lenqosa la Iseraele ho Afrika Borwa, Monghadi Eliav Belotsercovsky, kgahlahonong la Maafrika Borwa, boetapele ba Afrika Borwa ka hare le ka ntle ho mmuso ho kenyelletsa le setjhaba se buang kgahlanong le polao e sehlooho e etswang ke mmuso wa Iseraele kgahlanong le Mapalestina.

src: The disparaging remarks of Ambassador Belotsercovsky are contrasted by the statements of two former Israeli ambassadors to South Africa (Illan Baruch and Dr. Alon Liel) who have been consistent in describing the actions of their government against Palestinians as Apartheid.
tgt: Dipuo tse nyenyefatsang tsa Lenqosa Belotsercovsky di fapane le dipolelo tsa manqosa a mehleng a mabedi a Iseraele ho Afrika Borwa (Illan Baruch le Dr. Alon Liel) a nnileng a dula a tsitsitse ha a hlalosa diketso tsa mmuso wa bona kgahlanong le Palestinians e le Kgethollo le Lehloyo la Morabe o mong.

src: The disparaging remarks against those speaking up against the atrocities and the country’s leaders make ambassador Belotsercovsky position more and more untenable.
tgt: Dipuo tsa nyenyefatsang kgahlanong le ba buang kgahlanong le tlhekefetso le baetapele ba naha di etsa hore boemo ba lenqosa Belotsercovsky e be bo sa hlokomelweng le ho feta.

src: As such Cabinet has directed the Department of International Relations and Cooperation to convey the South African government displeasure with the ambassador formally through diplomatic channels.
tgt: Kahoo Kabinete e laetse Lefapha la Dikamano tsa Matjhaba le Tshebedisano hore le fetisetse molao wa mmuso ka molao wa metjha ya bodiplomate wa ho se thabele se etswang ke lenqosa lena la bodiplomate.

src: Medium Term Budget Policy Statement Cabinet welcomed the 2023 Medium Term Budget Policy Statement (MTBPS), which provided a frank assessment of the current economic climate and demonstrated government’s firm hold on our nation’s finances amid tough revenue constraints.
tgt: Polelo ya Leano la Bajete ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Mahareng Kabinete e thabetse Bajete ya Tekanyetso ya Nako e Mahareng ya 2023 (MTBPS), e faneng ka tekanyo e tshepahalang ya boemo ba moruo ba hona jwale mme ya bontsha ho tshwarella ka tiyo ha mmuso ditjheleteng tsa naha hara dikgaello tse boima tsa tjhelete.

src: The decisions in the MTBPS improve our fiscal framework stimulate economic growth while balancing our social commitments that support the vulnerable in our nation.
tgt: Diqeto tsa MTBPS di ntlafatsa moralo wa ditjhelete wa rona di ntlafatsa kgolo ya moruo ha ka nako e tshwanang di lekalekanya boitlamo ba rona setjhabeng bo tshehetsang mafutsana naheng ya rona.

src: The Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan has contributed to many green shoots in our economy.
tgt: Leano la Ntlafatso le Kahobotjha ya Moruo di bile le seabo ho ditholwana tse ngata tse ntle ho moralo wa ditjhelete moruong wa rona.

src: High Speed Rail Development Cabinet approved the High Speed Rail Development Framework and the financial implications for implementation will be discussed between the Ministers of Transport and Finance Cabinet approved the prioritisation of the Johannesburg to Durban corridor for a detailed feasibility study, and the Johannesburg-Polokwane to Musina, and the Johannesburg to Mbombela will be put to the market.
tgt: Ho Ahuwa ha Seporo sa Terene ya Lebelo le Phahameng Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana Ho Ahuwa ha Seporo sa Terene e Tsamayang ka Lebelo le Phahameng mme Letona la Dipalangwang le la Ditjhelete ba tla tshohla taba ya ditjhelete tse tla hlokahalang bakeng sa ho kenya monahano ona tshebetsong.

src: Draft White Paper on Citizenship, Immigration and Refugee Protection Cabinet approved the publication of the White Paper on Citizenship, Immigration and Refugee Protection for public comments.
tgt: Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho potlakiswa ha marangrang a diphaseje tsa Johannesburg ho ya Durban bakeng sa boithuto bo felletseng ba kgonahalo e jwalo, le ho tloha Johannesburg ho ya Polokwane ho isa Musina, le Johannesburg ho ya Mbombela di tla behwa mmarakeng.

src: The draft Policy aims to provide a framework to guide the granting of residency and citizenship to foreign nationals, as well as the protection of refugees and asylum seekers in South Africa, cognisant of the Republic’s national security interests and in compliance with international agreements and protocols on migration that South Africa is party to.
tgt: Moralo wa Tokomane ya Leano la Mmuso ho Boahi, Ho Falla le Tshireletso ya Baphaphathehi Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana kgatiso ya Tokomane ya Leano la Mmuso ho Boahi, ho Falla le Tshireletso ya Baphaphathehi bakeng sa maikutlo a setjhaba.

src: The 6th Annual Progress Report on the implementation of the White Paper on the Rights of People with Disabilities Cabinet has approved for publication in the government gazette the 6th Annual Progress Report on the implementation of the White Paper on the Rights of People with Disabilities.
tgt: Tlaleho ya Selemo sa bo6 ya Kgatelopele ya Tokomane ya Leano ho Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Holofofetseng Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho phatlalatswa koranteng ya mmuso ha Tlaleho ya Selemo sa bo6 ya Kgatelopele ya Tokomane ya Leano ho Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Holofofetseng ho kenngwa tshebetsong.

src: The publication of the progress report will coincide with the international commemoration of the Disability Rights Awareness Month from 3 November to 3 December.
tgt: Phatlalatso ya tlaleho ena e tla tsamaisana le sehopotso sa matjhaba sa Kgwedi ya Tlhokomediso ya Ditokelo tsa Batho ba Holofetseng ho tloha ka la 3 Pudungwana ho isa ho la 3 Tshitwe.

src: The progress report also signals an increase of the minimum employment equity target from 2% to 3% for persons with disabilities as from the 2024/2025 financial year, towards a minimum 7% employment equity target for persons with disabilities by 2030.
tgt: Tlaleho ya tswelopele e boetse e bontsha kgolo morerong wa tekatekano ya khiro ho tloha ho bonyenyane ba dipersente tse 2 ho isa ho tse 3 bakeng sa batho ba holofetseng ho tloha selemong sa ditjhelete sa 2024/2025, ho isa ho bonyenyane ba dipersente tse 7 tsa morero wa tekatekano ya khiro bakeng sa batho ba holofotseng ka 2030.

src: Bills Draft African Renaissance and International Cooperation Fund (ARF) Bill Cabinet approved the submission of the ARF Amendment Bill to Parliament.
tgt: Dibili Moralo wa Bili ya Tsosoloso ya Afrika le Letlole la Tshebedisano ya Matjhaba (ARF) Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana tlhahiso ya Phetoho ya Bili ya ARF Palamenteng.

src: The Bill seeks to amend the ARF Act (Act 51 of 2000) and establish the South African Development Partnership Agency that will serve as a mechanism to support South Africa’s development and cooperation with sister countries through the promotion of democracy, good governance, the prevention and resolution of conflict, socio-economic development and integration.
tgt: Bili ena e reretswe ho fetola Molao wa ARF (Molao wa bo51 wa 2000) le ho theha Mokgatlo wa Ntshetsopele ya Maqhama ya Afrika Borwa, o tla sebetsa jwalo ka thuluse bakeng sa ho tshehetsa ntshetsopele ya Afrika Borwa le tshebedisano le dinaha tse mabapi ka ho kgothalletsa demokrasi, bookamedi bo molemo, thibelo le tharollo ya dikgohlano, ntshetsopele ya moruo setjhabeng le kopanyo.

src: All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant clearance.
tgt: Ho Thonngwa Pele batho bohle ba thonngwa, ho hlahlobisiswa mangolo a bona a thuto le a mang a hlokahalang.

src: Appointment of Mr Ebrahim Rasool as Chairperson of the Development Bank of Southern Africa.
tgt: Ho thonngwa ha Monghadi Ebrahim Rasool jwalo ka Modulasetulo wa Ntshetsopele ya Banka ya Afrika Borwa.

src: Appointment of Ms Margaret Mosibudi Phiri as a member to the National Nuclear Regulator Board
tgt: Ho thonngwa ha Mme Margaret Mosibudi Phiri jwalo ka setho sa Boto ya Taolo ya Nuclear ya Naha.

src: Upcoming Events Anti-Corruption Dialogue The Anti-Corruption Dialogue will be held on 8 and 9 November 2023 at Birchwood Hotel in Ekurhuleni to mobilise society in the fight against corruption in line with the country’s National Anti-Corruption Strategy Cabinet, in November 2020, approved the National Anti-Corruption Strategy (NACS 2020-2030).
tgt: Diketsahalo tse Tlang Puisano ya Ntwa Kgahlanong le Bobodu Puisano ya Ntwa Kgahlanong le Bobodu e tla tshwarwa ka la 8 le la 9 Pudungwana 2023 Birchwood Hotel e Ekurhuleni bakeng sa ho hlomella setjhaba twantshong ya bobodu tumellanong le Leano la Naha la Ntwa Kgahlanong le Bobodu la naha ya rona.

src: This is a country strategy that is aimed at creating a corruption-free society while also encouraging citizens to have zero-tolerance for corruption and abide by the rule of law.
tgt: Kabinine, ka Pudungwana 2020, e tjhaetse monwana Leano la Naha la National Anti-Corruption Strategy (NACS 2020-2030).

src: 16 Days of Activism Campaign for No Violence Against Women and Children 2023 This year marks the 25th anniversary of South Africa’s participation in the 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children Campaign which will be observed under the theme: “Accelerating actions to end Gender-Based Violence and Femicide (GBVF): Leaving no one behind”.
tgt: Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 la 2023 la Thibelo ya Tlhekefetso ya Basadi le Bana Selemo sena se tshwaya sehopotso sa bo25 sa ho nka karolo ha Afrika Borwa ho Letsholo la Matsatsi a 16 bakeng sa Thibelo ya Tlhekefetso ya Basadi le Bana, se tla ketekwa tlasa sehlooho se reng: “Ho tiisa mehato ya ho fedisa Tlhekefetso ya Bong le Polao ya Basadi (GBVF): Ho se siye mang kapa mang morao”.

src: This global campaign runs from 25 November, the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women to 10 December, International Human Rights Day.
tgt: Letsholo lena la lefatsheng ka bophara le ba teng ho tloha ka la 25 Pudungwana, Letsatsi la Matjhaba bakeng sa ho Fedisa Tlhekefetso kgahlanong le Basadi ho isa ho la 10 Tshitwe, Letsatsi la Matjhaba la Ditokelo tsa Botho.

src: It aims to combat violence against women whilst upholding human rights.
tgt: Le reretswe ho fedisa tlhekefetso kgahlanong le basadi ha ka nako e tshwanang le tshehetsa ditokelo tsa botho.

src: 3 14th Policy Dialogue Forum South Africa will co-host the 14th Policy Dialogue Forum in collaboration with the UNESCO International Teacher Task Force for Education (TTF) in January 2024 under the theme “Addressing teacher shortages and making the profession more attractive”.
tgt: Foramo ya bo14 ya Dipuisano tsa Maano Afrika Borwa e tla ba moamohedi mmoho ho Foramo ya bo14 ya Dipuisano tsa Maano e sebedisana mmoho le UNESCO International Teacher Task Force bakeng sa Thuto (TTF) ka Pherekgong 2024 tlasa sehlooho se reng “Ho rarollo bothata ba kgaello ya matitjhere le ho etsa hore mosebetsi ona o kgahle”.

src: The forum will bring together government officials, NGOs, teachers and education experts to discuss critical issues pertaining to the conditions of service for teachers, issues of teacher autonomy and accountability as well as how to make teaching an attractive profession.
tgt: Foramo ena e tla kopanya basebetsi ba mmuso, di-NGO, matitjhere le ditsebi tsa thuto bakeng sa ho tshohla ditaba tsa bohlokwa tse mabapi le maemo a tshebetso bakeng sa matitjhere, ditaba tsa boikemelo le boikarabelo ba matitjhere hammo le kamoo ho ka etswang hore botitjhere e be mosebetsi o kgahlang.

src: Messages Congratulations
tgt: Melaetsa Ditebohiso

src: Cabinet extended its congratulations and well wishes to: The Proteas for securing a place in the semi-finals of the the ICC World Cup 2023 in India.
tgt: Di-Proteas bakeng sa ho sirelletsa sebaka sa tsona ho di-semi-final tsa Mohope wa Lefatshe wa 2023 wa ICC India.

src: Despite the setback in their match against India yesterday, the country remains firmly behind the team and is confident they will continue to build and make us proud.
tgt: Ho sa tsotellehe ditshitiso papading ya tsona kgahlanong le India maobane, naha e dula e tshehetsa ka tiyo sehlopha me e kgodisehile hore se tla tswelapele ho ikaha le ho etsa hore re be motlotlo.

src: Moto GP racing star Brad Binder who is now the outright premier class podium record holder for South Africa after his top three finish at the Thailand Grand Prix.
tgt: Naledi ya lebelo la Moto GP Brad Binder eo hona jwale a tshwereng rekoto ya maemo a hodimo a primiyamo bakeng sa Afrika Borwa ka mora ho ba ya itlhommeng pele hara bahlodi ba bararo ba qetileng lebelo la Thailand Grand Prix.

src: South Africa’s first pro-wheelchair bodybuilder Macethandile Kulati for defending his title at the 2023 International Federation of Body Builders and Fitness World Championship in Slovenia.
tgt: Mampodi wa pele ya phahamisang ditshepe ya tsamayang ka wheelchair wa Afrika Borwa Macethandile Kulati bakeng sa ho sirelletsa sekola sa hae ho 2023 International Federation of Body Builders and Fitness World Championship Slovenia.

src: South African Chartered Accountants for earning the top position in the Edelman global professional trust survey.
tgt: Di-chartered Accountant tsa Afrika Borwa bakeng sa ho fumana maemo a phahameng ho tlhahlobo ya lefatshe ya ditsebi tse tsheptjoang ya Edelman.

src: Dr Claude Mashego for winning the inaugural Miss World South Africa and she will now represent South Africa at the Miss World in New Delhi, India in December this year.
tgt: Ngaka Claude Mashego bakeng sa ho hapa ka lekgetlo la pele Miss World South Africa mme jwale o tla emela Afrika Borwa tlhodisanong ya Miss World New Delhi, India ka Tshitwe selemong sena.

src: Advocate Kholeka Gcaleka following her appointment as the new Public Protector for a term of seven years with effect from 1 November 2023.
tgt: Mmuelli Kholeka Gcaleka ho latela ho kgethwa ha hae jwalo ka Mosireletsi wa Setjhaba e motjha bakeng sa nako ya dilemo tse supileng tse tla qala ka la 1 Pudungwana 2023.

src: Condolences Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of: Paralympic gold medallist Zanele Situ who was the first black South African female athlete to win a gold medal at the Paralympic Games in Sydney in 2000.
tgt: Matshediso Kabinete e fetisetsa matshidiso le kutlwelo bohloko ho malapa le metswalle ya:

src: Former Bafana-Bafana assistant coach and football legend Phil “Mr Jones” Setshedi.
tgt: Mohapi wa medale ya kgauta dipapading tsa batho ba holofetseng Zanele Situ eo e neng e le moatlelete wa pele wa mosadi wa Moafrika Borwa wa motho e motsho ho hapa medale ya kgauta Dipapading tsa Batho ba Holofetseng Sydney ka 2000.

src: Warrant Officer Sthembiso Mazibuko of the National Intervention Unit who was killed during a shootout with criminals in Ntuzuma, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Mothusi wa mehleng wa mokwetlisi wa Bafana-Bafana le sebapadi se hlwahlwa sa bolo Phil “Mr Jones” Setshedi.

src: Issues in the Environment
tgt: Maemo a Renang

src: Economic Recovery and Growth Quarterly Labour Force Survey (QLFS) Cabinet welcomes the 2023, 3rd quarter, QLFS results as released by Statistics South Africa that indicated employment figures have surpassed the pre-COVID-19 employment levels.
tgt: Kgolo le ho Tsoseletswa ha Moruo Dipalopalo tsa Batho ba Sebetsang (QLFS) Kabinete e amohetse ho lokollwa ha dipalopalo tsa kotara ya boraro ya selemo sa 2023 sa batho ba sebetsang QLFS ke Lefapha la Afrika Borwa la Dipalopalo.

src: Cabinet is pleased that all provinces but one have contributed to the 399 000 increase to the number of employed people to a total of 16,7 million people in employment in the 3rd quarter, compared to 16,3 million in the 2nd quarter of 2023.
tgt: Dipalopalo tsena di bontsha hore palo ya batho ba sebetsang e feta ya pele ho nako ya COVID-19.

src: The strong contributions to additional jobs of KwaZulu-Natal (up by 152 000), Limpopo (up by 70 000), North West (up by 61 000) and Mpumalanga, indicate the gradual but steady realisation of the goal of the Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan of rebuilding better, stronger and inclusively.
tgt: Kabinete e thabisitswe ke taba ya hore diprofensi kaofela di bile le kabelo keketsehong ena ya 399 000 ya batho ba sebetsang ho tloha ho ba dimilione di 16,3 ka kotara ya bobedi ya 2023 ho isa ho ba dimilione di 16,7 ka kotara ya boraro.

src: Cabinet appreciates the continued and consistent contribution of the following sectors and industries: The formal sector employment increased by 287 000 whereas informal sector increased by 29 000 jobs Finance (this includes business services) up by 237 000 jobs Community and social services up by 119 000 jobs and agriculture by 61 000 jobs.
tgt: Diprofensi tse bileng le kabelo haholo keketsehong ena ke (ka keketseho ya 152 000), Limpopo (ka keketseho ya 70 000), Leboya Bophirima ha mmoho le Mpumalanga (ka keketseho ya 61 000).

src: Cabinet is also pleased that despite remaining challenges, youth unemployment is gradually declining (a decrease of 1.9% from the previous quarter), and a 237 000 increase in the number of employed youth, rising to a total of six (6) million youth in employment.
tgt: Kabinete e leboha makala le diindasteri tse latelang ka kabelo ya tsona ya kamehla: Lekala la mesebetsi ya moshwelella e eketsehileng ka e 287 000 eo e seng ya moshwelella yona e eketsehile ka e 29 000 Lekala la ditjhelete (lona le kenyeletsa la ditshebeletso tsa ditjhelete) ka keketseho ya mesebetsi e 237 000 Lekala la ditshebeletso tsa setjhaba lona le fumane keketseho ya mesebetsi e 119 000, la temo lona la fumana keketseho ya mesebetsi e 61 000.

src: Investments In the same trajectory of a recovering and growing economy, Cabinet welcomed the additional R5-billion investment by the Ford Motor Company for its new plug-in hybrid electric Ford Ranger that is earmarked for export to Europe, New Zealand and Australia.
tgt: Kabinete e boetse e elellwa kgahlamelo e mpe e tliswang ke mathata a phepelo ya motlakase le ho thothwa ha thepa makaleng a kang la tlhahiso, dirashwa, ho thothwa ha thepa le ditshebeletso tse ding.

src: The P&G cumulative investment since totals approximately R900 million since 2018 and currently employed over 4000 direct and indirect jobs throughout its value chain.
tgt: Kabinete e boetse e thabisitswe ke ho fokotseha hanyane ha palo ya batjha ba sa sebetseng (palo ya ba sa sebetseng e fokotsehile ka persente tse ho tloha ka kotara e fetileng), mme re bone keketseho ya 237 000 ya batjha ba sebetsang, e leng se behileng palo ya batjha bohle ba sebetsang ho dimilione tse tsheletseng.

src: Both The Ford Motor Company and P&G project launches are testament of the valuable contribution of President Cyril Ramaphosa’s investment drive through the South Africa Investment Conference, and a reaffirmation of South Africa as an investment destination of choice.
tgt: Matsete Ntle le katleho ena ya kgolo ya moruo, Kabinete e boetse e thabetse matsete a dibilione tse R5 tsa khamphane e hlahisang makoloi ya ha Ford ka tlhahiso ya koloi ya bona e tsamayang ka motlakase ya Ford Ranger e tla rekisetswa le dinaheng tse kang Yuropa, New Zealand le Australia.

src: Cabinet congratulated Ministers Thoko Didiza and Ebrahim Patel for the work done to ensure the opening of this market for South African red meat products.
tgt: Kabinete e boetse e amohetse matsete a khamphane ya ha Procter & Gamble (P&G) ka tlahiso ya bona e ntjha ya maleiri a mofuta wa Pampers Premium Care mane Ekurhuleni, Gauteng.

src: Deliberate distortions of the Agri-Black Economic Empowerment (BEE) requirements for agricultural exports Cabinet condemned deliberate distortions by some sections of the media of the Agri-BEE requirements for agricultural exports to stoke racial tensions, and reminded the media that its freedom equally comes with responsibility.
tgt: Matsete ana a khamphane ya ha Ford le ya ha P&G, ke bopaki ba katleho ya leano la Mopresidente Cyril Ramaphosa le neng le thakgolwe Sebokeng sa Matsete sa Afrika Borwa, e leng se pakang taba ya hore Afrika Borwa ke sebaka se nepahetseng sa ho etsa matsete.

src: Cabinet expressed its appreciation to the agricultural industry, in particular the SA Wine and Agricultural Chamber of Business, commonly known as Agbiz, for rejecting attempts to plunge the country and the sector into racial tensions by publicly clarifying the distortions as soon as they were published.
tgt: Tumellano ya Thekisetsano ya Nama ya Kgomo Pakeng tsa Afrika Borwa le Saudi Arabia Kabinete e thabetse ho tekenwa ha tumellano ya thekisetsano ya nama ya kgomo pakeng tsa Afrika Borwa le Saudi Arabia e tekennweng Sebokeng sa Matsete sa Saudi le Dinaha tsa Afrika.. Tumellano ena ke mohato wa bohlokwa o netefatsang hore dihlahiswa tsa nama ya kgomo di fumana thekiso mebarakeng ya bohlokwa, e leng se netefatsang kabelo ya lekala la temo moruong le ho theheng mesebetsi.

src: Your posture on this matter, demonstrated that indeed you have embraced the spirit canvassed by the Springboks of Stronger Together.
tgt: Kabinete e phaphathela Matona a mabedi matsoho, e leng Thoko Didiza le Ebrahim Patel ka mosebetsi wa bona wa ho netefatsa hore dihlahiswa tsa rona tsa nama ya kgomo di kena mebarakeng eo ya matjhaba.

src: Tourism Cabinet noted the partnership established between the Department of Tourism and Google as a game changer that will assist in promoting South Africa as a prime tourist destination.
tgt: Ho se Bue Nnete ka Boomo ka se Hlokahalang Bakeng sa ho Romelwa ha Thepa Dinaheng tsa Kantle Tlasa Leano la Agri-Black Economic Empowerment (BEE) Kabinete e tshwela ka mathe taba ya ho se bue nnete ke ba bang ba boraditaba ka se hlokahalang mabapi le ho romelwa ha thepa ya dihlahiswa tsa temo dinaheng tsa kantle, e leng se bakang qhwebeshano pakeng tsa merabe setjhabeng sa rona.

src: The partnership aims, amongst others, to facilitate the use of digital tools to enhance tourism experiences and sustainability, including the commitment that Google Maps will use technology to avoid crime hotspots.
tgt: Kabinete e fetisetsa diteboho tsa yona ho lekala la tsa temo, haholoholo ba Mokgatlo wa Tlhahiso ya Veine le Mokgatlo wa Dikgwebo tsa Temo, o tsebisahalang ka Agbiz, ka ho se dumelle diteko tsena tse neng di batla ho tlisa pherekano ya semorabe lekaleng lena ka hore ba phakise ba hlakise ntlhakemo ya bona menyenyetsing ena eo e neng e se ya nnete.

src: National Anti-Corruption Advisory Council’s (NACAC) National Dialogue Cabinet welcomed the successful hosting of the NACAC’s National Dialogue, which deliberated on progress in implementing the National Anti-Corruption Strategy and recommendations of the Judicial Commission of Inquiry into Allegations of State Capture.
tgt: Twantsho ya Bonokwane le Bobodu Leano la Kopanelo la Twantsho ya Bonokwane Kabinete e thabetse ho romelwa ha sehlopha sa Sesole sa Naha (SANDF) sa ditho tse 3 300 ho tloha ka la 28 Mphalane 2023 ho fihlela ka la 28 Mmesa 2024, ho thusa Sepolesa sa Afrika Borwa (SAPS) le makala a mang a qobellang molao ho lwantsha diketso tsa ho rafa ho seng molaong naheng ena.

src: The progress includes eight (8) out of 16 recommended pieces of legislative reforms to address specific recommendations of the State Capture Commission that are now before Parliament.
tgt: Ho romelwa hona ha sesole, ke sesupo sa boinehelo ba mmuso ba ho fedisa diketso tsa ho rafa ho seng molaong ha mmoho le ho tlisa diphetoho kgolong ya moruo o kenyeletsang bohle.

src: These Bills cover areas such as public procurement, administrative reform, conduct of public servants, reform of intelligence services, money laundering and electoral reform.
tgt: Letona la Toka le le shebaneng le Twantsho ya Bonokwane ba fane ka kgatelopele e seng e fihletswe mosebetsing ona wa ho lwantsha bonokwane bona, mme Letona la Sepolesa lona bekeng e fetileng le fane ka dipalopalo tsa diketso tsa bonokwane tsa kotara e fetileng.

src: The Asset Forfeiture Unit has been granted freezing orders worth R14 billion for state capture related cases and has recouped R.4 billion of the ill-gotten gains.
tgt: Dipuisano tsa Naha tsa Moifo wa Dikeletso mabapi le Twantsho ya Bonokwane (NACAC) Kabinete e thabetse ho tshwarwa ka katleho ha Seboka sa Naha sa NACAC moo ho sona ho ileng ha buisanwa ka kgatelo pele e seng e fihletswe ho kengweng tshebetsong ha Leano la Naha la Twantsho ya Bonokwane ho latela dikgothaletso tsa Komeshene ya menyenyetsi ya ho Hulwa ha Mmuso ka Nko.

src: In addition, the Investigating Directorate has taken 34 state capture and corruption cases to court, involving 205 accused persons.
tgt: Kgatelopele e seng e fihletswe e kenyeletsa ho ntlafatswa ha melao e robedi (8) ho e 16 ka sepheo sa ho kenya tshebetsong dikgothaletso tsa Komeshene ena mme melao ena kaofela e ka pela Palamente ka ona motsotso.

src: Cabinet wishes to remind members of the community about government support programmes such as the Child Support Grant which is aimed at assisting families to meet the basic needs of children.
tgt: Kabinete e etsa kgoeletso setjhabeng ho sebedisana le mmuso ho lwantsha sekgobo sena, le ho thusa mekgatlo e qobellang molao ho tshwara babelaellwa ba diketso tsena.

src: This is in addition to the comprehensive Social Assistance Programme through which government provides healthy meals to vulnerable households through the National School Nutrition Programme and Community Nutrition and development centres.
tgt: Ho Shwa ha Bana ka Lebaka la ho se je ka Nepo Kabinete e mametse ka tse lethwethwe tlaleho ya Komeshene ya Afrika Borwa ya Ditokelo tsa Botho ya ho shwa ha bana ka lebaka la ho se je ka nepo.

src: Voter Registration Cabinet reiterated its call to all eligible voters to register to vote at their nearest voting station, including to update their details during the Voter Registration Weekend of 18 to 19 November 2023.
tgt: Kabinete e hopotsa setjhaba ho sebedisa mananeo a mmuso a kang Tjhelete ya Pei ya Bana eo ka yona ho ikemiseditsweng ho thusa malapa ka ditlhoko tsa sethatho tsa bana.

src: To assist voters who need to collect IDs they have applied for or to apply for Temporary Identification certificates, the Department of Home Affairs had aligned its operating hours with those of the IEC during the voter registration weekend.
tgt: Lena ke le leng la mananeo a tlatsetso ho a kang la Phepo ya Bana Dikolong le Dibakeng tsa Ntshetsopele ya Setjhaba.

src: Cabinet has reminded Citizens can also use the online voter registration facility (WEBTOKEN) which has been operating since February 2023, to register or update their details.
tgt: Ho Ingodisetsa Dikgetho Kabinete e rata ho hopotsa bohle ba nang le tokelo ya ho kgetha ho ingodisetsa dikgetho kapa ho lekola dintlha tsa bona ditsing tse haufi le bona Mafelong a Boingodiso ba Dikgetho, e leng la la 18 le la la 19 Pudungwana 2023.

src: Water Security Cabinet is pleased with reports that the disputes that resulted in delays towards implementation of the Mzimvubu Dam project have been resolved and site establishment commenced in early November, whilst consultations with traditional leaders on social issues is underway.
tgt: Kabinete e hopotsa setjhaba hore se ka nna sa ingodisa kapa sa lekola dintlha tsa sona ka mokgwa wa inthanete kgokelong ya (WEBTOKEN) eo e sa leng e sebetsa ho tloha ka Hlakola 2023.

src: Cabinet was updated that the raising of the Clanwilliam Dam wall to increase storage capacity to 344 million cubic metres for the benefit of the people of the West Coast District Municipality, Cederberg Local Municipality and Matzikama Local Municipality is underway.
tgt: Ntlafatso ya Meralo ya Motheo Motlakase Letona le shebaneng le motlakase Ofising ya Mopresidente le fane ka kgatelopele mabapi le ntlafatso ya phepelo ya motlakase.

src: Cabinet was briefed that the construction of the Tzaneen Dam re- commenced in June 2023, with the estimated completion date of April 2025.
tgt: Paballo ya Metsi Kabinete e thabetse tlaleho ya hore qabang e neng e le teng e bakileng tiehiso ho thakgolweng ha projeke ya Letamo la Mzimvubu e se e rarolotswe mme mosebetsi o qadile mathwasong a Pudungwana.

src: Cabinet was apprised that a joint team of the three metropolitan municipalities (Ekurhuleni, Joburg and Tshwane) and Rand Water continue to meet daily to address root causes of water challenges.
tgt: Setjhaba se tla una molemo mosebetsing ona ke sa Mmasepala wa Setereke sa West Coast, wa Lehae wa Cederberg, le wa Matzikama.

src: At the centre of Gauteng’s water challenges is water losses caused by old municipal infrastructure and deficiencies in water leakage monitoring and efficient repairs.
tgt: Kabinete e boetse ya hlajwa malotsana ka taba ya hore mosebetsi wa kaho ya Letamo la Tzaneen o boetse wa qala ka Phuptjane 2023 mme ho hakangwa ha o tla fela ka Mmesa 2025.

src: SA Connect Phase Two Cabinet received and considered an update report on the implementation of the SA Connect Phase 2 Project.
tgt: Kabinete e thabisitswe ke mosebetsi wa kopanelo wa bommasepala ba baholo ba bararo, (e leng wa Ekurhuleni, Joburg le wa Tshwane) le ba ha Rand Water wa ho kopana kamehla ho leka ho rarolla sesosa sa mathata a metsi.

src: SA Connect is a flagship programme of government that seeks to bridge the digital divide by connecting households and government institutions and provide Wi-Fi access to communities across the country.
tgt: Sesosa se seholo sa mathata a metsi Gauteng ke meralo ya motheo e seng e tsofetse le ho se lokiswe ha dipeipi tse dutlang.

src: On progress with Phase 2 of the project, Cabinet was pleased that 1 000 households were connected with broadband and that 1 000 community Wi-Fi hotspots are planned to be installed by December 2023.
tgt: Mokgahlelo wa Bobedi wa SA Connect Kabinete e fumane tlaleho ka ho kengwa tshebetsong ha Mokgahlelo wa Bobedi wa SA Connect.

src: In addition, the project has rolled out infrastructure for Internet connectivity that allows households to access the Internet at cheaper rates.
tgt: SA Connect ke lenaneo la mmuso la ho tlisa ditshebeletso tsa dijithale setjhabeng ka ho netefatsa hore setjhaba ka bophara ho phatlalla le naha ha mmoho le ditsi tsa mmuso di fumana kgokahano ya Wi-Fi.

src: For R249 per month, a subscribing household has unlimited access to robust internet, with cheaper data costs as low as R5 for one gig per day.
tgt: Kabinete e motlotlo ka ditaba tsa hore Mokgahlelo ona wa Bobedi o se o entse hore malapa a ka bang 1 000 e be a se a hokantswe ho Wi-Fi ka mokgwa wa broadband, mme pele Tshitwe e fela ho tla be ho na le dibaka tsa kgokahanyo ya Wi-Fi tse ka bang 1 000 setjhabeng.

src: It is estimated that the project will also contribute to economic participation through the provision of 4 505 semi-skilled and 169 skilled employment opportunities, and will support over 75 small to medium-sized companies.
tgt: Ho feta moo, projeke ena e se e kentse meralo ya motheo e tla thusa malapa ho kgona ho kena ho inthanete ka ditefello tse tlase.

src: In addition, high demand spectrum will be provided to more than 18 000 schools, 943 libraries, 5 731 health facilities and 8 241 tribal authorities over the next months through the social obligations to telecommunications companies.
tgt: Malapa a ka ingodisetsa kgokahanyo e se nang moedi ya ditefello tsa R249 kapa ho reka data ka lenane la R5 gig e le nngwe ya letsatsi.

src: It is anticipated that the project will deliver connectivity to more than five million households and 32 000 community Wi-Fi hotspots across the country over the next 36 months.
tgt: Ho hakangwa ha projeke ena e tla ba le kabelo moruong ka ho hlahisa mesebetsi e sa hlokeng kwetliso e kalo e ka bang 4 505 le e 169 e hlokang kwetliso mme hape e tla thusa le dikgwebo tse nyane le tse bohareng tse ballwang ho Ditsi tsa setjhaba di tla fumana kgokelo e matla ya Inthanete.

src: Cabinet was briefed that the Minister of Communications and Digital Technologies had determined December 2024 as the final date for the switch-off of all analogue broadcasting services, and that progress is on to meet the set target date.
tgt: Maqhubu a Kgaso a Dijithale Kabinete e thabetse kgatelopele e seng e fihletswe mosebetsing wa ho fetolela maqubu a kgaso ho tloha ho analoku ho tla ho dijithale.

src: Municipal Cleaning and Greening Programme Cabinet encourages South Africans to join the programme to keep our country clean and free from litter by participating in the municipal cleaning and greening initiatives taking place across the country.
tgt: Ho tloha ka la 23 Phupu 2023, ditsi tse 123 tsa kgaso ya analoku tsa megahertz tse ka hodimo ho 694 di ile tsa tingwa diprofensing tse nne tse neng di setse e leng ya Kapa Botjhabela, KwaZulu-Natal, Kapa Bophirima le Gauteng.

src: Capacity of the State Improved National and Provincial Audit Outcomes (2022/23 financial year) Cabinet was briefed by the Auditor-General of South Africa (AGSA) non the outcomes of the 2022/23 financial year national and provincial audits.
tgt: Kabinete e ile ya fumana tlaleho ho tswa ho Letona la Kgokahanyo, Dijithale le Thekenoloji hore Tshitwe 2024 e tla ba nako ya ho qetela ya ho tima ka ho phethahala kgaso ya analoku.

src: The AGSA pointed out to encouraging trend of continuous improved performance which indicates overall improvement in accountability, transparency, adequacy and effectiveness of controls.
tgt: Lenaneo la Bommasepala la ho Hlwekisa Tikoloho Kabinete e kgothaletsa Maafrika Borwa ho kena letsholong la ho hlwekisa naha ya habo rona ka ho nka karolo letsholong la bommasepala le tswellang pele naheng ka bophara.

src: The departments and institutions that have achieved unqualified audits with no findings (clean audits) have increased from 94 during the 2018/2019 to 147 during the 2022/2023, reporting a year-on-year improvement.
tgt: Lenaneo lena le seng le thehile mesebetsi e fetang e 37 000, ka lona ho ikemiseditswe ho fedisa dibaka tse seng molaong tsa ho lahlela matlakala tse fetang tse 7 251 naheng ka bophara.

src: The institutions and departments with Disclaimed findings have decreased from 25 during 2018/2019 reporting period to 5 during 2022/2023 reporting period and represent only 1% of audited institutions.
tgt: Bokgoni a Mmuso Ho Ntlafala ha Sephetho sa Tekolo ya Dibuka tsa Ditjhelete tsa Mafapha a Naha le a Diprofensi (Selemo sa Ditjhelete sa 2022/23) Kabinete e ile ya fumana tlaleho ya Mohlahlobi e Moholo wa Dibuka tsa Ditjhelete wa Naha (AGSA) ya sephetho sa selemo sa ditjhelete sa 2022/23 sa mafapha a naha le a diprofensi.

src: Although the Auditor-General reports an estimated R14 billion in financial losses, measures to address material irregularities also show an improvement.
tgt: AGSA o ile a rotloetsa mafapha ho tswelapele le mosebetsi o motle wa tshebediso e nepahetseng ya ditjhelete e bontshang boikarabelo le taolo e nepahetseng.

src: Although challenges still remain, the outcomes of the 2022/23 national and provincial governments audits dispel claims that State capacity is in total collapse, with independent and objective assessment by institutions such as the AGSA indicating a very strong and continuous improvement trajectory.
tgt: Palo ya mafapha le mekgatlo tse nang le sephetho se sebe sa tshebediso ya ditjhelete di eketsehile ho tloha ho 94 ka selemo sa 2018/2019 ho ya ho 147 ka selemo sa 2022/2023.

src: President Ramaphosa and the Amir agreed to set up working teams that will look into increasing Qatar’s investment into South Africa to match the depth of the diplomatic relations.
tgt: Dikamano tsa Matjhabeng – Ketelo ya Semmuso Qatar Bekeng e fetileng, Mopresidente Cyril Ramaphosa o ile a etela naheng ya Qatar ho latela memo ya semmuso ke hlooho ya naha eo, Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, Amir.

src: Cabinet continues to be concerned by the atrocities of the Israeli Government against the people of Palestine, including the deliberate attacks on the United Nations (UN) School in Gaza and the massacre of hundreds of children who had sought refuge at the school, in addition to the continued attacks on hospital staff, patients and hospital infrastructure.
tgt: Tse Amang Dipolotiki Kabinete le yona e dumellana le kgoeletso ya baetapele ba dinaha tsa Afrika ba etsang kgoeletso ya ho fedisa ntwa e mane Gaza, nakong ya seboka sa African-Saudi se neng se le Riyadh se eteletswe pele ke Kgosana Mohammed Bin Salman.

src: It is because of these continued atrocities that are being committed with impunity by the Israeli Government with the support and protection of powerful countries, that on 17 November 2023, South Africa – together with the Comoros, Djibouti, Bolivia and Bangladesh – jointly referred the situation in Palestine and Israel to the International Criminal Court (ICC).
tgt: Seboka sena, se ile sa tshwela ka mathe taba ya ho bolawa ha setjhaba se se nang molato le ho tlola molao wa matjhaba ke mmuso wa Isiraele.

src: While the Palestinian Authority did ask the ICC to investigate crimes under the court’s jurisdiction in 2018, South Africa believes the current atrocities, particularly in Gaza, need renewed attention with the full backing of state parties.
tgt: Kabinete e ngongorehiswa ke tsela eo Isiraele e tshwereng batho ba Palestina ka yona, ho kenyeletsa le ho futuhela sekolo sa Matjhaba a Kopaneng (UN) se moo Gaza moo ho bolailweng bana ba balwang ka makgolo le baphaphathehi ba neng ba ipatile moo.

src: Our ambassador in the Hague delivered the referral in person, which asked the ICC to investigate the commission of war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide with a view to holding those most responsible accountable.
tgt: Sehloho se seng ke ho futuhela dipetlele le basebeletsi ba tsona.

src: Given that much of the global community is witnessing the commission of these crimes in real time, including statements of genocidal intent by many Israeli leaders, we expect that warrants of arrests for these leaders, including Prime Minister Netanyahu, will be issued shortly.
tgt: Ke ka lebaka la ketso tsena tse sehloho tse etswang ke mmuso wa Isiraele e tshehetswe ke dinaha tse ding tse matla tse entseng hore ka la 17 Pudungwana 2023, Afrika Borwa – ha mmoho le dinaha tse kang Comoros, Djibouti, Bolivia le Bangladesh – di tlalehe taba ena ya Palastina le Isiraele Lekgotleng la Dinyewe la Matjhaba (ICC).

src: We expect now that other state parties have also added their voices for an end to the impunity by Israel, and the significant levels of evidence available, that international warrants of arrest will be issued by the time the Conference of Parties meet in mid-December in New York.
tgt: Jwalo ka ha dinaha tsa matjhaba di iponela seo re buang ka sona, re tshepa hore mangolo a ho tshwara baetapele bana ba kenyeletsang Tonakgolo Netanyahu, a tla fumaneha hautshwanyane.

src: The Just Energy Transition Implementation Plan (JET-IP) Cabinet approved the JET-IP, which will guide South Africa’s transition to low carbon economy through the scaling up of renewable energy sources.
tgt: Afrika Borwa e tshehetsa maikemisetso a APRM a ho tshehetsa Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Afrika (AU) hobane o tshehetsa puso ya demokrasi le ho ntshetsa kontinente ena pele.

src: The JET-IP sets out a number of interventions South Africa needs and investments required for the country to transition to a low carbon and climate resilient economy in line with the National Determined Contributions presented to the UCabinet is of the view that the JET-IP demonstrates South Africa’s commitment to a just transition in line with the country’s energy needs.
tgt: Keteko ena ya dilemo tse 20 e tla kenyeletsa ho nka karolo ha dihlooho tsa ha jwale le tsa mehleng tsa dinaha le Komeshene ya ATshebediso ya ditjhelete tse Akhaontong ya Lekala le Hapang Thepa (CARA) tseo Beng ba di Fumaneng ka Bonokwane Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho sebediswa ha tjhelete e ho CARA ho lwantsha ho rafa ho seng molaong esitana le mefuta e meng ya bonokwane.

src: The JET-IP will be driven by a combination of reforms in the energy sector, including the Mpumalanga Just Transition, New Energy Vehicles and Green Hydrogen, among others.
tgt: Tjhelete ena e abetswe SAPS, SANDF, Lefapha la Ditaba tsa Lehae le Akgente e laolang Madiboho.

src: The plan further responds to South Africa’s commitments under the Paris Agreement and UN Framework Convention on Climate Change as well as the National Development Plan (NDP) commitments.
tgt: Ba ha SAPS ba tla sebedisetsa tjhelete ena ho reka dikoloi, dirwalankgwana, di-Nyala le ho jala mapolesa a fetang 4 000.

src: The JET-IP will enable South Africa to gradually meet its carbon emissions reduction commitments while at the same time, it will ensure inclusive economic growth, energy security and employment.
tgt: Ho rafa hona ho seng molaong le bonokwaneng bo bong bo hlophisitsweng bo lahlehisetsa Afrika Borwa ka dibilione tsa diranta jwalo ka selemo mme bo balehisa le boramatsete naheng ena.

src: Draft National Public Transport Subsidy Policy Cabinet approved the gazetting of the draft National Public Transport Subsidy Policy for public comments.
tgt: Ho Kengwa Tshebetsong ha Leano la Just Energy Transition (JET-IP) Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho kengwa tshebetsong ha JET-IP, e leng mokgwa o tla thusa Afrika Borwa ho fetohela tshebedisong ya mokgwa wa motlakase o sa silafatseng tlhaho.

src: The policy proposes that South Africa’s public transport funding should move from subsidising a particular mode of transport to a user-subsidy model.
tgt: JET-IP e tlile le mekgwa e fapafapaneng ya ho thusa ha mmoho le matsete a hlokwang ke naha ena ho ka fetohela mokgweng wa motlakase o sa silafatseng tlhaho le moruo o sa thefulweng ke maemo a lehodimo ho latela Leano le neng le tshetlehelwe UKabinete e bona hore JET-IP e bontsha boinehelo ba Afrika Borwa ho tlisa diphetoho ho latela ditlhoko tsa naha ena tsa motlakase.

src: Priority Six: Economic transformation and job creation Priority Seven: A better Africa and a better world.
tgt: Ditlaleho tsena ke karolo ya bohlokwa ya dintho tse pele tse tla thusa mmuso ho atlehisa leano la ona la NDDitlaleho tsena di tlo tsepamisa maikutlo dinthong tse supileng tsa bohlokwa tse neng di hlwawe ke Kabinete ya botshelela, e leng: Ya Pele: Ho aha mmuso o nang le bokgoni, o tshepahetseng le o tswellang pele Ya Bobedi: Thuto, bokgoni le bophelo bo botle Ya Boraro: Tshebediso e ntle ya tjhelete ya setjhaba ka ho tlisetsa setjhaba ditshebeletso tsa sethatho le tsa boleng Ya Bone: Ho dudiswa ha batho ho kopanetsweng, ha mmoho le bommasepala Ya Bohlano: Tshebedisano ya setjhaba

src: The Minister in The Presidency responsible for Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation will lead detailed briefings with the clusters on the Programme of Action.
tgt: Letona le shebaneng le Meralo, ho Behwa Leihlo ha mmoho le ho Lekolwa ha maano le tla fana ka dintlha tse feletseng hore dintho di tla tsamaya ka mokgwa o fe.

src: BILLS South African National Petroleum Company (SANPC) Bill Cabinet approved the publication of the SANPC Bill for public comments.
tgt: Tshisinyo ya melao Tshisinyo ya Molao Taolo ya Dikhamphane tse Hlahisang Mafura a Dikoloi (SANPC) Kabinete e tjhaetse monwana ho phatlalatswa ha Tshisinyo ya Molao wa SANPC bakeng sa maikutlo a setjhaba.

src: The Bill gives effect to the Cabinet decision to merge PetroSA, South African Gas Development Company (iGas) and the Strategic Fuel Fund.
tgt: Tshisinyo ena ya molao, e tlo kenya tshebetsong qeto ya Kabinete ya ho kopanya khamphane tse pedi tsa mmuso e leng PetroSA, Khamphane ya Mmuso e Hlahisang Kgase (iGas) le letlole la Strategic Fuel Fund.

src: The Bill makes provisions for the establishment of a state-owned company that will ensure South Africa participates meaningfully in oil and gas development.
tgt: Tshisinyo ena e tla thusa mmuso ho theha khamphane e tla netefatsa hore Afrika Borwa e kgona ho ba le kabelo e kgolo tlhahisong ya oli le kgase.

src: It will also guarantee the country’s security of energy supply to support economic development and growth.
tgt: E tla boela e thusa ho tlisa botsiso phepelong ya motlakase, e tshehetse le kgolo ya moruo.

src: The SANPC will oversee strategic planning, coordination and governance of the country’s petroleum resources, and this will contribute to development and job creation.
tgt: SANPC e tla shebana le ho ralwa ha maano a mmuso, kgokahano ya ona le hona ho laolwa ha dihlahiswa tsa oli, e leng se tla thusa le ho theha menyetla ya mesebetsi.

src: Appointments All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant clearance.
tgt: Kgiro Pele batho bohle ba hirwa, ho hlahlobisiswa mangolo a bona a thuto le a mang a hlokahalang.

src: Reappointment of Dr Molefi Motuku as Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Council for Mineral Technology (MINTEK) (reappointment) Appointment of Mr Siyabulela Koyo as CEO of Amatola Water Re-appointment of Ms Poppy Khoza as Managing Director of the South African Civil Aviation Authority (renewal of employment contract) Members of the Phongolo – Umzimkhulu Catchment Management Agency Board.
tgt: Ho hirwa ha Ngaka Molefi Motuku Motsamaise e Moholo (CEO) wa Moifo wa Thekenoloji ya Dimenerale (MINTEK) (o kgethilwe hape) Ho hirwa ha Ntate Siyabulela Koyo ho ba Motsamaise e Moholo (CEO) wa Amatola Water Ho kgethwa hape ha Mme Poppy Khoza ho ba Molaodi e Moholo wa Lekala la Bofofisi la Afrika Borwa (ho tsoseleditswe konteraka ya kgiro) Ditho tsa Boto ya Taolo ya Akgente ya Phongolo – Umzimkhulu Catchment.

tgt: Ngaka Thava Kelly (Modulasetulo)

tgt: Ntate Sibusiso Makhanya (Motlatsa Modulasetulo)

tgt: Moprofesara Purshottama Reddy

tgt: Mme Tsakane Zwane (Motlatsa Modulasetulo)

tgt: Mme Doris Liana Theresia Dondur

src: Upcoming events 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children (25 November to 10 December) This year marks the 25th Anniversary since South Africa initiated the 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children campaign.
tgt: Seboka sena, se tla tshwarwa ka la 27 le la 28 Pudungwana 2023 mane Tshwane tlasa lepetjo le reng: “Matsapa a ho Phethahatsa Boinehelo ba Tumellano ya Mokgatlo wa Dinaha tsa Afrika wa ho Fedisa Tlhekefetso ya Basadi le Banana.”

src: South Africa and the Union of Comoros will co-host the 3rd AU Men’s Conference on Positive Masculinity in Leadership to End Violence against Women and Girls on 27 and 28 November 2023 in Pretoria under the theme: “Consolidating Commitments Towards the African Union Convention on Ending Violence Against Women and Girls.”
tgt: Kabinete e lebisa ditebo le ditakaletso tse ntle ho: Moprofesara Dire Tladi, ya neng a sebetsa Yunivesithing ya Pretoria, ya kgethetsweng ho ba moahlodi wa Lekgotla la Matjhaba la Toka la UMoprofesara Tladi ke serutehi se hlomphehang, mme ke Moafrika Borwa wa pele ho kgethelwa lekgotleng lena haesale le thehwa dilemong tse 78 tse fetileng.

src: ProfTladi is a highly respected scholar, a skilled diplomat and is the first South African ever to be elected to the Court in its 78 year history, the second judge from the Southern African region and the second youngest judge ever to be selected to the court.
tgt: O boetse hape ke moahlodi wa bobedi wa lekgotla lena ho tswa ho Afrika e ka Borwa, e bile e le moahlodi e monyane ho ba feta lekgotleng lena.

src: The AGSA for being appointed the external auditor of the UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization .
tgt: AGSA ho kgethelwa ho ba mohlahlobi wa dibuka ya ikemetseng wa Mokgatlo wa Thuto, Saense le Setso ho USena se bontsha hore mekgatlo ya Afrika Borwa e maemong a matjhaba.

src: Previously, the AGSA was an external auditor of the UN, more than 10 years ago.
tgt: AGSA e kile ya eba mohlahlobi ya ikemetseng wa UN dilemong tse fetang tse leshome tse fetileng.

src: Mamelodi Sundowns for flying the flag high and making history by winning the Inaugural African Football League.
tgt: Mamelodi Sundowns ka ho etsa nahane ya ho hapa Liki ya Pele ya Dihlopha tsa Afrika.

src: This triumph is another example of the unifying power of sport, which continues to foster nation-building and social cohesion.
tgt: Sena se bontsha tsela eo dipapadi di nang le tshusumetso ka teng esitana le hona ho kopanya setjhaba.

src: Mamelodi Sundowns Ladies for becoming the CAF Women’s Champions League Final by beating Sporting Club Casablanca.
tgt: Mamelodi Sundowns Ladies ka ho ba bomampodi ba Liki ya CAF ya Basadi, ba hlola Sporting Club Casablanca.

src: The Proteas for demonstrating resilience and fighting spirit in their defeat against Australia in the Cricket World Cup semi-finals and congratulate Australia for winning the ICC 2023 World Cup.
tgt: Proteas ka ho finyella ho sekamakgaolakgang ho Mohope wa Lefatshe wa Kirikete moo ba neng ba hlolwe ke Australia, mme re lebohele le yona Australia ka ho hapa Mohope oo wa Lefatse wa ICC wa 2023.

src: Legendary actor and playwright Dr John Kani, who has been awarded an honorary Officer of the Most Excellent Order of the British Empire (OBE) in recognition for his services to drama.
